delta.zh: 泥沙把这条河的三角洲淤塞了。

delta.en: The delta region of the Rio Grande river was a forsaken land of thickets and swamps.
delta.zh: 格兰德河的三角洲地区是块布满了灌木丛及沼泽地的被遗忘之地。

delta.en: The Nile divides at its mouth and forms a delta.
delta.zh: 尼罗河在河口分岔， 形成了一个三角洲。

hemisphere.en: They say God spoke to them and told them to go on a mission to the poorest country in the Western Hemisphere.
hemisphere.zh: 他们说上帝向他们开口讲话，告诉他们到西半球最贫穷的国家继续进行传教活动。

hemisphere.en: Of course, were they the first people in the Western hemisphere?
hemisphere.zh: 当然，他们是西半球的第一批人吗？

hemisphere.en: It is further divided into four regions, or lobes, in each hemisphere.
hemisphere.zh: 每个半球又进一步分化为四个区域或叶。

globe.en: Dr. Russel is creating an elite herd by cross-breeding goats from around the globe.
globe.zh: 罗素博士正在通过使来自世界各地的山羊杂交而创造一种精品羊群。

globe.en: He still wheels and deals around the globe.
globe.zh: 他仍在世界各地钻营谋取。

globe.en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
globe.zh: 顶灯现在被一个白色的球状物罩了起来。

plateau.en: We took a plane southwest across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
plateau.zh: 我们乘飞机朝西南方,越过安纳托利亚高原,飞往卡帕多细亚。

plateau.en: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
plateau.zh: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

plateau.en: The Qinghai-Xizang Plateau has long been known as the roof of the world.
plateau.zh: 青藏高原素有世界屋脊之称。

plain.en: A plain necklace was her only adornment.
plain.zh: 她身上的饰物就只有一串简单的项链。

Antarctic.en: The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever.
Antarctic.zh: 南极周围的原始水域将永远消失。

Antarctic.en: The findings come amid growing concern over the future of the Antarctic.
Antarctic.zh: 这些发现成果的出现正值人们对南极洲的未来日益担忧之际。

Antarctic.en: With Russia's help, Belarus is preparing to build its first Antarctic base.
Antarctic.zh: 在俄罗斯的帮助下，白俄罗斯正准备建立第一个南极基地。

polar.en: The polar vortex is a system of wintertime winds.
polar.zh: 极地涡旋是冬季风形成的一个风系。

polar.en: There was a period of excessive warmth which melted some of the polar ice.
polar.zh: 有段时期温度过高，融化了极地的部分冰层。

pole.en: The truck crashed into a telegraph pole.
Five members of Scott's expedition made it to the South Pole.
pole.zh: 斯科特率领的探险队的五名成员一直来到了南极。

pole.en: When Scott reached the South Pole he found that Amundsen had anticipated him.
pole.zh: 斯科特到达南极时发现阿蒙森已先到过那里。

axis.zh: 地球环绕自身的轴心转动。

axis.en: Precession, basically is the change in the direction of earth's axis of rotation.
axis.zh: 岁差，基本上是地球自转轴方向的改变。

aggravate.en: If the reports are well-founded, the incident could seriously aggravate relations between the two nations.
aggravate.zh: 如果这些报道是有根据的，那么该事件将可能导致两国间的关系严重恶化。

aggravate.en: Stress and lack of sleep can aggravate the situation.
aggravate.zh: 紧张和缺少睡眠会使情况恶化。

deteriorate.en: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war.
deteriorate.zh: 人们担心局势会恶化为全面战争。

deteriorate.en: Food is apt to deteriorate in summer.
The chemicals on shoes can deteriorate air quality.
deteriorate.zh: 鞋子上的化学物质会恶化空气质量。

degrade.en: Jays prefer crickets, but crickets degrade more quickly.
degrade.zh: 松鸡喜欢蟋蟀，但蟋蟀退化得更快。

degrade.en: Certain irrigation practices degrade soil quality and reduce agricultural productivity.
degrade.zh: 某些灌溉措施会降低土壤质量，降低农业生产力。

degrade.en: The main reason was that steel cables degrade very, very quickly in contact with saltwater.
degrade.zh: 主要原因是钢索与盐水接触后降解非常快。

upgrade.en: How do we know when to invest in an upgrade?
upgrade.zh: 我们如何知道何时投资升级？
人们应该定期升级他们的设备。

upgrade.en: Maybe there's no need for an upgrade and that's OK.
upgrade.zh: 也许不需要提升也没关系。

erode.en: Then over many more years, the Phosphorus-rich rocks of the new land begin to erode and the cycle continues.
erode.zh: 然后过了许多年，含磷丰富的新陆地岩石开始被侵蚀，而且循环还在继续。

erode.en: The central state, though often very rich and very populous, was intrinsically fragile, since the development of new international trade routes could undermine the monetary base and erode state power.
erode.zh: 尽管中央帝国通常非常富有和人口稠密，它本质上是很脆弱的，因为新的国际贸易路线的发展可能会破坏货币基础和侵蚀国家权力。

erode.en: The rain will erode the deeds of his life.
erode.zh: 雨水将慢慢地腐蚀掉他的生命契约。

Mediterranean.en: Barcelona has become one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.
Mediterranean.zh: 巴塞罗那已经成为地中海地区最具活力、最为繁荣的城市之一。

Mediterranean.en: Chef Idris Caldora offers an inspired menu that captures the spirit of the Mediterranean.
Mediterranean.zh: 伊德里斯·卡尔多拉厨师的菜单很有创意，充分体现了地中海风情。

Mediterranean.en: You have the choice of night fishing in the Mediterranean, or windsurfing on a lake in Switzerland.
Mediterranean.zh: 你可选择在地中海夜间垂钓，或是在瑞士的湖上玩帆板。

marine.en: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.
marine.zh: 贝赞尼克正在潜水采集海洋生物。

marine.en: Marine mammals generally swim with the current.
marine.zh: 海洋哺乳动物一般顺水而游。

marine.en: Marine life was discovered at depths previously thought to be azoic.
marine.zh: 在先前被认为没有任何生命迹象的海洋深处发现了海洋生物。

pacific.zh: 安尼塔开车沿着太平洋公路向北行驶。

pacific.en: A chain of volcanoes girdles the Pacific.
pacific.zh: 环绕太平洋的是一连串的火山。

pacific.en: Palm trees stir in the soft Pacific breeze.
pacific.zh: 棕榈树在太平洋和煦的微风里轻轻摇动。

ocean.zh: 灰蒙蒙的大海在他们下面翻滚。

ocean.en: There was a vertical drop to the ocean.
ocean.zh: 至海洋有一段垂直落差。

ocean.en: Every room has a window facing the ocean.
ocean.zh: 每个房间都有一扇面对大海的窗。

navigation.en: They will be helped by the very latest in navigation aids.
navigation.zh: 他们将得到最新的导航设备的帮助。

navigation.en: Pack ice around Iceland was becoming a threat to navigation.
navigation.zh: 冰岛周围的浮冰一度成为船舶航行的威胁。

navigation.en: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
navigation.zh: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

gulf.en: A crisis was rapidly developing in the Gulf.
The tremor was centred in the Gulf of Sirte.
gulf.zh: 地震以苏尔特湾为中心。

gulf.en: The low, marshy land runs out for miles toward the gulf.
gulf.zh: 这片低洼的沼泽地沿海湾方向延伸数英里。

beach.zh: 我们骑着马沿海滩慢跑。
这个海滩是孩子的理想去处。

coast.zh: 那是一段美丽的海岸线。

brook.en: The Bow Brook forms the western boundary of the wood.
brook.zh: 鲍溪成了树林的西边界。

brook.en: Brother, I pray you, do not drink of this brook; you will be changed into a wolf, and devour me.
brook.zh: 哥哥，我求求你，不要喝这个小溪的水；你会变成一头狼，然后把我吞掉。

current.en: The canoe found the current and swung around.
current.zh: 独木舟遇上了急流，打着转。

current.en: What is the current thinking on this question?
current.zh: 目前对这个问题的看法是什么？

tide.en: Is the tide coming in or going out?
Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.
tide.zh: 在低潮时数英里的沙滩就会显现出来。

tide.en: We set sail (for France) at high tide.
tide.zh: 我们在涨潮时起航（前往法国）。

source.en: What is their main source of income?
source.zh: 他们的主要收入来源是什么？

source.en: Success in sport is a source of national pride.
source.zh: 体育成就是民族光荣的源泉。

source.en: Plants are the ultimate source of all foodstuffs.
source.zh: 植物是所有食物的最终来源。

stream.en: The valley is watered by a stream.
stream.zh: 这山谷有一条小溪流过。

shallow.zh: 他是个浅薄、不友好的人。

shallow.en: They waded the river at a shallow point.
I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
shallow.zh: 我认为他浅薄、虚荣、不可信。

superficial.en: The other injured man had a superficial stomach wound.
superficial.zh: 另一名受伤男子是腹部表层受伤。

superficial.en: The book shows only a superficial understanding of the historical context.
superficial.zh: 这部书表现出对历史背景肤浅的理解。

sandy.en: He checked the sandy areas of the arroyo for any tracks.
sandy.zh: 他检查了旱谷沙地的所有痕迹。

sandy.en: Sandy leaned across the table, his face uncomfortably close to Brad's.
sandy.zh: 桑迪将身体探过桌子，他的脸贴近布拉德的脸，使布拉德感觉很不自在。

stony.en: I mean, it's easier to find an iron meteorite or a stony iron.
stony.zh: 我的意思是，找到铁陨石或石质铁会更容易。

stony.en: They listened to him in stony silence.
stony.zh: 他们冷漠地静静听他讲。

stony.en: The steep, stony ground is well drained.
stony.zh: 多石陡峭的地面很容易排水。

vertical.en: There was a vertical drop to the ocean.
vertical.zh: 至海洋有一段垂直落差。

vertical.en: The climber inched up a vertical wall of rock.
vertical.zh: 那名登山者一点点爬上了一处垂直的岩石峭壁。

vertical.en: For some buildings a vertical section is more informative than a plan.
vertical.zh: 对一些建筑物来说，垂直剖面图比平面图提供的信息更多。

smooth.zh: 这种金属摸上去光滑而冰冷。

steep.en: The path led up a steep hill.
steep.zh: 小路通向一座陡峭的山丘。
他们爬上了一个陡峭的堤岸。
我们把车开上了陡峭的峡谷。

rough.zh: 凯茜作了一个粗略的计算。
他们比赛总是这么粗野吗？

flat.zh: 这乡村一马平川，平淡无奇。

Oceania.zh: 他们把这条船命名为“大洋洲号”。

Oceania.en: Comparing stillbirth rates from 1995 to 2009, the least progress has been seen in sub-Saharan Africa and Oceania.
Oceania.zh: 比较了1995年至2009年的死产率之后发现，撒哈拉以南非洲和大洋洲的进展最慢。

Oceania.en: Future research will be required to determine if these findings hold true for other territories in Asia and Oceania with similar malaria epidemiology.
Oceania.zh: 还需做进一步研究以确定这些发现是否适用于有类似疟疾流行病的亚洲和大洋洲。

peninsula.en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
peninsula.zh: 那只船停泊在了离半岛北海岸不远处。

peninsula.en: Dalian is in the south of the Liaodong Peninsula.
peninsula.zh: 大连位于辽东半岛南部。

peninsula.en: The "Empty Quarter" is a huge area of sand that covers about a quarter of the Arabian Peninsula.
peninsula.zh: “空白之地”是一大片沙地，覆盖了四分之一的阿拉伯半岛。

mainland.en: Similar trends are observable in mainland Europe.
mainland.zh: 类似的趋势在欧洲大陆也能见到。

mainland.en: The island is joined to the mainland by a bridge.
mainland.zh: 这个岛有一座桥与大陆相连。

mainland.en: The Hebrides are to the west of the Scottish mainland.
mainland.zh: 赫布里底群岛位于苏格兰本土的西面。

climate.zh: 经济气候依然是不确定。

climate.en: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
climate.zh: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

climate.en: They wanted to move to a warmer climate.
climate.zh: 他们想迁移到气候较温暖的地区。

parallel.en: The road runs parallel to the river.
parallel.zh: 这条路和这条河是平行的。
这些平行线像是岔开了。

parallel.en: Remsen Street is parallel with Montague Street.
parallel.zh: 雷姆森大街与蒙塔古大街是平行的。

narrow.zh: 他拐进了一条狭窄的街道。
入口处是一道狭窄的拱门。
他们骑马走在狭窄的乡村小路上。

meteorology.en: Diels also hopes to see the birth of "interactive meteorology"—not just forecasting the weather but controlling it.
meteorology.zh: 迪尔斯还希望看到“互动气象学”的诞生——不仅仅是预测天气，而是控制它。

meteorology.en: They wouldn't even have been able to get started without earth science understanding—knowledge about wind, storms, meteorology.
meteorology.zh: 如果没有对地球科学的了解——关于风、风暴、气象学的知识，他们甚至不可能起步。

heating.en: The heating is on a time switch.
heating.zh: 暖气靠定时开关自动供热。
该供暖系统可自动关闭。

heating.en: I am thinking of installing central heating.
heating.zh: 我在考虑安装中央供暖系统。

moderate.en: He was an easygoing man of very moderate views.
moderate.zh: 他是一个有着温和观点性情随和的人。

moderate.en: The team enjoyed only moderate success last season.
moderate.zh: 上个赛季，这个队伍只取得了中等成绩。

moderate.en: Lasik is best for moderate, not severe, vision problems.
moderate.zh: 镭射视力矫正手术对中等而不严重的视力问题最有效。

mild.zh: 他是个温和有礼的男人。
咖啡和茶是轻度兴奋剂。

mild.en: She received a mild reproof from the teacher.
mild.zh: 她受到了老师温和的责备。

arid.en: Many Namibians are subsistence farmers who live in the arid borderlands.
arid.zh: 许多纳米比亚人都是自给自足的农民，居住在干旱的边境地区。

arid.en: Twenty million years ago, Idaho was not the arid place it is now. Rather, it was warm and damp, populated by dense primordial forest.
arid.zh: 2000万年前，爱达荷州不像现在这样干旱。确切地说，它那时温暖潮湿，生长着茂密的原始森林。

arid.en: Regularly flowing rivers and streams that originate within arid lands are known as "endogenous".
arid.zh: 起源于干旱地区的流动性河流和溪流通常被称为“内源河流”。

tropic.en: For centuries he braved arctic cold, tropic heat and inhuman privations to wrest gold from the earth.
tropic.zh: 几个世纪以来，他冒着北极的严寒、热带的酷暑和非人的贫困，从地球上攫取黄金。

tropic.en: According to scientific results, on Winter solstice, a right angle is formed by the sun and the tropic of carpricorn.
tropic.zh: 根据科学的结果，在冬至，太阳和南回归线形成了一个直角。
我们必须保护热带雨林。

thermal.en: He was found by a police helicopter using thermal imaging equipment.
thermal.zh: 他被一架警用直升飞机用热成像设备找到了。

thermal.en: Rescue teams are using thermal imaging to locate survivors of the earthquake.
thermal.zh: 救援队伍正利用热成像确定地震幸存者的位置。

thermal.en: For systems transforming solar to thermal energy, the thermal energy may be stored in matter as either latent heat or sensible heat.
thermal.zh: 对于将太阳能转化为热能的系统，热能可能以潜热或显热的形式存储在物质中。

moist.en: The outside air was heavy and moist and sultry.
moist.zh: 户外的空气阴沉、潮湿而闷热。

moist.en: The soil is reasonably moist after the September rain.
moist.zh: 9月的雨水之后，土壤适度湿润。

moist.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
moist.zh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

humid.en: It's hot out – very hot, very humid.
humid.zh: 外面热烘烘的–非常热，非常潮湿。

humid.en: The island is hot and humid in the summer.
humid.zh: 这个岛在夏季又热又潮湿。
这些植物喜欢温暖潮湿的空气。

snowy.zh: 我们大步流星地穿过雪封的旷野。

frost.zh: 霜在窗子上形成了图案。

frost.en: The car windows were covered with frost.

hail.zh: 我们顶着冰雹和大雪开车。

hail.en: Hail was hammering down onto the roof.
It started to hail, huge great stones.
hail.zh: 天空开始下冰雹，巨大的雹子。

shiver.zh: 剧烈的颤抖使他抽搐不已。

shiver.en: A chill shiver rippled over his skin.
shiver.zh: 一阵寒颤传遍了他全身。

shiver.en: A cold shiver ran down her spine.

tremble.en: I will never forget the look on the patient's face, the tremble in his hand.
tremble.zh: 我将永远不会忘记那病人脸上的表情和他颤抖的手。

tremble.en: He felt the earth tremble under him.
tremble.zh: 他感觉大地在脚下颤动。

tremble.en: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
tremble.zh: “请理解这个”，她开始用颤抖的声音说道。

frigid.en: A snowstorm hit the West today, bringing with it frigid temperatures.
frigid.zh: 一场暴风雪今天袭击西部地区，带来了严寒低温。

frigid.en: Less solar energy is lost in evaporation at the frigid poles than in the tropics.
frigid.zh: 与热带地区相比，在寒冷的两极蒸发中损失的太阳能更少。

frigid.en: There was a frigid atmosphere in the room.
frigid.zh: 房间里一片冷淡的气氛。

thaw.zh: 天气转暖，冰雪开始融化了。

thaw.en: We slogged through the mud of an early spring thaw.
thaw.zh: 我们在初春解冻期的泥泞里艰难跋涉。

thaw.en: It's so cold the snow doesn't get a chance to thaw.
thaw.zh: 天气太冷了，积雪都没机会融化。

freeze.zh: 你能不能把这个蛋糕冷藏起来？
有些水果比其他的适宜于冷藏。

freeze.en: The trees were damaged by a freeze in December.
freeze.zh: 那些树被12月的一次冰冻冻坏了。

chill.en: A chill shiver rippled over his skin.
chill.zh: 一阵寒颤传遍了他全身。

chill.en: His words sent a chill down her spine.
chill.zh: 他的话让她觉得毛骨悚然。

lightning.zh: 如今驾车需要飞快的反应。

lightning.en: Another flash of lightning lit up the cave.
lightning.zh: 又一道闪电照亮了那个洞穴。

stormy.en: I'm afraid you're running a risk setting sail in such stormy weather.
stormy.zh: 挑上这么个暴风雨的天气出航，你恐怕太冒险了吧！

stormy.en: Today's collection provides some amazing examples of stormy photography which can be very difficult to capture.
stormy.zh: 今日的合集提供了一些叹为观止的暴风雨摄影范例，这是非常难捕捉到。

stormy.en: The letter was read at a stormy meeting.
stormy.zh: 这封信是在一次群情激愤的会上读的。

downpour.en: A heavy downpour interrupted the football match.
downpour.zh: 一场骤雨中断了这场足球赛。

downpour.en: On this day, after a downpour, it smells musty.
downpour.zh: 那天，一场倾盆大雨过后，房子里有股霉味。

downpour.en: The downpour plastered his shirt to his body.
downpour.zh: 倾盆大雨把他的衬衫像贴膏药一样贴在他身上。

rainfall.en: There has been below average rainfall this month.
rainfall.zh: 这个月的降雨低于平均降雨量。

rainfall.en: There have been four years of below average rainfall.
rainfall.zh: 已经有4年降雨量低于平均水平了。

rainfall.en: Record levels of rainfall fell over the southeast of the country.
rainfall.zh: 该国东南部降下了最高纪录的雨量。

sprinkle.en: Sprinkle onion and cheese in the pie plate.
sprinkle.zh: 把洋葱和干酪撒在饼盘中。

sprinkle.en: You can sprinkle shallots and tomatoes on the surface as you like.
sprinkle.zh: 你可以随喜好在表面撒上青葱和番茄。

sprinkle.en: Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired and top with a thinly sliced apple.
sprinkle.zh: 如果需要的话，撒上肉桂，然后在上面放上切成薄片的苹果。

rainbow.en: The second rainbow will be bigger than the first, and directly above it.
rainbow.zh: 第二道彩虹将比第一道更大，并位于第一道的正上方。

rainbow.en: New Zealand's quarrel with France over the Rainbow Warrior incident was formally ended.
rainbow.zh: 新西兰和法国之间关于“彩虹勇士号”事件的争端已经正式了结。

Celsius.en: Night temperatures can drop below 15 degrees Celsius.
Celsius.zh: 夜间温度可能会降到15摄氏度以下。

Celsius.en: It will be a mild night, around nine degrees Celsius.
Celsius.zh: 晚间天气温和，温度约九摄氏度。

Celsius.en: The thermometer shows the temperature in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
Celsius.zh: 温度计显示摄氏温度和华氏温度。

shower.en: She heard him turn on the shower.
shower.zh: 她听见他拧开了淋浴器。
现在我们有一个功能正常的淋浴器。

peak.en: She's at the peak of her career.
Phone calls cost 20c per unit off-peak.
peak.zh: 非高峰时间电话费每单位两角。

mount.en: Mount Marcy is the highest mountain in the Adirondacks.
mount.zh: 马西山是阿迪朗达克山脉中最高的山。

mount.en: Mexico's Mount Colima began spewing lava and ash last night.
mount.zh: 墨西哥科利马山昨晚开始喷发熔岩和火山灰。

mountain.zh: 他用哑剧形式表示爬山。
我们骑着马走在山里的小路上。

ridge.en: The fawn ran to the top of the ridge.
He slowed the pace as they crested the ridge.
ridge.zh: 当他们到达山脊时，他放慢了步伐。

ridge.en: Rammick lives high on a ridge in a 400-home subdivision.
ridge.zh: 拉米克住在高高的山脊上一块有400户的住宅区。

hillside.en: The local rock is quarried from the hillside.
hillside.zh: 当地的石头都是从那片山坡开采的。

hillside.en: Olives look romantic on a hillside in Provence.
hillside.zh: 在普罗旺斯的一个山坡上橄榄树看起来很浪漫。

hillside.en: The hotel perched precariously on a steep hillside.
hillside.zh: 旅店立在陡峭的山坡上状似摇摇欲坠。

slope.en: The town is built on a slope.

slope.zh: 过了一英里后，山坡变陡了。

slope.en: The street must have been on a slope.
slope.zh: 那条街一定是一直在一个斜坡上。

valley.zh: 乳白色的薄雾弥漫了山谷。
我们把车开上了陡峭的峡谷。

range.en: The article covered a wide range of topics.
range.zh: 这篇文章讨论了一系列广泛的论题。

range.en: We stock a wide range of perfumes.
range.zh: 我们备有各种各样的香水。
它们的价格在$3到$15之间变化。

southern.zh: 他滑稽地模仿她的南方口音。

southern.en: She spoke in a slow southern drawl.
southern.zh: 她带着南方的拖腔慢条斯理地讲话。

southern.en: He had developed a slight southern accent.

overlook.en: Houses which overlook the lake cost more.
overlook.zh: 俯瞰湖泊的房子要价高些。

overlook.en: I pulled off the road at a scenic overlook.
overlook.zh: 在一个可以眺望优美风景的地方，我将车停在了路旁。

overlook.en: Pretty and comfortable rooms overlook a flower-filled garden.
overlook.zh: 那些漂亮、舒适的房间俯瞰着一个花团锦簇的花园。

oriental.en: There were Oriental carpets on the floors.
oriental.zh: 地板上铺着东方的地毯。

oriental.en: This design came to be known as the Oriental style.
oriental.zh: 这种设计后来被称为东方风格。

oriental.en: The floor was overlaid with rugs of oriental design.
oriental.zh: 地板上覆盖着东方图案的地毯。

irregularly.en: He was eating irregularly, steadily losing weight.
irregularly.zh: 他吃饭不规律，体重不断下降。

irregularly.en: Irregularly shaped brown or blue spots in the nail bed can be melanomas.
irregularly.zh: 甲床上不规则的棕色或蓝色点可能是黑索瘤。

irreversible.en: She could suffer irreversible brain damage if she is not treated within seven days.
irreversible.zh: 如果在7天内得不到治疗，她的大脑有可能会受到不可恢复的损害。

irreversible.en: She had been in what doctors described as an irreversible vegetative state for five years.
irreversible.zh: 她陷入医生们所说的一种不可逆转的植物人状态已达5年之久。

irreversible.en: Cambridge scientist Peter Wadhams, who's been measuring and monitoring the Arctic since 1971, says the decline is irreversible.
irreversible.zh: 剑桥科学家彼得·沃德姆斯自1971年以来一直在测量和监测北极，他说这种减少是不可逆转的。

eastern.en: The wild card in the picture is eastern Europe.
eastern.zh: 局势中的未知因素在东欧。

eastern.en: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
eastern.zh: 这种调味品会给菜肴添加一种东方风味。

eastern.en: There's no mistaking the eastern flavour of the food.
eastern.zh: 该食物的东方口味肯定不会错的。

inevitable.zh: 你得接受必然发生的事。
官僚主义所致的延误是不可避免的。

inevitable.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
inevitable.zh: 妥协是生活不可避免的一部分。

inappropriate.en: It is inappropriate simply to throw money at these problems.
inappropriate.zh: 只是用钱去处理这些问题是不适当的。

inappropriate.en: I feel the remark was inappropriate for such a serious issue.
inappropriate.zh: 我觉得对如此严肃的问题来说，这评论是不恰当的。

inappropriate.en: He chose a singularly inappropriate moment to make his request.
inappropriate.zh: 他选在一个极其不恰当的时刻提出要求。

sediment.en: Many organisms that die in the sea are soon buried by sediment.
sediment.zh: 许多在海里死亡的生物很快便被沉淀物掩埋。

sediment.en: They found a unique layer of sediment worldwide.
sediment.zh: 他们在世界各地发现了一层独特的沉积物。

sediment.en: Sediment sorting and compaction influence permeability and porosity.
sediment.zh: 沉积物的分选和压实作用影响渗透率和孔隙度。

silt.en: Silt and windblown soil buried the site even deeper.
silt.zh: 泥沙和风吹来的尘土把这个遗址埋得更深了。

silt.en: Loam is a soil with roughly equal proportions of clay, sand and silt.
silt.zh: 壤土是由大约等份的黏土、沙和粉砂合成的。

silt.en: The river deposited silt at its mouth.

abnormal.en: He concluded that Oswald was somewhat abnormal.
abnormal.zh: 他断定奥斯瓦德有点不正常。

abnormal.en: The abnormal bleeding is your body's own red flag of danger.
abnormal.zh: 这反常的流血是你身体本身的危险信号。

muddy.zh: 浑浊的水慢慢变得清澈起来。
我们扑哧扑哧地穿过泥泞的田地。

muddy.en: The car got stuck in the muddy ground.

clay.zh: 这些砖是用陶土制成的。

clay.en: She fashioned a pot from the clay.

dirt.en: I started to scrub off the dirt.
He brushed the dirt off his jacket.

rural.zh: 那是赏心悦目的乡村风光。

rural.en: He has a romantic view of rural society.
rural.zh: 他对于乡村地区有种不切实际的看法。

rural.en: Agriculture forms the backbone of the rural economy.
rural.zh: 农业是农村经济的基础。

suburb.en: They live in a wealthy suburb of Chicago.
suburb.zh: 他们住在芝加哥郊区的一处富人区。

suburb.en: Anna was born in 1923 in a suburb of Philadelphia.
suburb.zh: 安娜1923年出生在费城市郊。

suburb.en: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a Seattle suburb.
suburb.zh: 玛格丽特和她有病的妈妈住在西雅图郊区。

outskirts.en: They live on the outskirts of Milan.
As they approached the outskirts of the city, Ella's mood visibly lightened.
outskirts.zh: 随着他们越来越接近市郊，埃拉的心情明显变得轻松了。

outskirts.en: He did not take the direct route to his home, but made a detour around the outskirts of the city.
outskirts.zh: 他没有直接回家，而是在市郊绕了一段路。

desolate.en: Today it's pretty desolate, barren and extremely hot.
desolate.zh: 现今那里非常荒凉、土地贫瘠，而且极其炎热。

desolate.en: He lives in a great, big, desolate old house in the country and no one goes near him.
desolate.zh: 他住在乡下一幢又大又荒凉的的老房子里，没有人接近他。

desolate.en: When plants first made the transition ashore more than 400 million years ago, the land was barren and desolate, inhospitable to life.
desolate.zh: 4亿多年前，植物第一次向海岸上迁移时，陆地上荒凉而贫瘠，并非生命宜居之地。

remote.en: The monastery is in a remote mountain pass.
remote.zh: 那僧院在一个偏远的山坳通道处。

distant.zh: 他是我远房的一个表亲。

distant.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.

adjacent.zh: 这些飞机在毗连的跑道上降落。

adjacent.en: He sat in an adjacent room and waited.
adjacent.zh: 他坐在一间相邻的房间里等。

adjacent.en: The schools were adjacent but there were separate doors.
adjacent.zh: 这些学校相邻，但是有各自的门。

toxic.en: Too much toxic waste is being dumped at sea.
toxic.zh: 太多的有毒废料在向大海里倾倒。

toxic.en: Many toxic effects can be studied at the cellular level.
toxic.zh: 许多毒性作用在细胞阶段就可加以研究。

pollution.en: We need more laws to stop pollution.
pollution.zh: 我们需要制定更多法律来防止污染。

pollutant.en: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

pollutant.en: Nitrogen dioxide is a pollutant emitted by automobiles.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化氮是汽车排放的一种污染物。

pollutant.en: Sulfur dioxide, a major contributor to acid rain, is an especially serious pollutant because it diminishes the respiratory system's ability to deal with all other pollutants.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化硫是酸雨的主要成因之一，它是一种特别严重的污染物，因为它会降低呼吸系统处理其他污染物的能力。

contaminate.en: An urban food myth contends that if food spends just a few seconds on the floor, dirt and germs won't have much of a chance to contaminate it.
contaminate.zh: 一个有关食物的都市神话声称，如果食物只在地上停留几秒钟，灰尘和细菌就不太有可能污染它。
敌对关系损害我们的健康。

contaminate.en: Previously, MTBE (methyl tertiary-butyl ether) was the oxygenate of choice, but fell out of favour in 2004 when it was found to contaminate ground water.
contaminate.zh: 以前，MTBE（甲基叔丁基醚）曾作为汽油充氧剂，但是，在2004年，人们发现它污染了地下水，所以就不再使用它了。

geology.en: We went on a geology field trip.
geology.zh: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

geology.en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
geology.zh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

geology.en: At first he studied architecture, but later he switched to geology.
geology.zh: 起初他学建筑，但后来转到地质学。

border.zh: 约旦重新开放了与伊拉克的边界。

border.en: Guards have been posted along the border.
border.zh: 边界上已部署了边防岗哨。

fringe.en: My fringe was cut short, but the rest of my hair was long.
fringe.zh: 我的刘海剪得短,但其余的头发长。

fringe.en: The monarchists are a small fringe group who quarrel fiercely among themselves.
fringe.zh: 君主制拥护者们是个边缘性小团体，内部争吵激烈。

fringe.en: They are paid their salaries and are entitled to fringe benefits on a pro-rata basis.
fringe.zh: 他们领工资，同时还能按比例享受附加福利。

margin.en: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
margin.zh: 该集团去年的净利润空间为30%。

margin.en: She added her comments in the margin.
margin.zh: 她在页边空白处加上了她的评语。

plate.zh: 她往我的盘子里夹了很多食物。
她往我的盘子里夹了很多食物。

debris.en: Falling debris rained on us from above.
debris.zh: 碎片从上面像雨点儿一样落在我们身上。

debris.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
debris.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住一块块漂浮在水面上的残骸。

debris.en: The roof collapsed, showering us with dust and debris.
debris.zh: 屋顶塌了下来，灰尘、碎片纷纷落在我们身上。

gap.en: The product has filled a gap in the market.
gap.zh: 这个产品填补了市场的空白。

gap.en: By 1973, this gap had narrowed almost to vanishing point.
gap.zh: 到1973年，这一差距已缩小到几乎为零。

gap.en: The gap between the two teams has narrowed to three points.
gap.zh: 两队之间的差距缩小到三分了。

crack.en: Water seeped from a crack in the pipe.
crack.zh: 水从管道的一个裂缝中渗出。

crack.en: She peeped through the crack in the curtains.
crack.zh: 她透过窗帘的缝隙窥视。

splendid.en: He gave them a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.
splendid.zh: 他款待了他们一顿极好的熏三文鱼午餐。

splendid.en: The book includes a wealth of splendid photographs.
splendid.zh: 这本书有大量非常好的照片。

magnificent.en: The Taj Mahal is a magnificent building.
magnificent.zh: 泰姬陵是一座宏伟的建筑。

magnificent.en: Several magnificent oil paintings adorn the walls.
magnificent.zh: 几张华丽的油画使墙壁熠熠生辉。

grand.en: The wedding was a very grand occasion.

grand.zh: 这房子并不是十分富丽堂皇。

interesting.zh: 你去过任何有趣的地方吗？
我们就不能做点更有意思的事情吗？

interesting.en: I collect shells and interesting seaside items.
interesting.zh: 我收集贝壳以及海边有趣的东西。

super.zh: 我们度过了一段超好的时光。

super.en: I'm going to Greece in the summer so I've got to be super slim.
super.zh: 我这个夏天要去希腊，所以我得变得超级苗条才行。

wilderness.en: This area has been christened 'Britain's last wilderness'.
wilderness.zh: 这个地区被命名为“英国最后的荒野”。

wilderness.en: The Wilderness Society lobbied Congress to authorize the Endangered Species Act.
wilderness.zh: 荒野协会游说国会批准《濒危物种法》。

wilderness.en: Wilderness designation prohibits road building, the use of mechanized equipment and most other developments.
wilderness.zh: 荒野之地禁止筑路、使用机械设备以及绝大多数其它的开发。

dramatic.en: She gave a dramatic shudder of repulsion.
dramatic.zh: 她由于厌恶而身体剧烈发抖。

dramatic.en: He struck his breast in a dramatic gesture.
dramatic.zh: 他以戏剧性的姿态捶他的胸。

dramatic.en: The nation is gripped by the dramatic story.
dramatic.zh: 整个国家都被这个戏剧性的故事所吸引。

deforest.en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.
deforest.zh: 大火很可能永远地毁掉这片土地上的森林。

deforest.en: But when we arrived nobody knew we had to protect anything; we had to deforest.
deforest.zh: 但我们刚到这里的时候没有人想到我们要保护些什么；我们不得不伐林。

deforest.en: I would captivate them with money before telling them that we needed to deforest their land.
deforest.zh: 我会先用钱迷惑住他们，然后再告诉他们我们要采伐森林。

desert.zh: 索马里大部分地区都是荒漠。

desert.en: The heat in the desert was extreme.

desert.zh: 他们驱车600英里横穿沙漠。

fertile.zh: 农民们开垦了这个肥沃的山谷。

fertile.en: We have the most fertile soil in the Midwest.
fertile.zh: 我们在中西部有最肥沃的土壤。

fertile.en: The operation cannot be reversed to make her fertile again.
fertile.zh: 手术不可逆转，无法使她重获生育能力。

barren.en: He wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
barren.zh: 他想用该水来灌溉贫瘠的沙漠土地。

barren.en: That's probably the most bare, bleak, barren and inhospitable island I've ever seen.
barren.zh: 那可能是我见过的最光秃、最荒凉、最贫瘠和最不适合居住的岛屿。

fertilize.en: It only takes one sperm to fertilize an egg.
fertilize.zh: 只需一个精子就可以使卵受精。

fertilize.en: Since only one female usually lays eggs in a given larva, it would pay her to produce one male only, because this one male could fertilize all his sisters on emergence.
fertilize.zh: 因为通常只有一只雌性在一个特定的幼虫中产卵，所以它只会产生一只雄性，因为这只雄性可以在孵化时使它所有的姐妹受精。

fertilize.en: If they are females, a male may fertilize their eggs.
fertilize.zh: 若它们都是雌性，就要一只雄性来孵化她们的卵。

solar.en: Solar panels trap energy from the sun.
solar.zh: 太阳能电池板吸收太阳能。

solar.en: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.
solar.zh: 太阳能电池板只能在日光下起作用。

solar.en: Saturn is the second biggest planet in the solar system.
solar.zh: 土星是太阳系的第二大的行星。

calendar.en: This is one of the biggest weeks in the racing calendar.
calendar.zh: 这是全年赛马日程表中最重要的几个星期之一。

calendar.en: In the last calendar year the company had a turnover of $426m.
calendar.zh: 在上一个日历年度里，该公司的营业额为4.26亿美元。

calendar.en: It is one of the hottest tickets on Washington's social calendar.
calendar.zh: 这是华盛顿社交日程表上最热门的入场券之一。

lunar.en: "Well I suppose it is based on the old lunar months, isn't it?"—"Yes, that's right."
lunar.zh: “嗯，我想它是基于旧的阴历月份的，不是吗？”—“对，是那样的。”
把月球上的物质带回地球。

lunar.en: The vast volcanic slope was eerily reminiscent of a lunar landscape.
lunar.zh: 巨大的火山坡很奇怪地让人想起月球上的景观。

sunrise.zh: 雨是在日出前开始下的。
日出之前我就开始工作了。

sunset.zh: 我们从日出工作到日落。

sunset.en: There was a red sunset over Paris.
sunset.zh: 巴黎上空有一片红色晚霞。

dusk.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
dusk.zh: 街灯在黄昏时分亮起来。
我们于黄昏时分到家了。

dusk.en: At dusk bats appear in vast numbers.
dusk.zh: 蝙蝠于傍晚时分大批出现。

eclipse.en: A total solar eclipse is due to take place some time tomorrow.
eclipse.zh: 预计日全食会出现在明天的某个时候。

eclipse.en: An eclipse happens when the earth and moon are in line with the sun.
eclipse.zh: 地球和月亮与太阳处在一条直线上，日食就发生了。

eclipse.en: Mo did not want to be ruled by anyone and it is notable that she never allowed the men in her life to eclipse her.
eclipse.zh: 莫不想被任何人管制，很显然，她从不允许她生活中的男性使她黯然失色。

heaven.en: Heaven knows what they put in it.
heaven.zh: 天知道他们往里面放了些什么。

heaven.en: I feel like I've died and gone to heaven.
heaven.zh: 我仿佛觉得自己已经死了，进了天堂。

heaven.en: Now that he's been promoted he's in seventh heaven.
heaven.zh: 他得到擢升，简直乐上天了。

paradise.zh: 这一地区是鸟类观察者的乐园。

paradise.en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
paradise.zh: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

paradise.en: The ancient Egyptians saw paradise as an idealized version of their own lives.
paradise.zh: 古埃及人把天堂视为他们现实生活的理想形式。

sunshine.zh: 海湾在阳光下闪闪发光。

sunshine.en: We sat basking in the warm sunshine.
sunshine.zh: 我们坐着享受温暖的阳光。
这个房间几乎照不进阳光。

shade.en: Let's sit in the shade for a while.
shade.zh: 咱们在阴凉处坐一会儿吧。

shade.en: Let's sit in the shade and keep cool.
shade.zh: 咱们坐在阴凉处乘凉吧。

shade.en: I'm going to shade this part in.
shade.zh: 我要把这一部分画得再暗一些。

vapor.en: Then it snows because as the air rises, it cools off and loses its capacity to hold water vapor.
vapor.zh: 然后就会下雪，因为当空气上升时，它就会冷却并失去保持水蒸气的能力。

vapor.en: Such feedbacks might involve ice on land and sea, clouds, or water vapor, which also absorb radiant heat.
vapor.zh: 这种反馈可能涉及陆地和海洋上的冰、云或水蒸气，这些也会吸收辐射热。

vapor.en: Astronomers therefore prefer dry sites with little water vapor, which is generally found at higher altitudes.
vapor.zh: 因此，天文学家更喜欢水蒸气很少的干燥地点，而水蒸气通常出现在海拔较高处。

shadow.zh: 一片阴影掠过她的脸庞。

shadow.en: The ship's sail cast a shadow on the water.
shadow.zh: 船帆在水面上投下一片影子。

shadow.en: He has always lived in the shadow of his brother.
shadow.zh: 他一直生活在他哥哥的阴影之下。

evaporate.en: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
evaporate.zh: 向它上面快速喷冷气可使水蒸发掉。

evaporate.en: It is more difficult for gases to "evaporate" from them.
evaporate.zh: 气体更难从中“蒸发”出来。

evaporate.en: Some of the compounds in the oil evaporate reduce their impact on the environment.
evaporate.zh: 漏油中的一些化合物的蒸发能够降低它们对环境的影响。

circulate.en: Leave a gap at the top and bottom so air can circulate.
circulate.zh: 在顶部和底部各留一点空隙，这样空气就可以流通了。

circulate.en: Rumours began to circulate about his financial problems.
circulate.zh: 有关他财务困难的谣言开始流传开来。

circulate.en: Rumours were already beginning to circulate that the project might have to be abandoned.
circulate.zh: 有关这个项目可能被迫放弃的流言已经开始在四处传播。

precipitate.en: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions.
precipitate.zh: 我认为我们不应该做出仓促的决定。

precipitate.en: A decrease in face-to-face social contact can precipitate depression.
precipitate.zh: 面对面社交接触的减少会导致抑郁。

precipitate.en: Four compounds, namely 10 nonacosane, 24 methylenecycloartanol, stigmasterol and dacosterol have been isolated from the precipitate of the plant's methanol extract.
precipitate.zh: 从月腺大戟根甲醇提取液的沉淀部分，鉴定了4种化合物，分别为二十九烷醇10、24亚甲基环阿尔廷醇、豆甾醇和达考甾醇。

reservoir.en: Torrents of water gushed into the reservoir.
The reservoir was low after the long drought.
reservoir.zh: 久旱之后水库的水位下降了。

reservoir.en: Water is piped from the reservoir to the city.
reservoir.zh: 水用管子从水库输送到城市。

waterfall.en: As you descend, suddenly you see at last the hidden waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 你往下走，最终会突然发现那个隐秘的瀑布。

waterfall.en: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾中映出了一道彩虹。

waterfall.en: The water roiled to his left as he climbed carefully at the edge of the waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 当他在瀑布边缘小心攀爬时，水飞溅到他左边。

fountain.en: The main square has a fountain that spouts water 40 feet into the air.
fountain.zh: 主广场有个喷泉，喷水高达40英尺。

fountain.en: "What's that thing in the middle of the fountain?"—"Some kind of statue, I guess."
fountain.zh: “喷泉中间那个东西是什么？”—“我想是雕像之类的吧。”

spring.en: Trade usually picks up in the spring.

spring.zh: 她整个春季都表现得很稳健。

dew.en: The grass was wet with early morning dew.
dew.zh: 清晨的露水使得青草湿漉漉的。

pour.en: Letters of complaint continue to pour in.

drain.zh: 水打着旋流进了下水道。

drain.en: She tipped the dirty water down the drain.
drain.zh: 她把脏水倒入了下水道。

drown.en: Animals get tangled in fishing nets and drown.
drown.zh: 动物被缠在渔网里淹死了。

drown.en: It was as if she wanted us to drown together.
drown.zh: 她好像想要我们俩一起淹死似的。

drown.en: They drown when the tide rises, for then it is submerged.
drown.zh: 他们在涨潮时被淹死，因为那时岩石被海水被淹没了。

drip.en: She was then hooked up to an IV drip.
drip.zh: 接着就给她接上了静脉滴注。

drip.en: He was put on intravenous drip to treat his dehydration.
The silence was broken only by the steady drip, drip of water from the roof.
drip.zh: 只有屋顶上滴答滴答持续不断的滴水声打破了寂静。

gush.en: You can gush, fume or whine - anything goes.
gush.zh: 你可以滔滔不绝、勃然大怒，或者哀嚎抱怨，怎么样都行。

gush.en: In a moment more, the crowd began to gush forth from the doors of the church.
gush.zh: 过了一会儿，人群便开始从教堂的大门蜂拥而出。

dense.en: The area was covered in dense jungle.
This creature's fur is short, dense and silky.
dense.zh: 这种动物的毛短、浓密且柔顺。

dense.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
dense.zh: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

blow.zh: 哎呀！我给忘得一干二净了。
他有一头吹风造型了的金发。
这一击把那个女人的牙齿打掉了一小块。

puff.en: I took a puff on the cigarette and started coughing.
puff.zh: 我抽了一口烟就开始咳嗽起来。

puff.en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
puff.zh: 魔术师在一股烟雾中突然不见了。

puff.en: I was starting to puff a little from the climb.
puff.zh: 爬坡弄得我有点喘息起来。

intensity.en: The solemn intensity of Jade's gaze discomfited him.
intensity.zh: 在杰德强烈而严肃的凝视下他狼狈不堪。

intensity.en: Everyone I know who kept it up at that intensity is burned-out.
intensity.zh: 我所认识的一直保持那样工作强度的人都早衰了。

intensity.en: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety.
intensity.zh: 该工作的强度很少给个人留下悲伤或忧虑的机会。

intensive.en: Ahead of us lay ten days of intensive training.
intensive.zh: 我们还要进行十天的强化训练。
集约耕作使土壤变得贫瘠。

emerge.en: Further evidence of slowing economic growth is likely to emerge this week.
emerge.zh: 更多有关在减慢的经济增长的证据本周可能出现。

emerge.en: The cultural life of the country will sink into atrophy unless more writers and artists emerge.
emerge.zh: 如果没有更多的作家和艺术家出现，这个国家的文化生活将衰退。
新的事物每天都在出现。

flash.zh: 拍这个镜头我需要闪光灯。

flash.en: Stopping to rest, Pete shut off the flash.
flash.zh: 停下来休息的时候，皮特关掉了手电筒。

flash.en: Another flash of lightning lit up the cave.
flash.zh: 又一道闪电照亮了那个洞穴。

surrounding.en: The farm and surrounding area was flooded.
surrounding.zh: 农场和周围地区遭洪水淹没。

surrounding.en: The surrounding countryside is windswept and rocky.
surrounding.zh: 这周围的乡村风多石头多。

surrounding.en: We searched the surrounding neighbourhood for the missing boy.
surrounding.zh: 我们在附近寻找失踪的男孩儿。

environment.zh: 儿童需要一个充满关怀的环境。

environment.en: He has always been pro the environment.
The environment has become a very hot issue.
environment.zh: 环境已成为很热门的话题。

float.en: If it's made of wood it will float.
float.zh: 这要是木材做的就能浮在水面上。

float.en: There wasn't enough water to float the ship.
float.zh: 水不够深，船浮动不起来。

condition.zh: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

situation.zh: 我们已无法控制这一局面。

natural.zh: 哭泣是一种自然的释放压力的手段。
水是鱼的天然生活环境。
她是个天生的运动健将。

nature.zh: 他本质上就是个叛逆的人。
弄虚作假并非他的本性。

artificial.zh: 这种食品不含人工调味品。
这种果汁不含人工防腐剂。

artificial.en: Most artificial joints are cemented into place.
artificial.zh: 绝大部分人造关节是被黏结复位的。

synthetic.en: Boots made from synthetic materials can usually be washed in a machine.
synthetic.zh: 用合成材料做成的靴子通常可以在机器里洗。

synthetic.en: New synthetic foods will form a regular part of people's diets.
synthetic.zh: 新的合成食品将成为人们日常饮食的一部分。

synthetic.en: The main idea here is that synthetic chemical dyes replaced textile dyes.
synthetic.zh: 其主要想法是合成化学染料代替纺织染料。

petrol.zh: 所有的新汽车都加无铅汽油。

petrol.en: We drove there and back on one tank of petrol.
petrol.zh: 我们开车去那里来回用了一油箱汽油。

petroleum.en: If the organic material decays or is oxidized, it will not form petroleum.
petroleum.zh: 如果有机物腐烂或氧化，它不会形成石油。

petroleum.en: We ought to and can produce more petroleum.
petroleum.zh: 我们应该并且能够生产更多的石油。

petroleum.en: Environmentalists fret about the petroleum needed to make it.
petroleum.zh: 环保人士对生产所需的石油感到担忧。

gasoline.en: I siphoned the gasoline out of the car into a can.
gasoline.zh: 我用虹吸管把汽车里的汽油抽到桶里。

gasoline.en: I fill up the tank with gasoline about once a week.
gasoline.zh: 大约每个星期我加满一箱汽油。

gasoline.en: The gasoline in the bottle has evaporated.

respire.en: Some products, such as asparagus, corn, and strawberries, respire at a higher rate than other products, such as apples, oranges, and potatoes.
respire.zh: 一些产品，如芦笋、玉米和草莓，比其他产品，如苹果、橘子和土豆的呼吸速率要高。

respire.en: All living things respire as long as they live.
respire.zh: 一切生物只要活着都要呼吸。

respire.en: It is also produced when living organisms respire.
respire.zh: 二氧化碳也可经由活体生物的呼吸作用而产生。

photosynthesis.en: Now I need to mention another thing about photosynthesis.
photosynthesis.zh: 现在我需要提到关于光合作用的另一点。

photosynthesis.en: I didn't explain how different wavelengths of light affect photosynthesis.
photosynthesis.zh: 我没有解释不同波长的光如何影响光合作用。

photosynthesis.en: But, unlike sunlight, the light from these LEDs did not support photosynthesis.
photosynthesis.zh: 但是，与阳光不同的是，这些发光二极管发出的光不支持光合作用。

dioxide.en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
dioxide.zh: 溶解的二氧化碳使水更具酸性。

dioxide.en: Humans take in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide.
dioxide.zh: 人吸入氧气，呼出二氧化碳。

dioxide.en: Burning fossil fuels uses oxygen and produces carbon dioxide.
dioxide.zh: 燃烧化石燃料消耗氧气并产生二氧化碳。

vegetation.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

vegetation.en: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这片丘岭草木茂盛，郁郁葱葱。

vegetation.en: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这家小酒店的花园里种着亚热带植物。

herb.en: The dried herb is obtainable from health shops.
herb.zh: 这种干药草在保健店里能买到。

herb.en: Cantaloup is belonged to cucurbitaceous, a year of rampant herb.
herb.zh: 香瓜属葫芦科，一年蔓生草本植物。

herb.en: Technically speaking, a spice is part of an aromatic plant that is not a leaf or herb.
herb.zh: 从技术上讲，香料是芳香植物的一部分，不只是叶子或药草。

perennial.en: The perennial vegetation adjusts to the aridity by means of various avoidance mechanisms.
perennial.zh: 多年生植物会采用各种躲避机制以适应干旱。

perennial.en: We learned that the Botai were able to build large perennial villages, sometimes with hundreds of homes.
perennial.zh: 我们了解到博泰人能够建造大型的常年村庄，有时候村里有上百户人家。

botany.en: They shared a common interest in botany.
botany.zh: 他们都对植物学感兴趣。

botany.en: To what degree are you interested in botany?
botany.zh: 你对植物学的兴趣达到什么程度？

botany.en: To earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
botany.zh: 要获得植物科学奖章，侦察员可以在农学、园艺学或野外植物学之间进行选择。

ecology.en: Oil pollution could damage the fragile ecology of the coral reefs.
ecology.zh: 石油污染可能破坏珊瑚礁脆弱的生态环境。

ecology.en: Development has been guided by a concern for the ecology of the area.
ecology.zh: 关注本地区的生态状况一直是发展的指导原则。

ecology.en: We are reproducing ourselves at such a rate that our numbers threaten the ecology of the planet.
ecology.zh: 我们繁衍得如此之快，以至于人口数量威胁到地球的生态系统。

ecosystem.en: The ecosystem will be thrown out of whack.
This unique ecosystem may soon be under pressure.
ecosystem.zh: 这个独特的生态系统可能很快就会面临压力。

ecosystem.en: The question of ecosystem stability is complicated.
ecosystem.zh: 生态系统稳定性的问题是复杂的。

horticulture.en: With trade barriers in place, the horticulture industry in Kenya will shrivel as quickly as a discarded rose.
horticulture.zh: 由于贸易壁垒的存在，肯尼亚的园艺产业将会像遗弃的玫瑰一样迅速枯萎。

horticulture.en: Dutch peasants were able to remain unaffected by this crisis for a long time because they had specialized in dairy farming, industrial crops, and horticulture.
horticulture.zh: 荷兰的农民能够在很长一段时间内不受这场危机的影响，因为他们专门从事于奶牛养殖、工业作物和园艺的工作。

horticulture.en: In addition to dairy farming and cultivating industrial crops, a third sector of the Dutch economy reflected the way in which agriculture was being modernized—horticulture.
horticulture.zh: 除了奶牛养殖和工业作物种植，荷兰经济的第三部分反映了农业现代化的方式——园艺。

organism.en: Multiplication of cells leads to rapid growth of the organism.
organism.zh: 细胞的繁殖导致有机体的迅速生长。

organism.en: DNA carries the genetic blueprint which tells any organism how to build itself.
organism.zh: 脱氧核糖核酸带有决定有机体形成方式的遗传型板。

genetics.en: Genetics is also bringing about dramatic changes in our understanding of cancer.
genetics.zh: 遗传学也正使我们对癌症的理解发生巨大的变化。

genetics.en: The study of psychology has recently been widely cross-fertilized by new discoveries in genetics.
genetics.zh: 心理学研究最近从遗传学的新发现中受益匪浅。

genetics.en: McClintock started in a temporary job with the genetics department.
genetics.zh: 麦克林托克在遗传学系开始了一份临时工作。

mutation.en: Scientists have found a genetic mutation that appears to be the cause of Huntington's disease.
mutation.zh: 科学家们已经发现一个似乎是亨廷顿病病因的遗传突变。

mutation.en: If a copy of a gene is a bit different from the original, that's called a genetic mutation.
mutation.zh: 如果一个复制的基因与原来的有些许不同，那就叫做基因突变。

mutation.en: Furthermore, the single copy of a founder mutation often confers a survival advantage on carriers.
mutation.zh: 此外，创始者突变的单一拷贝通常赋予携带者生存优势。

diversity.en: Two of our greatest strengths are diversity and community.
diversity.zh: 我们的两个最大优点是多样性和团体精神。

diversity.en: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.
diversity.zh: 教育方面需要更加多元化和更大的选择性。

diversity.en: We have nothing against diversity; indeed, we want more of it.
diversity.zh: 我们并不反对多样化；其实，我们希望有更多的多样化。

variation.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
variation.zh: 这种略有变化的美味煎蛋饼做起来又快又容易。

variation.en: Variation among humans is limited to the possible permutations of our genes.
variation.zh: 人类的变化形式受限于我们基因可能的那些排列。

variation.en: Modern violins had a greater variation, a larger differential.
variation.zh: 现代小提琴有更大的变化，更大的差异。

hybridization.en: We explore the sensitivity and specificity of in situ hybridization in human papillomavirus in condyloma acuminata tissues.
hybridization.zh: 我们探讨原位分子杂交法诊断尖锐湿疣的敏感性与特异性。

hybridization.en: The objective is to study the value of HPV immunohistochemical technique and in situ hybridization for diagnosis of condylomata.
hybridization.zh: 目的探讨 HPV 免疫组化技术及原位杂交技术在尖锐湿疣病变中的应用价值。

classify.en: Classify them by branch, region, and year.
classify.zh: 将它们按部门、地区和年份分类。

classify.en: Thing is that it's very difficult to classify.
This is true regardless of how we classify the service.
classify.zh: 无论我们如何对服务进行分类，这都是真的。

reproduce.zh: 这些生物体通过单性生殖进行繁殖。

reproduce.en: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
reproduce.zh: 大多数爬行动物通过在陆地产卵进行繁殖。

reproduce.en: The movie makes no pretension to reproduce life.
reproduce.zh: 这部电影并未标榜重现了真实生活。

evolve.en: It is interesting that Chinese characters evolve from pictures and signs.
evolve.zh: 有趣的是，汉字是由图画和符号演变而来的。

evolve.en: So why would animals evolve a characteristic that seems to endanger them?
evolve.zh: 那么，为什么动物会进化出一种似乎会危及它们自身的特性呢？

evolve.en: Sometimes primary group relationships evolve out of secondary group relationships.
evolve.zh: 有时主要的群体关系从次要的群体关系演变而来。

fluctuate.en: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
fluctuate.zh: 如果你病了，体温会波动。

fluctuate.en: The analysis reveals that intensity appears to fluctuate with a clear, well-defined rhythm.
fluctuate.zh: 分析表明，强度似乎以一种清晰的、明确的节奏在波动。

fluctuate.en: Later on in the early years of the nineteenth century, when Fort Vancouver became the headquarters of the Hudson's Bay Company, deer populations continued to fluctuate.
fluctuate.zh: 后来，在19世纪初，当温哥华堡成为哈德逊湾公司的总部时，鹿的数量继续波动。

reclaim.en: The good news for the industry was that investors don't seem to be in any hurry to reclaim their money.
reclaim.zh: 对该行业来说，好消息是投资者们似乎不急于要求收回他们的钱。

reclaim.en: The richest merchants in Amsterdam contributed money to reclaim a good 7,100 hectares of land.
reclaim.zh: 阿姆斯特丹最富有的商人们捐钱并开垦了7100公顷的良田。

reclaim.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
reclaim.zh: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

cultivate.en: The people cultivate mainly rice and beans.
cultivate.zh: 这里的人们主要种植稻子和豆类。
我们该如何培养积极的情感呢？

cultivate.en: I want to cultivate the relationship with myself.
cultivate.zh: 我想培养和自己的关系。

sow.en: The piglets are taken from the sow to be fattened for market.
sow.zh: 这些小猪被从母猪身边带走，好育肥上市。

sow.en: Help us to know how to sow our tears.
sow.zh: 帮助我们知道如何播种我们的眼泪。

sow.en: Are they weeping in sorrow as they sow?
sow.zh: 他们是否在播种时悲伤哭泣呢？

harvest.en: The poor harvest caused prices to rise sharply.
harvest.zh: 收成不好导致物价急剧上涨。

harvest.en: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule.
harvest.zh: 蔬菜收割灾难性地滞后于计划。

harvest.en: Rice farmers here still plant and harvest their crops by hand.
harvest.zh: 这里的稻农仍然用手工种植和收割庄稼。

pluck.en: Tha's got too much pluck in thee.
It takes a lot of pluck to start a new job at his age.
pluck.zh: 在他这个年纪开始一份新的工作要有很大的勇气。

pluck.en: When you get hungry, just pluck a pear off the tree and eat it.
pluck.zh: 肚子饿了你就从树上采摘一个梨吃吧。

yield.zh: 高利率的存款会产生丰厚的收益。

pick.en: She bent to pick a red rose.
pick.zh: 她弯下腰摘了一朵红玫瑰。

pick.en: The winner gets first pick of the prizes.

rear.en: I got a ding in my rear fender.
rear.zh: 我汽车后面的挡泥板撞瘪了一处。

rear.en: Her car crashed into the rear of a van.
rear.zh: 她的汽车撞毁了一辆面包车的尾部。

rear.en: A high gate blocks the only entrance to the rear.
rear.zh: 一座高大的门挡住了通往后面的唯一入口。

arable.en: The terrain changed quickly from arable land to desert.
arable.zh: 这里的地形很快由耕地变为沙漠。

arable.en: He had nearly a thousand acres of grazing and arable land.
arable.zh: 他拥有近千亩的牧场和可耕地。

arable.en: To feed the larger population, humans need to obtain arable land, so there is a massive clearing of trees.
arable.zh: 人类为了养活比以前更多的人口，需要获得可耕地，因此大量砍伐树木。

plow.en: While most harvesting is still done manually, some have abandoned the ox-pulled plow for tractors.
plow.zh: 虽然大部分收割还是手工的，但有些人已经废弃了使用牛拉犁而改用拖拉机。

plow.en: There are those who would prefer to plow golf courses under because of the water and chemicals they use.
plow.zh: 有些人更愿意将高尔夫球场给犁掉，因为它们耗费水和化学品。

plow.en: "Monument to the Plow" called for a triangular site a mile wide on each side to be planted with seasonal crops on rotation.
plow.zh: 《犁的纪念碑》要求一三角状地块，每边宽一英里，以轮种方式在每个边种植季节性作物。

spade.zh: 铁锹撞在什么金属物件上发出刺耳的声音。

spade.en: I grabbed the spade and started digging.
spade.zh: 我抓起铁锹开始挖了起来。

spade.en: Whatever does that want a spade for?

rake.en: I watched the men rake leaves into heaps.
rake.zh: 我看见男人们把树叶耙成堆。

rake.en: Rake up the trash on the ground.
There's a little spade, a rake, a fork and hoe.
rake.zh: 有一把小铲子，一把耙子，一把叉子和一把锄头。

stack.en: A stack of files awaited me on my desk.
stack.zh: 我桌上有一堆文件正待我去处理。

stack.en: He ordered them to stack up pillows behind his back.
stack.zh: 他命令他们在他背后堆放一些枕头。

stack.en: There's a stack of unopened mail waiting for you at the house.
stack.zh: 家里有一大堆信等你拆呢。

heap.en: His clothes lay in a heap on the floor.
She piled the papers in a heap on her desk, just anyhow.
heap.zh: 她把文件在桌上随便搁成一堆。

heap.en: There is one database heap per database.
heap.zh: 每个数据库都有一个数据库堆。

bundle.en: Her eyes suddenly alighted on the bundle of documents.
bundle.zh: 她的目光突然落到了这捆文件上。

bundle.en: That car must have cost a bundle.
She tied the newspapers in a bundle.

bunch.zh: 他们是一群很棒的小伙子。

bunch.en: She picked me a bunch of flowers.
She was given a huge bunch of flowers.
bunch.zh: 有人给她送了一大束花。

sunlight.zh: 阳光在他的眼镜上闪光。
我们来到明媚的阳光下。
他在强烈的阳光下直眨眼睛。

vase.en: What am I bid for this vase?
vase.zh: 诸位愿给这个花瓶出多少钱？

vase.en: You can use that glass as a vase.
vase.zh: 你可以把那个玻璃杯当作花瓶用。
希拉里拿起一个花瓶向他打去。

fungus.en: 200,000 specimens of fungus are kept at the Komarov Botanical Institute.
fungus.zh: 20万个真菌标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。

fungus.en: These are not single individual plants; each one is a symbiotic combination of an alga and a fungus.
fungus.zh: 这些不是单个的植物；每一种都是藻类和真菌的共生组合。

fungus.en: But this particular fungus nibbles away only at certain layers in the wood, leaving other layers alone.
fungus.zh: 但是这种特殊的真菌只会慢慢啃食木头的特定几层结构，而不去啃其他层。

mold.en: Mold is usually green, white, black or gray.
mold.zh: 霉菌通常为绿色、白色、黑色或灰色。

pollen.en: Seeds and pollen are spread by the wind.
pollen.zh: 种子和花粉是随风传播的。

pollen.en: As the day goes on, the pollen dries up and becomes hard.
pollen.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，花粉变得又干又硬。

pollen.en: Avoid trips to the country while the pollen count is high.
pollen.zh: 花粉计数高时，尽量避免去乡村旅行。

germinate.en: Some seed varieties germinate fast, so check every day or so.
germinate.zh: 有一些品种的种子发芽快，所以差不多每天都要察看一下。

germinate.en: Nitrogen dioxide in the smoke induces the seeds to germinate.
germinate.zh: 烟雾中的二氧化氮诱导种子发芽。

germinate.en: Actually, the seeds don't retain the power to germinate for very long.
germinate.zh: 事实上，种子不能长时间保持发芽的能力。

seed.zh: 头号种子选手轻松获胜。
微小的粒子紧贴着种子。

seed.en: The plant can be propagated from seed.
seed.zh: 这种植物可由种子繁殖。

burgeon.zh: 植物能从任何可获得的空间中迅速生长。

burgeon.en: My confidence began to burgeon later in life.
burgeon.zh: 我的信心到了晚年开始迅速增长。

burgeon.en: When spring is coming all trees began to burgeon.
burgeon.zh: 春天到来的时候所有的树木开始发芽。

bud.en: It is important to recognize jealousy and to nip it in the bud before it gets out of hand.
bud.zh: 意识到嫉妒并在它发展到无法控制之前就把它消灭于萌芽状态，这一点至关重要。

bud.en: This puts stress on the bud eventually bursting it open.
bud.zh: 这会给花蕾施加压力，最终迫使它开花。

flower.en: The flower opens to reveal a bee.
flower.zh: 花开了，露出来一只蜜蜂。
我一直在除花坛里的杂草。

flower.en: Cut the flower stems on the slant.

blossom.en: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
blossom.zh: 雨开始下，桃树就开花了。

bloom.en: Most roses will begin to bloom from late May.
bloom.zh: 大多数玫瑰从五月末开始开花。

bloom.en: There are a lot of roses in bloom.

aromatic.en: Technically speaking, a spice is part of an aromatic plant that is not a leaf or herb.
aromatic.zh: 从技术上讲，香料是芳香植物的一部分，不只是叶子或药草。

aromatic.en: The UV spectrum most resembled that of the aromatic tropylium ion.
aromatic.zh: 紫外光谱与芳香族对苯二酚离子的光谱最相似。

aromatic.en: In this reaction, it was found that trifluoroethanol and substoichiometric amounts of an aromatic thiol.
aromatic.zh: 在这个反应中，发现了三氟乙醇和亚化学计量的芳香族硫醇。

ripen.en: I'm waiting for the apples to ripen.
This helps to ripen new growth and makes it flower profusely.
ripen.zh: 这有助于新植物成熟并且开出繁茂的花朵。

ripen.en: They've got fruit retailing down to a fine art. You can be sure that your pears will ripen in day.
ripen.zh: 他们精于水果零售之道。你可以放心，你那些梨一天之内就会熟。

scent.en: The dogs must have lost her scent.
scent.zh: 狗准是闻不到她的气味了。

scent.en: A police dog picked up the murderer's scent.
scent.zh: 一条警犬嗅出了凶手的气味。

scent.en: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window.
scent.zh: 蔷薇的香味随风从窗户飘进来。

fruit.zh: 他们主要吃水果和坚果。

wither.en: In autumn the leaves wither and fall off the trees.
wither.zh: 秋天，树叶枯萎并从树上落下来。

wither.en: During months without water under a harsh sun, they wither, shrink and contract until they look like a pile of dead gray leaves.
wither.zh: 暴晒且少雨的月份里，它们会枯萎、皱缩、变小，直至看起来像堆灰扑扑的枯叶。

wither.en: The flower went on, "My days have passed and I'm going to wither. That makes me so sad."
wither.zh: 花儿继续说：“我的生命已经流逝，我将要枯萎。这让我很难过。”

decompose.en: As the waste materials decompose, they produce methane gas.
decompose.zh: 废物腐烂时会产生沼气。
当它们死亡，它们就会分解。

decompose.en: When the plants die, they decompose, and the phosphorus is recycled back into the soil.
decompose.zh: 当植物死亡时，它们会分解，磷就会被回收到土壤中。

rot.en: The house was riddled with dry rot.
rot.zh: 屋子因木材干腐而变得千疮百孔。

rot.en: The rubbish in modern landfills does not rot.
rot.zh: 现代垃圾填埋场里的垃圾不会腐烂。

rot.en: The wood must not get damp as rot can quickly result.
rot.zh: 木头不能受潮，否则很快就会烂掉。

rainforest.en: Our survival is inextricably linked to the survival of the rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 我们的生存与雨林的生存息息相关。

rainforest.en: They do serious harm to tropical rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 他们对热带雨林造成严重危害。

rainforest.en: Low-level slash and burn farming doesn't harm rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 低水平的刀耕火种不会损害雨林。

stale.zh: 他们的婚姻已了无热情。

stale.en: There was a powerful smell of stale beer.
stale.zh: 有一股浓烈的馊啤酒的气味。

stale.en: A miasma of stale alcohol hung around him.
stale.zh: 他身上老有股难闻的酒精味。

jungle.en: The tiger's home is in the jungle.
The lion is the king of the jungle.
We decided to go deeper into the jungle.
jungle.zh: 我们决定继续深入丛林。

decay.en: There are problems of urban decay and gang violence.
decay.zh: 存在都市衰败和黑帮暴力问题。

decay.en: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
decay.zh: 牙斑没有清除就会导致蛀牙和牙龈疾病。

decay.en: The landlord had let the building fall into decay.
decay.zh: 房东不管，房子已经破烂不堪。

plantation.en: They were sold to plantation owners and forced to work long.
plantation.zh: 他们被卖给种植园主，被迫长时间工作。

plantation.en: They were sold to plantation owners and forced to work long hours.
plantation.zh: 他们被卖给种植园主，被迫长时间工作。

plantation.en: Most visitors to the Caribbean are rich, like the plantation owner.
plantation.zh: 大多数来加勒比地区的游客都很富有，就像种植园主一样。

terrace.en: All rooms have a balcony or terrace.
terrace.zh: 所有的房间都有阳台或露台。

terrace.en: We lingered over breakfast on the terrace.
terrace.zh: 我们在平台上慢条斯理地吃着早餐。

charcoal.en: Grill the steaks over a wood or charcoal fire that is quite hot.
charcoal.zh: 在相当热的柴火或木炭火上烤牛排。

charcoal.en: They make the charcoal by burying wood in the ground and then slowly burning it.
charcoal.zh: 他们制作木炭时要把木头埋进地里，然后让它慢慢燃烧。

charcoal.en: It's like an old charcoal burner. The coffee is heated up like charcoal.
charcoal.zh: 它就像一个旧的木炭燃烧器。咖啡像木炭一样被加热。

timber.en: Men were loading up a truck with timber.
timber.zh: 工人正在把木料装上卡车。

timber.en: He felled, peeled, and hewed his own timber.
timber.zh: 他自己砍树、剥皮并劈成木材。

timber.en: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber.
timber.zh: 他们一直在用小麦交换棉花和木材。

field.en: He is an innovator in this field.
field.zh: 他是这个领域的革新者。

field.en: They are all expert in this field.
field.zh: 他们都是这个领域的行家。
运动员们慢慢跑进赛场。

log.en: You need a password to log on.
The system is unable to log you on.
log.zh: 这个系统无法让你登录。

log.en: Customers pay to log on and gossip with other users.
log.zh: 顾客们花钱登录，与其他用户闲聊。

logo.en: The team's logo was emblazoned on the baseball caps.
logo.zh: 球队标识醒目地印在棒球帽上。

logo.en: She was sporting a T-shirt with the company's logo on it.
logo.zh: 她穿了一件带有公司徽标的T恤衫，很是得意。

logo.en: The company carries a variety of binders that can be imprinted with your message or logo.
logo.zh: 该公司经营各种可以印上客户所需信息或标识的活页夹。

forestry.en: They had no idea about scientific forestry.
forestry.zh: 他们对科学林业一无所知。

forestry.en: Jadav Payeng is a forestry worker from Jorhat, India.
forestry.zh: Jadav Payeng 是一名来自印度乔哈特的林业工人。

forestry.en: But through a Great Depression era programme, known as the "National Youth Administration", Borlaug was able to enroll in the University of Minnesota at Minneapolis to study forestry.
forestry.zh: 但是，通过一个被称为“国家青年管理局”的大萧条时期的项目，博洛格得以进入明尼阿波利斯市的明尼苏达大学学习林业。

bough.en: I rested my fishing rod against a pine bough.
bough.zh: 我把我的鱼竿靠在松树的一个大树枝上。

bough.en: The Tree trembled so in every bough that one of the tapers set fire to the foliage.
bough.zh: 枞树的每根枝子都在发抖，弄得一根蜡烛烧着了一根枝子。
“看到了，它只能和孩子在一道时是这样！” 苹果枝说。

trunk.zh: 我把箱子盖上，用绳子捆结实。

trunk.en: The leg to be stretched should be positioned behind your trunk with your knee bent.
trunk.zh: 要伸展的那条腿应该放在躯干的后面并弯曲膝盖。

branch.en: He chopped a branch off the tree.
branch.zh: 他从那棵树上砍下一根树枝。

branch.en: Deposits can be made at any branch.
branch.zh: 在任何一家分行都可以存钱。

branch.en: A branch whipped across the car window.
branch.zh: 一条树枝突然划过车窗。

root.en: We got to the root of the problem.
root.zh: 我们触及了这个问题的根源。

root.en: Most plants will root in about six to eight weeks.
root.zh: 大多数植物会在六到八周内生根。

root.en: There would be a major drive to root out corruption.
root.zh: 将会有一场根除腐败的大规模的运动。

hay.en: He drove by with a big load of hay.
hay.zh: 他开着装满干草的车过去了。

hay.en: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.
hay.zh: 他种植了2000英亩的小麦和饲料用草。

hay.en: She's a victim of the dreaded hay fever.

straw.en: The floors are covered with woven straw mats.
straw.zh: 地板上铺着用草编织的垫子。

straw.en: She was noisily sucking up milk through a straw.
straw.zh: 她正用吸管咕嘟咕嘟地喝牛奶。

straw.en: I stumbled through mud to a garden strewn with straw.
straw.zh: 我跌跌撞撞地走过泥泞来到一个散满稻草的院子。

reed.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
reed.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

reed.en: Referee Michael Reed had no hesitation in awarding a penalty.
reed.zh: 裁判迈克尔·里德毫不犹豫地判了罚球。

reed.en: Reed credits Thomas Bouchard's work for today's surge in twin studies.
reed.zh: 里德认为，托马斯·布沙尔的工作促成了如今双胞胎研究的激增。

thorn.en: The thorn of bone may dislodge from his throat without surgery.
thorn.zh: 也许不用动手术就能去除他喉咙卡着的那块骨刺。

thorn.en: Nightingale pressed closer against the thorn, and the thorn touched her heart, and a fierce pang of pain shot through her.
thorn.zh: 南丁格尔更加的靠近那个刺，刺碰到了她的心脏，一股剧烈的疼痛击穿了她的身体。

thorn.en: She fell to reflecting again, and in looking downwards, a thorn of the rose remaining in her breast accidentally pricked her chin.
thorn.zh: 她又陷入了沉思，向下看时，她戴在胸前的玫瑰花刺扎了一下她的下巴。

weed.en: He is eager to weed out the many applicants he believes may be frauds.
weed.zh: 他急于剔除那些他认为可能是行骗的申请人。
到了20世纪20年代，杂草猖獗。

weed.en: I volunteered to weed the hospital garden.
weed.zh: 我自愿给医院的花园除草。

meadow.en: For six months they camped out in a meadow at the back of the house.
meadow.zh: 他们在房子后面的草地上露宿了6个月。

meadow.en: Ten men went to mow a meadow.

meadow.zh: 孔雀在周围的草地上昂首阔步。

grass.zh: 草都干了，东一片西一片的。
草长得又茂密又柔软光滑。

lawn.en: I mow the lawn every week in summer.
lawn.zh: 夏天我每周都要修剪草坪。

lawn.en: There were ducks quacking on the lawn.
lawn.zh: 有鸭子在草坪上发出嘎嘎的叫着。

lawn.en: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate.
lawn.zh: 她轻快地跑过草坪，来到大门口。

olive.zh: 她穿了一件橄榄绿的T恤衫。

olive.en: She speared an olive with her fork.
olive.zh: 她用叉子扎起一个橄榄。

olive.en: Olive oil and garlic feature prominently in his recipes.
olive.zh: 橄榄油和大蒜在他的食谱中显得很重要。

pine.zh: 两个房间里都有仿古松木家具。

vine.en: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings.
vine.zh: 繁殖葡萄藤最容易的办法就是采取硬木扦插。

vine.en: A vine wraps round a big tree.
vine.zh: 一根藤绕在一棵大树上。

vine.en: It was the last leaf on the vine.
vine.zh: 这是藤蔓上最后的一片叶子。

violet.en: The light was beginning to drain from a violet sky.
violet.zh: 光线正开始从紫罗兰色的天空中渐渐消失。

violet.en: Red and violet are at opposite ends of the spectrum.
violet.zh: 红色和紫色位于光谱的两端。
我的毛笔是紫罗兰色的。

tulip.zh: 我们称这种狂热为“郁金香狂热”。

tulip.en: One particular tulip bulb was sold and exchanged for a small ship.
tulip.zh: 卖了一个特别的郁金香球茎，换来了一艘小船。

tulip.en: Panic spread like wild fire and the tulip market collapsed totally.
tulip.zh: 恐慌像野火一样蔓延，郁金香市场彻底崩溃。

reef.en: The island is encircled by a coral reef.
reef.zh: 这个岛周围都是珊瑚礁。

reef.en: An unspoiled coral reef encloses the bay.
reef.zh: 未经破坏的珊瑚礁围绕着该海湾。

mint.zh: 她嘴里咂着一颗薄荷糖。
她嘴里咂着一颗薄荷糖。

alga.en: These are not single individual plants; each one is a symbiotic combination of an alga and a fungus.
alga.zh: 这些不是单个的植物；每一种都是藻类和真菌的共生组合。

alga.en: "There's no way on earth that genes from an alga should work inside an animal cell," says Sidney Pierce from the University of South Florida.
alga.zh: 来自南佛罗里达大学的西德尼·皮尔斯说：“在地球上，藻类的基因不可能在动物细胞内起作用。”

alga.en: They may have evolved by the modification of conceptacles from plants' alga-like ancestors.
alga.zh: 它们可能是通过修饰植物类藻类祖先的概念而进化而来的。

enzyme.en: This enzyme would make the filtration of beer easier.
enzyme.zh: 这种酶会使啤酒更容易过滤

enzyme.en: The scientists are cautious about using enzyme therapy on humans.
enzyme.zh: 科学家们对于人体使用酶疗法持谨慎态度。

enzyme.en: The natural enzyme is harmful to humans and animals.
enzyme.zh: 天然酶对人和动物都是有害的。

catalyst.en: Many policy makers insist that consumer spending is a strong economic catalyst and, therefore, a paucity of retail stores is a contributing factor to low-performing economies.
catalyst.zh: 许多政策制定者坚持认为，消费者支出是一个强大的经济催化剂，因此，零售商店稀缺是经济表现不佳的一个促成因素。

catalyst.en: I see my role as being a catalyst for change.
catalyst.zh: 我认为我的角色是促成变革。

catalyst.en: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
catalyst.zh: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

emission.en: The emission of gases such as carbon dioxide should be stabilized at their present level.
emission.zh: 二氧化碳之类气体的排放应该被控制在目前的水平上。

emission.en: It is clear that the U.S. will meet its emission goals.
emission.zh: 很明显，美国将会达到其排放目标。

emission.en: Emission of these "greenhouse" gases contributes to global warming.
emission.zh: 这些“温室”气体的排放会导致全球变暖。

release.en: She commanded the release of the prisoners.
