release.zh: 释放这些囚犯被认为是危险的。

circulation.en: The coins were taken out of circulation.

circulation.zh: 这份报纸的发行量在继续增长。

circulation.en: A number of forged tickets are in circulation.
circulation.zh: 有一些假入场券在流通。

absorb.en: Steel barriers can bend and absorb the shock.
absorb.zh: 铁栅栏会弯曲并吸收冲击力。

absorb.en: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
absorb.zh: 黑色墙壁在白天吸收大量的热。

exceed.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose.
exceed.zh: 超过建议使用的剂量会有危险。

exceed.en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
exceed.zh: 你每天酒精摄入量不能超过两个单位。

exceed.en: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.
exceed.zh: 如果超出了透支限额，就有被银行加收费用的风险。

uptake.en: The drug increases the number of red cells in the blood, enhancing oxygen uptake by 10 percent.
uptake.zh: 这种药增加血液里的红细胞数量，将氧气吸收量提高百分之十。

uptake.en: Vitamin D, or calciferol, is another fat-soluble steroid vitamin that functions to stimulate calcium uptake from the gut and its deposition in bone.
uptake.zh: 维生素 D，或钙醇，是另一种脂溶性类固醇维生素，其功能是促进肠道吸收钙并强化骨骼。

uptake.en: Vitamin D, or calciferol, is another fat soluble steroid vitamin which functions to stimulate calcium uptake from the gut and its deposition in bone.
uptake.zh: 维生素 D，或钙醇，是另一种脂溶性类固醇维生素，其功能是促进钙从肠道吸收并沉积在骨头中。

nutrient.en: You said that the nitrogen cycle is also an important nutrient cycle.
nutrient.zh: 你说了，氮循环也是一个重要的营养循环。

nutrient.en: You can look at the nutrient broken down as a function of the percent daily values.
nutrient.zh: 你可以把分解的营养成分看做及每日建议摄取量的一个功能。

energy.en: It's a waste of time and energy.

surroundings.zh: 我们在富丽堂皇的环境中用餐。

surroundings.en: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
surroundings.zh: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

surroundings.en: Schumacher adapted effortlessly to his new surroundings.
surroundings.zh: 舒马赫毫不费力地适应了他的新环境。

mechanism.en: Pain acts as a natural defence mechanism.
mechanism.zh: 疼痛算是一种自然防护机制的作用。

mechanism.en: There's no mechanism for punishing arms exporters who break the rules.
mechanism.zh: 对于违反规定的军火出口商还没有惩罚机制。

mechanism.en: Senators say it is crucial that a mechanism is found to compensate for inflation.
mechanism.zh: 参议员们说找到抵消通货膨胀的机制是至关重要的。

counterbalance.en: Perhaps you have awful faults to counterbalance your few good points.
counterbalance.zh: 也许你有可怕的缺点来抵消你不多的优点。

counterbalance.en: The accused's right to silence was a vital counterbalance to the powers of the police.
counterbalance.zh: 被告人的沉默权对警方的权力是一种至关重要的抗衡。

counterbalance.en: Advertisers sometimes offset or counterbalance an exaggerated claim with a disclaimer—a qualification or condition on the claim.
counterbalance.zh: "广告商有时会通过补偿或者免责的形式，即对索赔要求的一种限定或条件，来平衡夸大的说辞。

protect.en: I, Long Aotian, swear to protect Liu Bo'er with my life!
protect.zh: 我龙傲天要誓死守护刘波儿！
protect.source: 《一年一度喜剧大赛》少爷和我

protect.en: My prime concern is to protect my property.
protect.zh: 我最关心的是保护自己的财产。

protect.en: Women banded together to protect each other.
protect.zh: 妇女们联合起来互相保护。

conservation.en: The benefits of conservation are both financial and aesthetic.
conservation.zh: 保护自然环境在经济上和美化环境上都有好处。

conservation.en: Scientific research and conservation are intimately connected.
conservation.zh: 科学研究与环境保护联系密切。

conservation.en: The district is under consideration for designation as a conservation area.
conservation.zh: 正在考虑将这个地区指定为保护区。

preserve.en: We will do everything to preserve peace.
preserve.zh: 我们将竭尽全力维护和平。

preserve.en: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.
preserve.zh: 维护和平的努力失败了。

extinguish.en: The firemen did their best to extinguish the fire.
extinguish.zh: 消防队员竭尽全力灭火。

extinguish.en: Apart from the fire, the water used to extinguish it also caused a lot of damage to Notre Dame Cathedral.
extinguish.zh: 除了大火，用于灭火的水也对巴黎圣母院造成了很大的破坏。

extinguish.en: However many generations succeed us in coming centuries, none of them will ever see this species that we extinguish.
extinguish.zh: 在未来的几个世纪里，无论我们传承了多少代人，他们都不会再看到被我们灭绝掉的物种。

demolish.en: Our intention was quite the opposite – to demolish rumours that have surrounded him since he took office.
demolish.zh: 我们的意图恰恰相反–要粉碎自他就职以来就缠着他的谣言。

demolish.en: We are going to demolish the old building.
demolish.zh: 我们准备爆破这座旧大楼。

demolish.en: A record she would demolish the following year!
demolish.zh: 而这个记录她明年肯定能打破。

perish.en: Most of the butterflies perish in the first frosts of autumn.
perish.zh: 大多数蝴蝶在秋季初霜来临时死亡。

perish.en: We are genetically programmed to disintegrate and perish, even under ideal conditions.
perish.zh: 我们生来就注定要分解死亡，即使在理想的条件下也是如此。

perish.en: If Italy does perish, the euro dies too.
perish.zh: 如果意大利挂了，那么欧元也会玩完的。

ruin.en: The bank stepped in to save the company from financial ruin.
ruin.zh: 银行的介入使这家公司免于经济崩溃。

infringe.en: People fear that security cameras could infringe personal liberties.
infringe.zh: 人们担心保安摄像机会侵犯人身自由。

infringe.en: "OK," he said, "maybe you don't infringe these seven patents."
infringe.zh: 好吧，他说，可能你们真的没有侵犯这七项专利。

infringe.en: These measures need not be intrusive, or infringe upon sovereignty.
infringe.zh: 这些措施不必具有干预性，无需涉及主权。

undermine.en: He accused me of slandering him and trying to undermine his position.
undermine.zh: 他指控我诽谤他并想削弱他的地位。

undermine.en: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement.
undermine.zh: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

undermine.en: Offering advice on each and every problem will undermine her feeling of being adult.
undermine.zh: 每个问题都为她提出忠告会逐渐削弱她的成年意识。

extinction.en: The mountain gorilla is on the verge of extinction.
extinction.zh: 居住在山区的大猩猩已濒临灭绝。

extinction.en: They have driven the rhino to the edge of extinction.
extinction.zh: 他们已经把犀牛逼到了灭绝的边缘。

extinction.en: The loggers say their jobs are faced with extinction because of declining timber sales.
extinction.zh: 樵夫们说他们的工作因不断下降的木材销售而面临消亡。

outcome.zh: 谁也无法预料结果如何。

outcome.en: The outcome didn't surprise me at all.
outcome.zh: 这一结果完全在我的意料之中。

seasonal.en: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
seasonal.zh: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

seasonal.en: The figures aren't adjusted for seasonal variations.
seasonal.zh: 这些数字未作季节性变化调整。
许多植物是季节性生长的。

impact.zh: 一股剧烈的冲击力将她猛地向前抛了出去。

impact.en: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
impact.zh: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

impact.en: Such schemes mean little unless they impact people.
impact.zh: 除非能对人们造成影响，否则这样的计划意义不大。

pattern.en: All three attacks followed the same pattern.
The pattern is essentially the same in all cases.
pattern.zh: 这种模式在所有情况下基本相同。

pattern.en: Mornings in our house always follow a set pattern.
pattern.zh: 在我们家，每天上午的生活总是遵循一种固定的模式。

experimental.en: The equipment is still at the experimental stage.
experimental.zh: 这种设备仍处于试验阶段。

experimental.en: The senator is ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.
experimental.zh: 该参议员已准备好争取那条禁令的试验性解除。

experimental.en: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages.
experimental.zh: 然而，目前免疫疗法还处于试验阶段。

favorable.en: Some plants can even survive in favorable microhabitats above the snow line.
favorable.zh: 有些植物甚至可以在雪线以上的有利的微环境中生存。

favorable.en: Favorable policies are in effect to encourage employees' professional development.
favorable.zh: 这些优惠政策实际上是为了鼓励员工的专业发展。

productive.en: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive.
productive.zh: 他对下一轮会谈也会富有成效充满了希望。

productive.en: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation's productive capacity.
productive.zh: 过于庞大的重整军备开支会给国家的生产力带来难以承受的负担。

effective.zh: 所有这些方法都同等有效。

effective.en: The world desperately needs an effective WTO.
effective.zh: 世界急切需要一个有效的世贸组织。

effective.en: Humour is a more effective defence than violence.
effective.zh: 幽默是比暴力更有效的防御武器。

considerable.zh: 对这栋建筑物的损坏相当严重。

considerable.en: She argued her case with considerable passion.
considerable.zh: 她相当激动地为自己的主张提出论据。

considerable.en: The argument seemed to have considerable merit.
considerable.zh: 这个论点似乎有相当大的价值。

efficient.en: The service at the hotel is efficient and unobtrusive.
efficient.zh: 那旅馆的服务工作有效率而不夸张。

efficient.en: Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
efficient.zh: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

efficient.en: The service at the hotel is efficient and unobtrusive.
efficient.zh: 那旅馆的服务工作有效率而不夸张。

immense.en: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident.
immense.zh: 摆在俄罗斯的欧洲商人面前的巨大困难是极其明显的。

immense.en: If it had hit the Earth, it would have made a crater 100 miles across and thrown up an immense cloud of dust.
immense.zh: 如果它撞上了地球，就会砸出一个100英里宽的大坑并扬起巨大的尘埃云团。

massive.en: We ran up a massive hotel bill.
massive.zh: 我们累积了大笔的旅馆费。
他们有一座非常大的房子。
这间房子很大但无气派可言。

minimal.en: The work was carried out at minimal cost.
minimal.zh: 这项工作是以最少的开销完成的。

minimal.en: The cooperation between the two is minimal.
minimal.zh: 两者之间的合作是最低程度的。

minimal.en: There's only a minimal amount of risk involved.

maximal.en: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement."
maximal.zh: 詹妮·拉德斯基在她的数字产品研究中宣称：“发展科技的目的就是为了让你沉浸其中，生产数字产品是为了促进最大的参与度。”

maximal.en: During development, maximal security is not productive.
maximal.zh: 在开发期间，最大化安全性无助于生产。

maximal.en: Technically, a gap is a maximal sequence of contiguous Spaces.
maximal.zh: 从技术上讲，间隙是最大的连续空格序列。

optimal.en: You can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
optimal.zh: 你可以通过子问题的局部最优方案从而得到全局优化解决方案。

optimal.en: In the first feasible region above, the optimal solution is the right vertex of the solution space.
optimal.zh: 在上面的第一个可行域中，优化解决方案是解析空间中的右顶点。

optimal.en: Extreme high-performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
optimal.zh: 极限高强度运动可能会带来最佳的心血管功能，但这些运动肯定无法延长寿命。

biologist.en: Dingle is an evolutionary biologist who studies insects.
biologist.zh: 丁格尔是一位研究昆虫的进化生物学家。

biologist.en: Biologist Edmond Mouton runs the nutria control program for Louisiana.
biologist.zh: 生物学家 Edmond Mouton 负责路易斯安那州的海狸鼠控制项目。

biologist.en: To prove his point, Cialdini cites an interview with molecular biologist James Watson.
biologist.zh: 为了证明他的观点，Cialdini 引用了分子生物学家 James Watson 的采访。

zoologist.en: Zoologist Eugene Morton has propounded a general theory of the vocal sounds that animals make.
zoologist.zh: 动物学家尤金·莫顿提出了一个有关动物发声的通论。

zoologist.en: In a latest reanalysis of Gavan's data, nevertheless, zoologist Elizabeth Watts has found that as chimpanzees reach sexual maturity, the growth rate of their limbs accelerates.
zoologist.zh: 然而，动物学家伊丽莎白·沃茨在对加万的数据进行的最新再分析中发现，随着黑猩猩达到性成熟，它们四肢的生长速度会加快。

zoologist.en: As a zoologist focusing on the studies of apes and monkeys, I've been studying why humans evolved to become the naked ape, and why skin comes in so many different shades around the world.
zoologist.zh: 作为一名专注于猿类和猴子研究的动物学家，我一直在研究为什么人类会进化成裸猿，以及为什么世界各地的人们皮肤会有这么多不同的色调。

ecologist.en: An ecologist who studies a pond today may well find it relatively unchanged in a year's time.
ecologist.zh: 如今研究池塘的生态学者很可能会发现，池塘在一年之内基本没什么变化。

ecologist.en: "Many factors contributed to the decline", said Patrick McIntyre, an ecologist who was the lead author of the study.
ecologist.zh: 该研究的领头作者、生态学家帕特里克·麦克伦泰尔表示：“许多因素导致了这种下降。”

ecologist.en: "Our philosophy with the island has always been, 'OK, remove the threats and let the island go back to what it was'," says ecologist Christina Boser.
ecologist.zh: 生态学家克里斯蒂娜·波沙说：“对待这座岛的理念一直是，‘好的，消除威胁，让岛屿回归它原本的样子’。”

botanist.en: A young English botanist named Charles Darwin, the author of the theory of evolution, was the first European to see alerces, with trunks that had a circumference of 130 feet.
botanist.zh: 进化论的作者、年轻的英国植物学家查尔斯·达尔文，是第一个看到落叶柏树干圆周长达一百三十英尺的欧洲人。

botanist.en: What the botanist tells us after a number of imperfect lectures, the flower proclaimed in a minute.
botanist.zh: 植物学家需要开几次不完美讲座之后才能告诉我们的事情，花在一分钟内就告诉我们了。
亨里是英国的植物学家。

mammal.en: A whale is a kind of mammal.
Bats is the only mammal that can fly.
mammal.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一能飞的哺乳动物。

primate.en: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
primate.zh: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长目动物。

primate.en: You won't ever find feathers on a mammal or gills on a primate.
primate.zh: 你在哺乳动物身上找不到羽毛，在灵长类动物身上找不到腮。

primate.en: In this case, the animals were lemurs –a type of primate related to monkeys and apes.
primate.zh: 在此项案例中，被实验的动物是狐猴——这是一种与猴子和猿有关的灵长目动物。

vertebrate.en: The left side of most vertebrate brains, for example, seems to process and control feeding.
vertebrate.zh: 例如，大多数脊椎动物的左脑似乎负责的是处理和控制进食。

vertebrate.en: Thus the anaerobic energy reserves of a vertebrate are proportional to the size of the animal.
vertebrate.zh: 因此，脊椎动物的无氧能量储备与动物的大小成正比。

vertebrate.en: This is not surprising because the design of any flying vertebrate is subject to aerodynamic constraints.
vertebrate.zh: 这并不奇怪，因为任何会飞的脊椎动物的设计都受到空气动力学的限制。

reptile.en: I mean, crocodiles' brains are the most developed of any reptile.
reptile.zh: 我的意思是，鳄鱼的大脑是所有爬行动物中最发达的。

reptile.en: For today, let's look at a reptile, a predator that hasn't evolved much in the last seventy million years.
reptile.zh: 今天，让我们来看看一种爬行动物，一种在过去七千万年里没有进化很多的食肉动物。

reptile.en: 55,000 reptile skins from India, 19,000 big-eye thresher shark fins in Ecuador and 23 metric tonnes of pangolin in Asia have all been seized.
reptile.zh: 来自印度的55000张爬行动物皮、厄瓜多尔的19000只大眼长尾鲨鳍和亚洲的23吨穿山甲都被查获。

amphibian.en: Why does the speaker choose that amphibian as her representative of a public creature?
amphibian.zh: 为什么那位演讲者要选择这种两栖动物作为公众生物的代表呢？

amphibian.en: The world is an amphibian smorgasbord to the Epomis beetles.
amphibian.zh: 这个世界对于青步甲来说简直就是一个两栖类美食餐厅。

amphibian.en: At first this amphibian deals with the cooler days by burying itself in the soil.
amphibian.zh: 起初，天气乍凉的时候，这种两栖动物将自己埋在土壤里。

carnivore.en: It's a gharial, perhaps the largest terrestrial carnivore ever to walk the earth, larger than T-Rex.
carnivore.zh: 这是一条长吻鄂，可能是地球上有史以来最大的陆地食肉动物，比霸王龙还要大。

carnivore.en: The polar bear is the largest terrestrial carnivore, being more than twice as big as the Siberian Tiger!
carnivore.zh: 北极熊是陆地上最大的肉食性动物，比西伯利亚虎都要大两倍多！

carnivore.en: With our present data, we don't know what precisely the interactions were between a primate and a big carnivore.
carnivore.zh: 根据我们现有的数据，我们无法确切了解灵长目动物与大型食肉动物之间的相互作用是什么。

herbivore.en: The herbivore prey is of a different mind.
herbivore.zh: 食草动物的猎物有不同的想法。

herbivore.en: You probably would call me a vegetarian. But scientists call me a herbivore because I only eat leaves, grass, and other plants.
herbivore.zh: 你可能会称我为素食者。但科学家称我为草食动物，因为我只吃叶子、草和其它植物。

herbivore.en: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible and smell wise.
herbivore.zh: 相比之下，食草动物的肉更易食用，闻起来更美味。

creature.zh: 熊猫是一种胆小的动物。
他是个离群索居且胆怯的人。

creature.en: The dormouse is a shy, nocturnal creature.
creature.zh: 榛睡鼠是一种在夜间活动的胆小动物。

wildlife.zh: 这个地区的野生动植物很多。

wildlife.en: Development of the area would endanger wildlife.
wildlife.zh: 开发这一地区将会危及野生生物。

wildlife.en: It takes time and patience to photograph wildlife.
wildlife.zh: 拍摄野生动物要肯花时间，要有毅力。

fauna.en: This resulted in the "biome," a combination of coexisting flora and fauna.
fauna.zh: 这就产生了生物群系的概念——一种植物群和动物群共存的结合体。

fauna.en: The news is constantly reporting what human endeavours have caused extensive damage to flora and fauna in the planet.
fauna.zh: 新闻正不断报道人类给地球动植物群造成严重破坏的所作所为。

fauna.en: The deep sea typically has a sparse fauna dominated by tiny worms and crustaceans, with an even sparser distribution of larger animals.
fauna.zh: 深海通常有稀疏的动物群，以微小的蠕虫和甲壳类动物为主，更大的动物分布更少。

flora.en: Lichens were probably the first successful flora.
flora.zh: 地衣可能是第一个成功的植物群。

flora.en: This resulted in the "biome," a combination of coexisting flora and fauna.
flora.zh: 这就产生了生物群系的概念——一种植物群和动物群共存的结合体。

species.zh: 大熊猫是一种濒危物种。

flock.en: They kept a small flock of sheep.
The explosion scattered a flock of birds roosting in the trees.
flock.zh: 爆炸声把栖息在树丛中的鸟群惊散了。

flock.en: What was that big dark animal coming towards his flock?
flock.zh: 那是什么大型黑色动物冲他的羊群来了？

swarm.en: A swarm of people encircled the hotel.
swarm.zh: 一大群人包围了这家酒店。

swarm.en: At the time, this was the largest swarm of robots ever tested.
swarm.zh: 当时，这是测试过的最大的机器人群。

swarm.en: A network swarm is all edges and therefore open-ended any way you come at it.
swarm.zh: 一个网络群到处都是边，因此，无论你以何种方式进入，它都是开放的。

herd.en: She pushed her way through a herd of lunchtime drinkers.
herd.zh: 她从一群午餐时饮酒的人中间挤了过去。

herd.en: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower.
herd.zh: 一群山羊正在啃着塔基周围的草皮。

herd.en: With no natural predators on the island, the herd increased rapidly.
herd.zh: 由于岛上没有天然食肉动物，牧群的数量迅速增加。

throng.en: We pushed our way through the throng.

throng.zh: 一位官员从人群中挤过。

crowd.en: Please don't crowd. If anyone gets hurt, I'll be heartbroken, okay?
crowd.zh: 大家别拥挤，每个人受伤我都会很伤心的ok？
满怀期待的一群人聚在了一起。

beast.zh: 他将他们称之为“野兽机器”。

beast.en: Now we have a beast of a different kind.
beast.zh: 现在我们有一种不同的野兽。

beast.en: He saw the public as a great beast or a bewildered herd.
beast.zh: 他认为大众是野兽或者是迷路的羊群。

brute.en: "Badger," said the Rat, "_I_feel like a brute; I wonder what YOU feel like?"
brute.zh: “班杰，”水鼠兰特说，“我觉得自己像个没良心的野兽；我想知道你是什么感觉？”

brute.en: He was a great brawny brute of a man.
brute.zh: 他是个魁梧壮实、粗野的人。

brute.en: You've forgotten my birthday again, you brute!
brute.zh: 你又忘了我的生日了，你这个没良心的！

cruel.en: He was a cruel and vicious man.
cruel.zh: 他是一个残忍而凶恶的人。

cruel.en: This is a little cruel, but there you go.
cruel.zh: 这是有点儿残忍，但也没办法。

derive.en: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.
derive.zh: 大部分病人能从翻阅旧相册中获得乐趣。

derive.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
derive.zh: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

derive.en: They derive greater pleasure from buying things.
derive.zh: 他们从买东西中获得更大的快乐。

originate.zh: 所有的碳水化合物均来源于植物。

originate.en: Current services originate in two key measures.
originate.zh: 当前的服务起源于两个关键措施。

originate.en: Regularly flowing rivers and streams that originate within arid lands are known as "endogenous".
originate.zh: 起源于干旱地区的流动性河流和溪流通常被称为“内源河流”。

stem.en: Stem cell research is supported by many doctors.
stem.zh: 干细胞研究得到很多医生的支持。

stem.en: The plant's stem is marked with thin green longitudinal stripes.
stem.zh: 这种植物的茎上长有绿色细长条纹。

stem.en: 'Writ' is the stem of the forms 'writes', 'writing' and 'written'.

descendant.en: He was an O'Conor and a direct descendant of the last High King of Ireland.
descendant.zh: 他属于奥康纳家族，是爱尔兰最后一位君王的嫡系后裔。

descendant.en: These adaptations served their descendant well as they invaded land.
descendant.zh: 这些适应机制在它们的后代进化成陆生生物时起了很好的协助作用。

descendant.en: This method tells you all information you need to know: whether one node is descendant of an ancestor of the other, whether it is before or after, and so on.
descendant.zh: 这个方法告诉您所有想知道的信息：一个节点是否是另一个节点的祖先的后代，它是在前面还是后面呢，等等。

offspring.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
offspring.zh: 后代体内含有父母亲基因图谱的混合。

offspring.en: Eleanor was now less anxious about her offspring than she had once been.
offspring.zh: 这时，埃莉诺已不像以前那样为子女担忧了。

offspring.en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway.
offspring.zh: 这颗彗星将于2061年返回，到时我们都可以看到它。哦，无论如何，我们子孙是可以看到的。

ancestor.en: Her Chinese friends referred to the empress as their venerable ancestor.
ancestor.zh: 她的中国朋友们称那位皇后是令他们尊敬的祖先。

ancestor.en: Their ancestor is different from that of micro bats.
ancestor.zh: 它们的祖先与微型蝙蝠的祖先不同。

ancestor.en: My ancestor was a preacher, traveling around the countryside.
ancestor.zh: 我的祖先是一位游历于乡间的传教士。

subgroup.en: In this paper, closed groups and proper subgroup are classified.
subgroup.zh: 本文对闭群和真子群进行了分类。

subgroup.en: The subgroup members are treated as in step 2.
subgroup.zh: 子组成员按照步骤2进行处理。

interbreed.en: Eventually the subpopulations become so genetically distinct that they cannot interbreed even if the physical barriers between them were removed.
interbreed.zh: 最终，这些亚种群在基因上变得如此不同，以至于即使消除了它们之间的物理障碍，它们也无法杂交。

interbreed.en: High rates of straying can be problematic because misdirected fish may interbreed with the existing stock to such a degree that any local adaptations that are present become diluted.
interbreed.zh: 高偏离率可能是一个问题，因为被误导的鱼可能会与现有种群杂交，而这种杂交的程度会稀释现有的任何当地适应能力。

hybridize.en: Marine and freshwater stickleback can hybridize in contact zones.
hybridize.zh: 海水和淡水棘鱼可以在接触区杂交。

hybridize.en: They do plan to hybridize humans, not doing away with our species, but improving it.
hybridize.zh: 他们计划和人类杂交，而不是消灭我们这个物种，而是进行改良。

hybridize.en: Take a look at the application that you will hybridize by moving part of its infrastructure.
hybridize.zh: 接下来，让我们先看一下这个通过转移部分基础设施实现混合的应用程序。

breed.en: He used to breed dogs for the police.
breed.zh: 他过去为警察部门养殖狗。

breed.en: Frogs will usually breed in any convenient pond.
breed.zh: 青蛙通常在任何适宜的水塘里繁殖。

breed.en: Many animals breed only at certain times of the year.
breed.zh: 很多动物只在一年的某个时候交配繁殖。

feed.en: The printer has an automatic paper feed.
feed.zh: 这台打印机有自动进纸装置。

proliferate.en: For example, an excess of certain proteins can cause cells to proliferate abnormally and become cancerous; a lack of the protein insulin results in diabetes.
proliferate.zh: 例如，某些蛋白质的过量会导致细胞异常增殖并癌变；胰岛素蛋白质的缺乏会导致糖尿病。

proliferate.en: At the other extreme, we might successfully translocate the species, but within five or ten years that species could proliferate and become an invasive species.
proliferate.zh: 在另一个极端，我们可能会地转移这个物种，但是在5至10年内，这个物种可能会激增并成为一个入侵物种。

proliferate.en: In the corporate environment, it's easy for worksheet files to proliferate rapidly.
proliferate.zh: 在公司环境中，工作表文件很容易迅速扩散。

sterility.en: The disease can cause sterility in men and women.
sterility.zh: 这种疾病可能导致男女不育。

sterility.en: This disease causes sterility in both males and females.
sterility.zh: 这种疾病会导致男女不育。

sterility.en: The zone of massive sterility coincides geographically, grosso modo, with the regions in central Congo
sterility.zh: 大范围不育区在地理条件上大体上和刚果中部地区一致。

courtship.en: Courtship is somewhat vocal with a lot of displaying by the male.
courtship.zh: 雄性动物的求偶有点大肆声张的，他们要大力炫耀自己。

courtship.en: After a three-weekend courtship, Pam accepted Randy's proposal of marriage.
courtship.zh: 经过一段为期3个周末的恋爱，帕姆接受了兰迪的求婚。
这是一场旋风般的求爱。

mate.zh: 他已经找到了理想的配偶。

mate.en: This allows the pair to mate properly and stops the hen from staying in the nest.
mate.zh: 这可以使这一对正常交配同时也阻止雌禽待在窝里。
它在为它的伴侣找吃的呢。

hatch.zh: 这些卵很快孵化成幼虫。

hatch.zh: 母的必须找个温暖的地方孵蛋。

spawn.en: Despite living in different waters, all eels spawn in the sea.
spawn.zh: 尽管生活在不同的水域，所有的鳗鱼都在海里产卵。

spawn.en: Nobody knows how they do it with such accuracy, or why eels spawn where they do.
spawn.zh: 没有人知道它们如何做到那么准确，或是鳗鱼为什么要在大海里产卵。

spawn.en: The light comes from female firefly squids, which spawn in spring, then die and wash ashore.
spawn.zh: 这种光来自雌性萤火虫乌贼，它们在春天产卵，然后死亡，被冲到岸上。

brood.en: Where did the rest of the brood fly to?
brood.zh: 一窝中其他的飞到哪儿去了?

brood.en: Nor does it explain why, in a species where one parent determines handedness, a brood is not exclusively right-or left-handed when the offspring would have the same genetic predisposition.
brood.zh: 这也不能解释为什么在一个由父母一方决定用利手的物种中，当后代具有相同的遗传倾向时，他们并非完全是右撇子或左撇子。

brood.en: Nor does it explain why, in a species where one parent determines handedness, a brood is not exclusively right or left-handed when the offspring would have the same genetic predisposition.
brood.zh: 这也不能解释为什么在一个由父母一方决定利手的物种中，当后代具有相同的遗传倾向时，他们并非完全是右撇子或左撇子。

lay.zh: 她躺在那儿，直到天亮才睡着。

paw.en: His brow resting on his paw, he pondered long and deeply.
paw.zh: 他用爪子支着额头，沉思了许久。

mature.en: Jane is very mature for her age.

fin.en: Help save the sharks! Shark fin soup is popular in northern China.
fin.zh: 帮助拯救鲨鱼！鱼翅汤在中国北方很流行。

fin.zh: 蜜雪儿伸出她的手，轻柔地触摸着其中一只海豚的鳍。

fin.en: Do they realize that they're killing a whole shark each time they enjoy a bowl of shark fin soup?
fin.zh: 他们是否意识到，每次享用一碗鱼翅汤时，他们就会杀死一整条鲨鱼？

plume.zh: 1982年，一名飞行员在印度尼西亚的爪哇岛遇到了从喷发的加隆贡火山喷发出的火山灰羽。

plume.zh: 夏威夷岛链的自然历史清楚地显示了太平洋板块在一个固定的羽流上的运动。

plume.en: The surface mark of an established plume is a hot spot—an isolated region of volcanoes and uplifted terrain located far from the edge of a surface plate.
plume.zh: 一个已形成的烟羽的表面标志是一个热点——一个远离表面板块边缘的火山和隆起地形的孤立区域。

bristle.en: His lies made her bristle with rage.
bristle.zh: 他的谎话使她火冒三丈。

fur.zh: 狩猎这种动物是为了获取其毛皮。

curl.zh: 让卷发自然地风干以最大限度地增加头发的卷曲和光泽。

parasite.en: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through faecal matter.

parasite.zh: 血吸虫病的诊断方法是，检测粪便或尿液标本中寄生虫卵。

parasite.en: An example of a parasite is a tapeworm that lives inside the intestines of a larger animal and absorbs nutrients from its host.
parasite.zh: 寄生虫的一个典例是绦虫，它生活在更大的动物的肠道内，从宿主那里吸收营养。

spider.zh: 蜘蛛在窗外结了一张完整的网。

mosquito.zh: 一只蚊子就能传染很多人。

mosquito.zh: 我撩开蚊帐，跳下床，拉开百叶窗。

mosquito.zh: 最近几十年，基孔肯雅热的蚊子媒介已传播到欧洲和美洲。

butterfly.en: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
butterfly.zh: 蝴蝶在花丛中飞来飞去。

butterfly.en: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
butterfly.zh: 它是一只非常漂亮的蝴蝶，翅膀张开有2英寸宽。

butterfly.en: The caterpillar will eventually metamorphose into a butterfly.
butterfly.zh: 毛毛虫最终将蜕变成一只蝴蝶。

penguin.zh: 这只企鹅名为皮埃尔，25岁，来自加利福尼亚科学院。

penguin.zh: 企鹅出版社希望这个网站能够吸引代理商、编辑和出版商来挖掘新的人才。

cricket.zh: 这场板球比赛极少有让观众兴奋的地方。

cricket.zh: 夏季学期里我们常在村里的空地上玩板球。

seal.zh: 他揭去封蜡，把纸卷展开。

seal.en: The leak was eventually traced to a broken seal.
seal.zh: 最后查出泄漏是由于密封处破裂所致。

camel.zh: 那头骆驼驮的是谷物吗？

camel.zh: 骆驼是一种哺乳动物，但是几维鸟是一种鸟。

elephant.en: The kids had a ride on an elephant at the zoo.
elephant.zh: 在动物园里，孩子们骑着大象走了一圈。

elephant.zh: 象是现今陆地上最大的动物。

dragon.zh: 每年端午节镇子里都要举行赛龙舟活动。

wolf.zh: 那只狼在那颗树上抓挠，还嗥叫了整整一个晚上。

wolf.zh: 公羊队坚忍不拔，在雷诺市以32比28的比分击败了内华达狼群队。

汉斯，你的小牛犊在哪儿呢？

zebra.zh: 白氏斑马是一种极其美丽的斑马变种。
斑马，斑马,你听到什么了？

ivory.en: He showed him how to blow into the ivory mouthpiece.
ivory.zh: 他给他演示了如何把气吹进象牙吹口。

ivory.en: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
ivory.zh: 身处象牙塔里，他们并不真正懂得毒品犯罪多么有害。

donkey.en: Time is like a wild donkey. Once it starts running, it never stops.
donkey.zh: 时间像一头野驴呀，跑起来就不停。

donkey.en: The donkey brayed and tried to bolt.
donkey.zh: 这头驴嘶叫着，企图挣脱缰绳。

donkey.en: A mule is a cross between a horse and a donkey.
donkey.zh: 骡是马和驴杂交的产物。

saddle.en: I want to be gone from here as soon as we can saddle up.
saddle.zh: 我想一配好鞍就离开这儿。

saddle.en: Why don't we saddle a couple of horses and go for a ride?
saddle.zh: 为什么我们不给几匹马配上鞍骑着转转？

saddle.en: It had a saddle with springs sticking out, which wore away the seat of my trousers.
saddle.zh: 马鞍上的弹簧翘了出来，磨坏了我臀部的裤子。

falcon.en: "The Wandering Falcon" is not a long book.
falcon.zh: 《流浪的猎鹰》这本书篇幅并不长。

falcon.en: The first launch of Falcon 9 could change the course of human space flight.
falcon.zh: 猎鹰9号的首次发射可能会改变人类太空飞行的进程。

falcon.en: With nine engines on the first stage, Falcon 9 can reach orbit even if one or more fails.
falcon.zh: 猎鹰9号的第一级有9个引擎，即使一个或多个引擎故障，它仍然可以到达预定轨道。

eagle.zh: 一只鹰在头顶上空盘旋。

eagle.en: The eagle was an emblem of strength and courage.
eagle.zh: 鹰是力量和勇气的象征。

harness.zh: 兽医临时凑成了一套马具。

harness.en: Turkey plans to harness the waters of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers for big hydro-electric power projects.
harness.zh: 土耳其计划利用底格里斯河与幼发拉底河的水来建造大型水力发电工程。

harness.en: You can easily harness the power of both.
harness.zh: 您可以轻易地利用二者的能力。

hawk.zh: 一只鹰在小山的上空翱翔。

hawk.en: The hawk poised in mid-air ready to swoop.
hawk.zh: 老鹰在半空中盘旋，准备俯冲。

hawk.en: Can you all watch me like a hawk a second?
hawk.zh: 你们能像老鹰一样看我一会儿吗？

owl.zh: 一只猫头鹰在附近啼叫。

owl.en: The owl seems to have deserted its nest.
owl.zh: 这只猫头鹰似乎不要这个窝了。

owl.en: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
owl.zh: 猫头鹰对于很多加利福利亚的印第安人来说是神圣的。

sparrow.zh: 麻雀回答说：“还不够可怜！”

sparrow.en: The sparrow gave the old man a basket of gold and silver.
sparrow.zh: 麻雀给了老人一篮子金子和银子。

sparrow.en: I am glad you are well and have good friends, dear sparrow.
sparrow.zh: 亲爱的麻雀，我很高兴你过得很好，还有好朋友。

pigeon.en: A large Pigeon flew far above him.
pigeon.zh: 一只大鸽子从他头顶上飞过。

pigeon.en: Oh, dear Pigeon, how I wish I had your wings!
pigeon.zh: 噢，亲爱的鸽子，我多么希望我有你的翅膀啊！

pigeon.en: Toward evening the Pigeon said: "I'm very thirsty!"
pigeon.zh: 傍晚时分，鸽子说：“我渴极了！”

swallow.en: You are asked to swallow a capsule containing vitamin B.
swallow.zh: 你被要求吞下一颗含维生素B的胶囊。

swallow.en: After the operation you may find it difficult to chew and swallow.
swallow.zh: 手术后你咀嚼和吞咽都会感到困难。

swallow.en: Sometimes he regurgitates the food we give him because he cannot swallow.
swallow.zh: 有时他会倒嚼我们喂给他吃的食物，因为他无法吞咽。

crow.en: The wings of a crow can never cover up the sun.
crow.zh: 乌鸦的翅膀遮不住太阳。

crow.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
crow.zh: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

crow.en: He wanted to make his critics eat crow.
crow.zh: 他想迫使批评他的人们认错。

swan.en: The team's mascot is a giant swan.
swan.zh: 这个队的吉祥物是只大天鹅。
天鹅大声地拍打着翅膀。

swan.en: 'Swan Lake' is one of the great classical ballets.
swan.zh: 《天鹅湖》是一部伟大的古典芭蕾舞剧。

goose.en: The big white goose became a black goose.
goose.zh: 这只雪白的大鹅变成了一只黑鹅。

goose.en: It's time for bed, little goose, little goose.
goose.zh: 该睡觉啦，小小鹅，小小鹅。

cock.en: The cock crows and the dawn chorus begins.
cock.zh: 公鸡叫了,众鸟的清晨鸣唱随之开始了。

cock.en: Do you hear the cock crow, Tukey?
cock.zh: 杜克，你听到公鸡叫了吗？

cock.en: The hen did this and the cock was cheerful again.
cock.zh: 母鸡照做了，公鸡又高兴了。

hare.en: A hare started off into the forest.
hare.zh: 一只野兔迅速跑进树林。

rat.en: He held his breath as a rat scuttled past.
rat.zh: 见一只老鼠跑过，他屏住了呼吸。

rat.en: Mr. Rat, Mr. Rat, I'm near the river.
rat.zh: 老鼠先生，老鼠先生，我在河边。

rat.en: A rat? Yes, a rat. Right next to you.
rat.zh: 老鼠？对，一只老鼠，就在你身旁。

mouse.en: He moves the cursor, clicks the mouse.
The mouse ran away, squeaking with fear.
mouse.zh: 那只老鼠吓得尖叫着溜了。

mouse.en: A cat often plays with a mouse before the kill.
mouse.zh: 猫在咬死老鼠之前常常要耍弄它一番。

frog.en: We dissected a frog in biology class.
frog.zh: 我们在生物课上解剖了一只青蛙。

frog.en: The frog plopped back into the water.
frog.zh: 青蛙扑通一声跳回水中。

sting.zh: 小心给荨麻扎着—荨麻有刺！

sting.en: A wasp or bee sting is painful but not necessarily serious.
sting.zh: 被黄蜂或蜜蜂蜇一下疼是疼，但未必碍事。

bite.en: The dog gave me a playful bite.
bite.zh: 狗闹着玩地咬了我一下。
大多数欧洲蜘蛛不咬人。

roar.zh: 我们听见了狮子的吼声。

roar.en: I could barely hear above the roar of traffic.
roar.zh: 过往车辆的轰鸣声使我几乎什么也听不见。
响起了一片表示赞成的喊叫声。

bark.en: Deer had stripped the tree of its bark.
Deer had stripped all the bark off the tree.
I set the log on the ground and shaved off the bark.
bark.zh: 我把原木放在地上，然后刨掉树皮。

rub.en: She gave her knee a quick rub.
She sometimes asks if I want a back rub.
rub.zh: 她有时问我是否想要一次背部按摩。

rub.en: You may need to give the floor a rub-down with glasspaper.
rub.zh: 你可能得用玻璃砂纸打磨一下地板。

creep.zh: 不安全感可能会悄然而生。
不知不觉间，开始出错了。

creep.en: It makes my flesh creep to think of it.
creep.zh: 一想起它我就心惊肉跳。

habitat.en: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
habitat.zh: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

habitat.en: This species has nearly died out because its habitat is being destroyed.
habitat.zh: 因栖息地正受到破坏这一物种已濒于灭绝。

habitat.en: To save remaining herds and habitat, the national parks department is planning to cull 2000 elephants.
habitat.zh: 为挽救余下的兽群及其栖息地，国家公园管理部门正计划杀掉2000头大象。

crawl.en: I felt something crawl up my arm.
crawl.zh: 我觉得有个东西顺着手臂往上爬。

crawl.en: Our baby is just starting to crawl.
crawl.zh: 我们的宝宝刚开始会爬。

crawl.en: I began to crawl on my hands and knees toward the door.
crawl.zh: 我开始手脚并用向门爬去。

hive.en: A dark cloud of bees comes swarming out of the hive.
hive.zh: 黑压压的一大群蜜蜂从那座蜂巢涌过来。

hive.en: Glass hives offer a close-up view of the bees at work, with the queen bee in each hive marked by a white dot.
hive.zh: 玻璃蜂房可以近距离观察工作中的蜜蜂，每个蜂房的蜂王都被打上白点标记。

hive.en: Tapping on the hive excited the bees.

nest.en: I can see an eagle's nest on the rocks.
nest.zh: 我能看到岩石上的一个鹰巢。

nest.en: The owl seems to have deserted its nest.
nest.zh: 这只猫头鹰似乎不要这个窝了。

nest.en: Some species may nest in close proximity to each other.
nest.zh: 一些鸟类可能彼此紧挨着筑巢。

cage.zh: 这个笼子闻起来有粪便味。

cage.en: He opened up a cage and lifted out a 6ft python.
cage.zh: 他打开一个笼子，提起了一条6英尺长的蟒蛇。

cage.en: Keep the dog confined in a suitable travelling cage.
cage.zh: 把狗关进适于旅行的笼子里。

cell.en: Each cell of our bodies contains 46 chromosomes.
cell.zh: 我们体内的每个细胞都有46条染色体。

cell.en: Stem cell research is supported by many doctors.
cell.zh: 干细胞研究得到很多医生的支持。

cell.en: Sickle-cell anaemia is passed on through a recessive gene.
cell.zh: 镰状细胞贫血通过隐性基因遗传给后代。

barn.zh: 他有意朝谷仓大步走去。

barn.en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
barn.zh: 1979年，作为折扣酒品专卖店的立可仓生意兴隆。

stable.zh: 她的心理状态不十分稳定。

stable.en: She led the horse back into the stable.
stable.zh: 她把那匹马牵回了马厩。

stable.en: Conditions were set fair for stable economic development.
stable.zh: 形势适合经济稳定发展。

barrier.en: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
barrier.zh: 我认识到我必须得克服语言障碍。

barrier.en: The Yangtze river is a natural barrier to the north-east.
barrier.zh: 长江是东北方向的一道天然屏障。

barrier.en: Ozone is the earth's barrier against ultra-violet radiation.
barrier.zh: 臭氧是地球防止紫外线辐射的屏障。

bar.en: At the bar he ordered a cider.
bar.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯苹果汁。
她坐在酒吧的柜台那里。

anatomy.en: Cadavers are used to teach med students surgical skills and anatomy.
anatomy.zh: 尸体是教授医学院学生外科手术技术和解剖用的。

anatomy.en: One use would be to make one's corpse available to the study of anatomy.
anatomy.zh: 一个用处是可以把一个人的尸体用于解剖学研究。

anatomy.en: He is now learning anatomy, algebra, biology and geometry which are all science and math courses.
anatomy.zh: 他现在正在学习解剖学、代数、生物学和几何学，这些都属于科学和数学课程。

gene.en: The gene for asthma has been identified.
gene.zh: 哮喘病的基因已被识别。

gene.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
gene.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

gene.en: The gene is only part of the causation of illness.
gene.zh: 基因只是疾病的部分诱因。

epidemic.en: Today, doctors are fearing a worldwide epidemic.
epidemic.zh: 如今，医生们在担心一次世界性的流行。

epidemic.en: Hospitals were already fully extended because of the epidemic.
epidemic.zh: 这场流行病已使各医院以最大负荷运转。

epidemic.en: Health officials have successfully confined the epidemic to the Tabatinga area.
epidemic.zh: 卫生官员们已经成功地将该传染病控制在塔巴廷加地区。

germ.en: This was the germ of a book.
germ.zh: 这是一本书的创作萌芽。

germ.en: There was a thick growth of staph germ.
germ.zh: 葡萄球菌的胚芽生长得很茂盛。

germ.en: The germ of protest has continued to spread.
germ.zh: 抗议行动的胚芽还在四处蔓延。

bacteria.en: Warm milk is the ideal breeding ground for bacteria.
bacteria.zh: 温牛奶是细菌理想的繁殖地。

microbe.en: Genes involved in microbe siderophore production and uptake are derepressed.
microbe.zh: 微生物铁载体产生和吸收的基因被抑制了。

microbe.en: We have a microbe doing something different than life as we know it.
microbe.zh: 我们培养了一种和我们所知的生命完全不同的微生物。

microbe.en: One day, when he was using a microscope to watch the microbe, a messenger visited him.
microbe.zh: 一天，他正在用一台显微镜观察微生物的时候，一个送信者来拜访他。

virus.en: There's a virus going around the office.
virus.zh: 办公室里流行着一种病毒性疾病。

virus.en: The virus seems to have attacked his throat.
virus.zh: 病毒似乎已侵害到他的咽喉。

virus.en: Her heart was irreparably damaged by a virus.
virus.zh: 她的心脏被某种病毒不可补救地损伤了。

metabolism.en: If you skip breakfast, your metabolism slows down.
metabolism.zh: 你如果不吃早饭，新陈代谢速度会减慢。

metabolism.en: The body's metabolism is slowed down by extreme cold.
metabolism.zh: 严寒可以使身体新陈代谢的速度下降。

metabolism.en: That slows the plant's metabolism and protects its dried-out tissues.
metabolism.zh: 这减缓了植物的新陈代谢，保护了其干枯的组织。

protein.en: You need more protein to build you up.
protein.zh: 你需要更多蛋白质以增强体质。
极为精密的蛋白质纤维是能被看见的。

protein.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
protein.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

vitamin.zh: 橘子含有丰富的维生素C。
加热会逐渐破坏维生素C。

secrete.en: The lungs of a fetus secrete a liquid that mixes with its mother's amniotic fluid.
secrete.zh: 胎儿的肺部会分泌一种能与母亲的羊水混合的液体。

secrete.en: Farmer ants secrete antibiotics to control other fungi that might act as "weeds", and spread waste to fertilise the crop.
secrete.zh: 农民蚂蚁分泌抗生素来控制其他可能充当“杂草”的真菌，并传播排泄物来给作物施肥。

secrete.en: We know they smear a liquid on the tube, but we don't know where they secrete it from or what its chemical composition is.
secrete.zh: 我们知道它们在管上涂抹了一种液体，但我们不知道它们从哪里分泌出这种液体，也不知道它的化学成分是什么。

excrete.en: Another adaptation to the salty environment is the ability to excrete excess salt back to the environment.
excrete.zh: 它们适应咸水环境的另一项进化能力是：将过多的盐分释放回环境中。

excrete.en: To excrete perspiration through the pores of the skin.
excrete.zh: 通过皮肤上的毛孔排泄汗液。

excrete.en: Infected poultry excrete virus in their secretions and faeces.
excrete.zh: 受感染家禽将病毒分泌或排泄到它们的唾液或粪便中。

devour.en: The dogs come and devour the bacon.
Passing the pangolin around like a football, inquisitive lions spent hours trying to devour the armor-plated creature.
devour.zh: 好奇的狮子们把穿山甲像足球一样传来传去，花了好几个小时试图吃掉这个被盔甲包裹的生物。

devour.en: A medium-sized dog will devour at least one can of food plus biscuits per day.
devour.zh: 一只中等大小的狗每天至少要干掉一罐食物外加饼干。

instinct.en: He should have let his instinct guide him.
instinct.zh: 他本该让直觉指导他的行动。

instinct.en: Many birds have a remarkable homing instinct.
instinct.zh: 很多鸟类具有了不起的返回原地的本能。

instinct.en: Horses have a well-developed instinct for fear.

intuitive.en: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.
intuitive.zh: 他能直觉地感到读者需要什么。

intuitive.en: A positive pregnancy test soon confirmed her intuitive feelings.
intuitive.zh: 阳性的孕检结果很快证实了她的直觉。
这一策略在直觉上讲是有道理的。

potential.zh: 这个男孩有很大的潜力。

potential.en: The house has a lot of potential.

functional.en: These units played a key functional role in the military operation.
functional.zh: 这些单位在军事行动中起到了主要的职能作用。
这镜子能照人，但也有装饰作用。

functional.en: The hospital will soon be fully functional.
functional.zh: 这家医院将很快全面运作。

intelligence.zh: 为什么军事情报如此缺乏？

intelligence.en: He deserted from army intelligence last month.
intelligence.zh: 他上个月从军队情报部门开了小差。
很多诵读困难者的智力都在平均水平以上。

sensitive.zh: 就业是一个非常敏感的问题。

flexible.en: The talks can succeed if both sides are flexible and serious.
flexible.zh: 如果双方都灵活并且认真，这些会谈就能成功。

flexible.en: You need to be more flexible and imaginative in your approach.
flexible.zh: 你的方法必须更加灵活，更富有想象力。

flexible.en: WYSIWYG editing makes your word processing smoother and more flexible.
flexible.zh: “所见即所得”编辑使你的文字信息处理更加顺畅和灵活。

optical.en: A sensor channels the light signal along an optical fibre.
optical.zh: 传感器沿光导纤维输送光信号。

optical.en: These optical fibres may be used for new sorts of telephony.
optical.zh: 这些光纤可以应用在新型电话通讯系统。

optical.en: Optical scanners ensure that imperfections in the cloth are located and removed.
optical.zh: 光电扫描器能确保找出并去除布料上的瑕疵。

acoustic.en: Do you remember when everyone went unplugged and acoustic?
acoustic.zh: 你还记得那时乐队都不使用电声而是用原声演奏吗？

acoustic.en: She chose to be backed by a classy trio of acoustic guitar, bass and congas.
acoustic.zh: 她选择了用原声吉他、低音吉他和康茄鼓组成的经典三重奏组合为自己伴奏。

acoustic.en: In our case, we have found the true acoustic echo beacon.
acoustic.zh: 在我们的例子中，我们找到了真正的声学回声信标。

nocturnal.en: The dormouse is a shy, nocturnal creature.
nocturnal.zh: 榛睡鼠是一种在夜间活动的胆小动物。

nocturnal.en: Nocturnal animals sleep by day and hunt by night.
nocturnal.zh: 夜间活动的动物白天睡觉晚上猎食。

nocturnal.en: When there is a full moon, this nocturnal rodent is careful to stay in its burrow.
nocturnal.zh: 在有满月出现的时候，这种夜间出没的啮齿类动物小心地呆在它的洞里。

dormant.en: During the winter the seeds lie dormant in the soil.
dormant.zh: 冬天种子在土壤中休眠。

dormant.en: The pupae remain dormant in the soil until they emerge as adult moths in the winter.
dormant.zh: 蛹在土壤下休眠，直到冬季才变为成年的蛾飞出来。

dormant.en: And Lechuguilla is pretty much dormant now.
dormant.zh: 而龙舌兰现在几乎处于休眠状态。

hibernation.en: "In fact, " she said after a while, "we have gone into hibernation."
hibernation.zh: “事实上，”过了一会儿，她说，“我们已经进入了冬眠状态。”

hibernation.en: Now when they emerge in the spring from hibernation, the mating process begins.
hibernation.zh: 现在，当它们从冬眠中醒来时，交配的过程就开始了。

hibernation.en: Animals which save energy by hibernation or lethargy (e. g. bats or hedgehogs) live much longer than those which are always active
hibernation.zh: 通过冬眠或昏睡来节省能量的动物（例如蝙蝠或刺猬）比那些一直很活跃的动物活得更久。

track.zh: 火车沿着轨道嘎嚓嘎嚓地缓慢行驶着。
这条小道绝险地蜿蜒而上。

trace.en: How far back can you trace your family tree?
trace.zh: 你的家谱可以追溯到多少代？

trace.en: The trace showed a normal heart rhythm.

prey.en: The lions closed in on their prey.
The baby fish are easy prey for birds.
prey.zh: 这些小鱼很容易被鸟类捕食。

alternate.en: They were streaked with alternate bands of colour.
alternate.zh: 他们都带有色彩交替相间的条纹。

predator.en: Now if you are a bird and there is a predator around.
predator.zh: 假设你是一只鸟，且现在周围有捕食者。

predator.en: A predator is an animal that hunts and eats other animals.
predator.zh: 捕食性动物是一种猎食其他动物的动物。

predator.en: It serves to distract a predator while the octopus makes its escape.
predator.zh: 它的作用是在章鱼逃跑时分散捕食者的注意力。

victim.en: The victim has not yet been named.
victim.zh: 受害人的姓名仍未得知。

victim.en: The "victim" revealed he was only playacting.
victim.zh: 该“受害者”透露他只是在装腔作势。

captive.en: They were taken captive by masked gunmen.
captive.zh: 他们被蒙面的持枪歹徒劫持了。

captive.en: Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
captive.zh: 孩子们到动物园来正是为了看那些被关起来的动物。

captive.en: Her heart had begun to pound inside her chest like a captive animal.
captive.zh: 她心如鹿撞，怦怦跳个不停。

defensive.en: Troops took up a defensive position around the town.
defensive.zh: 部队在全城采取了守势。

defensive.en: Green is a defensive lineman for the Atlanta Falcons.
defensive.zh: 格林是亚特兰大猎鹰球队的防守前锋队员。

defensive.en: Like their children, parents are often defensive about their private lives.
defensive.zh: 跟孩子们一样，家长们对他们的私生活通常也是自卫的。

undergo.en: These act like batteries when they undergo a temperature change: attach electrodes to them and they generate a current.
undergo.zh: 它们经历温度变化时会像电池一样工作：给它们接上电极，它们就会产生电流。

undergo.en: Fans may undergo body searches by security guards.
undergo.zh: 仰慕者们可能要接受保安人员的搜身。

undergo.en: He went into the hospital to undergo tests for a pain in his abdomen.
undergo.zh: 他去了医院接受对他的腹部疼痛进行的各项检查。

vulnerable.en: She was left feeling exposed and vulnerable.
vulnerable.zh: 她感到自己孤立无助，非常脆弱。

vulnerable.en: Those most vulnerable to heat stress are the elderly.
vulnerable.zh: 上了年纪的人最容易因受热而生病。

vulnerable.en: Their tanks would be vulnerable to attack from the air.
vulnerable.zh: 他们的坦克将易受空袭。

suffer.en: Let the people suffer. I will take blame.
suffer.zh: 苦一苦百姓，骂名我来担！

suffer.en: Your Majesty, you have made Shilan suffer so bitterly.
suffer.zh: 皇上，你害得世兰好苦啊。
节食者们经受剧烈的情绪变化的折磨。

subsistence.en: In this cupboard the grandfather kept everything that he needed for his subsistence.
subsistence.zh: 爷爷把生活所需的一切东西都放在这个橱柜里。

subsistence.en: They had no visible means of subsistence.
Many families are living below the level of subsistence.

exist.en: The magic cure for inflation does not exist.
exist.zh: 解决通货膨胀的神奇方法并不存在。
组合方式可能有许多种。

exterminate.en: A huge effort was made to exterminate the rats.
exterminate.zh: 花了大气力来消灭这些老鼠。

exterminate.en: Wondrously, scientists have found lately that the white blood cells in the human body's immune system can locate, attack, and exterminate particles harming our body.
exterminate.zh: 令人啧啧称奇的是，科学家们最近发现，人类免疫系统内的白血球，能够寻找、攻击、以及歼灭会伤害我们身体的微粒。

exterminate.en: Right be complained directly or of pass on of Consumer's Committee of city of hill of exterminate of Fujian Province Consumer's Committee, fierce complain, end in 10 workaday processing commonly.
exterminate.zh: 对直接投诉或福建省消委会、武夷山市消委会转交的投诉件，一般在10个工作日处理完毕。

tame.en: They never became tame; they would run away if you approached them.
tame.zh: 它们从没有被驯服，如果你靠近，它们就跑开了。

tame.en: These ideas may seem tame today, but they were inflammatory in his time.
tame.zh: 这些想法今天看来也许是平淡乏味的，但在他那个时代却是很有煽动性的。

keeper.en: He won the soccer game with the goal keeper.
keeper.zh: 他和守门员一起赢了这场足球比赛。

keeper.en: The young men understand they are their brother's keeper.
keeper.zh: 年轻人懂得他们是兄弟的守护者。

galaxy.zh: 银河系由1千亿颗恒星组成。
天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

galaxy.en: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
galaxy.zh: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

cosmos.en: A team of astronomers working at the European Southern Observatory in Chile, led by Simon Clark, spotted a flyer in the cosmos.
cosmos.zh: 在智利的欧洲南方天文台，由西蒙·克拉克领导的天文学家团队发现了宇宙中的一个飞行物。

cosmos.en: A few astronomers thought they could see even more of a dinosaur-cosmos link, a pattern of mass extinctions occurring like clockwork in the geologic record.
cosmos.zh: 一些天文学家认为他们可以看到更多的恐龙与宇宙之间的联系，这种大规模灭绝的模式就像地质记录上的时钟一样。

cosmos.en: But such transits have paved the way for what might prove to be one of the most vital breakthroughs in the cosmos—detecting Earth-sized planets orbiting other stars.
cosmos.zh: 但是这样的凌日现象已经为被证明可能是宇宙中最重要的突破之一的说法铺平了道路，这个说法即找到那些围绕其他恒星轨道公转的和地球大小相似的行星。

shepherd.en: The shepherd followed, carrying a torch to light his way.
shepherd.zh: 牧羊人跟在后面，举着火把把路照亮。

shepherd.en: The Lord is my shepherd and I shall ask for nothing.
shepherd.zh: 耶和华是我的牧者，我一无所求。

universe.en: The universe is slowly yielding up its secrets.
universe.zh: 宇宙慢慢地展现出它的秘密。

universe.en: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
universe.zh: 认为另有一个平行宇宙的概念是很难理解的。

universe.en: The clear inference is that the universe is expanding.
universe.zh: 显然结论是宇宙在扩大。

interstellar.en: Rather, they are dark because of interstellar dust that hides the stars behind it.
interstellar.zh: 相反，它们之所以是黑暗的，是因为星际尘埃将恒星隐藏在它的后面。

interstellar.en: The interstellar material, rather like terrestrial clouds, comes in all shapes and sizes.
interstellar.zh: 星际物质很像地球上的云，形状大小各异。

interstellar.en: Optical astronomy is most directly affected, for although interstellar gas is perfectly transparent, the dust is not.
interstellar.zh: 光学天文学受到最直接的影响，因为虽然星际气体是完全透明的，但尘埃却不是。

terrestrial.en: Still, some small terrestrial animals can achieve high speeds.
terrestrial.zh: 然而，一些小型陆生动物可以达到高速。

terrestrial.en: The terrestrial world is green now, but it did not start out that way.
terrestrial.zh: 陆地世界现在是绿色的，但一开始它并不是这样的。

terrestrial.en: These rocky planets are called "Terrestrial Planets".
terrestrial.zh: 这些岩态行星被称为“类地行星”。

celestial.en: Tulips actually hail from an area that Chinese call the Celestial Mountains in Central Asia.
celestial.zh: 郁金香实际上来自位于中亚、中国人称为“天山”的地区。

celestial.en: Galileo's observations of Jupiter's satellites showed that the Ptolemaic theory of the motion of celestial bodies is false.
celestial.zh: 伽利略对木星卫星的观察表明，托勒密关于天体运动的理论是错误的。

celestial.en: Prayer can add to your joy a celestial perfume.
celestial.zh: 祷告能在你的欢乐上替你加上一阵属天的香味。

astrology.en: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.
astrology.zh: 这一发现似乎证实了流行占星术的一些观点。

astrology.en: Today, people still look to stars or genes, astrology or genetics, in the hope of finding the source of exceptional abilities or personal characteristics.
astrology.zh: 今天，人们仍然研究星星或基因、占星术或遗传学，希望找到超常的能力或个人特征的来源。

astrology.en: The type of astrology that most western astrologers practice, horoscopic astrology, requires an exact birth time in order to work properly.
astrology.zh: 大部分西方占星师所使用的占星方法，需要对方提供准确的出生时间，才能正常进行运算。

comet.en: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
comet.zh: 这颗彗星的轨道和地球的轨道相交。

comet.en: We were not altogether sure that the comet would miss the Earth.
comet.zh: 我们不太确定这颗彗星是否会错过地球。

comet.en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway.
comet.zh: 这颗彗星将于2061年返回，到时我们都可以看到它。哦，无论如何，我们子孙是可以看到的。

astronaut.en: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.
astronaut.zh: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。

astronaut.en: There is an astronaut model on it.
astronaut.zh: 上面有一个宇航员模型。

astronomy.en: We are on the threshold of a new era in astronomy.
astronomy.zh: 我们将迈入天文学的新时代。

astronomy.en: The discovery is being hailed as the Holy Grail of astronomy.
astronomy.zh: 这个发现被认为是为天文学圆了梦。

astronomy.en: Descartes received his stimulus from the new physics and astronomy of Copernicus, Galileo, and others.
astronomy.zh: 笛卡儿从哥白尼、伽利略和其他科学家的新物理学和天文学中获得了灵感。

meteorite.en: The blast may have vaporized the meteorite.
meteorite.zh: 爆炸可能使陨石汽化了。

meteorite.en: The Allende meteorite is classified as a chondrite.
meteorite.zh: 阿连德陨石被归类为球粒陨石。

crater.en: Ash began to erupt from the crater.
crater.zh: 火山灰开始从火山口喷出。

crater.en: They blasted a huge crater in the runway.
crater.zh: 他们在飞机跑道上炸了一个大坑。

crater.en: The lava will just ooze gently out of the crater.
crater.zh: 熔岩只会缓缓地从火山口流出来。

ash.en: Ash began to erupt from the crater.
ash.zh: 火山灰开始从火山口喷出。

ash.en: She dusted some ash from her sleeve.
He brushed the cigarette ash from his sleeve.
ash.zh: 他掸掉了袖子上的烟灰。

dust.en: She blew the dust off the book.

dust.zh: 空气由于灰尘弥漫而闷塞。

envelope.en: Why do you sit there looking like an envelope without any address on it?
envelope.zh: 为什么你坐在那儿，看上去像是一个没写地址的信封？
她打开了带有香味的信封。

envelope.en: He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
envelope.zh: 他把一张邮票贴到信封上。

spacecraft.en: The two spacecraft will link up in orbit.
spacecraft.zh: 两艘宇宙飞船将在轨道上对接。

spacecraft.en: A radio signal was sent to the spacecraft.
spacecraft.zh: 向宇宙飞船发出了无线电信号。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft burned up as it entered the earth's atmosphere.
spacecraft.zh: 宇宙飞船进入地球大气层时被烧毁。

spaceship.en: Its spaceship was engineered by Bert Rutan, renowned for designing the Voyager.
spaceship.zh: 它的飞船由伯特·鲁坦设计建造，此人因设计“旅行者”号飞船而闻名。
它像一艘降落的宇宙飞船。
那是一艘宇宙飞船，它速度很快。

chunk.en: Chester Cheetah chews a chunk of cheep cheddar cheese.
chunk.zh: 切斯特猎豹嚼着一大块切达干酪。

chunk.en: The next time you see a chunk of seaweed … notice the beauty of it.
chunk.zh: 下次你看到一大块海草……注意它的美。

chunk.en: Everyone got a chunk of meat which was distributed by a bizarre stone knife.
chunk.zh: 每个人都得到一大块肉，用一把奇怪的石刀分着吃。

probe.en: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair, and stitch up again.
probe.zh: 外科医生会拿起器械进行探查、修复，然后再缝合。
“天问一号”探测器是什么时候发射的？
“天问一号”是中国首个火星探测器。

module.zh: 从一个模块转换到另一个模块。

module.en: Go download the module and get started.
module.zh: 去下载这个模块，然后开始。

module.en: You create a new module for the selector.
module.zh: 您为选择器创建一个新的模块。

propulsion.en: The nineteenth century witnessed a revolution in ship design and propulsion.
propulsion.zh: 19世纪经历了船舶设计和推进上的一次重大变革。

propulsion.en: Propulsion is provided by a rocket engine, rather than a propeller and rudder, which makes steering difficult.
propulsion.zh: 推进器是由火箭发动机提供的，而不是螺旋桨和方向舵，这使得转向变得困难。

propulsion.en: Scientists and engineers are beginning to study this ability of fishes in the hope of designing more efficient propulsion systems for ships.
propulsion.zh: 科学家和工程师们开始研究鱼类的这种能力，希望能设计出更有效的船舶推进系统。

dynamic.en: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
dynamic.zh: 市场的动力要求有不断的变化和调整。

dynamic.en: The programme is 90 minutes of dynamic Indian folk dance, live music, and storytelling.
dynamic.zh: 该节目为90 分钟，由动感印度民间舞蹈、现场音乐表演和说书组成。

dynamic.en: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader.
dynamic.zh: 他看来是个富有创新力与活力的领导。

pressure.zh: 压力现在毫无减弱之意。

motion.en: Some scenes were filmed in slow motion.
motion.zh: 几组镜头被拍成了慢动作。

motion.en: This exercise is done in one smooth motion.
motion.zh: 这套体操是由一个流畅的动作完成的。

vent.en: She gave vent to her anger and jealousy.
vent.zh: 她发泄了自己的怒意和嫉妒。

vent.en: She telephoned her best friend to vent her frustration.
vent.zh: 她打电话给自己最好的朋友来发泄她的沮丧。

vent.en: She gave full vent to her feelings in a violent outburst.
vent.zh: 她大发脾气以宣泄情绪。

tail.en: The dog ran up, wagging its tail.
tail.zh: 那条狗摇着尾巴跑上前去。

tail.en: The tail tapered to a rounded tip.
tail.zh: 尾部越来越细，最后成了个圆尖。

curve.en: The slope increases as you go up the curve.
curve.zh: 你顺着那条弯路往上走，坡度越来越大。

curve.en: We just change the curve into straight lines.
curve.zh: 我们只是把曲线变成了直线。

curve.en: It's a tough learning curve and it won't always make you popular.
curve.zh: 这是一条艰难的学习曲线，且并不一定让你受欢迎。

exploration.en: The moon landing inaugurated a new era in space exploration.
exploration.zh: 登陆月球开创了太空探索的新纪元。

exploration.en: China has earmarked more than $20 billion for oil exploration.
exploration.zh: 中国已留出二百多亿美元用于石油勘探。

exploration.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
exploration.zh: 他对那个神话的探索揭示了美国人的心理。

expedition.en: The expedition was bedevilled by bad weather.
expedition.zh: 探险队深受恶劣天气的困扰。

expedition.en: Forty-three members of the expedition were killed.
It won't be labelled in any way as a military expedition.
expedition.zh: 它无论如何也称不上是一次军事远征。

observatory.en: This makes it seem unlikely Nazca is an observatory.
observatory.zh: 这使得纳斯卡不太可能是一个天文台。

observatory.en: There is a small network of rhombus in tokyo astronomical observatory.
observatory.zh: 东京天文台有一个小的菱形网。

observatory.en: Here's an irony, the building we are in now, the astronomy building not far from our observatory, has unshielded lights.
observatory.zh: 讽刺的是，我们现在所在的这栋楼，离我们天文台不远的那座天文楼，竟然有未屏蔽的灯。

telescope.zh: 这个望远镜可以放大50倍。

telescope.en: The telescope was pointing in the wrong direction.
Mars was visible, dead in the centre of the telescope.
telescope.zh: 火星清晰可辨，正好就在望远镜的中心。

spectacle.en: It was a spectacle not to be missed.

spectacle.zh: 目击了这一奇异的景象。

ecliptic.en: Saturn still shines in the night though, farther eastward along the ecliptic plane.
ecliptic.zh: 尽管如此，土星仍然在黄道平面向东更远的地方发光。

ecliptic.en: Different circle in the sky which is the plane of the ecliptic of the solar system.
ecliptic.zh: 这将是另一个循环，这平面就是整个太阳系的黄道。

ecliptic.en: The ecliptic plane is defined as the imaginary plane containing the Earth's orbit around the sun.
ecliptic.zh: 黄道平面是一个假想的平面，理论上它包含了地球环绕太阳运行的轨道。

orbit.en: The two spacecraft will link up in orbit.
orbit.zh: 两艘宇宙飞船将在轨道上对接。

orbit.en: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
orbit.zh: 这颗彗星的轨道和地球的轨道相交。

orbit.en: The orientation of the planet's orbit is changing continuously.
orbit.zh: 该行星轨道的方向不断变化。

diameter.en: It turns out that the diameter is actually 2.5 centimeters.
diameter.zh: 它的直径实际上是 2.5 厘米。

diameter.en: The microscope can magnify the object 100 times in diameter.
diameter.zh: 这架显微镜能把物体的直径放大100倍。

radius.en: He indicated a semicircle with a radius of about thirty miles.
radius.zh: 他标示出一个半径大约三十英里的半圆。

radius.en: Simply change the radius to 2000, and you should start to see some results.
radius.zh: 只需将半径更改为2000，您应当便会看到一些结果，当然。

radius.en: The radiation radius of the radioactive radium radiator in the stadium is variable.
radius.zh: 放射性的镭散热器在体育场的辐射半径是可变的。

substance.en: There is some substance in what he says.
substance.zh: 他的话是有一定根据的。

composition.en: We had to write a composition on the subject "My Pet."
composition.zh: 我们得就“我的宠物”这个主题写一篇作文。

composition.en: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions.
composition.zh: 电视改变了大型体育赛事观众的数量及其社会构成。

composition.en: Extracting information about the large-scale composition of a planet from a sample weighing a millionth of a gram was a fascinating example of scientific endeavour.
composition.zh: 从重量为百万分之一克的样品中提取有关行星宏观组成的信息是一个极为有趣的科学尝试实例。

compound.en: Common salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
compound.zh: 普通食盐是钠和氯的化合物。

compound.en: A compound sentence contains two or more clauses.
compound.zh: 复合句包含两个或多个从句。

compound.en: Honey is basically a compound of water, two types of sugar, vitamins and enzymes.
compound.zh: 蜂蜜主要是水、两种糖、维生素和酶的混合物。

fossil.en: Burning fossil fuels uses oxygen and produces carbon dioxide.
fossil.zh: 燃烧化石燃料消耗氧气并产生二氧化碳。

fossil.en: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
fossil.zh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

fossil.en: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
fossil.zh: 电力工业消耗大量的矿物燃料。

specimen.en: I found that there were these rings in every specimen except for the smallest.
specimen.zh: 我发现这些环在所有的标本中都存在，最小的除外。

specimen.en: The snake has been named Silver Boa because it is metal-colored and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree.
specimen.zh: 这条蛇被命名为银蟒，因为它呈金属色，并且第一个被发现的标本当时正在爬一棵银色棕榈树。

specimen.en: The snake has been named silver boa because it is metallic colored and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree.
specimen.zh: 这种蛇被命名为银蟒，因为它是金属色的，而且发现的第一个标本是爬一棵银色的棕榈树。

sample.zh: 采集了一份常规的脱氧核糖核酸样本。

sample.en: 'I'd like to see a sample of your work,' said the manager.
sample.zh: “拿一件你做的货样给我看看。”经理说。

molecule.en: The DNA molecule is compounded from many smaller molecules.
molecule.zh: 脱氧核糖核酸分子是由许多更小的分子组成的。

molecule.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
molecule.zh: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

molecule.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
molecule.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

particle.en: A proton is an elementary particle of matter that possesses a positive charge.
particle.zh: 质子是带正电荷的物质的基本粒子。
粒子物理学家和天文学家经常合作。

particle.en: A fundamental particle is created when three ribbons are joined in a "plait".
particle.zh: 当三条纽带织成一根“辫子”时，就产生了一个基本粒子。

atom.en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
atom.zh: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

atom.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
atom.zh: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

atom.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
atom.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

ion.en: It is a naked electron and is a sodium positive ion.
ion.zh: 它是个裸电子，是钠正离子。

ion.en: Quartz is quartz—a silicon ion surrounded by four oxygen ions—there's no difference at all between two-million-year-old Pleistocene quartz and Cambrian quartz created over 500 million years ago.
ion.zh: 石英是石英——由四个氧离子围绕的硅离子——200万年前的更新世石英和5亿年前的寒武纪石英之间没有任何区别。

ion.en: We talked about this reaction here, where we had chloride ion in the gas phase plus sodium ion in the gas phase.
ion.zh: 我们在讨论这一个反应，气态的氯原子加上气态的钠原子。

quantum.en: Both quantum mechanics and chaos theory suggest a world constantly in flux.
quantum.zh: 量子力学和混沌理论都指出世界处在不断变化中。
它确实发生在量子力学中。

quantum.en: He set up in that way an alternative form of quantum mechanics.
quantum.zh: 他就是以那样一种方式建立了量子力学的另一种形式。

electron.en: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
electron.zh: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

electron.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
electron.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。

electron.en: It is a naked electron and is a sodium positive ion.
electron.zh: 它是个裸电子，是钠正离子。

liquid.en: It's vital not to overheat the liquid.
liquid.zh: 最关键的是不要让液体过热。

fluid.zh: 这种植物分泌出一种黏液。

fluid.en: Surgeons siphoned off fluid from his left lung.
fluid.zh: 外科医生用虹吸管从他的左肺吸出液体。

fluid.en: Eating too much salt can cause fluid retention.
fluid.zh: 摄盐过多会导致体液潴留。

synthesize.en: This confusion has been exacerbated by a paucity of serious attempts to synthesize and evaluate available data on the details of avian and dinosaurian evolution.
synthesize.zh: 由于缺乏认真的尝试来综合和评估鸟类和恐龙进化细节的现有数据，这种混乱变得更加严重。

synthesize.en: What I want is for you to synthesize information to reflect back on what we've read and discussed and to form your own ideas, not just repeat points from the textbook.
synthesize.zh: 我想让你们综合信息来反映我们读过和讨论过的内容，形成自己的观点，而不是仅仅重复课本上的观点。

synthesize.en: A third function of intuition is to synthesize isolated bits of data and practice into an integrated picture, often in an "Aha!" experience.
synthesize.zh: 直觉的第三个功能是将孤立的数据和实践整合成一个完整的画面，通常一次是“惊讶”的经历。

solid.zh: 所有的固体食物她都不肯吃。

method.en: There is just one method that might work.
method.zh: 只有一个方法可能起作用。

method.en: The most frequently used method is radiocarbon dating.
method.zh: 最常用的方法是放射性碳定年法。

method.en: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
method.zh: 避孕药是最有效的节育办法。

formation.en: He was flying in formation with seven other jets.
formation.zh: 他和另外7架喷气式飞机编队飞行。

formation.en: My profession had an important influence in the formation of my character and temperament.
formation.zh: 我的职业对我的性格和性情的形成有重要的影响。
这是理解行星形成的关键。

spectrum.en: Red and violet are at opposite ends of the spectrum.
spectrum.zh: 红色和紫色位于光谱的两端。

spectrum.en: A spectrum is formed by a ray of light passing through a prism.
spectrum.zh: 一束光通过棱镜就会形成光谱。
你不能从（信念）范围上跳下来。

dimension.en: You will open a new dimension to your life.
dimension.zh: 你将为你的生活打开一个新的维度。

dimension.en: Loutherbourg, like other contemporary painters, wanted to add the dimension of time to his paintings.
dimension.zh: 像其他当代画家一样，卢德堡想要在他的绘画中加入时间这一维度。

dimension.en: The Vroom model emphasizes the participative dimension of leadership: how leaders go about making decisions.
dimension.zh: 弗鲁姆模型强调领导力的参与性维度：领导者如何进行决策。

frequency.en: You can't hear waves of such a high frequency.
frequency.zh: 你听不到这么高频率的声波。

frequency.en: The frequency of Kara's phone calls increased rapidly.
frequency.zh: 卡拉打电话的频率迅速增加。

frequency.en: Objects like this turn up at sales with surprising frequency.
frequency.zh: 这样的东西在拍卖会上出人意料地频繁出现。

antenna.en: You'll need a good antenna to exploit the radio's performance.
antenna.zh: 你需要一根好的天线来充分利用该电台的节目。

antenna.en: Can you see the radio antenna on that hill?
antenna.zh: 你能看见那座山上的无线电天线吗？

antenna.en: They erected a television antenna on the roof.
antenna.zh: 他们在屋顶上架起了电视天线。

signal.en: At an agreed signal they left the room.
signal.zh: 收到约定的信号后，他们离开了房间。

signal.en: A radio signal was sent to the spacecraft.
signal.zh: 向宇宙飞船发出了无线电信号。

circuit.en: Fewer workers are needed to solder circuit boards.
circuit.zh: 焊接电路板需要较少的工人。

circuit.en: The fire was started by an electrical short-circuit.
circuit.zh: 火灾是由电线短路引发的。

circuit.en: The switches close the contacts and complete the circuit.
circuit.zh: 这些开关可接通形成闭合电路。

refraction.en: One source of error is refraction, the bending of light beams as they pass through air layers of different temperature and pressure.
refraction.zh: 误差的一个来源是折射，即光束通过不同温度和压力的空气层时发生的弯曲现象。

refraction.en: The Chinese also launched weather balloons near their theodolites to measure atmospheric temperature and pressure changes to better estimate refraction errors.
refraction.zh: 中国还在经纬仪附近发射了气象气球来测量大气温度和压力变化，以更好地估计折射误差。

refraction.en: What would a negative index of refraction look like?
refraction.zh: 如果折射率是负的,会发生什么事情?

radioactive.en: Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
radioactive.zh: 放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

radioactive.en: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
radioactive.zh: 废料被安全地封存，直到其不再有辐射。

radioactive.en: They were exposed to radioactive fallout during nuclear weapons tests.
radioactive.zh: 他们在核武器试验过程中暴露于放射性核辐射。

ultraviolet.en: Exposure to ultraviolet light is closely linked to skin cancer.
ultraviolet.zh: 受紫外线照射与皮肤癌紧密相关。

ultraviolet.en: The ozone layer shields the earth from the sun's ultraviolet rays.
ultraviolet.zh: 臭氧层保护地球不受太阳紫外线的辐射。

ultraviolet.en: Ozone is produced by the reaction between oxygen and ultraviolet light.
ultraviolet.zh: 臭氧是氧气与紫外线发生化学反应而产生的。

discernible.en: His face was barely discernible in the gloom.
discernible.zh: 在黑暗中很难看得清他的脸。

discernible.en: Far away the outline of the island is just discernible.
discernible.zh: 远远的，那岛的轮廓依稀可见。

discernible.en: There is often no discernible difference between rival brands.
discernible.zh: 相互竞争的品牌之间往往看不出明显的区别。

distinct.en: There was a distinct smell of gas.
Being tall gave Tony a distinct advantage.
distinct.zh: 托尼个子高是个明显的优势。
身高6英尺3英寸有明显的劣势！

collision.en: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
collision.zh: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

collision.en: Their car was in a head-on collision with a truck.
collision.zh: 他们的车同一辆卡车迎面相撞。

collision.en: There was a slight collision but my car was undamaged.
collision.zh: 虽有轻微碰撞，但我的汽车没有损坏。

invisible.en: Most spiders weave webs that are almost invisible.
invisible.zh: 大多数蜘蛛可结成几乎看不见的网。

invisible.en: Above him an invisible plane droned through the night sky.
invisible.zh: 在他头顶上空一架隐形飞机飞过夜空，不断发出低沉单调的声音。

invisible.en: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph.
invisible.zh: 在地面上看不见的图案可能是空中照片中最为醒目的部分。

squash.zh: 他打壁球时背部受伤了。

cataclysmic.en: Floods and other cataclysmic events like tsunamis.
cataclysmic.zh: 洪灾和海啸等其他灾难性事件。

cataclysmic.en: Cataclysmic housing crises are easy to spot, but also rare.
cataclysmic.zh: 灾难性住房经济危机容易发现，却也很少发生。

fragment.en: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.
fragment.zh: 她什么都读，对新闻的每一个片段都细细品味。

fragment.en: We introduce fragment identifiers for the speakers.
fragment.zh: 我们为演讲者引入了片段标识符。

fragment.en: You can see one of these functions in the code fragment below.
fragment.zh: 您可以在下面的代码片段中看到这些函数之一。

overwhelming.en: He felt an overwhelming sense of loss.
The sense of déjà vu was overwhelming.
overwhelming.zh: 似曾经历过的感觉非常强烈。
对他不利的证据确凿，无法抵赖。

hopeless.zh: 你是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。

hopeless.en: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.
hopeless.zh: 他的演讲辞写得很好，但他的演讲却不可救药。
她对人事管理一窍不通。

despair.en: My handwriting was the despair of my teachers.
despair.zh: 我的字写得很差，使老师们感到十分失望。

despair.en: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse.
despair.zh: 别让你自己绝望；这样将只会使情况变得更糟。

desperate.en: They admit they are now desperate for a lucky break.
desperate.zh: 他们承认现在非常渴望交上好运。

desperate.en: There are hundreds of people desperate to adopt a child.
desperate.zh: 有数以百计的人极其渴望收养小孩。

desperate.en: I was absolutely desperate to see her.

secondary.en: She taught history at a secondary school.
secondary.zh: 她在一所中学教过历史。

secondary.en: Experience is what matters—age is of secondary importance.
secondary.zh: 重要的是经验—年龄是次要的。

secondary.en: Examinations are taken after about five years of secondary education.
secondary.zh: 经过约五年的中等教育后参加考试。

primary.en: We turn now to our primary question.
primary.zh: 我们现在转到我们的主要问题上。

primary.en: Computers are now commonplace in primary classrooms.
primary.zh: 计算机如今在小学教室里很普遍。

primary.en: It comes in bright primary colours that kids will love.
primary.zh: 它的颜色都是孩子们喜爱的亮丽原色。

college.zh: 他们正为上大学做准备。
我们的小女儿在大学读书。

academy.en: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.
academy.zh: 这些奥斯卡金像奖看来证实了他的职业生涯的价值。

academy.en: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
academy.zh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

academy.en: The movie won nine Academy Awards, including Best Picture.
academy.zh: 这部电影荣获九项奥斯卡金像奖，包括最佳影片奖。

institute.en: Mr. Lin is associate director of the Institute.
institute.zh: 林先生是该研究所的副主任。

institute.en: He got a scholarship to the Pratt Institute of Art.
institute.zh: 他得到了一笔普拉特艺术学院的奖学金。

institute.en: He visited the Institute of Neurology in Havana where they both worked.
institute.zh: 他在哈瓦那参观了他们俩都曾工作过的神经病学研究所。

learn.zh: 你在哪里学会的焊接技术？

study.zh: 这项研究是在以往工作的基础上进行的。
孩子们宁愿玩而不愿学习。

acquire.zh: 人们必须从某个地方获得这种技能。

acquire.en: They acquire knowledge not found in books.
acquire.zh: 他们获得书本以外的知识。

acquire.en: Pury also believes that people can acquire courage.
acquire.zh: 普里还认为，人可以获得勇气。

expertise.en: Griffith's expertise is in writing legal briefs.
expertise.zh: 格里菲思的专长在于撰写法律案情摘要。

expertise.en: We have the expertise to help you run your business.
expertise.zh: 我们有帮助你经营自己业务的专门知识。

expertise.en: We need to tap the expertise of the people we already have.
expertise.zh: 我们需要利用我们现有人员的专业知识。

knowledge.en: His knowledge of French is only fair.
knowledge.zh: 他的法语知识还算可以。

knowledge.en: He denied all knowledge of the affair.

novice.en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
novice.zh: 在这些事情上我是一名新手，中尉。你是行家。

novice.en: How about attracting new people to perennial gardening and developing novice gardeners into avid gardeners?
novice.zh: 吸引新的人们种植多年生植物，把园艺初学者发展成园艺爱好者怎么样？

recruit.en: He is hoping to recruit a chairman from outside the company.
recruit.zh: 他在希望从公司之外招聘一位董事长。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Hispanic officers.
recruit.zh: 警方正试图招收更多的黑人和西班牙裔的警官。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
recruit.zh: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

literate.en: Your children should be literate and numerate.
literate.zh: 你的孩子们应该会识字识数。

literate.en: All students should be numerate and literate when they leave school.
literate.zh: 所有的学生毕业时都应具备计算和读写的能力。

literate.en: We look for applicants who are good with numbers, computer-literate, and energetic self-starters.
literate.zh: 我们找精于计算、懂电脑、精力充沛、工作主动的申请人。

illiteracy.en: For example, John Mogger became concerned about the problem of illiteracy three years ago, so he started teaching five prisoners in Brazil.
illiteracy.zh: 例如，John Mogger 三年前开始关注文盲问题，所以他开始在巴西对五名囚犯进行教学。

illiteracy.en: It would help to end illiteracy and disease, but it would also dislocate a traditional way of life.
illiteracy.zh: 它该会有助于消除文盲和疾病，但也会打乱一种传统的生活方式。

illiteracy.en: The campaign to wipe out illiteracy launched out with great vigour.
illiteracy.zh: 扫盲运动轰轰烈烈地展开了。

numerate.en: Your children should be literate and numerate.
numerate.zh: 你的孩子们应该会识字识数。

numerate.en: All students should be numerate and literate when they leave school.
numerate.zh: 所有的学生毕业时都应具备计算和读写的能力。

numerate.en: Some children still leave school both illiterate and in numerate.
numerate.zh: 一些儿童离开学校时仍然是既不能读写又不会算的。

problem.zh: 违反法律是一个严重的问题。
更广泛的问题依然存在。

affair.zh: 整个事件以悲剧而告终。

affair.en: The newspapers exaggerated the whole affair wildly.
affair.zh: 报章毫无根据地夸大了整个事件。
吃午餐曾是一件从容的事。

controversial.en: Immigration is a controversial issue in many countries.
controversial.zh: 移民在很多国家都是一个有争议的问题。

controversial.en: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.
controversial.zh: 工艺和美术之间的区别更有争议。

controversial.en: Winston Churchill and Richard Nixon were both controversial figures.
controversial.zh: 温斯顿•邱吉尔和理查德•尼克松都是有争议的人物。

issue.zh: 你只不过是在回避问题。
这个问题至今仍在激烈地辩论中。

obscure.en: Her poetry is full of obscure literary allusion.
obscure.zh: 她的诗随处可见晦涩的文学典故。

obscure.en: We mustn't let these minor details obscure the main issue.
obscure.zh: 我们不能让枝节问题掩盖主要问题。
我觉得她的讲座非常费解。

instill.en: Through consumption, people come to understand, instill meaning in, and act upon objects encountered in the world.
instill.zh: 通过消费，人们开始理解、灌输意义，并对世界上遇到的物体采取行动。

instill.en: The easy rhythm and pop arrangement even instill a feeling of musical eroticism.
instill.zh: 轻松的旋律和流行音乐的安排甚至逐渐注入了一种音乐的情色的感觉。

instill.en: Schools should foster children's interest in sports to instill into them the values of teamwork and sportsmanship.
instill.zh: 学校应该培养孩子们对运动的兴趣，以教导他们合作和体育精神的价值。

puzzle.en: We fitted together the pieces of the puzzle.
puzzle.zh: 我们把拼图玩具的各部分拼合在了一起。

puzzle.en: We invited readers who completed the puzzle to send in their solutions.
puzzle.zh: 我们邀请解完谜的读者交出谜底。

puzzle.en: The rise in accidents remains a puzzle.

riddle.en: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the universe.
riddle.zh: 科学家们昨天宣布已经解开了宇宙诞生之谜。

riddle.en: This is the riddle you have to solve.
riddle.zh: 这是你必须要解决的谜题。

enhance.en: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
enhance.zh: 这是提高公司声誉的机会。

enhance.en: The White House is eager to protect and enhance that reputation.
enhance.zh: 白宫急于保护并提高那声望。

enhance.en: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
enhance.zh: 大幅画作能增加小房间的宽敞感。

emphasize.en: He flourished the glass to emphasize the point.
emphasize.zh: 他挥舞着杯子来强调这一点。

emphasize.en: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
emphasize.zh: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

emphasize.en: Economists emphasize measurable quantities – the number of jobs, the per capita income.
emphasize.zh: 经济学家们强调可以测算的量–职位数量，人均收入。

enable.en: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
enable.zh: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

enable.en: This will enable the audience to sit in comfort while watching the shows.
enable.zh: 这能使观众看演出时舒服地坐着。

enable.en: The spacecraft will enable scientists to study some dark corners of the solar system.
enable.zh: 太空船使得科学家可以研究太阳系中一些不为人知的角落。

cram.en: After dinner, it's time to hit the books again—at one of Seoul's many so-called cram schools.
cram.zh: 晚饭后，又到了在首尔众多所谓的一个补习班里读书的时间了。

cram.en: To make up for the mediocrity, zealous parents send their kids to the expensive cram schools.
cram.zh: 为了弥补平庸，积极的父母把孩子送到昂贵的补习班。

cram.en: The aim is to reduce the importance of costly tutors and cram schools, partly to help students enjoy a more normal high-school life.
cram.zh: 目的是降低昂贵的家教和补习班的重要性，部分是为了帮助学生享受更正常的高中生活。

motive.en: The motive for the killing is unknown.
There seemed to be no motive for the murder.
motive.zh: 这起谋杀案看不出有什么动机。

motive.en: The police have excluded theft as a motive for the murder.
motive.zh: 警方已排除这起谋杀案中的偷窃动机。

stimulate.en: These businesses stimulate the creation of local jobs.
stimulate.zh: 这些企业刺激了当地就业机会的产生。

stimulate.en: America's priority is rightly to stimulate its economy.
stimulate.zh: 美国的首要任务自然是刺激经济。

stimulate.en: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
stimulate.zh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。

motivate.en: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
motivate.zh: 你是如何激励人们努力而高效地工作的？

motivate.en: I think athletes sink or swim depending on how they motivate themselves.
motivate.zh: 我认为运动员的成败取决于他们如何激励自己。

motivate.en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
motivate.zh: 我们的艰巨任务是要激励那些投票者并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

inspire.en: He has neither the policies nor the personal charisma to inspire people.
inspire.zh: 他既没有谋略也没有个人魅力去鼓舞人。

inspire.en: We must promote originality, inspire creativity and encourage innovation.
inspire.zh: 我们必须提倡独创性，激发创造力，鼓励创新。

inspire.en: Subjects were picked to inspire or entertain.
inspire.zh: 文章主题要有激励人心或是让人愉悦的效果。

indulge.en: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine.
indulge.zh: 她只是偶尔才会喝上杯葡萄酒。

indulge.en: They went into town to indulge in some serious shopping.
The inheritance enabled him to indulge his passion for art.
indulge.zh: 这笔遗产使他能够尽情投入他热爱的艺术。

impetus.en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
impetus.zh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。
