solo.zh: 原版以吉他独奏为特色。

melody.zh: 我们要唱贝多芬旋律下面的低音部分。

rhythm.zh: 节奏布鲁斯演变成为摇滚乐。

rhythm.zh: 基本的韵律感和音高感是音乐教师的必备素质。

disc.zh: 披头士乐队于1962年灌制了他们的第一张唱片。

merchandise.zh: 这是第一部为自己的商品做银幕植入式广告的电影。

merchandise.en: From there, the merchandise was shipped across the Mediterranean Sea.
merchandise.zh: 货物从那里被运到地中海对岸。

stuff.en: Ugh! How can you eat that stuff?
stuff.zh: 啊！你怎么吃得下那种东西？
早期的东西通常都是很难听的。

souvenir.en: I bought the ring as a souvenir of Greece.
souvenir.zh: 我买了一枚戒指，留作对希腊的纪念。

souvenir.en: Please accept this little gift as a souvenir.
souvenir.zh: 请接受这个小礼物作为纪念品。

souvenir.en: You can keep that for a souvenir if you'd like.
souvenir.zh: 如果你们喜欢，你们可以把那个当做一个纪念品。

artefact.en: The Rosetta Stone is arguably the most famous archaeological artefact ever discovered.
artefact.zh: 罗塞塔石碑可以说是迄今为止发现的最著名的考古文物。

artefact.en: A wooden artefact found on the step pyramid at Saqqara looks uncannily like a modern glider.
artefact.zh: "在塞加拉的梯形金字塔上，人们发现了一个木制的手工制品，这个手工制品与一种现代滑翔机惊人地相似。
艺术品与人工制品之间存在着差异。

crude.en: Honestly, Nev! Must you be so crude!.
crude.zh: 天哪，尼夫！你怎么能如此粗暴呢！

crude.en: Crude oil is the world's most important commodity.
crude.zh: 原油是世界上最重要的商品。

material.en: Love without material foundation is just a plate of sand. No wind needed,it falls apart quickly.
material.zh: 没有物质的爱情，就是一盘沙，都不用风吹走两步路就散了

raw.en: Exploitable raw materials were in short supply.
raw.zh: 可开采的原料供应短缺。

raw.en: Raw materials were carried to the works by barge.
raw.zh: 原材料由驳船运到工厂。

raw.en: We cannot guarantee adequate supplies of raw materials.
raw.zh: 我们不能保证提供充足的原料。

utensil.en: Taking a camping utensil that can serve as a knife, fork and spoon to school.
utensil.zh: 他把一个可以做刀、勺子还有叉子的野营工具带到学校去了。

utensil.en: Objective To discuss the limitation of ultrasonic detection on prevenception utensil.
utensil.zh: 目的探讨超声在宫内节育器观察上的局限性。

utensil.en: The only unusual eating utensil is a pair of scissors used for cutting open the packages.
utensil.zh: 唯一不平常的就餐器具是一把剪刀，用来剪开包裹。

outfit.en: She was wearing an outfit she'd bought the previous day.
outfit.zh: 她穿着前一天买的一套服装。

outfit.en: Her stage outfit of hot trousers, over-the-knee boots and a tube top was a bit much.
outfit.zh: 她在舞台上的装扮是热裤、过膝长靴加紧身抹胸，太过分了。

outfit.en: The revamp includes replacing the old navy uniform with a crisp blue and white cotton outfit.
outfit.zh: 改进的内容包括将旧海军制服换成清新的蓝白相间的棉套装。

necessity.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
necessity.zh: 水是一种基本生活必需品。

necessity.en: There is agreement on the necessity of reforms.
necessity.zh: 关于改革的必要性有一致意见。

necessity.en: We were discussing the necessity of employing more staff.
necessity.zh: 我们在讨论是否需要雇用更多员工。

kit.zh: 我孩提时的偶像是基特·卡森。
克里斯托弗通常被称为基特。

kit.en: Make sure you keep a well-stocked first aid kit ready to deal with any emergency.
kit.zh: 确保你有一套足够库存的急救用具，随时应对任何突发情况。

trash.zh: 你可以把垃圾带出去吗？

trash.en: The yards are overgrown and cluttered with trash.
trash.zh: 院子杂草丛生，堆满了垃圾。

rubbish.zh: 他写的是自鸣得意、道貌岸然的垃圾。

garbage.en: Dig a pit and bury the garbage.
Put the lid on the garbage can.

garbage.zh: 一般的垃圾会被送到一般的垃圾填埋场。

recycle.en: The objective would be to recycle 98 percent of domestic waste.
recycle.zh: 该目标是循环使用98%的生活垃圾。

recycle.en: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
recycle.zh: 德国环保运动的力量已经使该国成了循环利用更多废料运动中的领先者。

reuse.en: Copper, brass, and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
reuse.zh: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以供再利用。

junk.en: He lived on a diet of junk food.
We still get junk mail for the previous occupants.
junk.zh: 我们仍会收到给先前住户的垃圾邮件。

junk.en: The truth is that junk bonds were misnamed, and therefore misunderstood.
junk.zh: 事实上，“垃圾债券”被叫错了名字，因此也被误解了。

litter.en: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
litter.zh: 动物们排斥一窝中最弱小的幼仔。

litter.en: If you see litter in the corridor, pick it up.
litter.zh: 如果你看到走廊里有垃圾，就把它捡起来。

litter.en: The amount of litter in the streets is unbefitting for a historic city.
litter.zh: 街道上垃圾之多与历史名城不协调。

waste.zh: 浪费好好的食物是有罪的！

waste.en: It's a waste of time and energy.
The waste was dumped in the sea.

landfill.en: The poison inside them moves through rain water to the bottom of the landfill.
landfill.zh: 它们里面的毒物通过雨水流到垃圾填埋场的底部。

landfill.en: Shrinking landfill space and rising costs for burying and burning rubbish are forcing local governments to look more closely at recycling.
landfill.zh: 垃圾填埋场面积的缩小，以及填埋和焚烧垃圾成本的上升，都在迫使地方政府更深入地研究如何回收利用垃圾。

landfill.en: It will come as no surprise to learn that the main candidates spent their largest sums on flyers, leaflets, posters and other bumf destined for the landfill.
landfill.zh: 得知主要的候选人将他们最大的一笔钱花在传单、传单、海报和其他注定要被填埋的垃圾上时，这并不惊讶。

sewerage.en: It is supposed to be washed down the gutter and into the city's vast sewerage system.
sewerage.zh: 它应该被冲入排水沟，流入城市的巨大排污系统。

sewerage.en: Sewerage systems carry wastes from homes, offices, and industries into water.
sewerage.zh: 排水系统将来自每家每户，办公室和工业中的废水排到水中。

sewerage.en: The pollutants that affect water come mainly from industries, farm, and sewerage systems.
sewerage.zh: 水的污染源主要来自工业、农场以及排水系统。

lotion.en: She rubbed the lotion into her skin.
lotion.zh: 她把润肤液揉搓进皮肤里。

lotion.en: The lotion cools and refreshes the skin.
lotion.zh: 润肤液使皮肤凉爽清新。

lotion.en: Regular use of a body lotion will keep the skin soft and supple.
lotion.zh: 定期使用润肤乳液可以使皮肤保持柔软光滑。

detergent.en: The detergent comes in powder or liquid form.
detergent.zh: 这种洗涤剂有粉状或液态两种。

detergent.en: This detergent is good for getting stains out.
detergent.zh: 这种洗涤剂能清除斑渍。

detergent.en: Grease marks can be removed with liquid detergent.

shampoo.en: This shampoo smells fruity and leaves the hair beautifully silky.
shampoo.zh: 这种洗发香波闻上去有水果味，使头发美丽柔顺。

shampoo.en: The shampoo lathers and foams so much it's very hard to rinse it all out.
shampoo.zh: 这种洗发水起泡太多，很难冲干净。

shampoo.en: Always using the same shampoo means that a residue can build up on the hair.
shampoo.zh: 总是用同一种洗发水意味着残留物会在头发上越积越多。

soap.en: He had soap suds in his ears.
Use a soap that is mild on the skin.
soap.zh: 使用对皮肤刺激性不强的肥皂。

soap.en: Make sure you rinse all the soap out.
soap.zh: 一定要把皂液冲洗干净。

tub.en: They found her lying in the tub.
tub.zh: 他们发现她躺在浴缸里。

tub.en: She poured all of the bath salts into the swirling water of the tub.
tub.zh: 她把所有的浴盐都倒进浴缸里旋动的水中。

plug.zh: 插头坏了，露出带电的电线。

plug.en: Check that the plug has not come loose.
plug.zh: 检查一下别让插头松脱了。
这个插头有没有安装保险丝？

tap.en: Is the tap water safe to drink?
tap.zh: 这自来水喝了不会闹病吧？

tap.en: A tap in the kitchen was dripping.

pipe.zh: 他（一口一口地）吸着烟斗。

tube.en: I work in the extruded tube business.
Stop up the other end of the tube, will you?
tube.zh: 你把管子的另一头堵上好不好？

tube.en: I went out today and bought a tube of toothpaste.
tube.zh: 我今天出去买了一管牙膏。

mop.en: Just a twist of the handle is all it takes to wring out the mop.
mop.zh: 只需旋转一下那个手柄就可以拧干拖把。

mop.en: Irene's use of the mop had been a calculated attempt to cover up her crime.
mop.zh: 艾琳使用拖把是个精心安排的举动，意在掩盖她的罪行。

mop.en: I mop the kitchen floor twice a week.
mop.zh: 我每周两次拖厨房的地板。

broom.en: There is a witch riding a broom.
broom.zh: 这有个骑着扫把的巫婆。

broom.en: We use broom to sweep the floor.

mattress.en: The mattress is best on a solid bed base.
mattress.zh: 床垫最好放在结实的床座上。

mattress.en: He crouched down and reached under the mattress.
mattress.zh: 他蹲下来，把手伸到了床垫下面。

mattress.en: The mattress and base are normally bought as a set.
mattress.zh: 床垫和床基通常成套购买。

sweep.en: Wintry weather continues to sweep across Colorado.
sweep.zh: 寒冬气候继续席卷科罗拉多州。

sweep.en: The rescue helicopter made another sweep over the bay.
sweep.zh: 救援直升机在海湾上空又搜索了一遍。
这些岛屿上经常刮大风。

carpet.en: I hope it doesn't stain the carpet.
The carpet was tacked to the floor.
carpet.zh: 地毯是用平头钉钉在地板上的。

rug.en: The corners of the rug were curling up.
The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
rug.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

rug.en: It is not possible to reposition the rug without damaging it.
rug.zh: 想要挪动地毯又不损坏它是不可能的。

mat.en: Wipe your feet on the mat before you come in, please.
mat.zh: 请在垫子上擦擦脚再进来。

mat.en: Of course, you found your door-mat.
mat.zh: 当然，你找到了你的擦脚垫。

mat.en: Who ever heard of a door-mat TELLING anyone anything?
mat.zh: 谁听说过擦脚垫能告诉人什么事？

cushion.en: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
cushion.zh: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶。

cushion.en: She embroidered flowers on the cushion covers.
cushion.zh: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

cushion.en: She embroidered the cushion covers with flowers.
cushion.zh: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

pad.en: Have a pad and pencil ready and jot down some of your thoughts.
pad.zh: 准备一本便笺簿和一支铅笔，迅速地记下你的一些想法。

pad.en: She wrote on a pad of paper.
pad.zh: 她写在了一本便笺簿上。

quilt.en: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
quilt.zh: 这床被子有好看的褶皱饰边，而且被面的花纹繁复。

blanket.en: I wrapped a blanket around the baby.
blanket.zh: 我用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

blanket.en: He rolled himself up in the blanket.
She tucked a blanket around his legs.
blanket.zh: 她拿一条毯子把他的双腿裹好。

sheet.en: This sheet has a tear in it.
He was as white as a sheet.
I tore another sheet from the pad.
sheet.zh: 我从本子上又撕下一张纸。

pillow.en: He pummelled the pillow with his fists.
pillow.zh: 他用双拳不停地捶打枕头。

pillow.en: The pillow cover can match up with the sheets.
pillow.zh: 这个枕巾可以和这些被单相配。

pillow.en: I have a pillow with my name embroidered on it.
pillow.zh: 我有一个绣着我名字的枕头。

sponge.en: He wiped off the table with a sponge.
sponge.zh: 他用一块海绵擦了桌子。

sponge.en: His mind was like a sponge, ready to absorb anything.
sponge.zh: 他的脑子跟海绵似的，什么都能吸收。

sponge.en: Take your jacket off and I'll sponge it down with water.
sponge.zh: 把你的夹克脱下来，我要用海绵蘸上水把它擦一擦。

towel.en: He flicked a wet towel at me.
He flicked me with a wet towel.
Pat it dry with a soft towel.
towel.zh: 用柔软的毛巾将它轻轻拍干。

staple.en: Royal gossip is a staple of the tabloid press.
staple.zh: 围绕王室成员的飞短流长是小报的主要内容。

staple.en: Fish is a staple in the diet of many Africans.
staple.zh: 鱼是许多非洲人饮食中的主食。

staple.en: It is well-known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
staple.zh: 众所周知，竹笋是熊猫的主要食物。

razor.en: He plugged his razor in to recharge it.
razor.zh: 他把剃刀插在插座上，给它充电。

razor.en: Van Gogh cut off his left ear with a razor blade in 1888.
razor.zh: 1888年，梵高用剃须刀片割掉了自己的左耳。

razor.en: Their electric razor gets hot and now the whole house smells like singed hair.
razor.zh: 他们的电动剃须刀变热了，现在整个房子闻起来像烧焦的头发。

shave.en: He never seemed to need a shave.
Charles decided to shave off his beard.
I lathered my face and started to shave.
shave.zh: 我往脸上涂了皂沫，然后开始刮胡子。

fuse.en: Changing a fuse is one of those fiddly jobs I hate.
fuse.zh: 换保险丝是我不愿干的麻烦事之一。

fuse.en: I paid $80 to have my car radio fixed and I bet all they did was change a fuse.
fuse.zh: 我付了$80修车里的收音机，我敢断定他们只是换了根保险丝。
检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

cable.en: They tied him to a chair with cable.
cable.zh: 他们用电缆把他绑在一把椅子上。

cord.en: He began to worry at the knot in the cord.
Mary got up, much mystified, and found the cord.
cord.zh: 玛丽站了起来，有些困惑，她找到了绳子。

cord.en: After the cord was cut, each sister took turns with their brother.
cord.zh: 绳索被割断后，姐妹们轮流和她们的兄弟在一起。

strand.en: She was wearing a strand of crystal beads.
Pauline wore a silk dress with a strand of pearls.
strand.zh: 保利娜穿了一条带有一串珍珠的丝绸连衣裙。

strand.en: She wore a single strand of pearls around her neck.
strand.zh: 她脖子上戴着单串珍珠。

match.zh: 火柴闪亮了一下就熄了。
他正在看一场英式足球比赛。

wax.en: It was recorded on a wax cylinder.

wax.zh: 上光蜡可保护木材和皮革。

paperback.zh: 这本小说重新发行了平装本。

paperback.en: When is it coming out in paperback ?
paperback.zh: 这本书的平装本什么时候出版？

paperback.en: She said she would buy the book when it comes out in paperback.
paperback.zh: 她说等那本书的平装本面市后她会买一本。

portfolio.en: The entire portfolio is worth $160,312. Of this amount, my investment is worth only $7,748.
portfolio.zh: 整个投资组合价值为$160312。在这当中，我的投资额仅为$7748。

portfolio.en: It is lumpy: you can offload parts of your share portfolio, but you cannot sell off the kitchen.
portfolio.zh: 这很麻烦：你可以抛售股票组合的一部分，但你却不能单卖一个厨房。

portfolio.en: The term investment portfolio conjures up visions of the truly rich—the Rockefellers, the Wal Mart Waltons, Bill Gates.
portfolio.zh: “投资组合”一词让人联想起真正的富人——洛克菲勒家族、沃尔顿家族、比尔·盖茨。

pamphlet.en: Madame Blavatsky wrote a pamphlet against phallicism.
pamphlet.zh: 布拉瓦夫人写了一本关于反对男性生殖器崇拜的册子。

pamphlet.en: We'll have to get this pamphlet out before next week.
pamphlet.zh: 我们必须在下星期前把这本小册子发出去。

pamphlet.en: His excellent pamphlet can be downloaded for free, here.
pamphlet.zh: 他那本出色的小册子，可以在这里免费下载。

tissue.en: As we age we lose muscle tissue.
tissue.zh: 随着年纪的增大，我们会失去一些肌肉组织。

tissue.en: The tissue and cartilage of a nose are too soft to fossilize.
tissue.zh: 鼻部的组织和软骨结构太软，无法形成化石。

tissue.en: Tissue that is removed during the operation is checked for signs of malignancy.
tissue.zh: 手术过程中切除的组织用于诊断疾病是否为恶性。

stationery.zh: 他们出售文具之类的东西。

stationery.en: I must go to the newsagent's to get some stationery.
stationery.zh: 我得去报刊经销处买一些文具。

memorandum.en: Perhaps even more so than with letters, memorandum should start with the statement of the purpose early in the message.
memorandum.zh: 也许备忘录比书信更重要的是，备忘录应该从信息的目的开始。

memorandum.en: When the internal message is lighthearted and relatively unimportant, humor in a memorandum can distinguish its author as a person with personality and depth.
memorandum.zh: 当内部信息是轻松的、相对不重要的时候，备忘录中的幽默可以展现作者的个性和深度。

memorandum.en: The King exclaimed, turning to the jury, who instantly made a memorandum of the fact.
memorandum.zh: 国王大叫道，转过身看着陪审员，陪审员立即作了记录。

duplicate.en: Is this a duplicate or the original?
His task will be to duplicate his success overseas here at home.
duplicate.zh: 他的任务将是在国内复制他在海外的成功。

duplicate.en: Robert Anderson to duplicate his Mexican success in the sub-continent.
duplicate.zh: 罗伯特·安德森在次大陆复制了他在墨西哥的成功。

cover.en: If it turns cold, cover the plants.
cover.zh: 如果天气变冷，就把植物盖起来。

scissors.en: He told me to get some scissors.

ink.en: The ink had run on the wet paper.
ink.zh: 墨迹在那张湿纸上渗开了。

rubber.zh: 这个男孩儿穿着橡胶底的鞋。

rubber.en: The smell of burning rubber filled the air.
rubber.zh: 空气中弥漫着橡胶燃烧的气味。

rubber.en: The stench of burning rubber was overpowering.
rubber.zh: 燃烧橡胶散发出的臭味极其强烈。

glue.en: I made a model out of paper and glue.
glue.zh: 我用纸和胶水做了一个模型。

glue.en: We used glue to stick the broken pieces together.
glue.zh: 我们用胶把碎片粘到一起。

glue.en: The smell of sawdust and glue pervaded the factory.
glue.zh: 锯屑和胶水的气味弥漫在工厂里。

shear.en: Competitors have six minutes to shear four sheep.
shear.zh: 参赛者们有6分钟的时间来给4只羊剪毛。

shear.en: The shear changed the quadrilateral into a parallelogram.
shear.zh: 四边形被剪成了平行四边形。

shear.en: To concrete shear walls, they add steel braces to a skyscraper's skeleton or beefier rebar.
shear.zh: 为了用混凝土覆盖剪力墙，他们把钢托支撑加到摩天大楼的骨架或是大钢筋上。

rim.en: There is also a new steering wheel with an energy-absorbing rim to cushion the driver's head in the worst impacts.
rim.zh: 还有新式方向盘，其边缘具有减震功能在最严重的冲击中缓冲保护司机的头部。

rim.en: Insects that land on the rim of the pitcher slide on the liquid and tumble in.
rim.zh: 落在水罐边缘的昆虫在液体上滑行，并在里面打滚。

rim.en: Other items included a Lapita burial urn with modeled birds arranged on the rim as though peering down at the human remains sealed inside.
rim.zh: 其他物品还包括一个拉皮塔人的骨灰盒，骨灰盒边缘摆放着模型鸟，仿佛在俯视密封在里面的人类遗骸。

element.en: Cost was a key element in our decision.
element.zh: 价钱是我们决策时考虑的主要因素。

element.en: Diamond is the crystalline form of the element carbon.
element.zh: 钻石是碳元素的晶体结构。
这个电壶需要一根新电热丝。

edge.en: I sat down at the water's edge.

chain.zh: 他敞开的衬衣里露出一条粗大的金链子。

chain.en: She had strung the shells on a silver chain.
chain.zh: 她把贝壳串在一条银链子上。

necklace.en: When did you first miss the necklace?
necklace.zh: 你最早发觉项链不见了是什么时候？

necklace.en: A plain necklace was her only adornment.
necklace.zh: 她身上的饰物就只有一串简单的项链。

necklace.en: The necklace consisted of amethysts set in gold.
necklace.zh: 这条项链是金镶紫水晶的。

bead.en: A bead curtain separated the two rooms.
bead.zh: 一挂珠帘子把两个房间分开。

bead.en: Her bead necklaces and bracelets jangled as she walked.
bead.zh: 她的珠子项链和手镯在她走路时叮当作响。

bead.en: You can imagine a bead with a wire going through it and the bead can only slide back and forth.
bead.zh: 你可以想象一个有金属丝穿过的珠子而且这个珠子只能前后滑动。

textile.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
textile.zh: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

textile.en: But the textile boom lasted only several decades.
textile.zh: 但是纺织业的繁荣只持续了几十年。

textile.en: They aided a substantial textile industry in another city.
textile.zh: 他们在另一座城市援助了一家庞大的纺织厂。

velvet.zh: 她身着蓝色的天鹅绒服装。

velvet.en: She was arrayed in a black velvet gown.
velvet.zh: 她穿着一件黑色天鹅绒长礼服。

velvet.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
velvet.zh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

wool.en: He wound the wool into a ball.

patch.en: He had a black patch over one eye.
Our dog has a bald patch on its leg.
patch.zh: 我们的狗腿上脱了一片毛。

rag.en: He plugged the hole in the pipe with an old rag.
rag.zh: 他用一块旧破布把管子上的那个洞塞住了。

rag.en: The ragged man drags a wagon of rag fragments.
rag.zh: 那个衣衫褴褛的人拉着一货车的破布碎片。

rag.en: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.
rag.zh: 他在一块油乎乎的抹布上擦着双手。

shabby.en: She wore shabby old jeans and a T-shirt.
shabby.zh: 她穿着一条破旧的牛仔裤和一件T恤衫。

shabby.en: The general divided his time between his shabby offices and his home in Hampstead.
shabby.zh: 将军的时间一部分在他那破旧的办公室里度过，另一部分在他汉普斯特德的家度过。

color.zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？
颜色是怎样被划定范围的？

yellow.zh: 他的眼球是不健康的蜡黄色。

white.zh: 我大口喝完两杯白葡萄酒。

brown.zh: 他脱掉了他的棕色无带鞋。
他拥有一双深邃的褐色眼睛。

purple.zh: 她穿着紫色和绿色的丝绸。

grey.zh: 该天花板是灰色并有裂缝的。

pink.zh: 她的连衣裙是非常鲜艳的粉红色。
朱迪最喜欢的颜色是粉红色。

pink.en: His face was a queer pink colour.

tan.en: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun.
tan.zh: 用化妆来伪造棕褐色的皮肤比让皮肤暴露于强烈的太阳光线更安全。

tan.en: They look best with tan or light brown suits.
tan.zh: 它们与棕褐色或浅棕色的西装搭配最好看。

tan.en: She is tall and blonde, with a permanent tan.
tan.zh: 她个子高，一头金发，皮肤黝黑。

stain.en: I rubbed at the stain on the cloth.
A dark red stain was spreading across his shirt.
stain.zh: 一个暗红色的污渍正在他的衬衫上渗开。
无原罪就是“无污点“的意思。

fade.en: The colour in this material does not fade.
Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
fade.zh: 此外，天然染料往往是浑浊的颜色而且它们很快褪色。

fade.en: My resentment of her slowly began to fade.
fade.zh: 我对她的怨恨慢慢地开始消退了。

blot.en: Her involvement in the fraud has left a serious blot on her character.
blot.zh: 她卷入了这次欺诈案，在她的品格上留下了一个很大的污点。

blot.en: Blot stain with vodka then launders in your regular wash.
blot.zh: 在污渍上抹点伏特加，然后按正常程序清洗即可。

blot.en: That foolish deed of his will remain a blot on his escutcheon.
blot.zh: 他的那种愚蠢行为将永远是他名誉上的污点。

figure.zh: 我的叔叔是个福斯塔夫式的人物。
甘地是一位有感召力的人物。
立方体是一种立体图形。

slender.en: Sherry is black, tall, slender and soft-spoken.
slender.zh: 谢里是黑人，个头高挑，身材苗条，说话柔声细气。

slender.en: She was of below average height, petite and slender.
slender.zh: 她低于平均身高，娇小且苗条。

slender.en: The slender stalks are weighed down with flowers.
slender.zh: 纤细的花梗被花儿压弯了。

slight.en: The table is at a slight tilt.

appetite.zh: 所有的水獭都有一个贪吃的胃口。

appetite.en: Go for a walk. It'll give you an appetite.
appetite.zh: 去散散步，你就有食欲了。

diet.en: We all need variety in our diet.
diet.zh: 我们都需要饮食多样化。

cater.en: They only publish novels which cater to the mass-market.
cater.zh: 他们只出版迎合大众市场的小说。

cater.en: In the contemporary western world, rapidly changing styles cater to a desire for novelty and individualism.
cater.zh: 在当代西方世界，快速变换着的款式迎合了人们对新奇和独特性的追求。
我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

treat.en: None of us knew how to treat her.
treat.zh: 我们中没有任何人知道该如何对待她。

treat.en: We treat boys exactly the same as girls.
treat.zh: 男孩、女孩我们完全同等对待。

treat.en: Valium is usually prescribed to treat anxiety.
treat.zh: 安定剂通常用于治疗焦躁。

provision.en: There is a lack of adequate provision for disabled students.
provision.zh: 为残疾学生提供的服务不够。

provision.en: The government is responsible for the provision of health care.
provision.zh: 政府负责提供医疗服务。

provision.en: One provision of the law was to roll back taxes to the 1975 level.
provision.zh: 该法律的一项条款是把税收削减至1975年的水平。

edible.en: The thallium content of chook is also lower than safe edible value.
edible.zh: 鸡不同部位的铊含量均低于铊的安全食用标准。

edible.en: Also they live in open fields where there is lots of edible vegetation.
edible.zh: 而且，它们生活在开阔的田野里，那里有很多可食用的植物。

edible.en: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible and smell wise.
edible.zh: 相比之下，食草动物的肉更易食用，闻起来更美味。

recipe.en: This recipe is foolproof—it works every time.
recipe.zh: 这个食谱绝对管用，每次都万无一失。

recipe.en: This recipe will be enough for four servings.

refectory.en: The Refectory is one of the finest restaurants in Columbus, Ohio.
refectory.zh: Refectory酒店是美国俄亥俄州哥伦布市最好的酒店之一。

refectory.en: The alfresco dining in the refectory has been particularly well received, as has the new gym and sauna.
refectory.zh: 在餐厅进行露天就餐更是颇受好评，同样受欢迎的还有新健身房和桑拿室。

refectory.en: The stereotypical village green and church tower overlook the Primary School Refectory built in 1609 by Edmond Gibbons.
refectory.zh: 千篇一律的乡村绿地，教堂的尖塔俯视着小学校的大食堂，这是由埃德蒙.吉伯于1609年所建的。

cafeteria.en: Does the college cafeteria provide a healthful diet?
cafeteria.zh: 此大学餐厅是否供应有益健康的膳食？

cafeteria.en: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria.
cafeteria.zh: 人们四仰八叉地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。

cafeteria.en: I went and had an overpriced cup of coffee in the hotel cafeteria.
cafeteria.zh: 我到宾馆的自助餐厅里喝了杯过于昂贵的咖啡。

restaurant.zh: 这餐馆为大众喜爱是理所当然的。
这个餐厅已换了新的东家。

buffet.en: Dinner will be a cold buffet, not a sit-down meal.
buffet.zh: 主餐是自助冷食，不是坐着等服务员送来的那种。

buffet.en: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
buffet.zh: 午饭时，可以选择自助餐或套餐。

buffet.en: It is a buffet, right? I love wedding buffets.
buffet.zh: 那是一个自助餐，对吗？我最喜欢婚礼自助餐了。

banquet.en: He was arranging floral centrepieces in the banquet hall.
banquet.zh: 他正在宴会大厅摆放餐桌中央的装饰花束。

barbecue.zh: 我们来一次户外烧烤吧！

barbecue.en: She shut the dog in the shed while she prepared the barbecue.
barbecue.zh: 她做烤肉时把狗关在窝里。

barbecue.en: We were going to have a barbecue but the rain put the mockers on that idea.
barbecue.zh: 我们打算露天烧烤，但因为下雨，计划泡汤了。

supper.zh: 他把晚饭吃的东西都吐了出来。
晚饭后我要做家庭作业。

refreshment.zh: 可以请您吃点喝点什么吗？

refreshment.en: In York we had a short stop for refreshment.
refreshment.zh: 在约克，我们稍作停留，吃了点东西。

appetizer.en: The host generally pays, and no one wants to hear you gripe about appetizer prices or shrimp count.
appetizer.zh: 主人通常都会支付账单，没人想要听到你抱怨关于开胃菜的价格或者小虾的个数。

snack.en: Lunch was a snack in the fields.
snack.zh: 午饭是在野外吃的快餐。

snack.en: I only have time for a snack at lunchtime.
snack.zh: 中午，我的时间只够吃点心。

snack.en: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
snack.zh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

cuisine.en: The Garden's menu is based on Hawaiian regional cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 花园饭店的菜肴以夏威夷地区的烹饪风格为基础。

cuisine.en: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 伊丽莎白·戴维兴奋地谈论普罗旺斯菜的口味、香气和特色。
他们为自己的美食感到自豪。

menu.zh: 一个侍者给他送上了菜单。

chef.zh: 迈克尔是受过职业培训的厨师。

chef.en: Bruce graduated to chef at the Bear Hotel.
chef.zh: 布鲁斯晋升为大熊酒店的厨师长。

chef.en: Try this new dish, created by our head chef.
chef.zh: 品尝一下这道新菜吧，是我们厨师长首创的。

takeaway.zh: 咱们今晚吃一顿外卖的饭菜吧。

takeaway.en: I never take chopsticks or plastic forks when I buy takeaway food.
takeaway.zh: 当我买外卖食物时，我从不使用筷子或塑料叉子。

takeaway.en: Everybody can buy takeaway food, but sometimes we're not aware how cheaply we can make this food ourselves.
takeaway.zh: 每个人都可以叫外卖，但有时我们并没有意识到自己做这些食物会有多便宜。

gourmet.en: The couple share a love of gourmet cooking.
gourmet.zh: 这对夫妇都有烹饪美食的爱好。

gourmet.en: Flavoured coffee is sold at gourmet food stores and coffee shops.
gourmet.zh: 调味咖啡在美食店和咖啡馆出售。

gourmet.en: As he traveled through the homes of early 19th century nobility, Carême forged the new art of French gourmet food.
gourmet.zh: 卡莱姆游历了19世纪早期贵族的家，并开创了法国美食这一新艺术。

order.zh: 改革显然是顺理成章的。

cutlery.en: Tables are set with white china and gold-banded silver cutlery.
cutlery.zh: 桌上摆好了白色瓷器和镶着金边的银制餐具。

cutlery.en: Each piece of cutlery is hand crafted and has it's own character.
cutlery.zh: 每一件餐具都是手工制作，各具特色。

cutlery.en: Though the chopstick is the quintessential cutlery choice throughout most of Asia.
cutlery.zh: 筷子是亚洲大部分国家最典型的餐具选择。

vegetarian.zh: 她公开声明自己是素食者。

ceramic.en: We'll now look at another ceramic which is made from mixing sand with minerals and heating to over 600 degrees Celsius.
ceramic.zh: 现在我们来看看另一种陶瓷，它是由沙子和矿物质混合，再加热到600多摄氏度制成的。

ceramic.en: Taihu region is one of the Chinese ceramics bases, of which the world-famous Yixing clay teapot is produced by Yixing's ceramic manufacturers.
ceramic.zh: 太湖地区是中国陶瓷生产基地之一，举世闻名的宜兴陶土茶壶就是由宜兴的陶瓷生产厂家生产的。

ceramic.en: Well over half of those ships were carrying cargo stored in large ceramic jars, many of which were preserved largely intact on the ocean floor.
ceramic.zh: 这些船只中有一半以上装载着储存在大型陶瓷罐子里的货物，其中许多罐子被完好无损地保存在海底。

silver.en: The cutlery is plate, not solid silver.
silver.zh: 这套餐具是镀银的，不是纯银的。

porcelain.en: There were lilies everywhere in tall white porcelain vases.
porcelain.zh: 到处都是插在白瓷高花瓶里的百合花。

porcelain.en: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
porcelain.zh: 属于这类物质的有云母、瓷器、石英、玻璃、木材等等。

porcelain.en: Her skin is porcelain with a smattering of freckles and she is slender, almost fashion-skinny.
porcelain.zh: 她的皮肤像瓷器那样，还带着一点雀斑。 她还很瘦，瘦得几乎像个模特。

bowl.en: She served him a bowl of beef stew.
bowl.zh: 她给他端了一碗炖牛肉。

bowl.en: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
bowl.zh: 我每天早上吃一碗麦片粥。

bowl.en: The glass bowl smashed into a thousand pieces.
bowl.zh: 玻璃碗咣的一声摔了个粉碎。

saucer.zh: 她的杯子把茶碟碰得叮当响。

saucer.en: I replaced the cup carefully in the saucer.
saucer.zh: 我小心翼翼地将杯子放回茶碟。

saucer.en: Rae's coffee cup clattered against the saucer as she picked it up.
saucer.zh: 蕾把咖啡杯拿起来的时候杯子碰响了茶碟。

tray.en: She came in with a tray of drinks.
tray.zh: 她端着一托盘饮料走进来。

tray.en: Stark took two whiskeys from a tray.
tray.zh: 斯塔克从托盘里拿了两杯威士忌。

tray.en: He brought her breakfast in bed on a tray.
tray.zh: 他把早餐用托盘给她送到床上。

dish.zh: 这个盘子是怎么打破的？
它从一个盘子里舐食牛奶。
每道菜端上来都是加过很多香料的。

fork.en: She stabbed the air with her fork.
She popped a balloon with her fork.
fork.zh: 她用叉子把气球砰的一声戳爆了。

fork.en: He poked at the spaghetti with a fork.

knife.en: He held the knife by its blade.

knife.zh: 那把刀划破了他的上衣。

spoon.zh: 她把调羹舔得干干净净。

spoon.en: He stirred his coffee with a spoon.
She licked the honey off the spoon.
spoon.zh: 她舔光了调羹上的蜂蜜。

mug.en: He picked up his mug and blew off the steam.
He stirred instant coffee into a mug of hot water.
mug.zh: 他将速溶咖啡搅入一大杯热水中。

mug.en: The mug tipped over, spilling hot coffee everywhere.
mug.zh: 杯子倒了，热咖啡溅得到处都是。

kettle.zh: 这个电壶需要一根新电热丝。
壶里的水开了，冒着蒸汽。

kettle.en: Someone went upstairs and brought down a huge kettle.
kettle.zh: 有人上楼拿下来一个巨大的水壶。

pan.en: She cracked an egg into the pan.
pan.zh: 她往锅里打了一个鸡蛋。

pan.en: She put a pan of water on the stove.

stove.en: I came in and kindled a fire in the stove.

stove.zh: “我们可能会毁了炉子。” —“管它呢！”

oven.en: The oven takes a while to heat up.
oven.zh: 烤箱得过会儿才能热起来。

oven.en: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
oven.zh: 在夏天，她的活动住房像个烤箱那样热起来。

pot.en: He was stirring a pot of soup.
She put some earth into the pot.
pot.zh: 她在花盆里放了一些泥土。

tin.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

tin.zh: 这个罐头能够装下那个罐头。

tin.en: Tin is a comparatively easy metal to smelt.
tin.zh: 锡是比较容易熔化的金属。

lid.en: I can't get the lid off this jar.
lid.zh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

beverage.en: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
beverage.zh: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。
咖啡是一种香味浓郁的饮料。

beverage.en: Notice the large beverage in this fellow's left hand.
beverage.zh: 注意这个人左手上的大瓶装饮料。

juice.en: Would you care for some orange juice?

soda.zh: 她很快地把汽水一饮而尽。
他喝了一杯冰激凌果味汽水。

soda.en: The soda was warm and had gone flat.
soda.zh: 这汽水是温的，已走了气。

coffee.zh: 他在咖啡里加了大量的糖。

alcohol.en: He gave up the crutch of alcohol.

alcohol.zh: 酒精对大脑迅速产生影响。

liquor.en: She drinks wine and beer but no liquor.
liquor.zh: 她喝葡萄酒和啤酒，但不沾烈性酒。

liquor.en: The room was filled with cases of liquor.
liquor.zh: 房间里满是一箱箱的烈性酒。

liquor.en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
liquor.zh: 1979年，作为折扣酒品专卖店的立可仓生意兴隆。

whisky.en: There was more whisky in it than soda.
whisky.zh: 那里面的威士忌比苏打水多。
这家工厂用蒸馏法酿造瓶装威士忌酒。

whisky.en: She swilled the whisky around in her glass.
whisky.zh: 她晃动着杯中的威士忌酒。

brandy.en: I gave him some brandy to ease the pain.
brandy.zh: 我给了他一些白兰地以减轻疼痛。

brandy.en: All sherry is made from wine fortified with brandy.
brandy.zh: 所有雪利酒都是由用白兰地强化了的葡萄酒制成的。

brandy.en: I don't drink whisky or brandy or any other spirits.
brandy.zh: 我不喝威士忌和白兰地，也不喝其他烈性酒。

drunk.zh: 他因为醉酒驾车被拘留了。
他喝醉了就喜欢寻衅滋事。
他喝醉酒，踉跄着回了家。

tobacco.en: Johnson still knew next to nothing about tobacco.
tobacco.zh: 约翰逊仍然对烟草几乎一无所知。

tobacco.en: We need to take a firm line on tobacco advertising.
tobacco.zh: 我们需要对烟草广告采取强硬的态度。

sober.en: He'd been drunk when I arrived. Now he was sober.
sober.zh: 我到的时候他已经喝醉了。现在他清醒了。
他穿着一套素净的灰色衣服。

vegetable.en: Severe brain damage turned him into a vegetable.
vegetable.zh: 严重的脑损伤使他变成了植物人。

vegetable.en: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule.
vegetable.zh: 蔬菜收割灾难性地滞后于计划。

vegetable.en: Peas, beans and lentils are a good source of vegetable protein.
vegetable.zh: 豌豆、豆荚和扁豆是植物蛋白质的大好来源。

tomato.en: It's similar in size to a tomato.
The tomato hit the wall with a splat.
tomato.zh: 西红柿啪的一声打在墙上。

tomato.en: Norman cut open his pie and squirted tomato sauce into it.
tomato.zh: 诺曼切开他的馅饼，往里面挤了番茄酱。

furnace.en: Their first job was to rewire the whole house and install a new furnace.
furnace.zh: 他们的第一份工作是给整个房子重新布线，并安装一个新火炉。

furnace.en: This room is as hot as a furnace.
furnace.zh: 这个房间热得像火炉一样。

furnace.en: Several processes—melting, refining, homogenising—take place simultaneously in the 2000 tonnes of molten glass in the furnace.
furnace.zh: 熔炉里的2000吨熔融玻璃中，几个过程——熔化、精炼、均质化——在同时进行。

potato.en: On the menu is wiener schnitzel and potato salad.
potato.zh: 菜单上有维也纳炸小牛排和土豆沙拉。

potato.en: All main courses are served with chips or baked potato.
potato.zh: 所有的主菜都配有炸土豆条或烤土豆。

pea.en: The tumour had shrunk to the size of a pea.
pea.zh: 肿瘤已缩小到豌豆大小。

pea.en: Each pea and peach on the beach can be reached by the peacock.
pea.zh: 海滩上的每一颗豌豆和桃子孔雀都能触及。

pea.en: You will learn how to cook a pea soup and a curd biscuit with raisins.
pea.zh: 你将学习如何煮豌豆汤和葡萄干凝乳饼干。

cabbage.zh: 我从来都讨厌吃卷心菜。

cabbage.en: "It's corned beef and cabbage," said Malone. "Yuck," said Maureen.
cabbage.zh: 马伦说：“是咸牛肉和白菜”。“嗯，真恶心”，毛琳说。

bean.en: Sometimes I take 'em off with a bean.
bean.zh: 有时我用蚕豆除掉它们。

bean.en: We have green bean casserole and pumpkin pie.
bean.zh: 我们有绿豆焙盘和南瓜馅饼。

bean.en: This is my favourite bean, and they are long bean.
bean.zh: 这是我最喜欢的豆角，它们是长豆角。

cucumber.en: Cucumber is good for soothing tired eyes.
cucumber.zh: 黄瓜对缓解眼睛疲劳很有效。
黄瓜和西兰花是绿色的。

onion.en: When the oil is hot, add the sliced onion.
onion.zh: 油热之后，加入切好的洋葱。

onion.en: You grind the onion and the raw cranberries together.
onion.zh: 你把洋葱和新鲜越橘一起磨碎。

eggplant.en: Now you just alternate layers of that mixture and eggplant.
eggplant.zh: 现在你只用把那种混合物与茄子一层层交叠起来。

eggplant.en: Apart from peppers and eggplant, many other vegetables grill well.
eggplant.zh: 除了甜椒和茄子，许多别的蔬菜烤起来也不错。

carrot.zh: 她的胡萝卜饼好吃极了。

carrot.en: It's never a carrot or a peach.
carrot.zh: 从来没有胡萝卜或桃子。

carrot.en: He made a snowman with a carrot nose!
carrot.zh: 他堆了一个长着胡萝卜鼻子的雪人！

mushroom.zh: 我已经把所有的蘑菇都拿出去了。

turnip.zh: 萝卜是另一种根茎类蔬菜。

turnip.en: The iron horse conducted the wood pig and turnip rabbit to play programs.
turnip.zh: 铁皮马指挥木头猪和萝卜兔演节目。

turnip.en: He yoked his oxen, and drew the turnip to the court, and gave it to the king.
turnip.zh: 他给他的牛套上牛轭，把萝卜牵到院子里，献给国王。

radish.en: It likes eating the grass, rabbit food, carrots, white radish, and other green vegetables.
radish.zh: 它喜欢吃草、兔粮、胡萝卜、白萝卜和其它的绿色蔬菜。

radish.en: Typical fare includes fried radish cake with a sweetish sauce, egg pancakes and soybean milk.
radish.zh: 典型的饭菜包括甜酱萝卜糕，鸡蛋煎饼和豆浆。

hull.en: She runs a general practice in Hull.
hull.zh: 她在赫尔开了个全科诊所。

hull.en: They got married and set up home together in Hull.
hull.zh: 他们结婚了，一同在赫尔建立了新家。

hull.en: They climbed onto the upturned hull and waited to be rescued.
hull.zh: 他们爬上了倾覆的船体，等候救援。

peel.en: The paint is starting to peel off.
Will you peel the potatoes for me?
peel.zh: 你给我削土豆皮好不好？

strip.en: The runway is simply a strip of grass.
strip.zh: 所谓跑道不过是一长条草地而已。

strip.en: The islands are separated by a narrow strip of water.
The yacht is built of cedar strip planking.
strip.zh: 这艘游艇用雪松木板材制成。

cherry.en: She tied a knot in a cherry stem.
cherry.zh: 她在樱桃梗上打了个结。

cherry.en: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
cherry.zh: 华盛顿的樱花今年开得早。

berry.en: Mr. Berry said the timing was a coincidence and that his decision was unrelated to Mr. Roman's departure.
berry.zh: 贝里先生说时间的安排是个巧合，而且他的决策与罗曼先生的离去毫无关系。

berry.en: Berry agrees and hopes her team's findings might one day help to break down plastics in landfills.
berry.zh: 贝里对此表示同意，并希望她团队的研究结果有朝一日能帮助分解垃圾填埋场中的塑料。

berry.en: Chuck Berry, who I saw a year or two ago, played guitar and did something approximating a dog walk.
berry.zh: 在一两年前，我看到 Chuck Berry 弹着吉他，像小狗走路一样跳着舞步。

grape.en: The colouring pigments from the skins are not allowed to bleed into the grape juice.
grape.zh: 这些果皮的色素不允许掺混进葡萄汁中。

grape.en: Is it a grape or a plum?
Juice blends contain various fruits like grape, apple and pear.
grape.zh: 混合果汁含有各种水果，如葡萄、苹果和梨。

peach.en: He picked out the ripest peach for me.
peach.zh: 他给我挑了个熟透了的桃子。

peach.en: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
peach.zh: 雨开始下，桃树就开花了。

peach.en: The walls were painted white with a hint of peach.
peach.zh: 墙壁粉刷成了略呈桃红的白色。

papaya.en: If you like, add some tropical fruits such as pineapple or papaya.
papaya.zh: 如果你喜欢，可以加入一些热带水果，如菠萝或木瓜。

papaya.en: If you like, add some tropical fruits such as pineapple or papaya.
papaya.zh: 如果你喜欢，可以加入一些热带水果，如菠萝或木瓜。

pear.en: She bit into a ripe juicy pear.
pear.zh: 她咬了一口熟透了的多汁的梨。

pear.en: Pear trees are grafted on quince rootstocks.
pear.zh: 梨树被嫁接到榅桲的根茎上。

pear.en: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.
pear.zh: 花园树木中患溃疡病最多的是苹果树和梨树。

plum.en: Italian plum tomatoes have a full flavour, and are best for cooking.
plum.zh: 意大利李子形番茄有着浓郁的味道，最适合烹饪。
把这个李子形番茄对半切开。

orange.en: I plucked an orange from the tree.
orange.zh: 我从树上摘了一个橙子。

orange.en: Orange is the big colour this year.
orange.zh: 橘黄色是今年的流行色。

orange.en: Would you care for some orange juice?

melon.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是哈密瓜。

melon.en: I bought this melon at half the price.

lemon.en: I plucked a lemon from the tree.
lemon.zh: 我从树上摘下一枚柠檬。

lemon.en: His favourite tipple was rum and lemon.
lemon.zh: 他最爱喝的饮料是朗姆酒加柠檬汁。

lemon.en: Grilled trout needs only a squeeze of lemon.
lemon.zh: 烤鳟鱼只需要一点柠檬榨汁。

corn.en: There was an old mill that really did grind corn.
corn.zh: 有一个真正碾磨玉米的老磨坊。

corn.en: The field had been ploughed and planted with corn.
corn.zh: 这块地已犁过并种上了玉米。

crop.en: Sugar is an important crop on the island.
crop.zh: 糖料作物是这个岛上的一种重要作物。

crop.en: Cranberries are a major cash crop in New Jersey.
crop.zh: 蔓越橘是新泽西州的一种主要经济作物。

grain.en: Surplus grain is being sold for export.
grain.zh: 过剩的谷物正销往国外。

grain.en: Any shortage could push up grain prices.
grain.zh: 任何短缺都会推动粮价上涨。

grain.en: The soup was a mash of grain and vegetables.
grain.zh: 那是用粮食和蔬菜做成的浓汤。

wheat.en: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.
wheat.zh: 他种植了2000英亩的小麦和饲料用草。

wheat.en: The price of wheat has decreased by 15%.

flour.en: She weighed out a kilo of flour.
If the dough is sticky, add more flour.
flour.zh: 如果面团很粘，就再加些面粉。

reap.en: Machines that reap and thresh in one operation.
reap.zh: 同时完成收割和脱粒的机器。

reap.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
reap.zh: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

reap.en: The company is just starting to reap the rewards of long-term investments.
reap.zh: 这家公司正开始收获长期投资的回报。

porridge.en: The prisoners subsisted on one mug of the worst quality porridge three times a day.
porridge.zh: 犯人一天三次靠一杯最差的粥维持生活。

porridge.en: They decided to boil the porridge first.

livestock.en: The heavy rains and flooding killed scores of livestock.
livestock.zh: 大雨和洪水淹死了许多家畜。

livestock.en: The robots are not limited to herding and monitoring livestock.
livestock.zh: 这些机器人并非仅能用于放牧和监控牲畜。

livestock.en: A livestock vaccine against the disease exists but is rarely used.
livestock.zh: 有一种家畜疫苗可以预防这种疾病，但它很少被使用。

chicken.zh: 卢克大声嚼着鸡肉三明治。

paste.en: It's quicker to cut and paste than to retype.
paste.zh: 剪切和粘贴比重新打字要快。

paste.en: This function allows you to cut and paste text.
paste.zh: 本功能可使你剪切并粘贴文本。

paste.en: She mixed the flour and water to a smooth paste.
paste.zh: 她把面和水和成细润的面团。

turkey.zh: 他们同土耳其缔结了一项条约。
我们过感恩节时总是吃火鸡。

beef.zh: 皮特狼吞虎咽地吃完了所有的炖牛肉。

beef.en: She served him a bowl of beef stew.
beef.zh: 她给他端了一碗炖牛肉。

mutton.en: This mutton has got a strong smell.
Hotpot is made from mutton and onion.
mutton.zh: 火锅是用羊肉和洋葱做的。

mutton.en: It has mutton slices and Chinese onion inside.

pork.en: Here the cooks dish out sweet and sour pork.
pork.zh: 在这儿厨师们把咕咾肉分份儿。

pork.en: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
pork.zh: 猪腿在火上经过了烟熏处理。

pork.en: This month's offers include a pork loin and avocados.
pork.zh: 这个月的特价品包括猪后臀肉和鳄梨。

sausage.en: The knife for cutting sausage was sitting in the sink.
sausage.zh: 用于切香肠的刀在水槽里。

pond.zh: 那傍晚的微风吹皱了水塘的表面。

pond.en: The pond was well stocked with fish.
The pond was choked with rotten leaves.
pond.zh: 池塘被腐烂的叶子塞满了。

rod.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
rod.zh: 该操作杆加倍弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的嗒嗒声。

rod.en: Her mother was there, trying to put a curtain rod up over the little window.
rod.zh: 她妈妈在那儿，正试着给小窗上安一根挂帘杆。

rod.en: This is a traditional fuel rod lens that glows underwater.
rod.zh: 这是一个传统的水下发光的燃料棒镜头。

dairy.en: He avoids all meat and dairy products.
dairy.zh: 他不吃任何肉类和奶制品。

yogurt.en: Yogurt is usually very low in fat.
yogurt.zh: 酸奶的脂肪含量通常很低。
酸奶是由活性培养菌制成的。

yogurt.en: This yogurt comes in ten different flavours.
yogurt.zh: 这种酸奶有十种不同的味道。

cheese.zh: 皮特吃了若干个硬面包圈和奶油奶酪。

butter.en: Butter is perishable and can go rancid.
Much of our butter comes from New Zealand.
butter.zh: 我们的黄油大多产自新西兰。
肉和奶油都贵得买不起。

salad.en: Can I help you to some more salad?
I think I'll go for the fruit salad.

hamburger.en: We stopped at a drive-in for a hamburger.
hamburger.zh: 我们在一家“免下车”餐馆停下来吃汉堡包。

hamburger.en: Shane was chowing down on a mammoth hamburger.
hamburger.zh: 谢恩正在狼吞虎咽的吃一个巨型汉堡。

sandwich.en: I ordered a beer and a sandwich.
sandwich.zh: 我要了一杯啤酒，一个三明治。

loaf.en: He was sawing energetically at a loaf of bread.
loaf.zh: 他正用力切着一条面包。

loaf.en: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold.
loaf.zh: 一块面包的价格已经涨了5倍。

loaf.en: Be quick, Gretchen! I had the silver pieces put into the smallest loaf to give you.
loaf.zh: 快点，格雷琴！我让人把这些银币放在最小的面包里并且给你。

pizza.en: I had a whole pizza to myself.
pizza.zh: 我独自吃了一整个比萨饼。
我们订一份外卖比萨饼吧。

pie.zh: 他把馅饼放在钓钩上作饵。

pie.en: We all had a second helping of pie.
pie.zh: 我们又都吃了一份馅饼。

pie.en: He polished off the remains of the apple pie.
pie.zh: 他把剩下的苹果派赶快吃完。

pasta.en: She dug into her bowl of pasta.
pasta.zh: 她津津有味地吃着碗里的面条。
我不怎么太喜爱意大利面食。

pasta.en: They stock every imaginable type of pasta.
pasta.zh: 他们备有各种能想到的意大利面食。

spaghetti.en: He's a dab hand at cooking spaghetti.
spaghetti.zh: 他是煮意大利面条的高手。

spaghetti.en: He poked at the spaghetti with a fork.

spaghetti.zh: 她吃了三盘意大利面条。

pudding.en: All that she would have to do was warm up the pudding.
pudding.zh: 她所需要做的只是加热布丁。

pudding.en: We found the apple pie pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious.
pudding.zh: 我们觉得这块苹果馅饼布丁令人无法抗拒。果然，它很美味。

soup.en: He was stirring a pot of soup.

biscuit.en: Someone has selfishly emptied the biscuit jar.
biscuit.zh: 有人自私地吃光了饼干罐里的饼干。

biscuit.en: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
biscuit.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃下了剩余的饼干和奶酪。

biscuit.en: Learn how to cook a curd biscuit with raisins.
biscuit.zh: 学习如何用葡萄干做凝乳饼干。

chocolate.zh: 他把那块巧克力一分为二。

jam.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam.
The fruit can be made into jam.
jam.zh: 这种水果可以制成果酱。

jam.en: Skim the jam and let it cool.
jam.zh: 撇去果酱上的浮沫，让它冷却。

nut.en: It's important to put a lock washer on that last nut, or it can work loose.
nut.zh: 重要的是要在最后一个螺母上安装一个防松垫圈，否则它会逐渐变松。

nut.en: They seldom remember where they buried every nut.
nut.zh: 他们不太记得自己把各个坚果都埋在哪儿了。

wasabi.en: I like to have sashimi and sushi with wasabi. That makes the taste delicious.
wasabi.zh: 我喜欢吃芥末的生鱼片和寿司，那使口味美味。

wasabi.en: Other flavors are green tea, ginger, sour plum, sesame, wasabi, clove, cardamom and pumpkin.
wasabi.zh: 其他口味包括绿茶、生姜、酸梅、芝麻、山葵、丁香、豆蔻和南瓜等。

wasabi.en: If the chef hasn't already added wasabi to your sushi, smear it directly onto the fish or roll.
wasabi.zh: 如果厨师没有直接在寿司里加入芥末，直接把芥末涂在鱼或者寿司卷上。

mustard.en: A little mustard is served on the side to add further piquancy.
mustard.zh: 旁边加上一点芥末来增添辛辣味。

mustard.en: He dropped his hot dog on the pavement and someone's dog ate it, mustard and all.
mustard.zh: 他把热狗掉在了街上，然后不知谁的狗给吃了，连带芥末全都吃了个精光。

mustard.en: Your wit is as thick as Tewkesbury Mustard.
mustard.zh: 你的智慧像图克斯伯里芥末一样厚。

vanilla.en: I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
vanilla.zh: 我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

vanilla.en: The vanilla gives off a nice smell.

pepper.en: She shook some pepper onto her sandwich.
pepper.zh: 她在她的三明治上撒了些胡椒。

pepper.en: The officers blasted him with pepper spray.
pepper.zh: 该警察用胡椒粉喷雾剂喷他。

pepper.en: Brush the eggplant with oil, add salt and pepper, and bake till soft. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a heavy pan.
pepper.zh: 给茄子刷好油，加盐和胡椒粉，烤到软。同时，加热厚底锅中剩余的油。

scallion.en: She often substitutes chopped scallion greens for garlic sprout.
scallion.zh: 她经常用切好的葱段代替蒜苗。

scallion.en: Wash and trim the scallion. Cut it into inch sections.
scallion.zh: 胡萝卜和洋葱去皮洗净切成块状，葱洗净切寸段。

scallion.en: Add in scallion and black mushrooms, stirring until fragrant.

garlic.en: You can taste the garlic in this stew.
garlic.zh: 在这炖肉里你可以尝出大蒜的味道。

garlic.en: The generous amount of garlic adds flavour.

ginger.en: I live mostly on coffee and ginger ale.
ginger.zh: 我喝咖啡和姜汁饮料几乎成瘾。

ginger.en: She was a mature lady with dyed ginger hair.
ginger.zh: 她是个成年女子，头发染成了姜黄色。

ginger.en: Put the onions and ginger in the oven and let them roast for thirty minutes.
ginger.zh: 把洋葱与生姜放入烤箱中烤30分钟。

vinegar.en: If the sauce seems too sweet, add a dash of red wine vinegar.
vinegar.zh: 如果酱太甜，就加少许红酒醋。

candy.en: Who wants the last piece of candy?

candy.zh: 吃吃这种糖。男孩子都喜欢吃糖。

salt.zh: 他朗诵一首题为《盐》的诗。

salt.en: Salt water is more buoyant than fresh water.

honey.zh: 你见到我的钥匙了吗，宝贝？

honey.en: She licked the honey off the spoon.
honey.zh: 她舔光了调羹上的蜂蜜。

honey.en: Warm the honey until it becomes runny.
honey.zh: 把蜂蜜加热到它变稀为止。

flavor.zh: 它有一种非常独特的味道。

flavor.en: Which flavor of moon cake do you like?
flavor.zh: 你喜欢什么口味的月饼呢？

flavor.en: These works have a strong flavor of rural life.
flavor.zh: 这些作品具有浓郁的农村生活气息。

sour.zh: 炎热的天气使得牛奶变酸了。

sour.en: Too much pulp produces a sour wine.
sour.zh: 过多的果肉会让酒变酸。

sour.en: The stewed apple was sour even with honey.
sour.zh: 炖过的苹果即使加了蜂蜜也还是酸的。

sweet.zh: 她是一位非常亲切的老太太。

bitter.zh: 这些叶子尝起来相当苦。
他一尝那苦味，做了个怪相。

spicy.en: The spicy flavours in these dishes call for reds rather than whites.
spicy.zh: 这些菜肴味道辛辣，宜配红葡萄酒而不是白葡萄酒。

delicious.zh: 他端上一顿可口的饭菜。
她招待我们吃了一顿可口的午餐。

delicious.en: They serve the most delicious roast beef.
delicious.zh: 他们做最美味的烤牛肉。

yummy.en: I'll bet they have yummy ice cream.
yummy.zh: 我打赌他们有好吃的冰激淋。

tasty.en: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
tasty.zh: 螃蟹虽然好吃，但很容易让人饱。

tasty.en: You don't have to spend a fortune to give your family tasty, healthy meals.
tasty.zh: 让家里人吃味道好又健康的餐食并不需要花许多钱。

spice.en: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
spice.zh: 这种调味品会给菜肴添加一种东方风味。

spice.en: The Spice Islands were within the Spanish domains.
spice.zh: 香料群岛曾是西班牙的领地。

spice.en: My team is working on a spice vending machine for spices.
spice.zh: 我的团队正在设计一个香料自动售货机。

sauce.zh: 这种调味汁尽是人造香料和色素。

ketchup.en: Would you like ketchup with your fries?
ketchup.zh: 你吃炸薯条要番茄酱吗？

thirsty.en: When a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often.
thirsty.zh: 婴儿口渴时，吃奶更频繁。

thirsty.en: They were all thirsty so I gave them a drink.
thirsty.zh: 他们都口渴了，所以我给了他们一杯饮料。

thirsty.en: Drink whenever you feel thirsty during exercise.
thirsty.zh: 锻炼时一感到口渴就喝水。

perfume.zh: 这种香水闻起来什么味道？

perfume.en: He caught a whiff of her perfume.
perfume.zh: 他闻到一股她身上的香水味。

supplement.en: Industrial sponsorship is a supplement to government funding.
supplement.zh: 工业界的赞助是对政府拨款的补充。

supplement.en: Business sponsorship must be a supplement to, not a substitute for, public funding.
supplement.zh: 商业赞助必须是公共资助的补充而非替代物。

supplement.en: The hand-out is a supplement to the official newspaper.
supplement.zh: 这份分发的是官方报纸的增刊。

ingredient.en: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
ingredient.zh: 什么是阿司匹林中的有效成分？

ingredient.en: Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
ingredient.zh: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

ingredient.en: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics.
ingredient.zh: 速度是所有体育运动的基本要素。

digest.en: Humans cannot digest plants such as grass.
You should allow a little time after a meal for the food to digest.
digest.zh: 饭后你应该留点时间让食物消化。

cook.zh: 她曾是个好得惊人的厨师。
她是一个特别好的厨师。
简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。

fry.en: You'll fry on the beach if you're not careful.
fry.zh: 若在海滩上不小心会被太阳灼伤的。

fry.en: We should use slow fire to fry fish.
And big fish provide more and better-quality fry.
fry.zh: 而大鱼可做更多更好的油炸食物。

bake.zh: 把糕饼烤至外皮呈金黄色。

bake.en: How did you learn to bake cakes?
bake.zh: 你是怎么学会烤蛋糕的？

bake.en: Bake until the pastry is golden and crisp.
bake.zh: 把油酥糕点烤至金黄酥脆。

roast.en: They serve the most delicious roast beef.
roast.zh: 他们做最美味的烤牛肉。

toast.en: He was choking on a piece of toast.
toast.zh: 他被一块烤面包噎得透不过气来。

toast.en: You'll be as warm as toast in here.
toast.zh: 你在这里会感到暖烘烘的。

lick.en: Well I will lick you, if you fool with me.
lick.zh: 好吧，如果你戏弄我，我就会打你。

lick.en: "And I didn't have to lick them, either," he added.
lick.zh: “而且我也没有打他们。”他补充道。

suck.en: Greenfly can literally suck a plant dry.
suck.zh: 蚜虫的确能把一株植物吸干。

suck.en: Good writers suck in what they see of the world, re-creating their own universe on the page.
suck.zh: 好的作家吸收他们所看到的世界，在书里重新创造自己的世界。

suck.en: You can suck the refreshment out through the straw.
suck.zh: 你可以用吸管把饮料吸出来。

chew.en: I do not chew gum in public.
chew.zh: 我不在公共场合嚼口香糖。

chew.en: After the operation you may find it difficult to chew and swallow.
chew.zh: 手术后你咀嚼和吞咽都会感到困难。

chew.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
chew.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

gum.en: I do not chew gum in public.
gum.zh: 我不在公共场合嚼口香糖。

soak.en: What I need is to soak in a hot tub.
soak.zh: 我需要的是在浴盆里泡个热水澡。

soak.en: I'm going to go and soak in the bath.
Give the shirt a good soak before you wash it.
soak.zh: 把衬衫好好泡一泡再洗。

dip.en: A brief dip into history serves to confirm this view.
dip.zh: 随便翻阅一下历史就足以证实这种观点。

dip.en: Just when she was ready to dip into her savings, Greg hastened to her rescue.
dip.zh: 就在她准备动用积蓄时，格雷格赶来救了她的急。

dip.en: He gave a dip of his head.

squeeze.en: We managed to squeeze six people into the car.
squeeze.zh: 我们在那辆车上挤进了六个人。

squeeze.en: Seven people in the car was a bit of a squeeze.
squeeze.zh: 那辆车坐了七个人是有点挤。

squeeze.en: If you move forward a little, I can squeeze past.
squeeze.zh: 你朝前挪一挪，我就可以挤过去了。

grind.en: There was an old mill that really did grind corn.
grind.zh: 有一个真正碾磨玉米的老磨坊。

grind.en: The grind of heavy machines could get on their nerves.
grind.zh: 重型机器发出的嘎嘎磨擦声会让他们心烦意乱。

grind.en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
grind.zh: 将胡椒子储藏在密封容器里，当你需要的时候把它磨成粉。

stir.zh: 不停地搅拌沙司，直到搅稠为止。

stir.en: A quick stir will mix them thoroughly.
stir.zh: 快速搅拌会使它们完全混合。

architecture.en: He began a new magazine on post-war architecture.
architecture.zh: 他创办了一份专论战后建筑的新杂志。

architecture.en: He studied classical architecture and design in Rome.
architecture.zh: 他在罗马学过古典建筑艺术和设计。

architecture.en: The building is a prime example of 1960s architecture.
architecture.zh: 这座大楼是20世纪60年代的典型建筑。

slice.en: Marina ate only one slice of bread.
slice.zh: 玛丽娜只吃了一片面包。

slice.en: He managed to slice a shot over the net.

erection.en: Americans were initially 14 for they had not raised the money to pay for the erection of the base.
erection.zh: 美国人最初是14岁，因为他们没有筹集到建造基地的资金。

erection.en: The rivalry between access providers offers the best protection against the erection of new barriers to the flow of information online.
erection.zh: 访问供应商之间的竞争提供了对抗线上信息流设置新障碍的最好保护。

erection.en: The erection of the building took several months.
erection.zh: 建造这座建筑物花了好几个月时间。

structure.en: How well does the teacher structure the lessons?
structure.zh: 老师对课程组织安排得如何？

structure.en: Sections of the structure have been left unsupported.
structure.zh: 这个结构有几部分没有支撑。

obstruct.en: They were accused of attempting to obstruct justice.
obstruct.zh: 他们被控企图妨碍司法公正。

obstruct.en: He has tried to obstruct intellectual freedom.
What varies is not the basic form but the incidental details that do not obstruct the object's primary function.
obstruct.zh: 变化的不是基本形式，而是不妨碍物体的主要功能的附属细节。

construct.en: My next work was to construct a nest and anchor it in a tree.
construct.zh: 我的下一步工作是建造一个巢穴,并把它固定在树上。

construct.en: Now let us construct two three-member sets based on the results.
construct.zh: 现在让我们根据结果构造两个三成员集。

construct.en: Vertical farms would need to be efficient, cheap to construct and safe to operate.
construct.zh: 垂直农场需要高效、廉价的建设和安全的运营。

establish.en: Ukraine indicated that it would establish its own army, 400,000 strong.
establish.zh: 乌克兰表示它将建立自己的军队，多达40万人。

establish.en: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
establish.zh: 我们正试图建立这些团体和金融机构间的联系。

establish.en: Police are trying to establish the cause of death.

found.zh: 我发现他和蔼可亲温柔迷人。
他刚刚建立的乐观情绪消失了。

concrete.zh: 我们坐在混凝土地板上。
我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

build.en: There are no plans to build new offices.
build.zh: 现在没有建新办公楼的计划。

build.en: They have permission to build 200 new houses.
build.zh: 他们得到建200座新房的许可。

build.en: We want to build a better life.
build.zh: 我们想创造更美好的生活。

steel.en: Coal and steel were the region's lifeblood.
steel.zh: 煤炭和钢铁曾是这个地区的生命线。

stability.en: It was a time of political stability and progress.
stability.zh: 那是一个政治稳定和进步的时期。

stability.en: Political stability, meanwhile, will be a prime concern.
stability.zh: 与此同时，政治稳定将是头等大事。

stability.en: My father wanted me to become a professional and have more stability.
stability.zh: 我父亲希望我成为一名专业人士，有更多稳定性。

site.en: Do you want to bookmark this site?
site.zh: 你想给这个站点做书签吗？
这个网站绝对值得设电子书签。

site.en: The monument was moved bodily to a new site.
site.zh: 整个纪念碑被迁到了新的地点。

venue.en: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
venue.zh: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。
会场被3 000名俱乐部会员挤得满满的。

venue.en: The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
venue.zh: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

landmark.en: Marble Arch is a famous London landmark.
landmark.zh: 大理石拱门是伦敦著名的标志性建筑。

landmark.en: The Menger Hotel is a San Antonio landmark.
landmark.zh: 蒙尔饭店是圣安东尼奥的一个标志性建筑。

landmark.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
landmark.zh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

situated.en: The hotel is conveniently situated close to the beach.
situated.zh: 那家旅馆坐落在海滩附近，非常方便。

situated.en: The hotel is centrally situated with ample free parking.
situated.zh: 饭店坐落在市中心，有充裕的免费停车位。

situated.en: The inn is picturesquely situated on the banks of the river.
situated.zh: 小客栈坐落在河畔，构成一幅美丽的图画。

locate.en: Now we need a way to locate this anchor.
locate.zh: 现在我们需要一种方法来定位这个锚点。

locate.en: Rescue planes are trying to locate the missing sailors.
locate.zh: 救援飞机正在努力查明失踪水手的下落。

locate.en: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room.
locate.zh: 设法确定气味是从哪里进入房间的。

reside.en: I reside at the mission at St. Michael's.
reside.zh: 我住在圣迈克尔教堂的布道所。

reside.en: Most known extrasolar planets reside in highly elongated, not circular, orbits.
reside.zh: 大多数已知的太阳系外行星都居住在高度拉长而非圆形的轨道上。

reside.en: Community members may reside temporarily in one of the lower zones to manage the extraction of products unavailable in the homeland.
reside.zh: 社区成员可以暂时居住在一个较低的区域，以管理在本土无法获得的产品的提取。

inhabit.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
inhabit.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

inhabit.en: The Olympic marmots inhabit meadows high in the Olympic Mountains where the weather conditions are much harsher.
inhabit.zh: 奥林匹克土拨鼠栖息的草地在奥林匹克山脉的高地，那里的气候条件要恶劣得多。

inhabit.en: A similar strategy—accelerated development combined with a resting stage—has also allowed amphibians to inhabit deserts.
inhabit.zh: 一个类似的策略——加速发展与休息阶段相结合——也使两栖动物得以栖息在沙漠中。

migrate.zh: 燕子在冬天迁徙到南方。
是什么导致了季风的迁移呢？

migrate.en: What about birds that migrate at night?

dwelling.en: The present position of the house coincides with that of an earlier dwelling.
dwelling.zh: 这栋房子现在的位置恰与原住宅的位置一致。

dwelling.en: After dwelling in Rio for ten years, she moved to Lisbon.
dwelling.zh: 她在里约居住了10年之后迁居到里斯本去了。

dwelling.en: He was therefore honourably received, and a special dwelling was assigned him.
dwelling.zh: 因此，他受到了隆重的接待，并被分配了到一个别致的住所。

skyscraper.zh: 那幢摩天大楼高耸入云。

skyscraper.en: The majesty of the skyscraper awed me.
skyscraper.zh: 这幢摩天大厦的雄伟气势令我惊叹。

skyscraper.en: The NEC's skyscraper and its gadgetry are controlled in the basement.
skyscraper.zh: 日本国家电气公司的摩天大楼和它的配件都在地下室进行控制。

settle.zh: 现在是当面解决这个问题的时候了。

settle.en: She had decided to settle permanently in France.
settle.zh: 她已经决定永久定居法国。
这样你的胃应该就不难受了。

villa.en: We rented a holiday villa in Spain.
villa.zh: 我们在西班牙租了一座假日别墅。

villa.en: My dream is to retire to a villa in France.
villa.zh: 我的梦想是退休后在法国住上一栋别墅。

mansion.en: The mansion has been put up for sale.
His new luxury mansion was a world away from the tiny house where he was born.
mansion.zh: 他那座新的豪宅与他出生的小屋完全不能相比。

mansion.en: I spent two nights in the mansion .
mansion.zh: 我在那座大厦住了两个晚上。

hostel.en: I've never stayed in a hostel before.
hostel.zh: 我以前从未住过招待所。

hostel.en: Someone told me there's another hostel called Gum Tree something.
hostel.zh: 有人告诉我那儿还有家招待所，叫“桉树”什么的。

hostel.en: The first possibility I found was a hostel called Top End Backpackers.
hostel.zh: 我找到的第一个选择是一家叫“顶级背包客”的招待所。

apartment.zh: 我们租了一套不带家具的公寓。
我有一套舒适的小公寓。
玛萨妮搬进了楼上的公寓。

hut.en: The little prefabricated hut was lifted away by a huge crane.
hut.zh: 那间小小的预制棚屋被一台巨大的起重机吊走了。

hut.en: You haven't lived till you've learned how to yodel at a tea dance in a mountain hut!
hut.zh: 你要是还未学会在山间小屋的下午茶舞会上用约德尔调歌唱的话，那你就白活了！

hut.en: Heidi just now came out of the hut.

lodge.en: He has four weeks in which to lodge an appeal.
lodge.zh: 他有4周时间来正式提出上诉。

lodge.en: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
lodge.zh: 我开车出了大门，经过看门人的门房。

lodge.en: He'd already started construction on a hunting lodge.
lodge.zh: 他已经开始建造一个狩猎用的小屋。

cellar.en: Suddenly she dashed down to the cellar.
He shone the flashlight around the cellar.
cellar.zh: 他用手电筒往地窖各处照了照。

cellar.en: Water had started to leak into the cellar.

cabin.en: He showed her to a small cabin.
cabin.zh: 他把她带到一间小房舱。

cabin.en: He paid for and was assigned a cabin in first class.
cabin.zh: 他付了钱，被安排到了头等舱。

shed.en: He was discovered hiding in a shed.
shed.zh: 人们发现他原来藏在棚屋里。

shed.en: David built us a shed in the back yard.
shed.zh: 戴维帮我们在后院搭了个棚子。
素食主义已经摆脱了其古怪的形象。

cradle.en: She rocked the baby to sleep in its cradle.
cradle.zh: 她摇动摇篮哄婴儿入睡。

cradle.en: The baby was rocked to sleep in a cradle.
cradle.zh: 婴儿在摇篮里被摇得睡着了。

cradle.en: A cradle is such a nice homely thing to have about a house.
cradle.zh: 摇篮在家庭中是一件很好的家常用品。

nursery.en: Her youngest child is at nursery now.
nursery.zh: 她最小的孩子现在上托儿所。

nursery.en: The nursery is bright and cheerful, with plenty of toys.
nursery.zh: 该托儿所明亮宜人，有许多玩具。

nursery.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
nursery.zh: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

shelter.en: They provided food and shelter for the poor.
shelter.zh: 他们为贫困者提供食物和住所。

shelter.en: They have dragged themselves thither for shelter.
shelter.zh: 他们费力地挪到那边躲避。

aisle.en: Coffee and tea are in the next aisle.
aisle.zh: 咖啡和茶在下一个走道处。

aisle.en: The aisle was floored with ancient bricks.
aisle.zh: 过道由古旧的砖块铺就。

aisle.en: She held me firmly by the elbow and led me to my aisle seat.
aisle.zh: 她使劲抓着我的胳膊肘，把我领到靠过道的座位上。

grid.zh: 地图上的坐标方格数字为C8。

grid.en: The project is designed to generate around 30 megawatts of power for the national grid.
grid.zh: 该工程规划为国家电网发电约3千万瓦。

grid.en: The television screens of the next century will be linked up to an emerging world telecommunications grid.
grid.zh: 下个世纪的电视屏幕将与一种新兴的世界电信网格相连。

block.en: He walked around the block three times.
block.zh: 他绕着这个街区走了3圈。

block.en: The drugs block the action of progesterone.
block.zh: 这些药物阻止孕酮发挥作用。

porch.en: A small boy tumbled off the porch.
porch.zh: 一个小男孩从门廊上摔了下去。

porch.en: I went out there on the front porch.
porch.zh: 我走了出来，到了前门廊。

porch.en: She huddled inside the porch as she rang the bell.
porch.zh: 她一边按门铃一边蜷缩进门廊里。

staircase.en: He groped his way up the staircase in the dark.
She was sitting on the bottom step of the staircase.
staircase.zh: 她正坐在最下面一磴楼梯上。

staircase.en: The house has a superb staircase made from oak and marble.
staircase.zh: 这座房子里有用栎木和大理石做成的一流的楼梯。

stair.en: The house had a panelled hall and a fine oak stair.
stair.zh: 房子的门厅装有镶板墙裙，楼梯是用高级栎木建造的。

stair.en: I often do stair climbing with my friends.
stair.zh: 我经常和朋友一起爬楼梯。

storey.en: The suspect took a leap out of a third-storey window.
storey.zh: 那个犯罪嫌疑人从三楼的窗口跳了出去。

storey.en: John was on the uppermost floor of the three-storey gatehouse.
storey.zh: 约翰在这栋三层门房的最高层。

storey.en: Some people proposed building multi-storey underground grave yards.
storey.zh: 有人提议修建多层地下墓地。

elevator.zh: 电梯猛震一下，升上去了。

elevator.en: I punched the button to summon the elevator.
We took the elevator to the fourteenth floor.

layer.en: A thin layer of dust covered everything.
layer.zh: 所有的物品上都积了薄薄的一层灰尘。

layer.en: Teeth have a hard surface layer called enamel.
layer.zh: 牙齿有一层叫做釉质的坚硬表层。

layer.en: I could see a thick layer of dust on the stairs.
layer.zh: 我能看见楼梯上厚厚的一层灰尘。

escalator.en: I pushed through the crowds and on to the escalator.
escalator.zh: 我挤过人群，上了自动扶梯。

escalator.en: The escalator wafts us up and down every day.
escalator.zh: 自动扶梯天天送我们上上下下。

escalator.en: But today, the escalator is jammed at the top.
escalator.zh: 但是今天，电梯堵在了顶楼。

handrail.en: Before we could replace the power supply, we would have to remove from the telescope a handrail fixed with four screws.
handrail.zh: 在更换电源之前，我们必须从望远镜上取下一个用四个螺丝固定的扶手。

handrail.en: I knew what it meant: The handrail could be completely pulled off and the safety tether might break, and I might therefore be pushed into space.
handrail.zh: 我知道这意味着什么：扶手可能会被完全扯下来，安全绳可能会断裂，我可能因此被推到太空中去。

handrail.en: Then Houston, the control centre on the earth, called up and told me to use the tape to tape the bottom of the handrail and pull it off the telescope.
