enter.zh: 警察注意到一个男人走进了银行。

exit.en: There was a stampede for the exit.
exit.zh: 出现了人群向出口的狂奔。

exit.en: The crowd made a mad rush for the exit.
exit.zh: 人群疯狂地冲向出口处。

exit.en: He made a quick exit to avoid meeting her.
exit.zh: 他迅速离去以避免见到她。

outward.en: Mark showed no outward signs of distress.
outward.zh: 马克在外表上没有现出沮丧的神色来。

outward.en: It was pointing outward at an angle of 45 degrees.

outside.en: Train your muscles and bones outside, and train your gomoku inside.
outside.zh: 外练筋骨皮，内练五子棋。

exterior.en: The exterior of the house needs painting.
The exterior walls were made of preformed concrete.
exterior.zh: 外墙是用预制混凝土建造的。

exterior.en: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
exterior.zh: 他不友好的外表下藏着一颗最善良的心。

inward.zh: 我内心释然地长出了一口气。

inward.en: Her calm expression hid her inward panic.
inward.zh: 她平静的外表掩盖了内心的恐慌。

inward.en: He pushed open the front door, which swung inward with a groan.
inward.zh: 他推开前门，门呀的一声向里开了。

interior.zh: 这种室内设计简约宜人。

interior.en: The ship's interior was an utter shambles.
interior.zh: 那艘船的内部一片狼藉。

external.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
external.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

external.en: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.
external.zh: 许多外在因素都可能影响人的心情。

external.en: College lecturers acted as external assessors of the exam results.
external.zh: 学院讲师是考试成绩的校外考核人。

inner.zh: “胆小鬼！”内心一个小声音坚持说。

inner.en: She doesn't reveal much of her inner self.
inner.zh: 她不大流露她的内心自我。

navigate.zh: 大多数蝙蝠通过回声定位飞行。

navigate.en: Such boats can navigate on the Hudson.
navigate.zh: 这样的船能在哈得孙河上航行。

voyage.en: He saw life as a voyage of discovery.
voyage.zh: 他把生命看作是一次探索未知世界的航行。

voyage.en: This voyage was his first taste of freedom.
voyage.zh: 这次航行使他第一次体验到自由的滋味。

voyage.en: In 1912, the Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.
voyage.zh: 1912年，泰坦尼克号首次航行时沉没。

internal.en: The medicine is not for internal use.

internal.zh: 该国加强了国内安全防卫。

internal.en: The doctor said the internal bleeding had been massive.
internal.zh: 医生说内出血的量很大。

aviation.en: The man had genius and had made his mark in the aviation world.
aviation.zh: 那位男士拥有天赋，而且在航空界已经成名。

aviation.en: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded.
aviation.zh: 该民航部长命令所有飞机不得起飞。

aviation.en: The airline's biggest headache is the increase in the price of aviation fuel.
aviation.zh: 令航空公司最头疼的问题是航空燃料价格的上涨。

safari.en: It arrived while I was on safari.
safari.zh: 这是在我外出期间送达的。

safari.en: He'd like to go on safari to photograph snakes and tigers.
safari.zh: 他想去游猎以拍摄蛇和老虎。

safari.en: Adrian Carr, a white Zambian, is one of the leading safari operators in the valley.
safari.zh: 艾德里安·卡尔是一名赞比亚的一名白人，他是这块谷地中主要的游猎经营者之一。

travel.zh: 在星期中间旅行较便宜。

parade.en: Felipe was in uniform for the parade.
He is not one to parade his achievements.
parade.zh: 他不是一个爱炫耀自己成就的人。

parade.en: The carnival parade was a magnificent spectacle.
parade.zh: 狂欢节游行场面热烈，蔚为大观。

haunt.en: The Wanglang Preserve in western Sichuan is the haunt of the giant panda.
haunt.zh: 川西的王朗自然保护区是大熊猫出没的地方。

haunt.en: Many a climb, they had together that took them far up, to the bare cliffs near the eagle's haunt.
haunt.zh: 他们一起爬了很多次山，爬到了离老鹰出没的地方不远的悬崖上。

haunt.en: The pub is a favourite haunt of artists.
haunt.zh: 这家酒吧是艺术家最爱光顾的地方。

attraction.en: The main attraction at Giverny is Monet's garden.
attraction.zh: 吉维尼主要的景点是莫奈花园。

attraction.en: Part of the attraction of photography is gadgets and mechanical doodads.
attraction.zh: 摄影术的吸引力部分在于它那些小装置和机械玩意儿。

attraction.en: She is the star attraction of the show.
attraction.zh: 她是这个节目中耀眼的明星。

memorial.en: The town raised a memorial to those killed in the war.
memorial.zh: 这座小镇为战争中牺牲的人树立了一座纪念碑。

memorial.en: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
memorial.zh: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。

memorial.en: The painting will be a lasting memorial to a remarkable woman.
memorial.zh: 这幅油画将成为对一位杰出女性的永久纪念。

pyramid.en: A twenty-foot steel pyramid is to be hoisted into position on top of the tower.
pyramid.zh: 一座20英尺高的钢制金字塔将被吊到塔顶该放的位置上。

pyramid.en: Traditionally, the Brahmins, or the priestly class, are set at the top of the social pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 传统上，婆罗门或僧侣阶层位于社会金字塔的顶层。

pyramid.en: The last group put the stones into the pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 最后一组把石头放进金字塔。

visa.en: Do you need a visa for the USA?

visa.zh: 他们居留超过了签证期限。

port.zh: 这个港口很安静，有未受破坏的自然美。

port.en: The ship spent four days in port.
port.zh: 这艘船在港口停泊了四天。

airline.zh: 航空公司对所造成的任何不便表示歉意。

airline.en: The airline industry took a hit last year.
airline.zh: 去年航空业受到了严重冲击。

airline.en: He spent seventeen years as an airline pilot.
airline.zh: 他当了17年的航空公司飞行员。

traffic.en: Coordinating airline traffic on the ground is as complicated as managing the traffic in the air.
traffic.zh: 协调飞机在地面上的交通和掌控空中交通一样复杂。

airplane.zh: 这架飞机有两套操纵装置。
他们开发了一种太阳能飞机。
她从我的飞机上摔了下来。

helicopter.zh: 直升机坠毁在附近的地面上。
他们最后被直升机救走了。

parachute.zh: 飞机用降落伞空投补给。

parachute.en: My first parachute jump was an exhilarating experience.
parachute.zh: 我第一次跳伞的经历很令人激动。

jet.en: He had arrived from Key West by jet.
jet.zh: 他已乘喷气式飞机从基韦斯特来了。

jet.en: I watched as they got on the jet ski.
jet.zh: 我看着他们坐上了喷气式滑艇。

jet.en: The aircraft is powered by a jet engine.
jet.zh: 这架飞机由喷气发动机驱动。

pilot.zh: 飞行员驾驶飞机安全着陆。
将来有一天我将成为一名飞行员。
飞行员完成了一个非常娴熟的着陆动作。

flight.zh: 我们订了同一班机的机票。
我那趟航班晚点了一小时。
该班机售票大大超出机位数量。

passenger.zh: 我把乘客门撞坏了一点。

passenger.en: She wedged herself into the passenger seat.

baggage.en: The baggage hall was crowded and noisy.
All exits must be kept clear of baggage.
baggage.zh: 所有出口必须保持通畅，不得堆放行李。

baggage.en: The fire started in the baggage compartment.
baggage.zh: 火是从行李舱着起来的。

luggage.en: Do you have a lot of luggage?
A luggage rack is a sensible option.
luggage.zh: 行李架是个明智的选择。

luggage.en: Two pieces of luggage have gone missing.

freight.en: Trains are taking a lot of freight that used to be routed via trucks.
freight.zh: 火车正在运送过去由卡车运送的大批货物。

freight.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labelled the freight as agricultural machinery.
freight.zh: 在报关单上，发货方将货物列为农业机械。

freight.en: Almost all the world's freight goes by sea, rail, and road.
freight.zh: 世界上几乎所有的货物都是通过海运、铁路和公路运输的。

rack.en: A luggage rack is a sensible option.
rack.zh: 行李架是个明智的选择。

rack.en: I took the key for the room off a rack above her head.
rack.zh: 我从她头顶上方的一个架子上拿下了该房间的钥匙。

rack.en: I looked through a rack of clothes at the back of the shop.
rack.zh: 我看遍了挂在商店尽里面的一架子衣服。

fare.en: The taxi driver picked up a fare at the station.
fare.zh: 出租车司机在车站接了一名乘客。

route.zh: 这条路线路标设置完善。
他们沿着事先规划的路线前进。

route.en: Which is the best route to take?

itinerary.en: The next place on our itinerary was Sedona.
itinerary.zh: 我们旅行计划的下一站是塞多纳。

itinerary.en: The two sides have agreed on the itinerary of the visit.
Life can be as busy or as relaxing as you like—we can even help you create your own itinerary of excursions to the other islands, each stunningly beautiful but very different.
itinerary.zh: 生活可以是繁忙的，也可以是轻松的，只要你喜欢——我们甚至可以帮助你设计自己的旅行路线到其他岛屿，每一个都美得令人惊叹，但非常不同。

passage.zh: 他读了一段爱默生的作品。

passage.en: Can you translate this passage into German?
passage.zh: 你能把这一段文字译成德语吗？

intersection.zh: 我们穿过了一个繁忙的道路交叉口。
这条公路止于一个十字路口。

intersection.en: Du Du was in his usual spot: the middle of Borgela and Sans-Fil Streets, a hilly hairpin intersection between downtown and the airport.
intersection.zh: 杜杜正在他常去的地方：博吉拉和桑菲尔街的中间，位于市中心和机场之间的丘陵发夹带的交叉口。

cross.en: The roads cross just outside the town.
cross.zh: 这些道路正好在城外交叉。
我开着他的货车横穿了全国。

path.zh: 三个男人挡住了她的去路。

lane.en: The road is only one lane wide.
lane.zh: 这条路只有一个车道那么宽。

lane.en: She signalled and pulled over into the slow lane.
lane.zh: 她给信号后把车开进了慢车道。

lane.en: The truck was travelling at 20 mph in the slow lane.
lane.zh: 那辆卡车以每小时20英里的速度行驶在慢车道上。

avenue.en: He walked up Fifth Avenue to clear his head.
avenue.zh: 他在第五大街上走，让头脑清醒清醒。

avenue.en: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue.
avenue.zh: 莉莉住在离公园大街不远的一处顶层公寓里。

avenue.en: Bergdorf Goodman has opened a men's shop on Fifth Avenue.
avenue.zh: 伯格多夫·古德曼在第五大道上开了一家男装店。

curb.en: He needs to learn to curb his temper.
curb.zh: 他得学着控制自己的脾气。

curb.en: It's easier to pick up apples than to drag tree branches all the way to the curb.
curb.zh: 摘苹果比把树枝一直拖到路边要容易得多。

curb.en: If patients pay very little out of their own pockets, they have little desire to curb consumption.
curb.zh: 如果病人自掏腰包支付的钱很少，他们就不会有遏制消费的意愿。

highway.zh: 安尼塔开车沿着太平洋公路向北行驶。
公路巡警关闭了这条路。

highway.en: I crossed the highway, dodging the traffic.
highway.zh: 我闪身避让着来往的车辆，穿过了公路。

signpost.en: There was a signpost where the two paths converged.
signpost.zh: 两条小路的相交处有一路标。

signpost.en: For him, the netsuke, so small and captivating, were not enough as a mere signpost to family history.
signpost.zh: 对他而言，这小巧迷人的吊坠并不能够作为仅仅是家族史的路标来看待。

signpost.en: This is a signpost on the road to American decline if we don't stop and restore the credibility of our markets.
signpost.zh: 如果我们不停下来，恢复我们市场的可信度，这就是通往美国衰落之路的指示牌。

pave.en: I believe this treaty will pave the way to peace in Europe.
pave.zh: 我相信这个条约将为欧洲的和平铺平道路。

pave.en: In India, they mix thrown-out plastic waste with asphalt and use it to pave new roadways.
pave.zh: 在印度，他们把丢弃的塑料废品和沥青混合起来，用来铺设新的道路。

pave.en: Last week, France announced that the country will pave 621 miles of road with solar panels over the next five years, with the goal of providing cheap, renewable energy to five million people.
pave.zh: 上周，法国宣布将在未来5年内铺设一条长达621英里的太阳能公路，以期为500万民众提供便宜的可再生的能源。

vehicle.en: The robbers drove off in a stolen vehicle.
vehicle.zh: 劫匪驾驶着一辆偷来的汽车逃跑了。

atlas.en: The events took place against the dramatic backdrop of the Atlas mountains.
atlas.zh: 活动在雄伟的阿特拉斯山脉举行。

atlas.en: Provided you have not cheated by consulting an atlas, you will notice something rather surprising.
atlas.zh: 如果你没有通过查阅地图集作弊，你会注意到一些相当令人惊讶的事情。

atlas.en: He feared that a map in the atlas could pull climate scientists into another vortex of damaging controversy.
atlas.zh: 他担心新闻评述会同地图集里的地图一道，将气象学家们拉入另一个破坏性争议的漩涡之中。

auto.en: The Auto Pact yoked Ontario into the United States economy.
auto.zh: 《汽车协定》强行将安大略纳入了美国经济体。

auto.en: Over the last decade, auto theft has increased by over 56 percent.
auto.zh: 过去的10年来汽车盗窃案上升了56％以上。

auto.en: Other authorities, however, think the auto is here to stay.
auto.zh: 然而，其他权威人士认为，汽车将继续存在。

tram.en: In 1882, the city's first electric tram cars went into service.
No money can be spent on the construction and operation of the tram.
tram.zh: 没有钱可以用于有轨电车的建设和运行。

tram.en: The project will also upgrade existing tram lines and bicycle paths.
tram.zh: 该项目还将改善现有的电车线和自行车道。

ambulance.en: He screamed for his wife to call an ambulance.
ambulance.zh: 他尖叫着，要妻子叫辆救护车来。

ambulance.en: When the ambulance had gone, the crowd dissolved.
ambulance.zh: 救护车离开后人群便散了。

coach.en: What you need is a drama coach.
coach.zh: 你需要的是一位戏剧指导。

coach.en: He's more than a coach, he's a friend.
coach.zh: 他不只是个教练，还是个朋友。

coach.en: Tony Woodcock has joined the team as coach.
coach.zh: 托尼•伍德科克已经作为教练加入了队伍。

express.en: Words cannot express how pleased I am.
express.zh: 言语无法表达我的愉快心情。

express.en: I'd like to send this express, please.
I could not express my innermost feelings to anyone.
express.zh: 我不能向任何人表达我内心深处的感情。

truck.en: They hitched a ride in a truck.
truck.zh: 他们搭乘了一辆路过的货车。

lorry.zh: 我的父亲是个卡车司机。

lorry.en: Emergency food supplies were brought in by lorry.
lorry.zh: 应急食物是用卡车运来的。

lorry.en: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy lorry.
lorry.zh: 他们不时听见一辆重型卡车的轰响声。

van.en: The driver got out of his van.

van.zh: 我开着他的货车横穿了全国。
他驾着厢式货车缓缓前行。

wagon.en: 150 years ago, wagon trains left from Lanham, Nebraska, bound for Oregon and California.
wagon.zh: 150年前，马车队从内布拉斯加州的拉纳姆出发驶往俄勒冈州和加利福尼亚。

wagon.en: On Sunday the horses were harnessed to a heavy wagon for a day-long ride over the border.
wagon.zh: 星期天这些马被套在一辆沉重的货车上，踏上长达一天的旅程越过边境。

pedicab.en: He has become the most popular pedicab driver in Kaifeng.
pedicab.zh: 他已经成为开封最受欢迎的三轮车手。

pedicab.en: In our alley alone, there are three pedicab riders.
pedicab.zh: 单单我们这条小巷就有三辆。

pedicab.en: This is my mother picking us up from the wharf, on pedicab.
pedicab.zh: 这是妈妈到码头接我们后乘坐三轮车回家。

carriage.en: I fought my way into a carriage just before the doors closed.
carriage.zh: 我正好在车门关闭之前挤进了一节车厢。

carriage.en: Again, buyers need to check if carriage is included in the price.
carriage.zh: 此外，买主需要核实售价中是否包含运费。

cart.zh: 大车哐当哐当地行驶在卵石路上。

cart.en: We harnessed two ponies to the cart.
cart.zh: 我们把两匹矮种马套到了车上。

cart.en: The cart began its gradual ascent up the hill.
cart.zh: 运货马车开始缓缓上山。

tractor.en: The truck was an 18-wheeler with a white tractor.
tractor.zh: 这辆卡车有18轮，还有一个白色牵引车头。

tractor.en: Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.
tractor.zh: 保罗把他的拖拉机挂在那辆小汽车上，然后把它拖到安全的地方。

tractor.en: A sprayer hooked to a tractor can spray five gallons onto ten acres.
tractor.zh: 挂在拖拉机上的喷雾器用五加仑液量能喷洒十英亩地。

garage.en: Tim climbed on to the garage roof.
garage.zh: 蒂姆爬到车库的房顶上。

garage.en: I have a battery tester in my garage.
garage.zh: 我的车库里有台电池测试仪。

garage.en: The police found him asleep in a garage.
garage.zh: 警察发现他在一处车库里睡着了。

cycle.en: We went for a cycle ride on Sunday.
cycle.zh: 我们星期天骑自行车去兜风了。

cycle.en: I usually cycle home through the park.
cycle.zh: 我通常骑自行车穿过公园回家。
这个周期一直循环往复。

horsepower.en: Our horsepower was less than half that of the winner.
horsepower.zh: 我们的马力还不到获胜者的一半。

motor.en: Both motor and sensory functions are affected.
motor.zh: 运动功能和感觉功能都受到影响。

motor.en: We are slaves of the motor car.

brake.en: The brake pedal had just snapped off.
brake.zh: 制动踏板刚才突然断裂了。

brake.en: The truck fishtailed when Bruun hit the brake.
brake.zh: 当布隆踩刹车时，卡车摆尾行驶。

brake.en: High interest rates are a brake on the economy.
brake.zh: 高利率阻碍了经济发展。

tire.en: The driver lost control when a tire burst.
tire.zh: 一只轮胎爆裂时司机失去了控制。

tire.en: People were beginning to tire in the midday heat.
tire.zh: 在中午的炎炎烈日下，人们开始感到疲劳。

tire.en: He felt he would never tire of listening to her stories.
tire.zh: 他觉得自己永远也不会厌倦听她的故事。

wheel.en: The wheel is pulling to the left.
The wheel is rubbing on the mudguard.

wheel.zh: 我的副驾驶突然抢过了方向盘。

honk.en: She pulled to the right with a honk.
honk.zh: 她按了声喇叭，把车开到了右边。
汽车司机鸣笛表示支持。

crew.en: In the distance the crew sighted land.
crew.zh: 船员发现在远处有陆地。

crew.en: Many crew members were up before reveille.
crew.zh: 许多船员在起床号响起之前就已经醒了。

crew.en: He is acting as liaison with the film crew.
crew.zh: 他担任拍摄组的联络员。

steward.en: They also claim that the security team elbowed aside a steward.
steward.zh: 他们还声称治安队把一名乘务员推到了一边。

steward.en: It suggests they haven't prioritized well enough how to steward their data.
steward.zh: 这表明他们没有很好地优先考虑如何管理他们的数据。

steward.en: The accord underlined Italy's global reputation as a good steward of art and culture.
steward.zh: 该协议突显了意大利作为艺术和文化的优秀管理者的全球声誉。

captain.en: He served as a captain in the army.

emergency.en: The government had to take emergency action.
emergency.zh: 政府只得采取紧急措施。

emergency.en: The government decreed a state of emergency.
emergency.zh: 政府下令进入紧急状态。

wreck.en: The wreck was raised from the seabed in June 2000.
wreck.zh: 沉船于2000年6月从海底打捞上来。

wreck.en: The precise location of the wreck was discovered in 1988.
wreck.zh: 船舶失事的确切地点是在1988年发现的。

crush.en: She had a crush on you, you know.
crush.zh: 你知道吧，她曾暗恋过你。

crush.en: They crush the olives with a heavy wooden press.
crush.zh: 他们用沉重的木制压榨机把橄榄压碎。

crush.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
crush.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

dash.en: Oh, Tim! I'm sorry but I have to dash.
dash.zh: 噢，蒂姆！很抱歉，但我得赶紧走了。

dash.en: He cut quite a dash in his uniform.
dash.zh: 他穿着这身制服显得特帅。

dash.en: The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
dash.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

crash.zh: 他平安逃过了这场车祸。

crash.en: The crash occurred on a sharp bend.
crash.zh: 碰撞发生在一个急转弯处。

disappear.en: They watched the bus disappear into the distance.
disappear.zh: 他们注视着公共汽车消失在远方。

disappear.en: It was uncharacteristic of her father to disappear like this.
disappear.zh: 就这样消失不是她父亲的风格。

disappear.en: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
disappear.zh: 交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

hazard.en: A new report suggests that chewing gum may be a health hazard.
hazard.zh: 一份新的报告指出，嚼口香糖可能给健康带来危害。

hazard.en: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
hazard.zh: 不幸的是，患感冒是这个行业的职业风险。

hazard.en: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard.
hazard.zh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

harbor.en: The Statue of Liberty towers stands above the harbor of New York.
harbor.zh: 自由女神像耸立在纽约港的上空。

harbor.en: Ships last a lot longer when they go to sea than when they stay in the harbor.
harbor.zh: 出海的船舶寿命要比留在港口里的船舶寿命长得多。

harbor.en: Though smaller than many other phocids, harbor seals are similar in size to most otariids.
harbor.zh: 虽然港海豹的体型较小，但其体型与大多数的 otariids（海狮和海狗）相似。

vanish.en: Ann saw the cheer vanish from her children face.
vanish.zh: 安看到孩子们脸上的笑容消失了。

vanish.en: The track seemed to vanish a hundred yards from where I stood.
vanish.zh: 离我站的地方一百码远，小路似乎消失了。

vanish.en: Some people believe that schools and libraries will vanish in the wake of the Internet.
vanish.zh: 一些人相信，在互联网到来之后，学校和图书馆会消失。

submerge.en: The waters were rising about the rock and would soon submerge it.
submerge.zh: 水涨到快跟岩石一样高了，很快就会将它淹没。

submerge.en: Their storage reservoirs stop the flow of rivers and often submerge towns, farms, and historic sites.
submerge.zh: 它们的蓄水池阻止了河流的流动，于是经常会淹没城镇、农场和历史遗迹。

submerge.en: The submarine had had time to submerge before the warship could approach.
submerge.zh: 潜水艇没等军舰靠近就及时潜入水下了。

dock.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
dock.zh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

dock.en: They dropped the sails and threw a line to a man on the dock.
dock.zh: 他们放下风帆，把船缆抛给码头上的人。

anchor.en: The ship lay at anchor two miles off the rocky coast.
anchor.zh: 船在离岩岸两英里处抛锚停泊。

sailor.en: A sailor carrying a sawn-off shotgun was arrested in Los Angeles.
sailor.zh: 一位携带着锯短的散弹枪的水手在洛杉矶被捕。

sailor.en: Divers this morning found the body of another American sailor drowned during yesterday's ferry disaster.
sailor.zh: 潜水员们今天早晨发现了在昨天渡轮失事中淹死的又一名美国水手的尸体。
他就可以像水手一样回答。

seaman.en: "Yes, can't you remember when we were very little," said the old seaman, "and ran and played about?"
seaman.zh: “是的，”老水手说，“你记得吗？我们小的时候常常在一起跑，一起玩耍。”

seaman.en: "I'm a seaman second class, " came the reply.
seaman.zh: “我是二等水兵。” 对方答复道。

seaman.en: Cook learnt fast and quickly became a skilled seaman.
seaman.zh: 库克学得很快，不久便成了一名技术熟练的水手。

steamer.zh: 你们的轮船什么时候启航？

steamer.en: The steamer Swadeshi had fouled the Howrah bridge and sunk.
steamer.zh: “斯瓦德希”号轮船撞在豪拉桥上沉没了。

steamer.en: Under the stress of competition, steamer was added to steamer, loss piled on loss, while the income dwindled till it ceased to be worth while to print tickets.
steamer.zh: 在竞争的压力下，轮船一艘艘增加，亏损越来越大，而收入却逐渐减少，最后连印船票都不值得了。

carrier.en: They brought baby Michael along in a carrier.
carrier.zh: 他们把小迈克尔放在婴儿车上一起带来了。

carrier.en: He stooped to pick up the carrier bag of groceries.
carrier.zh: 他弯腰提起装满食品杂货的购物袋。

carrier.en: American Airlines is the third-largest carrier at Denver International Airport.
carrier.zh: 美国航空公司是丹佛国际机场第三大客运航空公司。

liner.en: Hundreds of small craft bobbed around the liner as it steamed into the harbour.
liner.zh: 班轮驶进港口时，周围的许多小船颠簸起来。

liner.en: Once there were regularly scheduled airlines, it became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
liner.zh: 一旦有了定期的飞机航班，乘坐远洋客轮出差就变得不切实际了。

liner.en: How did you captain an ocean liner?
liner.zh: 你是怎样当上远洋客轮的船长的？

ferry.zh: 我们在奥斯坦德及时赶上了渡船。
渡轮拦腰撞了我们的船只。

ferry.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
ferry.zh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

vessel.en: The vessel yesterday reached anchorage off Dubai.
vessel.zh: 该船昨日抵达迪拜附近的锚地。

vessel.en: He loaded his vessel with another cargo and set sail.
vessel.zh: 他又往他的船上装了一件货就启航了。

vessel.en: A plane with Danish markings was over-flying his vessel.
vessel.zh: 一架带有丹麦标志的飞机正从他的轮船上空飞过。

raft.en: Several logs had been lashed together to make a raft.
raft.zh: 几根原木捆扎在一起做成了木筏。

raft.en: "Are you sure the raft is safe?" she asked anxiously. "Couldn't be safer," Max assured her confidently.
raft.zh: “你确定这筏子安全吗？”她不安地问。“再安全不过了，”马克斯自信地向她保证。

raft.en: My raft helps me cross the ocean of life.
raft.zh: 我的木筏帮助我横渡生命的海洋。

sail.zh: 我们明天下午两点起航。

sail.en: We set sail (for France) at high tide.
sail.zh: 我们在涨潮时起航（前往法国）。

sail.en: Most visitors come to sail or windsurf.
sail.zh: 游客大多是来进行帆船或帆板运动的。

oar.en: The blade of the oar had entangled itself with the strap of her bag.
oar.zh: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

oar.en: Each person has one oar which goes on one side.
oar.zh: 每个人都有一只桨，放在一边。

oar.en: They shoved off, presently, Tom in command, Huck at the after oar and Joe at the forward.
oar.zh: 他们很快就开船了，由汤姆掌舵，哈克划后桨，乔划前桨。

canoe.en: We paddled the canoe along the coast.
canoe.zh: 我们划着独木舟沿海岸而行。

canoe.en: The canoe floated upside down on the lake.
canoe.zh: 独木舟底朝天漂浮在湖面上。

canoe.en: The canoe is made from an impermeable wood.
canoe.zh: 该独木舟用防水木材制成。

turbine.en: If we can make a turbine, it's sold.
turbine.zh: 如果我们能制造涡轮机，它就卖出去了。

turbine.en: His name was Nenoit Fourneyron, and his device was the first successful water turbine.
turbine.zh: 他叫奈诺伊特·福内隆，他成功发明了第一个水轮机。

turbine.en: You don't have to erect a wind turbine in your backyard to make an impact on climate change.
turbine.zh: 你不需要在你的后院建造一个风力涡轮机来应对气候变化的冲击。

deck.en: I was hurled bodily to the deck.
deck.zh: 我整个人被扔到了甲板上。

deck.en: We lay sunning ourselves on the deck.
deck.zh: 我们躺在甲板上晒太阳。

propeller.zh: 一条绳子卡住了船的推进器。

propeller.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
propeller.zh: 随着低沉的隆隆声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

stern.en: He cast a stern glance at the two men.
stern.zh: 他严厉地瞪了那两名男子一眼。

stern.en: Our captain gave us a stern lecture on safety.
stern.zh: 我们的船长在安全问题上给了我们严厉的批评。

aboard.en: She invited 750 people aboard the luxury yacht, the Savarona.
aboard.zh: 她邀请了750人登上这艘豪华游艇，萨瓦罗纳号。

aboard.en: The most junior executive officer outranked the senior engineer officer aboard ship.
aboard.zh: 船上最低的执行官也比高级工程官的级别高。

aboard.en: As the ship berthed in New York, McClintock was with the first immigration officers aboard.
aboard.zh: 当那艘轮船停泊在纽约时，麦克林托克正和第一批上船的移民官员们在船上。

embark.en: Some forethought and preparation is necessary before you embark on the project.
embark.zh: 你着手进行这个项目之前必须有所考虑，有所准备。

embark.en: For some women I know, this sense of trust and self-belief later in life gave them the courage to leave dysfunctional relationships or embark on new career paths.
embark.zh: 对一些我认识的女性来说，这种信任感和自信心在日后给了她们离开不正常人际关系的勇气，或是从事新职业的勇气。

embark.en: Faced withunknown challenges, they are audacious enough to embark on a perilous journey while most of their peers enjoy stable salaries by working as white-collars at high-end office buildings.
embark.zh: 面对未知的挑战，他们敢于踏上一段危险的旅程，而他们的同龄人大多在高端写字楼里做白领，享受着稳定的薪水。

canal.zh: 他们沿运河测量了水深。

channel.en: I hope Channel 4 doesn't bleep it out.
channel.zh: 我希望第4频道别盖过这段话。

channel.en: Here the river is confined in a narrow channel.
channel.zh: 这条河在这里流入狭窄的河床。

ditch.en: The bicycle lay upended in a ditch.
ditch.zh: 自行车翻倒在一条小水沟里。

ditch.en: The car went skidding off the road into a ditch.
ditch.zh: 汽车打滑冲出公路跌进沟里。

ditch.en: I can't bring myself to ditch him and start again.
ditch.zh: 我不能说服自己抛弃他，又重新开始。

railroad.en: The Chicago and Northwestern Railroad wouldn't go along with that arrangement and said it would shut down completely.
railroad.zh: 芝加哥西北铁路公司不同意那项安排并说要彻底停止。

railroad.en: Court decisions always went against railroad workers.
railroad.zh: 法院的判决总是对铁路工人不利。

railroad.en: The railroad connects two cities, namely, New York and Chicago.
railroad.zh: 这条铁路连接两个城市，即纽约与芝加哥。

railway.en: He walked back over the railway bridge.
railway.zh: 他从铁路桥上走了回去。
这条铁路仍在建设之中。

railway.en: The new railway line will run overground.
railway.zh: 新铁路线将铺在地面上。

locomotive.en: Energy to drive a steam locomotive can be stored in other materials besides water.
locomotive.zh: 驱动蒸汽机车的能量可以储存在除水以外的其他物质中。

locomotive.en: This was before the steam locomotive, and canal building was at its height.
locomotive.zh: 这些事情都发生在蒸汽火车出现之前，而且，运河修建在那时正处于繁荣时期。

locomotive.en: At the conductor's whistle the engine-driver starts his locomotive-engine.
locomotive.zh: 乘务员哨声一响， 司机开动机车。

subway.zh: 过街地道里涂满了乱七八糟的图画和文字。

subway.en: The closest subway stop is Houston Street.
subway.zh: 最近的地铁站是休斯敦街。

subway.en: The subway is efficient and spotlessly clean.

tunnel.en: The tunnel was blasted out of solid rock.
tunnel.zh: 这条隧道是在坚固的岩石中炸出来的。

underground.en: The train was trapped underground by a fire.
underground.zh: 列车被一场大火困在了地下。

rail.en: Raw materials and labour come by ship , rail or road.
rail.zh: 从水上、铁路和公路运来原料和工人。

rail.en: Ticket prices include your flight and onward rail journey.
rail.zh: 票价包括您的飞行航程和接续的铁路旅费。

rail.en: She climbed the staircase cautiously, holding fast to the rail.
rail.zh: 她紧握扶手，小心翼翼地爬上楼梯。

depart.en: They depart, with a smile and a nod, and we miss them, and feel resentful.
depart.zh: 他们微笑着点点头，离开了，而我们又怀念他们，又怨恨他们。

depart.en: The research showed that the airport you depart from also influences the cost.
depart.zh: 这项研究显示，你离开的机场也会影响成本。

depart.en: These vehicles are only rated to spend about 200 days in space, so they'll have to depart soon.
depart.zh: 这些飞行器只能在太空中停留大约200天，所以他们必须尽快离开。

destination.en: Our luggage was checked all the way through to our final destination.
destination.zh: 我们的行李一直被托运到最终目的地。

destination.en: At last, after twenty hours on the boat, they arrived at their destination.
destination.zh: 乘船二十小时之后，他们终于到达了目的地。

destination.en: He gets you to your destination without turning the trip into a white-knuckle experience.
destination.zh: 他会将你安然无恙地送达你的目的地。

arrive.zh: 我们希望能在两点钟左右到达。
我们天黑以前应该能赶到。

delay.en: Can you delay him in some way?
delay.zh: 你能用什么办法耽搁他一下吗？
任何延误都可能导致失败。

postpone.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
postpone.zh: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

postpone.en: It was an unpopular decision to postpone building the new hospital.
postpone.zh: 延迟兴建新医院的决定是不得人心的。

postpone.en: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline.
postpone.zh: 延迟午夜的最后期限是根本不可能的。

defer.en: Customers often defer payment for as long as possible.
defer.zh: 顾客们经常尽可能地推迟付款。

defer.en: Let's say, both John and Mary defer to her leadership.
defer.zh: 假设，约翰和玛丽都服从她的领导。

defer.en: Doctors are encouraged to defer to experts.
defer.zh: 鼓励医生们听从专家的意见。

lull.en: There was a lull in political violence after the election of the current president.
lull.zh: 现任总统选举结束以后，政治暴力曾暂时平息。

lull.en: Most probably, the lull is due to the summer holidays.
lull.zh: 不过，现在的间歇很可能是正放暑假的缘故。

lull.en: So how likely is Toyota to repeat Audi's 15-year lull?
lull.zh: 那么，丰田有多大的可能性重复奥迪15年的恢复？

expire.zh: 你的驾照什么时候到期？
图书馆借书证四年后到期。

expire.en: He is planning another tour abroad, yet his passport will expire at the end of this month.
expire.zh: 他计划再次出国旅行，但他的护照将于本月底到期。

due.en: The accident was due to excessive speed.
due.zh: 事故的原因在于速度过快。

due.en: Many accidents were due to pilot misjudgment.
due.zh: 许多事故都是由于飞行员判断失误造成的。

postage.zh: 对于国外订单，邮资是另计的。
所有的价格都包括邮资和包装费。
本价格包括邮资和包装费。

mail.en: You can contact us by e-mail.
mail.zh: 你可以通过电子邮件跟我们联系。

stamp.en: A commemorative stamp will be issued October 15.
stamp.zh: 一枚纪念邮票将于10月15日发行。

stamp.en: He says he'll have no problem authenticating the stamp.
stamp.zh: 他说他完全可以鉴定这枚邮票。

stamp.en: He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
stamp.zh: 他把一张邮票贴到信封上。

packet.en: He went out to buy a packet of cigarettes.
They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.
packet.zh: 他们一下子把那包饼干全吃光了。

packet.en: A packet of photographs arrived with the mail.

parcel.en: The parcel came in this morning's post.
parcel.zh: 这个包裹是今天上午邮送来的。

parcel.en: There's a parcel and some letters for you.
parcel.zh: 有你的一个包裹和几封信。

parcel.en: I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel.
parcel.zh: 我设法偷偷地打开包裹的一角。

burden.en: The measures will lighten the tax burden on small businesses.
burden.zh: 这些措施将减轻小型企业的纳税负担。
艾米挺直身子，举起了身上的担子。

burden.en: We decided not to burden him with the news.
burden.zh: 我们决定不拿这个消息去烦他。

load.en: He talks such a load of piffle.

bind.en: Take him home and bind his wounds.
bind.zh: 带他回家，包扎他的伤口。

bind.en: The miser said, "Bind me fast, bind me fast, for pity's sake."
bind.zh: 守财奴说：“快把我绑起来，快把我绑起来，可怜可怜我吧。”

bind.en: They can bring us freedom in our relationships or bind us to them.
bind.zh: 它们可以给我们带来关系上的自由，也可以把我们束缚在一起。

transmit.en: The speed with which digital cameras can take, process, and transmit an image is phenomenal.
transmit.zh: 数码相机拍摄、处理、传输图像的速度惊人。

transmit.en: This is currently the most efficient way to transmit certain types of data like electronic mail.
transmit.zh: 这是目前传输电子邮件等某类数据最有效的方法。

deliver.zh: 我们承诺在48小时内送到。

transfer.en: The novel does not transfer well to the movies.
transfer.zh: 这部小说不太适宜改编成电影。

transfer.en: You can transfer data to a disk in a few seconds.
transfer.zh: 你可以在几秒钟内将数据转存到磁盘上。

transfer.en: How can I transfer money from my bank account to his?
transfer.zh: 怎么才能把我账户上的钱转到他的账户上呢？

transit.en: The contents of the package may have settled in transit.
transit.zh: 包裹里的东西可能在运输途中摇密实了。

transit.en: During their talks, the two presidents discussed the transit of goods between the two countries.
transit.zh: 在会谈中，两位总统讨论了两国之间货物的运输。

convey.en: Euclid was trying to convey his idea of a geometrical point.
convey.zh: 欧几里德正试图表达他的一个几何学观点。

convey.en: I have tried to convey something of the flavour of the argument.
convey.zh: 我试图表达某种类似论据的东西。

convey.en: Try to understand what messages they convey.
convey.zh: 尝试理解它们所传达的信息。

velocity.zh: 加速度和速度都是矢量。

velocity.en: Jaguars can move with an astonishing velocity.
velocity.zh: 美洲豹跑起来速度惊人。

velocity.en: I mean, that's the whole point of escape velocity, right?
velocity.zh: 我的意思是，这是逃逸速度的全部意义所在，不是吗？

swift.en: With a swift movement, Matthew Jerrold sat upright.
swift.zh: 马修·杰罗德迅速地坐直了。

swift.en: After the election there was a swift transfer of power.
swift.zh: 大选之后权力迅速交接。

swift.en: Our task is to challenge the U.N. to make a swift decision.
swift.zh: 我们的任务是敦促联合国做出迅速的决定。

speed.zh: 速度总是使他感到兴奋。
在这个时候速度是关键。

republic.en: The beer is brewed in the Czech Republic.
republic.zh: 这种啤酒是在捷克共和国酿造的。

republic.en: The Republic of Panama seceded from Colombia in 1903.

liberty.zh: 按了几个键后，丽贝卡连接上了她在自由航空公司的电脑。

liberty.en: You are at liberty to say what you like.

independence.en: He was afraid of losing his independence.
independence.zh: 他担心丧失自己的独立。

independence.en: I admired her independence and her spunk.
independence.zh: 我敬佩她的独立精神和她的勇气。

slum.en: This bum is an unemployed man in the slum.
slum.zh: 这个流浪汉是贫民区的一个失业者。

slum.en: Several businessmen had to slum it in economy class.
slum.zh: 几个商人只好将就着坐在经济舱里。

slum.en: In Sal Paulo, you can see shopping malls full of designer goods right next door to the slum areas without proper water and electricity supplies.
slum.zh: 在萨尔保罗，你可以看到紧挨着贫民区的购物中心里满是名牌商品，却没有适当的水电供应。

asylum.en: Only genuine refugees can apply for asylum.
asylum.zh: 只有真正的难民才能申请政治避难。

asylum.en: France has agreed to grant him political asylum.
asylum.zh: 法国已经同意给予他政治庇护。

refuge.en: They took refuge in a bomb shelter.
refuge.zh: 他们在一个防空洞里避难。

refuge.en: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
refuge.zh: 又有300人在美国大使馆避难。

refuge.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
refuge.zh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

population.zh: 伊拉克人口大约半数是什叶派教徒。

demographic.en: Such changes are also indicators of economic dynamism and demographic expansion.
demographic.zh: 这些变化也是经济活跃和人口膨胀的指示器。

demographic.en: There are substantial differences among consumers with similar demographic characteristics.
demographic.zh: 具有相似人口统计学特征的消费者之间存在实质性差异。

demographic.en: By the mid-19th century most of Europe was in the first stage of the demographic transition.
demographic.zh: 到19世纪中叶，欧洲的大部分地区处于人口转变的第一阶段。

citizen.en: She's Italian by birth but is now an Australian citizen.
citizen.zh: 她生于意大利，但现在是澳大利亚公民。

citizen.en: I don't appreciate being treated like a second-class citizen.
citizen.zh: 我不愿被人当作二等公民。

resident.en: Local resident groups have united in opposition to the plan.
resident.zh: 当地居民团体已联合起来反对这项计划。

resident.en: They cover preventative care for the local resident.
resident.zh: 他们为当地居民提供预防保健服务。

resident.en: And involving the future resident in the process can be very important.
resident.zh: 让未来的居民参与进来是非常重要的。

racial.zh: 对我来说，种族歧视非常可恶。

racial.en: The city had faced racial crisis and come through it.
racial.zh: 该城曾面临种族危机，但现已度过难关了。

racial.en: Longstanding poverty has been exacerbated by racial divisions.
racial.zh: 由来已久的贫穷因种族分裂而更加恶化了。

ethnic.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
ethnic.zh: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

ethnic.en: There is a crying need for more magistrates from the ethnic minority communities.
ethnic.zh: 迫切需要更多来自少数民族社区的官员。

ethnic.en: They've been living and working peacefully with members of various ethnic groups.
ethnic.zh: 他们一直与各种族群的成员们和平地生活和工作。

clan.en: Every family cultivates its vendetta; every clan, its feud.
clan.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的仇怨；每个氏族都有自己的世仇。

clan.en: To deal with the rabbit problem, settlers introduced stoats — a member of the weasel clan and a terrific predator.
clan.zh: 为了应对兔子的问题，定居者们引进了白鼬。 白鼬是黄鼠狼家族的一员——也是一个恐怖的掠食者。

clan.en: A weapon which would kill with accuracy at fifteen hundred yards opened a whole new vista of delights to every family or clan which could acquire it.
clan.zh: 一件能在一千五百码开外精准杀伤的武器，为每一个能获得它的家庭或部族带来了一幅全新的欢乐景象。

franchise.en: In the reorganization, Southern Television lost their franchise.
franchise.zh: 在改组过程中南方电视公司失去了特许经营权。

franchise.en: We have strengthened the franchise over the past year and GE Capital's earnings recovery should continue.
franchise.zh: 在过去的一年中，我们加强了特许经营，通用电气的资本收益恢复将继续。

franchise.en: The Iron Man franchise should trust Downey more, trust that we want to hang out with Tony Stark.
franchise.zh: 《钢铁侠》剧组应该更信任小唐尼一些，应该相信我们观众愿意跟着托尼·斯塔克。

entitle.en: This ticket does not entitle you to travel first class.
entitle.zh: 你拿这张票不能坐头等舱。

entitle.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
entitle.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

entitle.en: Golden parachutes entitle them to a full year's salary if they get booted out of the company.
entitle.zh: 黄金降落伞使他们一旦被公司解雇将有权获得一整年的薪水。

vote.en: The issue was put to the vote.

vote.zh: 所有隶属成员都有投票权。

respondent.en: One respondent to the survey believed that there is no true emotional bonding without touching and smelling a loved one.
respondent.zh: 一名调查对象认为，如果触摸不到爱人和闻不到爱人的气味，就没有真正的情感纽带。

respondent.en: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
respondent.zh: 一位受访者说：“艺术家帮助科学家开拓观众群体，并建立情感联系，从而改善学习效果。”
只有一位受访者表示乐观。

elect.en: The committee voted to re-elect him (as) chairman.
elect.zh: 委员会投票再次选举他担任主席。

elect.en: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
elect.zh: 委员会应对选出他们的那些人作出交代。

elect.en: Increasing numbers of people elect to work from home nowadays.
elect.zh: 现在越来越多的人选择在家上班。

preference.en: I can't say that I have any particular preference.
preference.zh: 我说不出自己有什么特别偏好。

preference.en: Preference will be given to graduates of this university.
preference.zh: 这所大学的毕业生会获得优先考虑。

preference.en: Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.
preference.zh: 咱们按优先顺序列出一份可能请到的发言者名单。

checklist.en: Make a checklist of the tools and materials you will need.
checklist.zh: 写一张你所需工具和材料的清单。
为你的小孩列一个清单。

poll.en: The final result of the poll will be known tomorrow.
poll.zh: 投票结果将于明天公布。

poll.en: A MORI poll showed that 68% of people opposed the ban.
poll.zh: 摩利公司的民意测验显示，有68%的人反对这一禁令。

poll.en: A recent poll gave Campbell a 68 percent support rating.
poll.zh: 最近的一次民意调查预计坎贝尔的支持率为68%。

nominate.en: The Security Council can nominate anyone for secretary-general.
nominate.zh: 安全理事会可以提名任何人为秘书长。

nominate.en: If you'd like to recognize the greenness of an individual or organization, why not nominate them for an Environmental Achievement Award.
nominate.zh: 如果你想赞扬某个人或团体的绿色环保行为，何不将他们提名为环境成就奖的候选人？

nominate.en: If you are interested, I will be happy to nominate you.
nominate.zh: 如果你感兴趣，我很乐意提名你。

ambition.zh: 这是她终身追求的目标。

ambition.en: He was corrupted by power and ambition.
ambition.zh: 权力与野心使他腐化堕落。

ambition.en: Even when I was young I never had any ambition.
ambition.zh: 即使当我年轻的时候我也从未有过什么雄心。

succession.en: They are semi-finalists for the fourth year in succession.
succession.zh: 这是他们连续第四年打入半决赛。

succession.en: He fired three shots in quick succession.
They had three children in quick succession.
succession.zh: 短短几年间，他们接连生了三个孩子。

welfare.zh: 福利给困苦提供了一个缓解。

welfare.en: The children's welfare must be seen as paramount.
welfare.zh: 孩子们的福利必须被视为是最为重要的。

welfare.en: Welfare reform is a top priority for the government.
welfare.zh: 福利改革是政府的当务之急。

harmony.en: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
harmony.zh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

harmony.en: Was it on the train "Harmony" that John met with his girlfriend?
harmony.zh: 约翰是在“和谐号”列车上遇到他的女朋友的吗？

harmony.en: The only way for us to survive is to live in harmony with nature.
harmony.zh: 我们生存的唯一途径就是与自然和谐相处。

flourish.en: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
flourish.zh: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

flourish.en: He opened the door for her with a flourish.
flourish.zh: 他做了一个夸张动作为她开了门。

flourish.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
flourish.zh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

succeed.zh: 这个项目似乎难以成功。

succeed.en: He is determined that you shall succeed.

steady.en: He spoke in a steady, even voice.
steady.zh: 当时他说话的声音平稳而镇静。

perspective.en: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
perspective.zh: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

perspective.en: I let things get out of perspective.
perspective.zh: 我没能正确地看待事物。

viewpoint.zh: 她对这个问题会有她自己的看法。

viewpoint.zh: 你得知道站在哪儿才会有好的视角。

viewpoint.en: From a practical viewpoint, I'd advise you not to go.
viewpoint.zh: 从实际角度考虑，我劝你不要去。

standpoint.en: From a medical standpoint a week is usually not a consequential delay.
standpoint.zh: 从医学观点看，一周通常不被视为是严重的拖延。

standpoint.en: He believes that from a military standpoint, the situation is under control.
standpoint.zh: 他认为从军事角度来看，局势已得到控制。

standpoint.en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
standpoint.zh: 从知识、道德和现实的角度来看，这种论点是站不住脚的。

prospect.en: The prospect of civil war is very real.
prospect.zh: 内战爆发的可能性确实存在。

prospect.en: There is no immediate prospect of peace.
prospect.zh: 短期内没有和平的可能。

prospect.en: The prospect of failure scares me rigid.
prospect.zh: 失败的可能吓得我都僵了。

outlook.en: He had a practical outlook on life.
I adopted a positive outlook on life.
outlook.zh: 我选择了一种积极的人生观。

outlook.en: The house has a pleasant outlook over the valley.
outlook.zh: 房子俯瞰山谷，景色宜人。

guideline.en: A written IQ test is merely a guideline.
guideline.zh: 书面的智商测试只是个参考。

guideline.en: The figures are a useful guideline when buying a house.
guideline.zh: 买房时这些数据很有参考价值。

guideline.en: Height-weight tables give an approximate guideline as to whether one is simply overweight or has passed into the obese stage.
guideline.zh: 身高体重表为判断一个人是单纯超重还是进入肥胖阶段提供了大致的指南。

ethic.zh: 从清教徒主义思想中衍生出的极强职业伦理。

ethic.en: Metamorphosis, in turn, certainly represents the horrible imagery of an ethic of lucidity.
ethic.zh: 反过来，《变形记》当然代表了一种清晰的伦理道德的可怕形象。

ethic.en: The former ethic suggested success was founded on integrity, modesty, loyalty, courage, patience, and so forth.
ethic.zh: 前一种伦理认为，成功建立在正直、谦虚、忠诚、勇气、耐心等的基础上。

suggest.en: I suggest we let the matter drop.
suggest.zh: 我建议咱们别再提及此事。

suggest.en: I suggest (that) we go out to eat.
The symptoms suggest a minor heart attack.
suggest.zh: 症状显示这是轻微心脏病发作。

proposal.zh: 这个建议已被断然否决。
这个建议并没有什么重大的争议。
目前人们正在详细讨论这个提案。

hint.en: She let fall a further heavy hint.
hint.zh: 她似乎无意中又说出了一个明显的提示。

hint.en: It was the barest hint of a smile.
hint.zh: 那是一个几乎不露一丝痕迹的笑。

hint.en: There was not a hint of badness in him.

advise.en: I'd advise you not to tell him.

affirm.en: I can affirm that no one will lose their job.
affirm.zh: 我可以肯定，谁都不会丢掉工作。

affirm.en: In my opinion, in the appraisal of migrant workers, it is one-sided to affirm everything or to negate everything.
affirm.zh: 在我看来，对农民工的评价中，肯定一切或否定一切都是片面的。

affirm.en: Everything I had accomplished seemed to affirm that opinion.
affirm.zh: 我所做成的每件事似乎都证实了那个观点。

proclaim.en: The details of her skeleton proclaim her human affinity.
proclaim.zh: 她骨骼的细节证明了她与人类的密切关系。

proclaim.en: They are no longer willing to debate whether photography is or is not a fine art, except to proclaim that their own work is not involved with art.
proclaim.zh: 他们不再愿意争论摄影是否是一门艺术，只是宣称自己的作品与艺术无关。

proclaim.en: What better time to proclaim the good news?
proclaim.zh: 什么时间分享这个好消息比较好呢？

claim.zh: 批评者声称这些卡车很危险。

claim.en: She is still pressing her claim for compensation.

state.zh: 音乐能引人进入沉思的状态。
我们担心他的精神状况。

state.en: State police are following up several leads.
state.zh: 州警察局正在追查几条线索。

clarify.en: Thank you for writing and allowing me to clarify the present position.
clarify.zh: 谢谢你来信并允许我澄清目前的状况。

clarify.en: I hope you could clarify a few things for me.
clarify.zh: 我希望你能帮我澄清几件事。

clarify.en: Mr. Wang wondered about her response, and just to clarify, he asked her another question.
clarify.zh: 王先生想知道她的回答，只是想澄清一下，他又问了她一个问题。

announce.en: They will announce the result of the vote tonight.
announce.zh: 今晚他们将宣布投票结果。

announce.en: He used the occasion to announce further tax cuts.
announce.zh: 他利用这个机会宣布再次减税。

announce.en: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter.
announce.zh: 她在计划宣布她与彼得的婚约。

assist.en: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.
assist.zh: 凡愿协助者可拨此号码联系。

assist.en: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.
assist.zh: 我们来这里保护和帮助病弱者。

assist.en: I was looking for a backer to assist me in the attempted buyout.
assist.zh: 我当时正在寻找一位赞助人来帮助我进行这次全面收购。

aid.en: They made a request for further aid.
aid.zh: 他们要求再给一些帮助。

aid.en: I can walk without the aid of crutches.
aid.zh: 我能够不借助拐杖走路。

implement.en: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
implement.zh: 领导才能是一种实行变革的能力。

implement.en: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.
implement.zh: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

implement.en: Now, let me scramble for my implement here.
implement.zh: 现在，让我在这里夺回我的工具。

encourage.zh: 父母鼓励一切可能的活动。

encourage.en: They encourage boys to be sensitive and artistic.
encourage.zh: 他们鼓励男孩子们要反应敏感并有美术才能。

encourage.en: They'd got a special grant to encourage research.
encourage.zh: 他们已得到了一笔用来支持研究的特别补助金。

monitor.en: Your doctor will monitor your blood pressure.
monitor.zh: 你的医生会监测你的血压。

monitor.en: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
monitor.zh: 官员们未曾获许监控选举。

monitor.en: He was watching a game of tennis on a television monitor.
monitor.zh: 他那时正在电视监控器上观看一场网球赛。

African.zh: 鼓是非洲音乐的基本乐器。
很多非洲部落相信转世再生。

admit.zh: 我得承认我一点都不懂。

European.zh: 大多数欧洲蜘蛛不咬人。

European.en: The tour takes in six European capitals.
European.zh: 这次旅游包括六个欧洲国家的首都。

European.en: London was different from most European capitals.
European.zh: 伦敦与大多数的欧洲首都城市不同。

Latin.zh: 现在学拉丁语的学生少得很。

Latin.en: Latin nouns have case, number and gender.
Latin.zh: 拉丁语名词有格、数和性。

Latin.en: Cuba was one of the least Catholic of the Latin countries.
Latin.zh: 古巴是拉丁语国家中最不信仰天主教的国家之一。

Jewish.en: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night.
Jewish.zh: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。

Jewish.en: Their children attend a Jewish parochial school.
Jewish.zh: 他们的孩子在一所犹太教区学校上学。

Jewish.zh: 布拉格最具神韵的街角之一是老犹太人区。

Arabian.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯的冬季期间内沙暴很常见。

Arabian.zh: “空白之地”是一大片沙地，覆盖了四分之一的阿拉伯半岛。

Arabian.en: Although men's touching is more normal in these cultures, physical contact between persons of opposite sexes who are not family members is negatively perceived in Arabian countries.
Arabian.zh: 尽管男性的身体接触在这些文化中更为正常，但在阿拉伯国家，人们会抵触非家庭成员的异性之间的身体接触。

Portuguese.en: Contemporary photographs are juxtaposed with a sixteenth century, copper Portuguese mirror.
Portuguese.zh: 把当代的照片与一面16世纪的葡萄牙铜镜摆放在一起。

Portuguese.zh: 野营是与当地居民接触的好途径，因为葡萄牙人本身就是热情的露营者。

Portuguese.zh: 我想说意大利语、葡萄牙语、韩语、中文、任何语言！

Roman.zh: 该小说的背景是罗马时期。
索雷吉耶塔女士是位罗马天主教徒。

Roman.zh: 反叛者与整个罗马军队战斗。

西班牙语已纳入课程内容。

Spanish.zh: 你还坚持说西班牙语吗？

Swiss.zh: 我当时正在吃夹火腿和瑞士乳酪的黑麦面包。

Swiss.zh: 我想保留我的瑞士银行账户。

Swiss.zh: 巨额款项存入了瑞士的银行账户。

Greek.zh: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

Italian.zh: 你他娘的意大利炮呢，给我拉上来！

soviet.zh: 苏联普通士兵的伙食很糟糕。

soviet.zh: 1990年，20万名苏联犹太人在以色列重新定居。

enterprise.zh: 国家官僚体制会压抑人的进取心和积极性。

enterprise.en: Its geographical location stimulated overseas mercantile enterprise.
enterprise.zh: 它的地理位置激发了海外商业企业的兴趣。

agent.en: An agent bought the rights to his life.
agent.zh: 一个代理商购买了他生平传记的出版权。

agent.en: Our realty agent says the sales contract is valid.
agent.zh: 我们的房地产代理人称该销售合同是有效的。

entity.en: These countries can no longer be viewed as a single entity.
entity.zh: 这些国家不能再被看成是一个单独的实体。

entity.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
entity.zh: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

entity.en: The unit has become part of a larger department and no longer exists as a separate entity.
entity.zh: 这个单位已附属于一个大的部门，不再作为一个实体独立存在。

invest.en: It would be hazardous to invest so much.
Many people don't like to invest in stocks.
invest.zh: 许多人不喜欢投资股票。

invest.en: They had the foresight to invest in new technology.
invest.zh: 他们有投资新技术的先见之明。

input.zh: 我将感激你在这方面的投入。

input.en: This program accepts input from most word processors.
input.zh: 这个程序可接受大多数文字处理系统输入的信息。

input.en: There has been a big input of resources into the project from industry.
input.zh: 工业界对这个项目投入了大量资源。

product.en: The product is at the design stage.
We cannot satisfy demand for the product.
product.zh: 我们不能满足对该产品的需求。

acquisition.en: Indeed, ease of acquisition is the problem.
acquisition.zh: 事实上，容易获得是个问题。

acquisition.en: He devotes his time to the acquisition of knowledge.
acquisition.zh: 他把时间用在获取知识上。

acquisition.en: The first hypothesis is the acquisition and learning distinction hypothesis.
acquisition.zh: 第一个假设是习得和学习差异的假设。

cargo.en: The cargo was hoisted aboard by crane.
cargo.zh: 货物由起重机吊上了船。

cargo.en: A fire had been reported in the cargo hold.
You can contract with us to deliver your cargo.
cargo.zh: 你们可以和我们签订合同，由我们负责运输你们的货物。

insure.en: Make sure you insure your camera against loss or damage.
insure.zh: 一定要给你的照相机投保，以防丢失或损坏。

insure.en: Families with modest incomes should insure the breadwinner or breadwinners first.
insure.zh: 收入不高的家庭应当首先为养家糊口的人投保。

insure.en: We insure against all damage, accidental or otherwise.
insure.zh: 我们的保险包括一切意外或其他损失。

reliable.zh: 我知道她是诚实可靠的。

guarantee.zh: 一些建筑商为他们的工作担保。

guarantee.en: The ticket will guarantee you free entry.
guarantee.zh: 这张票可保证你免费入场。

guarantee.en: Career success is no guarantee of happiness.
guarantee.zh: 事业成功并不是幸福的保证。

negotiation.zh: 拖得很长的谈判是不受欢迎的。

negotiation.en: We should not exclude the possibility of negotiation.
negotiation.zh: 我们不应该排除谈判的可能性。

negotiation.en: A contract is prepared in negotiation with our clients.
negotiation.zh: 我们和客户协商起草了一份合同。

attend.zh: 他们上的是哪一所学校？

attend.en: It was incumbent on them to attend.

attend.zh: 我们的孩子上同一所学校。

absent.en: She was absent for nine consecutive days.
The pictures, too, were absent from the walls.
absent.zh: 那些照片也不在那些墙上了。

wholesale.en: Warehouse clubs allow members to buy goods at wholesale prices.
wholesale.zh: 仓储式会所允许会员以批发价购买商品。

wholesale.en: We sell wholesale to several chains that sell retail to the public.
wholesale.zh: 我们批发给几家向公众零售的连锁店。

wholesale.en: They are only doing what is necessary to prevent wholesale destruction of vegetation.
wholesale.zh: 他们只是在做为防止植被遭大规模破坏而必须做的事情。

sale.en: They've put their house up for sale.

auction.zh: 吉恩在拍卖行做文书工作。

auction.en: The sale is a big coup for the auction house.
auction.zh: 这次拍卖额对该拍卖行而言是极为难得的成就。

auction.en: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.
auction.zh: 昨天的拍卖之前交易很少。

transaction.en: The transaction is completed by payment of the fee.
transaction.zh: 交易在支付费用之后就完成了。

transaction.en: Neither side would disclose details of the transaction.
transaction.zh: 双方都不会透露交易的细节。

transaction.en: The new device can also cancel the cheque after the transaction is complete.
transaction.zh: 这种新设备还能在交易结束后将支票注销。

deal.zh: 他们达成了协议，相互握手祝贺。

bid.en: The bank announced its intention to bid.
bid.zh: 银行宣布了其投标意向。

bid.en: Granada mounted a hostile takeover bid for Forte.
bid.zh: 格兰纳达公司向福特公司出价进行敌意收购。

bid.en: Hanson made an agreed takeover bid of $351 million.
bid.zh: 汉森按约定出价3.51亿美元进行收购。

turnover.en: We have a fast turnover of stock.

turnover.zh: 去年我们的营业额竟然增加了。

dump.en: The place was, if you'll pardon the expression , a dump.
dump.zh: 那个地方，请恕我直言，简直是个垃圾场。

dump.en: With bonfires outlawed in urban areas, gardeners must cart their refuse to a dump.
dump.zh: 市区禁止户外焚烧垃圾，园林工人必须用推车把垃圾运到垃圾场。

dump.en: But before you dump all of your retail stocks, there are more facts you should consider.
dump.zh: 但在你倾销所有的零售商品库存之前，还有更多需要考虑的问题。

export.zh: 加纳的主要出口产品是可可。

export.en: Export sales were up by 32% last year.
export.zh: 去年出口销售额增长了32%。

quota.en: I'm going home now—I've done my quota of work for the day.
quota.zh: 我现在要回家了—我已完成了今天的工作指标。

quota.en: The quota of four tickets per person had been reduced to two.
quota.zh: 每人4张票的限额已减少到了2张。

quota.en: The bill would force employers to adopt a quota system when recruiting workers.
quota.zh: 该法案将迫使雇主们在录用工人时采取配额制。

import.zh: 这种争论几乎不具重要性。

import.en: The country has to import most of its raw materials.
import.zh: 这个国家大多数原料均依赖进口。

benefit.en: I've had the benefit of a good education.
benefit.zh: 我得益于受过良好教育。

benefit.en: I might benefit from getting my teeth fixed.
benefit.zh: 把牙齿补好可能对我有好处。

benefit.en: He's not entitled to claim unemployment benefit.
benefit.zh: 他无权要求领取失业救济金。

share.zh: 股票价格停滞在102便士上。

stock.en: We stock a wide range of perfumes.
stock.zh: 我们备有各种各样的香水。

instalment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things,soap operas and instalment plans introduced in the 1970s. Both played an important9 although indirect, role in lowering the birth rate.
instalment.zh: 玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。尽管是间接的，两者在降低出生率方面都发挥了重要的作用。

instalment.en: The final instalment on the loan is due next week.
instalment.zh: 贷款的最后一期付款下个星期到期。

instalment.en: Upper-bracket taxpayers who elected to pay their tax increase in instalments must pay the third instalment by April 15.
instalment.zh: 选择分期支付增税的高额纳税人必须在4月15日之前交纳第3期税款。

deposit.zh: 房东可以收取一笔可退还的押金。

deposit.en: A returnable deposit is payable on arrival.
deposit.zh: 抵达时应支付可退还押金。

account.zh: 你的活期存款账户计息吗？

check.zh: 检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

check.en: Could you give the tyres a check?
Check that all the details are correct.
check.zh: 检查所有这些细节是否准确无误。

coin.zh: 咱们掷硬币猜边儿决定吧。

coin.en: The inscription on the coin had worn away.
coin.zh: 铸在这枚硬币上的文字已磨平了。

shilling.en: Mrs. Medlock said I was to have a shilling a week to spend.
shilling.zh: 梅德洛克太太说我每星期有一先令可以花。

shilling.en: There's twelve of us an' my father only gets sixteen shilling a week.
shilling.zh: 我们家有十二口人，我父亲一星期只挣十六先令。

shilling.en: As the boy stood in doubt, Durbeyfield put his hand into his pocket, and produced a shilling (a unit of money used in Britain until 1971).
shilling.zh: 男孩站在那里犹豫不决的时候，德北菲尔德把手伸进口袋，拿出一先令（1971年前在英国使用的货币单位）。

copper.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

treasure.en: This book is a treasure chest of information.
treasure.zh: 这本书是一个信息的宝库。

treasure.en: The treasure had lain undisturbed for centuries.
treasure.zh: 那份珍宝安然无恙地存放了几个世纪。

treasure.en: It was here, the buried treasure, she knew it was.
treasure.zh: 那些埋藏的珍宝就在这儿，她知道就在这儿。

wealth.en: They enjoyed all the trappings of wealth.
wealth.zh: 他们享有所有象征财富的东西。

wealth.en: There was a wealth of supporting evidence.

estate.en: He made a fortune in real estate.

estate.zh: 房地产依然是买方市场。

legacy.zh: 他们每人得到了5 000元的遗产。

legacy.en: You could make a real difference to someone's life by leaving them a generous legacy.
legacy.zh: 你留给某人一大笔遗产就可以真正改变他的生活。

legacy.en: The book proved such a success that the authors followed it up with "The Messianic Legacy."
legacy.zh: 该书获得了如此大的成功，以至作者随后又出了一本《天主的遗产》。

possess.en: Under state law, it is a misdemeanour to possess a firearm on school premises.
possess.zh: 根据该州法律，在校园里拥有枪械是一种轻罪。
他应该具备什么样的技能？

possess.en: Some animals possess the characteristic of man.
possess.zh: 有些动物具有人类的特征。

descend.en: The pilots were told to descend to 2-2,000 feet.
descend.zh: 飞行员被告知要将飞机下降到2-2000英尺。

descend.en: It expels gas to descend, and expels water from trim bladders to rise.
descend.zh: 它通过排出气体来下降，并通过把水排出气囊来上升。

worthy.en: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
worthy.zh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

worthy.en: He felt he was not worthy of her.
The bank might think you're worthy of a loan.
worthy.zh: 这家银行可能认为你应该得到一笔贷款。

valuable.zh: 幸运的是，没有贵重物品失窃。
入室窃贼偷走了贵重的东西没有？

valuable.en: We're wasting valuable time, time we can ill afford.
valuable.zh: 我们是在浪费宝贵的时间，我们浪费不起的时间。

incentive.en: There will be a strong incentive to enter into a process of negotiation.
incentive.zh: 将会有一个强烈的刺激来进入谈判的过程。

incentive.en: Neither side would have a real incentive to start a war. Ergo, peace would reign.
incentive.zh: 双方都没有发动战争的真实动机。因此，和平将会到来。

incentive.en: They have an incentive to keep us hooked.
incentive.zh: 他们有动机让我们上钩。

accelerate.en: Growth will accelerate to 2.9 percent next year.
Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
accelerate.zh: 暴露在日光下会加快老化过程。

salary.en: His salary is now in six figures.
salary.zh: 他的薪水现在是六位数。

salary.en: The lawyer was paid a huge salary.
salary.zh: 这个律师拿了很高的薪金。

salary.en: Most of my salary goes on the rent.
salary.zh: 我大部分工资都花在房租上了。

prompt.en: The meeting will begin at ten o'clock prompt.
prompt.zh: 会议将于十点钟准时开始。

prompt.en: You have been so prompt in carrying out all these commissions.
prompt.zh: 你执行所有这些任务非常迅速。

prompt.en: There are many emergencies which need prompt first aid treatment.
prompt.zh: 有很多紧急情况需要迅速的急救治疗。

income.zh: 来自销售税的收入下降了。
各人的收入明显提高了。

wage.en: Some of them earn below the minimum wage.
wage.zh: 他们中的一些人挣的钱低于最低工资。

wage.en: Wage rates depend on levels of productivity.
wage.zh: 工资水平取决于生产量的多寡。

wage.en: Wage increases must be in line with inflation.
wage.zh: 工资的增长必须与通货膨胀率一致。

refund.en: We will refund you your money in full.
refund.zh: 我们会退还你所有的钱。

refund.en: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
refund.zh: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

refund.en: We insisted on a refund of the full amount.
refund.zh: 我们坚持要求全额退款。

payment.en: Payment will be remitted to you in full.
payment.zh: 报酬将会全额汇寄给你。

payment.en: Interest will be charged for late payment.
payment.zh: 逾期付款必须支付利息。

reimburse.en: I'll be happy to reimburse you for any expenses you've had.
reimburse.zh: 我很乐意报销你的所有花费。
我们将付还所有相关费用。

reimburse.en: The company will reimburse you out of petty cash.
reimburse.zh: 公司将用小额备用金把钱还给你。

remuneration.en: Members of poor peasant families spun or wove cloth and linens at home for scant remuneration in an attempt to supplement meager family income.
remuneration.zh: 贫穷农民家庭的成员在家纺织布和亚麻以挣得很少的报酬，弥补微薄的家庭收入。

remuneration.en: It must also be done with a profit and remuneration structure that is fair to everyone.
remuneration.zh: 它还必须有一个对每个人都公平的利润和薪酬结构。
我可以问问我的酬劳是多少吗？

payroll.en: All told there were 104 people on the payroll.
Before Harrington knew it, she was down to her last $20,000, not enough to cover payroll.
payroll.zh: 在哈林顿知道这件事之前，她只剩下最后的2万美元，还不够支付工资单。

payroll.en: I thought graduate teaching assistants will automatically put on the payroll at the beginning of the semester.
payroll.zh: 我原以为研究生助教会在学期开始时自动进入发放工资的名单。

subsidy.en: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
subsidy.zh: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

subsidy.en: There were also pledges to soften the impact of the subsidy cuts on the poorer regions.
subsidy.zh: 也有保证要减轻消减给较贫困地区补贴所造成的冲击。

subsidy.en: The subsidy of 45 cents per gallon remains.
subsidy.zh: 每加仑45美分的补贴仍然在存在。

earn.en: He doesn't earn as much as me.

undertaking.en: The landlord gave a written undertaking that the repairs would be carried out.
undertaking.zh: 房东书面保证将进行维修。

undertaking.en: Organizing the show has been a massive undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 组织这场演出是一项巨大的任务。

undertaking.en: Making the house habitable was a major undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 把这房子收拾得可以住人是个大工程。

career.zh: 他在事业上正走下坡路。
她全力倾注于自己的事业。

profession.zh: 他们两人的职业都是医生。

profession.en: She is an honour to the profession.

occupation.en: Her main occupation seems to be shopping.
occupation.zh: 逛商店购物似乎是她的主要消遣。

occupation.en: I suppose I was looking for an occupation which was going to be an adventure.
occupation.zh: 我想我那时在寻找一份冒险型职业。

occupation.en: You will be asked to fill in a form with details of your birth and occupation.
occupation.zh: 你会被要求填写一张有关你的出生和职业详情的表格。

vocation.en: Her vocation is her work as an actress.
vocation.zh: 她适合的职业就是当演员。

vocation.en: Nursing is not just a job—it's a vocation.
vocation.zh: 护理不仅仅是一项工作，而且还是一种职业。

labor.en: The developments leave the airline with several problems, including an unsettled labor situation.
labor.zh: 事情的发展给航空公司带来了一些问题，其中包括不安定的劳工状况。
劳动节之后我们就开学了。

job.zh: 她的工作涉及许多方面。

workforce.en: The total was close to 20% of the workforce.
Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
workforce.zh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

workforce.en: The company yesterday shed a sixth of its workforce.
workforce.zh: 该公司昨天削减了1/6的劳动力。

personnel.zh: 她的第一份工作是在人事部。

personnel.en: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
personnel.zh: 我从人事档案里查到了你的地址。

workaholic.zh: 摩羯座是天生的工作狂。

clerk.en: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
clerk.zh: 很奇怪一名职员会感到如此地受人忽视。

clerk.en: A clerk had slipped the wrong tab on Tony's X-ray.
clerk.zh: 一位职员失手把一个错误的标签贴到了托尼的X光片上。

clerk.en: A sharp-eyed shop clerk spotted the fake.
clerk.zh: 一名眼尖的售货员发现了假货。

interview.zh: 她刚刚录制了一次采访。
她为参加面试打扮了一番。

employ.en: How many people does the company employ?
employ.zh: 这个公司雇用了多少人？

employ.en: We employ an expert to advise on new technology.
employ.zh: 我们聘用了一位专家担任新技术顾问。

employ.en: We'll have to check him out before we employ him.
employ.zh: 我们得先调查一下再雇用他。

recommend.en: What course of action would you recommend?
I recommend (that) he should see a lawyer.

hire.en: We had to hire maids through an agency.
hire.zh: 我们得通过代理公司雇用女佣。

hire.en: The price includes the hire of the hall.

dismiss.en: He was so irresponsible that I decided to dismiss him.
dismiss.zh: 他如此不负责任，我决定解雇他。

dismiss.en: I think we can safely dismiss their objections.
dismiss.zh: 我认为我们对他们的异议完全可以不予理会。

dismiss.en: They were quick to dismiss rumours of an off-screen romance.
dismiss.zh: 两人迅速否认了他们在现实生活中是情侣的传言。

fire.en: A sister can start a fire. Brother can't light the lamp.
fire.zh: 只许姐姐放火，不许弟弟点灯
警察中的神枪手开了火。

discharge.en: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay Miss Smith $500 compensation.
discharge.zh: 他被判有条件释放，并被命令向史密斯小姐支付$500的赔偿金。

discharge.en: There was a watery discharge from her ear.
discharge.zh: 她的耳朵里有水状物流出。

discharge.en: He received an honourable discharge from the army.

resign.en: He was under strong pressure to resign.
resign.zh: 他承受着要辞职的巨大压力。

sack.zh: 四百名工人面临解雇的危险。

sack.en: They got through a sack of potatoes.
sack.zh: 他们把一麻袋土豆吃完了。

sack.en: The poor old sod got the sack yesterday.
sack.zh: 那位可怜的老兄昨天给解雇了。

retire.en: He has announced his intention to retire.
retire.zh: 他已经宣布他打算退休。

retire.en: He is to retire on his sixtieth birthday.
Employees can retire at 60 if they choose.
retire.zh: 如果雇员愿意的话，可在60岁退休。

failure.zh: 失败会挫伤学生的积极性。

result.zh: 他们对这一结果感到欢欣鼓舞。
对这个结果她感到高兴。

abortion.zh: 堕胎从道德上讲合乎情理吗？
堕胎是个令人情绪十分激动的问题。

loss.en: The loss of jobs is highly regrettable.
loss.zh: 失去工作非常令人遗憾。

loss.en: We expressed our sympathy for her loss.
loss.zh: 我们对她的损失表示了同情。

loss.en: We are now operating at a loss.

opportunity.zh: 这白白浪费了一次机会。

opportunity.en: It was too good an opportunity to miss.
opportunity.zh: 这个机会太好了，不容错过。

chance.en: Chess is not a game of chance.
chance.zh: 国际象棋不是靠运气取胜的。

chance.en: It was a chance to start afresh.
chance.zh: 这是个重新开始的机会。

choose.zh: 挑选你喜欢的那个品牌。

choose.en: Whichever they choose, we must accept their decision.
choose.zh: 无论他们如何选择，我们都必须接受他们的决定。

solve.en: It isn't going to solve a single thing.
She tried her best to solve the problem.
solve.zh: 她尽了最大的努力解决这个问题。

solve.en: In itself, it's not a difficult problem to solve.
solve.zh: 这本身并不是个难解决的问题。

sustainable.en: The creation of an efficient and sustainable transport system is critical.
sustainable.zh: 一个高效而可持续发展的交通系统的创建是非常重要的。

sustainable.en: The farming methods of ants are at least sustainable.
sustainable.zh: 蚂蚁的养殖方式至少是可持续的。

sustainable.en: We've talked recently about the importance of sustainable energy.
sustainable.zh: 最近我们谈到了可持续能源的重要性。

change.zh: 政策僵化，需求就产生变化。
咱们可以交换一下座位吗？

develop.zh: 我们需要发展地方工业。

develop.en: These clashes could develop into open warfare.
develop.zh: 这些冲突可能会发展成公开的战争。

improve.zh: 我需要提高我的英语水平。
我得提高我的法语水平。
不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

manage.en: How did she manage to struggle free ?

regulate.en: The FCC has no statutory authority to regulate the Internet.
regulate.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会没有规范因特网的法定权力。

regulate.en: Under such a plan, the government would regulate competition among insurance companies so that everyone gets care at lower cost.
regulate.zh: 根据这样一个计划，政府会控制保险公司之间的竞争，这样每个人都能以较低价格获得保险。

regulate.en: The government should regulate the app-based car rental market.
regulate.zh: 政府应规范以应用软件为基础的汽车租赁市场。

sanction.en: He may now be ready to sanction the use of force.
sanction.zh: 他或许现在正准备批准使用武力。

sanction.en: The government refused to sanction a further cut in interest rates.
sanction.zh: 政府拒绝批准进一步降低利率。

sanction.en: The Security Council will consider taking future actions against sanction-busters.
sanction.zh: 安理会将考虑未来采取措施打击破坏制裁的人。

coordinate.en: She'll show you how to coordinate pattern and colours.
coordinate.zh: 她会向你展示如何搭配款式和颜色。

coordinate.en: They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
coordinate.zh: 为协调这个队的工作，他们任用了一位新经理。

coordinate.en: Government officials visited the earthquake zone on Thursday morning to coordinate the relief effort.
coordinate.zh: 政府官员星期四上午视察了地震灾区以协调救灾工作。

cooperate.en: He agreed to cooperate with the police investigation.
During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
cooperate.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

collaborate.en: She agreed to collaborate with him in writing her biography.
collaborate.zh: 她同意与他合作撰写她的传记。
粒子物理学家和天文学家经常合作。

legal.zh: 他发誓要诉诸法律行动。
安乐死是否应定为合法？

regulation.en: The regulation operates in favour of married couples.
regulation.zh: 这一规定的实施有利于已婚夫妇。

regulation.en: Some in the market now want government regulation in order to reduce costs.
regulation.zh: 市场上现在有人想要政府来管理以降低成本。

regulation.en: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
regulation.zh: 结果证明，大马哈鱼养殖业的管理是失当的。

treaty.en: The treaty seems to favour the US.
treaty.zh: 这个条约似乎偏向美国。
他们同土耳其缔结了一项条约。

rule.en: That's a good rule to go by.
He continued to rule the country de facto.
rule.zh: 实际上，他继续统治着这个国家。

rule.en: The new rule will be applied retrospectively.
rule.zh: 新的规定将具有追溯效力。

agreement.zh: 他们默默地点头表示同意。

charter.en: The charter proclaimed that all states would have their own government.
charter.zh: 宪章规定，各州皆允建立各自的政府。

charter.en: Seats on charter flights are usually sold as part of a package deal with hotel accommodations.
charter.zh: 包机的座位通常是作为酒店住宿打包出售的一部分。

charter.en: Green awareness is now entrenched—along with sport and culture—as a permanent dimension of the Olympic Charter.
charter.zh: 环保意识现在已经根深蒂固，它连同体育和文化一样，成为奥林匹克宪章的永久内容。

protocol.en: While SIP is a request-response protocol, there is not necessarily only one response to every one request.
protocol.zh: 虽然 SIP 是请求-响应协议，但每个请求不一定只有一个响应与之对应。

protocol.en: Cerf has been working with NASA's Pasadena Jet Propulsion Laboratory—the people behind the recent Mars expedition—to design what he calls an "interplanetary Internet protocol."
protocol.zh: 瑟夫一直在与美国宇航局的帕萨迪纳喷气推进实验室（最近火星探测的幕后人员）合作，设计他所说的“星际互联网协议”。

protocol.en: The Kyoto Protocol, which set different duties for all countries to cut emissions, states that different countries should reduce their collective greenhouse emissions accordingly.
protocol.zh: 《京都议定书》为各国设定了不同的减排义务，规定各国应相应地减少各自的温室气体排放总量。

norm.en: How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?
norm.zh: 照片中的笑容是如何成为后维多利亚时代的行为准则的？

norm.en: They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions.
norm.zh: 他们将触碰视为社会交往中的一种文化规范。

norm.en: Non-smoking is now the norm in most workplaces.
norm.zh: 大多数工作场所现在都已禁止吸烟。

criterion.en: The main criterion is value for money.
criterion.zh: 主要的标准是钱要用得划算。

criterion.en: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
criterion.zh: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

criterion.en: Practice is the sole criterion of truth.
criterion.zh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准。

benchmark.en: Tests at the age of seven provide a benchmark against which the child's progress at school can be measured.
benchmark.zh: 七岁时进行的测试为孩子在学校中的学习发展提供了一个测量基准。

benchmark.en: Inside the kit are the benchmark facilities for loading the database and driving the benchmark.
benchmark.zh: 这个工具包中有用于加载数据库和驱动基准测试程序的一些基准工具。

benchmark.en: The economic downturn is drying up demand for oil and natural gas, dropping the benchmark price for a barrel of oil to below $50.
benchmark.zh: 经济低迷正在抑制市场对石油和天然气的需求，导致基准原油价格跌破每桶50美元。

enforce.en: The legislation will be difficult to enforce.
It's the job of the police to enforce the law.
Desegregation may be harder to enforce in rural areas.
enforce.zh: 废除种族隔离可能更难在乡村地区实施。

admission.zh: 我们已将入场票的价格降低了10%。

standard.en: The paper was of non-standard size.
Their standard of living is very low.
Who sets the standard for water quality?

allow.zh: 我们必须考虑到人为的失误。

default.en: The company is in default on the loan.
On this screen, 256 colours is the default.
default.zh: 这个显示屏的系统设定值是256色。

default.en: The default option is to save your work every five minutes.
default.zh: 默认设置为每五分钟存盘一次。

reject.en: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
reject.zh: 动物们排斥一窝中最弱小的幼仔。
患者经常排斥移植的器官。

reject.en: It lies with you to accept or reject the proposals.
reject.zh: 接受或是拒绝这些建议由你决定。

constraint.en: Journalists were given the freedom to visit, investigate, and report without constraint.
constraint.zh: 新闻记者被赋予在没有约束下参观、调查和报道的自由。

constraint.en: The boy felt constraint in her presence.
constraint.zh: 那男孩在她面前感到局促不安。

constraint.en: The terrible constraint on organ transplantation is that every life extended depends on the death of someone young enough and healthy enough to have organs worth transplanting.
constraint.zh: 器官移植的可怕约束是，一个人生命的延长要依赖于另一个足够年轻、健康的人的死亡，因为只有这些人身上才有值得移植的器官。

official.zh: 这消息尚未经官方证实。
那是她第一次正式约会。
一位官员从人群中挤过。

potent.en: Crack is a highly potent and addictive derivative of cocaine.
potent.zh: 强效纯可卡因是一种药效极强、容易使人上瘾的可卡因制剂。

potent.en: This is one of the most potent ways, Tice found, to put anger to rest.
potent.zh: Tice 发现，这是平息愤怒最有效的方法之一。

potent.en: The other half of the name represents another ingredient, less infamous, perhaps, but also strangely potent: the kola nut.
potent.zh: 名字的另一半代表了另一种成分，也许不那么臭名昭著，但也有奇特的效力：可乐果。

mandatory.en: He was married, and that was mandatory.
mandatory.zh: 他结婚了，这是强制性的。

mandatory.en: I think that mandatory voting is a no-braine and dumb idea.
mandatory.zh: 我认为强制投票这事是一个无脑的，极其愚蠢的想法。

mandatory.en: An effective and mandatory program sponsored by the high school is the only solution to this serious problem.
mandatory.zh: 由高中主办的的有效的强制性项目是解决这一严重问题的唯一办法。

obligation.en: We have a moral obligation to protect the environment.
obligation.zh: 我们有道义责任保护环境。

obligation.en: She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.
obligation.zh: 她觉得没有义务告诉他实情。

obligation.en: Governments have at least a moral obligation to answer these questions.
obligation.zh: 政府至少在道义上有责任回应这些问题。

bound.zh: 他们把他的双手绑在一起。
这艘船是开往意大利的。

supreme.en: They took their appeal to the Supreme Court.
supreme.zh: 他们上诉到了最高法院。

supreme.en: The verdict was overruled by the Supreme Court.
supreme.zh: 最高法院驳回了那个裁决。

supreme.en: The Supreme Court ruled in Fitzgerald's favour.
supreme.zh: 最高法院判定菲茨杰拉德胜诉。

enact.en: It is imperative that governments around the world enact laws to protect the environment at home and abroad.
enact.zh: 世界各国政府必须制定法律来保护国内外的环境。

enact.en: It is imperative that governments around the world should enact laws to protect the environment both at home and abroad.
enact.zh: 世界各国政府必须制定法律来保护国内外环境。

enact.en: Members of the English Civil War Society will re-enact the battle.
enact.zh: 英格兰内战协会的成员将再次展现那场战争。

legislate.en: They promised to legislate to protect people's right to privacy.
legislate.zh: 他们承诺立法保护公民的隐私权。

legislate.en: The government will legislate against discrimination in the workplace.
legislate.zh: 政府将制定法律，在工作场所禁止歧视。

legislate.en: The law cannot legislate filial responsibility any more than it can legislate love.
legislate.zh: 法律不能给爱情制定法律，更不能为子女的义务而立法。

court.zh: 请向法庭陈述事情的经过。

equity.en: Batman may win every hand, but equity investors should still fear the Joker.
equity.zh: 《蝙蝠侠》可能战无不胜，但股权投资者仍应提防着《小丑》。

equity.en: If you're investing with a long time horizon, having an equity bias makes sense, stocks go up in the long run.
equity.zh: 如果你进行长线投资，存在股权偏好是合理的，那么从长期看，股票是上涨的。

equity.en: One school thinks that, even in cases of negative equity, most homeowners will not default if they can afford the payments.
equity.zh: 一学派认为，即使在负权益的情况下，如果可以负担还款，大部分房主将不会违约。

fair.zh: 蓝色适合于她白皙的肤色。

prejudice.zh: 对我来说，种族歧视非常可恶。

discrimination.zh: 妇女组织谴责性别歧视。
“这么做” 布特莱齐先生愤怒地说，“是歧视。”

discrimination.en: Eventually, he came face to face with discrimination again.

accuse.en: I accuse Consort Xi of adultery. She defiled the harem. Unforgivable.
accuse.zh: 臣妾要告发熹贵妃私通，秽乱后宫，罪不容诛！

accuse.en: He laughs loudly when I accuse him of fibbing.
accuse.zh: 我指控他撒谎时，他笑得很大声。

accuse.en: His father would accuse him of neglecting his filial duties.
accuse.zh: 他父亲会指控他没有尽孝。

sue.zh: 他们打算起诉，要求赔偿损失。

sue.en: Sue is training to be a doctor.

prosecute.en: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough.
prosecute.zh: 警方已决定不起诉，因为证据不够充分。

prosecute.en: He has decided to prosecute her after careful consideration of all the relevant facts.
prosecute.zh: 他仔细考虑了所有相关事实后，决定起诉她。

prosecute.en: The Attorney General was aware of the political implications of his decision to prosecute.
prosecute.zh: 总检察长知道自己起诉的决定可能引起的政治后果。

condemn.en: The Church has a duty to condemn violence.
condemn.zh: 基督教会有义务谴责暴力。

condemn.en: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
condemn.zh: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

condemn.en: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence.
condemn.zh: 政治领袖们昨天联合谴责最近发生的一波暴力事件。

complain.en: Then they had the gall to complain!
complain.zh: 而且他们居然还有脸抱怨！

boycott.en: We are asking people to boycott goods from companies that use child labour.
boycott.zh: 我们正呼吁大家抵制雇用童工的公司的产品。

boycott.en: A spokesman says the president has backed off from his threat to boycott the conference.
boycott.zh: 一位发言人说，总统已经撤回了他抵制这次会谈的威胁。

boycott.en: T. H. Breen argued that the consumer boycott was a brilliantly original American invention.
boycott.zh: T. H. Breen 认为，消费者抵制运动是美国的一项杰出发明。

session.en: The Arab League is meeting in emergency session today.
session.zh: 阿拉伯国家联盟今天正在举行紧急会议。

session.en: From September until December, Congress remained in session.
session.zh: 9月到12月国会一直处在开会期。

mediate.en: The Secretary-General was asked to mediate in the dispute.
mediate.zh: 有人请秘书长来调解这次纷争。

mediate.en: An independent body was brought in to mediate between staff and management.
mediate.zh: 由一个独立机构介入，在劳资之间进行调解。

mediate.en: Schools are not just a microcosm of society; they mediate it too.
mediate.zh: 学校不仅仅是社会的缩影；它们也会调解。

plea.en: He reached a plea bargain with the authorities.
plea.zh: 他和当局达成了辩诉交易。

plea.en: A plea bargain was offered by the state assuring her that she would not go to prison.
plea.zh: 该州提出了一份认罪辩诉协议，保证她不会入狱。

plea.en: The district court ruled that Popper's silence in court today should be entered as a plea of not guilty.
plea.zh: 该区法院裁决波珀今天在法庭中的缄默应被看作是进行无罪抗辩。

contradict.en: Bowen and Greene's results contradict that argument.
contradict.zh: 鲍恩和格林的结果与该论点相矛盾。

contradict.en: "I am sorry," said the Owl, "to have to contradict the Crow, my famous friend and colleague."
contradict.zh: “很抱歉，”猫头鹰说，“我不得不反驳乌鸦，我杰出的朋友和同事。”

appeal.zh: 我们打算对此裁决提出申诉。
我们必须扩大我们的吸引力。

persuade.en: I did my damnedest to persuade her.
persuade.zh: 我已经全力以赴地去说服她了。

persuade.en: How did you manage to persuade him?
I failed in my attempt to persuade her.

controversy.en: He is a lightning rod for controversy.
controversy.zh: 他是个富有争议的人物.

whisper.zh: 她低沉沙哑地轻声说话。

mutter.en: "Excuse me," I mutter, "I have to get this sham over with."
mutter.zh: “对不起。”我喃喃地说，“我得把这个假动作做完。”

mutter.en: John would rub his eyes and mutter, "It is true, we did fly."
mutter.zh: 约翰揉了揉眼睛，喃喃自语道：“这是真的，我们真的飞了。”

mutter.en: The old man, still pacing back and forth, ceased to speak aloud, and began to mutter.
mutter.zh: 老人仍在来回踱步，不再大声说话，开始喃喃自语起来。

murmur.en: The doctor said James had now developed a heart murmur.
murmur.zh: 医生说詹姆斯心脏现在出现了杂音。

murmur.en: The excited murmur grew louder as the whole group collected in the old dining room.
murmur.zh: 当所有人都聚集在老旧的餐厅时，兴奋的低语声音越来越大。

silent.zh: 欧文一反常态地保持着沉默。

mute.zh: 他缄默无言，对人疏远而且冷漠。

mute.en: She thought it better to mute her criticism.
mute.zh: 她觉得还是婉转地提出批评比较好。

mute.en: The child sat mute in the corner of the room.
mute.zh: 这孩子坐在屋子的角落里，一声不吭。

investigate.zh: 他觉得有必要作进一步调查。
警方决定作进一步调查。

investigate.en: The FBI has been called in to investigate.
investigate.zh: 联邦调查局奉命进行调查。

witness.en: He took the stand as the first witness.
He has been witness to a terrible murder.
witness.zh: 他目击了一起残忍的凶杀事件。

witness.en: He is trying to improperly influence a witness.
witness.zh: 他正试图不适当地影响一名证人。

justify.en: How can they justify paying such huge salaries?
justify.zh: 他们怎能证明付这么大笔薪金是正当的呢？

justify.en: He made a half-hearted attempt to justify himself.
justify.zh: 他没有尽力证明自己有理。

justify.en: No amount of rationalization could justify his actions.
justify.zh: 无论怎么解释，他的行为都不能说是正当的。

suitable.en: The hunt is on for a suitable candidate.
She seems eminently suitable for the job.
suitable.zh: 她看来非常适合这个工作。

suitable.en: This isn't a suitable place to unload the van.

reasonable.en: We sell good quality food at reasonable prices.
reasonable.zh: 我们以公道的价格出售优质食品。

reasonable.en: Public spending must be kept within reasonable bounds.
reasonable.zh: 公共开支必须控制在合理的范围内。
他是那种通情达理的人。

jury.zh: 陪审团作出了对被告有利的裁决。
陪审团裁决他谋杀罪不成立。

judge.zh: 她很善于鉴定别人的性格。
法官不断点头表示同意。

trial.zh: 他们的审讯很快就要开始。

suspect.zh: 警方怀疑当地的一个不良帮派。

suspect.en: He is the prime suspect in the case.
suspect.zh: 他是这个案子的首要嫌疑人。

jail.zh: 他已从监狱里放出来了。

jail.en: A forty-foot-high concrete wall encircles the jail.
jail.zh: 一道40英尺高的水泥墙环绕着该监狱。

prison.zh: 他今天早上从监狱里逃跑了。

prison.en: He had his enemies flung into prison.

confine.en: He did not confine himself to the one language.
confine.zh: 他没把自己局限于这一门语言。

confine.en: I will confine myself to looking at the period from 1900 to 1916.
confine.zh: 我将把自己考察的范围限定在1900年至1916年这段时间以内。

confine.en: Confine the use of insecticides to the evening and do not spray plants that are in flower.
confine.zh: 只限晚间使用杀虫剂，并且不要对花期植物喷药。

oversee.en: General Sachet is ordered to oversee such executions.
oversee.zh: 萨西尔将军受命监督了这些处决。

oversee.en: Assembly supervisors oversee workers who put together products by using power tools or other dangerous equipment.
oversee.zh: 装配主管监督那些使用电动工具或其他危险设备组装产品的工人。

oversee.en: Carpenter supervisors oversee carpentry work on a specified project to ensure that workers are on schedule and executing plans accordingly.
oversee.zh: 木匠监工监督特定项目的木工工作，以确保工人按时完成计划。

supervise.en: I supervise the packing of all mail orders.
supervise.zh: 我监督所有邮购商品的包装。

supervise.en: A team was sent to supervise the elections in Nicaragua.
supervise.zh: 一队人马被派去监督尼加拉瓜的选举。

supervise.en: The U.N. pledged to help supervise the clearance of mines.
supervise.zh: 联合国承诺帮助监督扫雷工作。

restrain.en: The government is taking steps to restrain inflation.
restrain.zh: 政府正在采取措施控制通货膨胀。
他们无法抑制自己的激动。
约翰努力压制住自己的怒气。

restrict.en: I restrict myself to one cup of coffee a day.
restrict.zh: 我限制自己每天只喝一杯咖啡。

restrict.en: We restrict the number of students per class to 10.
restrict.zh: 我们将每个班的学生人数限定为10人。

restrict.en: Having small children tends to restrict your freedom.
restrict.zh: 有年幼的孩子往往会限制你的自由。

commit.en: He hit out at public figures who commit adultery.
commit.zh: 他猛烈抨击犯通奸的公众人物。

commit.en: You don't have to commit yourself now, just think about it.
commit.zh: 你不必现在表态，只需考虑一下这件事。

sin.en: Chocolate equals sin in most people's lexicon.
sin.zh: 巧克力在大多数人的字典里等同于罪恶。

sin.en: Sin is a harsh tyrant in your life. But Christ not only died for our sins, he died to sin.
sin.zh: 罪是你生命中的一个残酷暴君。但是基督不仅为我们的罪舍命，而且他向罪而死。

vice.zh: 他们的代言人是副总裁。
蒂姆·芒顿成为新的副队长。

crime.zh: 犯罪数字正在迅速上升。

bribe.en: She had been offered a $50 000 bribe to drop the charges.
bribe.zh: 有人用5万元贿赂她，要她撤回控告。
他们贿赂便宜的仿制药对手。

bribe.en: If people can bribe police officers, it makes a nonsense of the legal system.
bribe.zh: 如果人们可以贿赂警察，那法律制度就失去了意义。

rob.zh: 她到罗布那儿寻求慰藉。

rob.en: Rob Harmeling won the sprint in Bordeaux.
rob.zh: 罗布•哈梅林赢得了波尔多短跑赛。

rob.en: That Rob was a snob and a social climber could not be denied.
rob.zh: 那个罗布是个势利小人，喜欢攀龙附凤——无可否定。

pirate.en: Pirate copies of the DVD are already being sold.

steal.en: He tried to steal second base but was out.
steal.zh: 他试图偷二垒但被判出局。

thief.en: The thief got clean away with the money.

murder.zh: 这宗谋杀案还没有侦破。

suicide.en: She had committed suicide by hanging herself.
Just look at this newspaper, nothing but robbery, suicide and murder.
suicide.zh: 看看这张报纸，上面除了抢劫、自杀和谋杀，什么都没有。

deceive.zh: 我厌恶那些欺骗我的人。

deceive.en: It is to deceive the whole country and the princess too!
deceive.zh: 这是欺骗整个国家和公主！

liar.en: The man is a crook and a liar.
liar.zh: 这名男子是个恶棍和骗子。

liar.en: He was a liar and a cheat.
liar.zh: 他是一个说谎的人，一个骗子。

fraud.en: This is a clear case of fraud.

fraud.zh: 有证据表明是巨额欺诈。

cheat.en: He was a liar and a cheat.
cheat.zh: 他是一个说谎的人，一个骗子。

cheat.en: It is just not credible that she would cheat.
cheat.zh: 她会行骗简直难以置信。

cheat.en: If he thinks he can cheat me, just let him try!
cheat.zh: 要是他以为能够骗过我，就让他来试一下吧！

trap.en: A trap was laid, with fresh bait.
trap.zh: 陷阱设置好，还投放了新诱饵。

trap.en: Suspecting nothing, he walked right into the trap.
trap.zh: 他毫无觉察，径直走入陷阱。

trap.en: Nathan's dog got caught in a trap.
trap.zh: 内森的狗被捕捉器夹住了。

pretend.en: She can sunbathe and pretend she's in Cancun.
pretend.zh: 她会进行日光浴并假装她是在坎昆。

pretend.en: Don't be surprised if I pretend not to recognise you.
pretend.zh: 要是我假装不认识你，你别觉得奇怪。

trick.zh: 但是，这个诡计使人自作自受。

trick.en: I'm surprised you fell for that trick.
trick.zh: 我感到惊奇，你竟中了那个诡计。

fool.en: Art dealers fool a lot of people.
fool.zh: 艺术品经销商会愚弄许多人。

stigma.en: Recognising obesity as a chronic disease with severe complications rather than a lifestyle choice "should help reduce the stigma and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity," he adds.
stigma.zh: 认识到肥胖是一种伴有严重并发症的慢性疾病，而不是一种生活方式的选择，“应该有助于减少许多肥胖人士所经历的耻辱和歧视。”他补充道。

stigma.en: There is no longer any stigma attached to being divorced.
stigma.zh: 离婚不再是什么丢脸的事。

stigma.en: A recent study found that absence claims labels can create a stigma around foods even when there is no scientific evidence that they cause harm.
stigma.zh: 最近的一项研究发现，即使没有科学证据表明食品有害，带有“不含”字样的标签也会使其污名化。

conform.en: The building does not conform with safety regulations.
conform.zh: 这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

conform.en: The lamp has been designed to conform to new safety standards.
conform.zh: 该灯设计得符合新的安全标准。

conform.en: This mark signifies that the products conform to an approved standard.
conform.zh: 这个标志说明这些产品符合指定的标准。

confess.en: We persuaded her to confess her crime.
confess.zh: 我们说服她坦白她的罪行。

confess.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
confess.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

confess.en: "I confess to being a big wuss," she admitted.
confess.zh: “我承认我是个胆小鬼。”她实话实说。

reconcile.en: He could not reconcile himself to the prospect of losing her.
reconcile.zh: 他一想到有可能失去她，就觉得难以忍受。

reconcile.en: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
reconcile.zh: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

reconcile.en: It's difficult to reconcile the demands of my job and the desire to be a good father.
reconcile.zh: 协调我工作的要求与我当个好父亲的愿望很难。

obey.en: Dogs can be trained to obey orders.
obey.zh: 狗可以训练得听从命令。
你必须服从船长的命令。
