succumb.en: A common defense of sport hunting is that it serves a vital wildlife-management function, without which countless animals would succumb to starvation and disease.
succumb.zh: 运动狩猎的一个常见辩护是，它提供了至关重要的野生动物管理功能，没有它，无数的动物将会死于饥饿和疾病。

succumb.en: And yet I succumb to watching it.
succumb.zh: 然而，我却需要看它，向它屈服。

succumb.en: Whatever you do, don't succumb to it.
succumb.zh: 无论你做什么，都不要屈服于它。

penalty.en: He was fouled inside the penalty area.
penalty.zh: 在罚球区内对方队员对他犯规。

penalty.en: The two men are facing the death penalty.
Are you for or against the death penalty?

fine.zh: “那很好。”他亲切友好地回答道。

mortgage.en: We paid off our mortgage after fifteen years.
mortgage.zh: 我们历经十五年的时间还清了抵押借款。

mortgage.en: Mortgage defaults have risen in the last year.
mortgage.zh: 按揭借款违约在近一年里呈上升趋势。

mortgage.en: They have burdened themselves with a high mortgage.
mortgage.zh: 他们负担了一笔很高的按揭借款。

ownership.en: Ownership of the land is currently being disputed.
ownership.zh: 这块土地的所有权现在还有争议。

ownership.en: Ownership is not clear because of expropriations in the Nazi era.
ownership.zh: 所有权因纳粹时期的征收而不明。

ownership.en: Russia and Ukraine have been disputing the ownership of the fleet.
ownership.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰一直在争夺该舰队的所有权。

copyright.en: Who owns the copyright on this song?
copyright.zh: 谁拥有这首歌曲的版权？

copyright.en: Who owns the copyright on this movie?
copyright.zh: 谁拥有这部电影的版权？

copyright.en: The agreement assigns copyright to the publisher.
copyright.zh: 协议规定将版权转让给出版商。

accredit.zh: 他们认定这些是他的见解。

accredit.en: We accredit him with finding that book.
accredit.zh: 我们相信是他找到那本书的。

accredit.en: vt. We accredit the invention of the electric light to Adison.
accredit.zh: 我们把电灯的发明归功于爱迪生。

privilege.en: He arrogated the privilege to himself alone.
She was cocooned in a private world of privilege.
privilege.zh: 她生活在与世隔绝的特权世界里。

privilege.en: Her attitudes solidified through privilege and habit.
privilege.zh: 由于特权和习惯,她的态度愈来愈顽固。

clue.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
clue.zh: 关于杀手身份的重大线索是他的绰号——花生。

clue.en: Geneticists in Canada have discovered a clue to the puzzle of why our cells get old and die.
clue.zh: 加拿大的遗传学家已经发现了解开我们细胞衰老死亡之迷的线索。

access.zh: 这家旅馆有轮椅通道吗？

access.en: She had unhindered access to the files.

anonymous.en: You can remain anonymous if you wish.
anonymous.zh: 如果你愿意你可以保持匿名。
捐赠者希望不披露姓名。

anonymous.en: The man was arrested after an anonymous tip-off.
anonymous.zh: 有人匿名举报后，那个人被抓了起来。

false.en: The whole argument rests on a false assumption.
false.zh: 整个论证都是基于一个错误的假设。

genuine.en: Only genuine refugees can apply for asylum.
genuine.zh: 只有真正的难民才能申请政治避难。

genuine.en: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
genuine.zh: 这不是真正的古董—你上当了。

genuine.en: If this offer is genuine, I will gladly accept it.
genuine.zh: 如果这份帮助是真诚的，我将愉快地接受它。

procedure.en: The next day I repeated the procedure.
procedure.zh: 第二天我重复了这个程序。
克里斯蒂娜隐约地记起了那个步骤。

consequence.en: This is a necessary consequence of progress.
It was an inevitable consequence of the decision.
consequence.zh: 那是这个决定的必然后果。

consequence.en: One consequence of global warming is extinction.
consequence.zh: 全球变暖的后果之一是物种灭绝。

routine.zh: 警察的工作主要都是按常规的。
采集了一份常规的脱氧核糖核酸样本。
你需要从日常工作中解脱出来去休息一下。

require.zh: 所有决定都需要全体一致同意。
位元映射地图需要巨大的存储空间。

require.en: State clearly how many tickets you require.
require.zh: 说清楚你需要多少张票。

request.zh: 他们拒绝了她的请求，不给她帮助。
他最后的请求突然阻止了她。

petition.zh: 吉尔自告奋勇组织请愿。
我们在为请愿书收集签名。

petition.en: They turned in a petition with 80 000 signatures.
petition.zh: 他们递交了一份有8万人签名的请愿书。

command.en: I closed my eyes at his command.
command.zh: 我听从他的命令闭上了眼睛。

command.en: This command will invoke the HELP system.
command.zh: 这条指令将启用“帮助”系统。

violence.zh: 暴力是他们非常厌恶的事。
他憎恶任何形式的暴力。

instruct.en: You can instruct your bank to allow a third party to remove money from your account.
instruct.zh: 你可以通知银行，允许第三方从你的账户取款。

instruct.en: Does it corrupt or instruct our children?
instruct.zh: 那它会使我们的孩子堕落，还是会教导他们呢？

instruct.en: Greater effort is needed to instruct children in road safety.
instruct.zh: 在指导儿童注意道路安全方面需要付出更大的努力。

conflict.zh: 这些结果与早期的发现相矛盾。

conflict.en: John often comes into conflict with his boss.
conflict.zh: 约翰经常和他的老板发生争执。

raid.en: It sounds like an air raid siren.
raid.zh: 这听起来像是空袭警报。

raid.en: The weapon used in the raid was a replica.
raid.zh: 抢劫案中使用的武器是一件仿制品。

raid.en: The success of the raid depended on split-second timing.
raid.zh: 袭击的成功取决于分秒不差的时间安排。

enormity.en: I was numbed by the enormity of the responsibility.
enormity.zh: 我对责任的艰巨性感到不知所措。

enormity.en: The full enormity of the crime has not yet been revealed.
enormity.zh: 这一罪行的严重性还没有充分揭示出来。

enormity.en: It was not long before I realized the enormity of my faux pas.
enormity.zh: 没过多久我就发现了我有多么的失礼。

campaign.zh: 他的竞选活动进展得不顺利。

campaign.en: He withdrew his support for our campaign.
campaign.zh: 他停止了对我们运动的支持。

campaign.en: The campaign has entered its final stretch.
campaign.zh: 竞选已进入最后冲刺阶段。

battle.zh: 有一块饰板用来纪念那次战役。

battle.en: The battle had reached a crucial juncture.
A much bigger battle is ahead for the president.
battle.zh: 总统还将面临一场更大的战斗。

explosion.zh: 她在那场爆炸中双目失明了。

struggle.en: They had to struggle against all kinds of adversity.
struggle.zh: 他们不得不同各种困境斗争。

struggle.en: He came to symbolize his country's struggle for independence.
struggle.zh: 他逐渐成为祖国为争取独立而斗争的象征。
他们的长期努力以失败告终。

bombard.en: The best way to see things differently to other people is to bombard the brain with things it has never encountered before.
bombard.zh: 以不同于他人的方式看待事物的最好方法就是用大脑从未接触过的事物来轰炸它。

bombard.en: Even today, microscopic meteorites continually bombard Earth, falling on both land and sea.
bombard.zh: 即使是现在，微小的陨石仍在不断地撞击地球，然后落到陆地上和大海中。

bombard.en: It carries fine particles of sand, which bombard exposed rock surfaces, thereby wearing them into yet more sand.
bombard.zh: 它携带着细小的沙粒，这些沙粒会轰击裸露的岩石表面，从而把岩石磨成更多的沙子。

bomb.en: It's not known who planted the bomb.
bomb.zh: 不知是谁放置了这颗炸弹。

bomb.en: The bomb has been safely disposed of.
The ground quaked as the bomb exploded.
bomb.zh: 炸弹爆炸时，地面都震动了。

blast.zh: 爆炸声震破了奥利·威廉斯的耳鼓。

blast.en: The blast may have vaporized the meteorite.
blast.zh: 爆炸可能使陨石汽化了。

blast.en: The blast caused several buildings to catch fire.
blast.zh: 爆炸导致了几个建筑物起火。

spark.en: A spark ignites the fuel in a car engine.
spark.zh: 汽车发动机中的燃料由火花点燃。

spark.en: He passed an electric spark through a mixture of gases.
spark.zh: 他使一束电火花穿过一团气体混合物。

spark.en: This spark is the strength of conviction.
spark.zh: 这个火花就是信念的力量。

twinkle.en: At night, lights twinkle in distant cabins across the valleys.
twinkle.zh: 晚上，灯光在山谷对面远处的小木屋里闪烁。

twinkle.en: Do you know why the stars twinkle so merrily?
twinkle.zh: 你知道为什么星星闪烁得那么快乐吗？

twinkle.en: "Yes, there is!" I say with a magical twinkle.
twinkle.zh: “是的，确实有！”我闪烁着神秘的眼神说道。

gunpowder.en: The introduction of gunpowder gradually made the bow and arrow obsolete, particularly in Western Europe
gunpowder.zh: 火药的使用使弓箭逐渐被淘汰，特别是在西欧。

gunpowder.en: The potentially lethal device was made from a length of hose packed with gunpowder, primers, and shrapnel.
gunpowder.zh: 这个能致命的装置是用一根装满火药、引信和弹片的软管做出来的。

gunpowder.en: The 24 Solar Terms is regarded as China's fifth great invention, after papermaking, printing, the compass and gunpowder.
gunpowder.zh: 二十四节气被认为是中国继造纸术、印刷术、指南针和火药之后的第五大发明。

missile.en: The missile homed in on the target.
The missile fell harmlessly into the sea.
missile.zh: 导弹落到了海里，没有导致任何伤害。

missile.en: Their most potent weapon was the Exocet missile.
missile.zh: 他们效力最强的武器是飞鱼导弹。

tank.en: The tank became bogged down in mud.
The tank had leaked a small amount of water.
We drove there and back on one tank of petrol.
tank.zh: 我们开车去那里来回用了一油箱汽油。

cannon.en: Where is your Italian cannon? Get it up here!
cannon.zh: 你他娘的意大利炮呢，给我拉上来！

cannon.en: The stillness of the night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
cannon.zh: 夜晚的寂静被大炮的轰鸣声打破了。

cannon.en: We heard the bang of a cannon.
cannon.zh: 我们听到轰的一声炮响。

weapon.en: Discipline was the new coach's secret weapon.
weapon.zh: 严格的训练是这位新教练的秘密武器。

weapon.en: Their most potent weapon was the Exocet missile.
weapon.zh: 他们效力最强的武器是飞鱼导弹。

weapon.en: He was charged with carrying an offensive weapon.
weapon.zh: 他被指控携带攻击性武器。

bullet.zh: 一颗子弹嗖的一声从我耳边飞过。
一颗子弹擦过他的胳膊。

rifle.en: There was a rattle of rifle fire.
rifle.zh: 有步枪射击发出的嘎嘎声。

rifle.en: When he appeared again, he was aiming the rifle at Wade.
rifle.zh: 他再次出现时，他正将步枪瞄准维德。

rifle.en: You'd swear he was a cardboard cut-out except that he'd moved his rifle.
rifle.zh: 你会断言他是个用纸板裁出的假人，除非他动了他的来福枪。

target.en: She fired an arrow at the target.
I hit the target fair and square.
The missile homed in on the target.

deflect.en: He raised his arm to try to deflect the blow.
deflect.zh: 他举起手臂试图挡开这一击。

deflect.en: Cage changed his name to deflect accusations of nepotism.
deflect.zh: 凯奇改了名字以转移裙带关系的指责。

deflect.en: The war did not deflect him from the path he had long ago taken.
deflect.zh: 战争没有使他改变很久之前就选择的道路。

mission.en: I reside at the mission at St. Michael's.
mission.zh: 我住在圣迈克尔教堂的布道所。

mission.en: The squadron flew on a reconnaissance mission.
mission.zh: 这支空军中队执行一项侦察任务。

flame.zh: 火焰噼啪噼啪地熄灭了。

flame.en: The custom of lighting the Olympic flame goes back centuries.
flame.zh: 点燃奥运圣火的风俗可追溯到几个世纪前。

flame.en: Can the heart's flame die in the flame of the funeral pile?
flame.zh: 心的火焰会在火葬堆的火焰中熄灭吗？

glitter.en: There was a triumphant glitter in his eyes.
glitter.zh: 他眼睛里闪烁着胜利的光辉。

glitter.en: Smoothed flat by generations of wind and rain, they glitter in the sun.
glitter.zh: 它们被一代代的风雨磨平，在阳光下闪闪发光。

flare.en: Solar flare activity is going to be much worse than what we've seen in the past.
flare.zh: 太阳耀斑活动将比我们过去看到的更糟糕。

flare.en: The flare of the match lit up his face.
flare.zh: 火柴的光照亮了他的脸。

flare.en: The sleeves are tight to the elbow, then flare out.
flare.zh: 袖子在肘部收紧，接着逐渐展开。

glow.en: The fresh air had brought a healthy glow to her cheeks.
glow.zh: 新鲜空气使她两颊红润、精神焕发。

glow.en: There was no light except for the occasional glow of a cigarette.
glow.zh: 除偶尔有香烟的微弱红光外没有一点亮光。

glow.en: She felt a small glow of satisfaction.
glow.zh: 她感到了一丝满足的喜悦。

sword.en: He came towards them with his sword drawn.
sword.zh: 他手持出鞘的剑向他们走来。

blade.en: He held the knife by its blade.
The blade of the knife glinted in the darkness.
It was beyond my ability to grind a blade this broad.
blade.zh: 把这么宽的刀刃磨锋利我做不到。

ax.en: He whittled a new handle for his ax.
ax.zh: 他为自己的斧头削了一个新斧柄。
你如何磨尖你的斧头呢？

arrow.en: She fired an arrow at the target.

hammer.en: He hit the nail squarely on the head with the hammer.
hammer.zh: 他用锤子正对着钉子敲下去。

hammer.en: We had to hammer and shout before they would open up.
hammer.zh: 我们不得不砰砰敲打并大喊大叫，他们才会开门。

spear.en: The spear is presumably the murder weapon.
The boys dug pits and baited them so that they could spear their prey.
spear.zh: 男孩子们挖了陷阱，在里面放上诱饵，以便用矛刺杀猎物。

spear.en: The tallest pine is a small stick to Satan's spear.
spear.zh: 最高的松木对于撒旦的长矛而言就如同一根小小的棍子。

helmet.en: He locked his helmet into position with a click.
helmet.zh: 他喀哒一声把头盔扣好。

helmet.en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorcycle.
helmet.zh: 一个戴着防撞头盔的男子正骑上一辆摩托车。

helmet.en: He waved back, put down the kickstand, and took off his helmet.
helmet.zh: 他向后挥挥手，放下撑脚架，并脱掉他的头盔。

shield.en: He clanged his sword three times on his shield.
shield.zh: 他用他的剑当当当地敲了3下盾。

shield.en: The gunman used the hostages as a human shield.
shield.zh: 持枪歹徒用人质作人体盾牌。

shield.en: The police officer fended off the blows with his riot shield.
shield.zh: 警察用防暴盾牌抵挡攻击。

pistol.en: The man fired several shots from his pistol.
pistol.zh: 那个男人用手枪开了几枪。

pistol.en: Three of the victims were pistol-whipped and two were shot.
pistol.zh: 三个被害者被用手枪柄打过，两个遭到枪击。

pistol.en: It is a myth that gunslingers in the American west cut notches in the handle of their pistol for each man they shot.
pistol.zh: 有种传说，美国西部的枪手们每杀死一个人就在他们的枪柄上刻下一个V形记号。

equip.en: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
equip.zh: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

equip.en: The charity provided money to staff and equip two hospitals.
equip.zh: 这个慈善机构提供资金装备了两家医院并配备了人员。

equip.en: Owners of restaurants have to equip them to admit disabled people.
equip.zh: 餐馆老板们必须给餐馆配备接纳残疾人的设施。

prepare.en: I'll prepare a revised estimate for you.
prepare.zh: 我将为你准备一份经过修正的评估报告。

prepare.en: The king urged his people to prepare for war.
prepare.zh: 国王呼吁臣民百姓准备作战。

deploy.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
deploy.zh: 它还承诺不会部署违反国际法或人权的人工智能。

deploy.en: Notwithstanding the previous guidelines, purchase at least one spare hard disk for each model hard disk you deploy.
deploy.zh: 尽管有前面的指导方针，但为您部署的每个模型硬盘购买至少一个备用硬盘。

deploy.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
deploy.zh: 谷歌在6月7日承诺不会“设计或部署”可能会造成“全面伤害”的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能制导武器，或将人工智能用于违反国际准则的监控。

provide.zh: 他们不肯提供任何细节。

provide.en: Can you provide any proof of identity ?
provide.zh: 你能提供什么身份证明吗？

hit.zh: 渡轮拦腰撞了我们的船只。
大部分人认为那是一次辉煌的成功。

beat.zh: 意大利鞋是无与伦比的。

punch.en: She landed a punch on his chin.
punch.zh: 她对着他的下巴揍了一拳。

strike.zh: 工人对是否罢工进行无记名投票表决。

chop.en: Three more schemes have got the chop.
chop.zh: 又有三个方案遭斧削了。

chop.en: Sometimes they have to chop down a tree for firewood.
chop.zh: 有时他们不得不砍倒一棵树来做木柴。

chop.en: You peel the onions and wash them, then chop them.
chop.zh: 你把洋葱削一下，再洗洗，然后再切碎。

stab.en: It made Peter kick instead of stab.
She felt a sudden stab of pain in the chest.
stab.zh: 她胸部突然感到一阵剧痛。

stab.en: Several tennis stars have had a stab at acting.
stab.zh: 几位网球明星曾尝试过演戏。

dilemma.en: I didn't have a ready answer for this dilemma.
dilemma.zh: 我没有现成的答案来解决这个进退两难的问题。

dilemma.en: She describes her own moral dilemma in making the film.
dilemma.zh: 她描述了自己拍摄这部电影时面临的道德困境。

plight.en: We were deeply moved by her plight.
plight.zh: 她的困境深深地打动了我们。

plight.en: She was touched by the plight of the refugees.
plight.zh: 难民的困境使她受到触动。

plight.en: They bore their plight with stoicism and fortitude.
plight.zh: 他们以坚忍刚毅的精神面对困境。

pitfall.en: These include hand collecting, using baits to attract the ants, ground litter sampling, and the use of pitfall traps.
pitfall.zh: 这些包括人工收集，使用诱饵吸引蚂蚁，地面垃圾取样，以及使用陷阱诱捕。

pitfall.en: One advantage of pitfall traps is that they can be used to collect over a period of time with minimal maintenance and intervention.
pitfall.zh: 陷阱的一个优点是可以在一段时间内用最少的维护和干预进行收集。

pitfall.en: A pitfall trap can be any small container placed in the ground with the top level with the surrounding surface and filled with a preservative.
pitfall.zh: 陷阱可以是任何放置在地面上的小容器，其顶部与周围的表面齐平，并装满防腐剂。

destitute.en: They seem destitute of ordinary human feelings.
destitute.zh: 他们似乎一点人情味都没有。

destitute.en: When he died, his family was left completely destitute.
More than a third of the population was destitute.
destitute.zh: 超过三分之一的人口处于贫困。

conspiracy.en: He claimed that it was all a conspiracy against him.
conspiracy.zh: 他声称这完全是一个针对他的阴谋。

conspiracy.en: They were brought to trial for treasonable conspiracy.
conspiracy.zh: 他们因叛国的阴谋而被交付审判。

conspiracy.en: He suspects there's a conspiracy to cover up the crime.
conspiracy.zh: 他怀疑有掩盖这桩罪行的阴谋。

famine.en: The famine threatened to depopulate the continent.
famine.zh: 饥荒威胁着该大陆人口数量。

famine.en: If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
famine.zh: 如果旱灾继续下去很可能要发生饥荒。

famine.en: Many Irish people went over to America during the famine.
famine.zh: 许多爱尔兰人在饥荒时期迁徙到美国。

starve.en: If my back go idle, I starve.
starve.zh: 如果我的背闲着，那我就要挨饿了。

starve.en: What can we do, but lie here and starve?
starve.zh: 除了躺在这里挨饿，我们还能做什么呢？

starve.en: Brother A said he would starve to death; Brother B said he wouldn't.
starve.zh: 哥哥 A 说他会饿死；弟弟 B 说他不会。

deprive.en: To deprive the boy of his education is a violation of state law.
deprive.zh: 剥夺这个男孩的受教育权是一种违反州法律的行为。

deprive.en: It may deprive a team of business opportunities.
deprive.zh: 它可能会剥夺一个团队的商业机会。

deprive.en: This will deprive your body of vital energy needs.
deprive.zh: 这将剥夺你身体对生命能量的需求。

seize.zh: 当你活着的时候，好好把握生命。
我们应该抓住这个宝贵的机会。

pursue.en: We don't pursue anything. We just go up and throw two punches.
pursue.zh: 我们什么都不追求，我们上去梆梆就是两拳。

pursue.en: She wishes to pursue a medical career.
She returned to London to pursue her acting career.
pursue.zh: 她返回伦敦去从事她的表演事业。

offend.en: A TV interviewer must be careful not to offend.
offend.zh: 电视采访者必须小心别得罪人。

offend.en: Neil did not mean to offend anybody with his joke.
offend.zh: 尼尔开那个玩笑并非想冒犯谁。

offend.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.

threat.zh: 通货膨胀是一种持续的威胁。

threat.en: It was a threat to world peace.
threat.zh: 这是对世界和平的威胁。

threat.en: I mistook her offer as a threat.
threat.zh: 我把她的好心错看成威胁了。

aggressive.en: Some children are much more aggressive than others.
aggressive.zh: 一些孩子比其他孩子好斗得多。

aggressive.en: We decided that in the game we would be physical and aggressive.
aggressive.zh: 我们决定，在比赛中我们将积极拼抢，大胆进攻。

invade.en: Whales will invade king penguins' breeding grounds.
invade.zh: 鲸鱼会入侵帝企鹅的繁殖地。

invade.en: Species that invade a territory can harm ecosystems, agriculture and human health.
invade.zh: 入侵一个地区的物种会危害生态系统、农业和人类健康。

invade.en: I suspect that whatever Facebook has done so far to invade our privacy, it's only the beginning.
invade.zh: 我认为，到目前为止，无论 Facebook 做了什么侵犯我们的隐私的事情，这仅仅是个开始。

trespass.en: Acts of trespass and petty theft often grew out of the blithe disregard that boys had for private property.
trespass.zh: 擅自侵入和小偷小摸的行为经常出自于男孩子们对私有财物漫不经心的轻视态度。
你可能会因擅自闯入而被起诉。

trespass.en: I mustn't trespass on your time any longer.
trespass.zh: 我不能再占用你的时间了。

intrude.en: That, too, explains the heavy Washington presence at this year's show, as these new technologies intrude upon heavily regulated areas.
intrude.zh: 这也解释了为什么在今年的展会上华盛顿有很多人参加，因为这些新技术侵入了受到严格监管的领域。

intrude.en: I'm sorry to intrude on you like this.
Do you feel anxious when unforeseen incidents intrude on your day?
intrude.zh: 当无可预料的事件侵扰到你的生活时，你会感到焦虑吗？

violate.en: Thornburgh said such demands wouldn't violate the First Amendment.
violate.zh: 桑伯说这样的要求不违反第一修正案。

violate.en: Nuclear weapons seem to violate the just war principle of proportionality.
violate.zh: 核武器似乎违背了罚当其罪的正义战争原则。

violate.en: Those who violate traffic regulations should be punished.
violate.zh: 那些违反交通规则的人应该受到惩罚。

attack.zh: 对查尔斯的攻击是不公正的。
防守队员击退了每一次进攻。

assault.en: Police were shocked by the viciousness of the assault.
assault.zh: 警方对这一攻击的残忍感到震惊。

assault.en: A third brigade is at sea, ready for an amphibious assault.
assault.zh: 第三旅在海上待命，随时准备从海上发起进攻。

assault.en: John's soldiers were readying themselves for the final assault.
assault.zh: 约翰的士兵们正在为最后的进攻做好准备。

challenge.zh: 比尔受到该挑战的激励。

challenge.en: She beat off a challenge to her leadership.
challenge.zh: 她战胜了对她的领导地位的挑战。

challenge.en: I hope that he proves equal to the challenge.
challenge.zh: 我希望他最后能应付这一挑战。

siege.zh: 围城已经和平地结束了。

siege.en: The siege is now in its eighteenth day.
The town capitulated after a three-week siege.
siege.zh: 这座城镇被围困三个星期后投降了。

enclose.en: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
enclose.zh: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。
请附上写明姓名地址的回邮信封。

enclose.en: I enclose two tickets along with this letter.

surround.en: The police fanned out to surround the house.
surround.zh: 警察散开包围了这座房子。

surround.en: How can one ever separate out the act from the attitudes that surround it?
surround.zh: 如何才能将行动同围绕着它的种种看法区分开来呢？

halt.en: The leading car came to a halt.
halt.zh: 行驶在前面的车停了下来。
公共汽车剧烈地晃动着停了下来。
汽车嘎的一声停了下来。

pause.zh: 他们停了下来，咬着铅笔。

pause.en: There was a long pause before she answered.
pause.zh: 她停了好一会儿才回答。

cease.en: They voted to cease strike action immediately.
cease.zh: 他们投票决定立即停止罢工。

cease.en: Heavy fighting erupted there today after a two-day cease-fire.
cease.zh: 激烈的战斗在两天的停火之后今天在那里爆发了。

cease.en: Dos Santos has demanded that UNITA sign a cease-fire and demobilize its troops.
cease.zh: 多斯·桑托斯强烈要求安哥拉彻底独立全国同盟签订停火协议并遣散它的军队。

oppose.zh: 我将反对改变这个法规。

oppose.en: More people favour a single European currency than oppose it.
oppose.zh: 支持欧洲单一货币的人比反对的多。

oppose.en: This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
oppose.zh: 本党会强烈反对恢复死刑。

oppress.en: Tackling the inequality, racism and other forms of "structural violence" which oppress the poor is as critical as extending the drugs.
oppress.zh: 解决压迫穷人的不平等、种族主义和其他形式的“结构性暴力”与推广药物一样重要。

oppress.en: Is it not the rich who oppress you?
oppress.zh: 那富足人岂不是欺压你们？

counter.en: He banged the money down on the counter.
counter.zh: 他把钱往柜台上砰地一掷。

counter.en: He propped his elbows upon a greasy counter.
counter.zh: 他把胳膊肘撑在油腻腻的柜台上。

deter.en: It is time to go beyond the shibboleth that conventional forces cannot deter.
deter.zh: 是时候摆脱那些传统力量无法阻止的旧观念了。

deter.en: No amount of foul weather, whether hail, wind, rain or snow, seems to deter them.
deter.zh: 不管天气有多恶劣，哪怕是冰雹、大风、雨还是雪，似乎都阻止不了他们。

deter.en: Supporters of the death penalty argue that it would deter criminals from carrying guns.
deter.zh: 死刑的支持者辩称，死刑可以阻止罪犯携带枪支。

forbid.en: I forbid anyone to touch that clock.
forbid.zh: 我不准任何人碰那台钟。

prohibit.en: Surfwatch allows parents to prohibit access to specific web sites, newsgroups, and bulletin boards.
prohibit.zh: 过滤器软件可以让父母禁止对特定的网站、新闻组和电子布告栏的访问。

prohibit.en: Record's suggestion is to prohibit agents from hiring models with a BMI below 18.
prohibit.zh: 克劳德的建议是禁止代理公司雇用身体质量指数低于18的模特。

prohibit.en: The trade laws did prohibit Anglo-Americans from competing with large-scale British manufacturing of certain products, most notably clothing.
prohibit.zh: 在英国大规模生产的某些产品上，贸易法确实禁止英裔美国人与英国竞争，尤其是服装产业。

prevent.en: We are taking steps to prevent pollution.
prevent.zh: 我们正在采取措施防止污染。
经常锻炼有助于防止体重增加。

betray.en: He was offered money to betray his colleagues.
betray.zh: 有人收买他出卖他的同事。

betray.en: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
betray.zh: 我实在告诉你们，你们中有个人要背叛我了。

betray.en: Now trust me--tell me what it is, and trust me--I won't betray you.
betray.zh: 现在相信我——告诉我是什么，相信我——我不会背叛你。

revolt.en: In February 1848, the people of Paris rose in revolt against the constitutional monarchy of Louis-Philippe.
revolt.zh: 1848年2月，巴黎人民奋起反抗路易-菲利浦君主立宪制。

revolt.en: If instead we regard the financing of warfare by taxation in this period as a background condition, then we will see the English reverse themselves as the main cause of the revolt.
revolt.zh: 如果我们将这一时期的通过税收来支持军事作为背景条件，那么我们就会看到英国人自己的失败反倒是造成反抗的主要原因。

treason.en: The crimes of murder and treason are not bailable.
treason.zh: 谋杀和叛国罪是不能保释的。
他们控告他犯了叛国罪。

rebel.en: She had been a rebel at school.
rebel.zh: 她在学校时就是个叛逆者。
阿莫瑞塔成了一位英勇无畏的反叛者。

rebel.en: He was taken prisoner by rebel soldiers.

traitor.en: He was labelled (as) a traitor by his former colleagues.
traitor.zh: 他被以前的同事称为叛徒。

traitor.en: He was a traitor. And he murdered someone in cold blood.
traitor.zh: 他是一个叛徒，而且他冷血地杀了人。

traitor.en: Tom chased the traitor home, and thus found out where he lived.
traitor.zh: 汤姆追着叛徒到了他的家，这样就知道他住在哪儿了。

patriot.en: He was also regarded as a great patriot because not only did his cartoons praise America, but, during World War II, his studios made training films for American soldiers.
patriot.zh: 他也被认为是一个伟大的爱国者，不仅因为他的卡通赞扬美国，而且，在第二次世界大战期间，他的工作室为美国士兵制作训练电影。

patriot.en: Of or relating to a chauvinistic patriot.
patriot.zh: 沙文主义者的或与其有关的。

reproach.zh: 他用责备的目光看着她。

reproach.en: You've no reason to reproach yourself, no reason to feel shame.
reproach.zh: 你没有理由责备自己，也没有理由感到羞愧。

reproach.en: The aunt went on, in a tone of mingled vexation and reproach.
reproach.zh: 阿姨继续说下去，口气里混杂着烦恼和责备。

blame.en: Let the people suffer. I will take blame.
blame.zh: 苦一苦百姓，骂名我来担！

evidence.zh: 我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

proof.zh: 我们没有任何确凿的证据。

proof.en: Do you have any proof of identity?

terror.zh: 她的眼睛里充满了恐惧。

terror.en: Her previous calm gave way to terror.
terror.zh: 她先前的泰然自若已变为惊恐。

terror.en: People fled from the explosion in terror.
terror.zh: 人们惊恐地逃离了爆炸现场。

terrible.zh: 她承认自己的法语很糟糕。

terrific.en: I am completely energized and feeling terrific.
terrific.zh: 我现在充满了活力，感觉棒极了。
我今天的感觉真是好极了！

horrible.en: Never in all my life have I seen such a horrible thing.
horrible.zh: 我一辈子也没见过这么恐怖的事。

horrible.en: I was repulsed by the horrible smell.
horrible.zh: 这种可怕的气味让我恶心。

alarm.zh: 安的脉搏因惊恐而加快了。

frighten.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
frighten.zh: 对不起，我没有吓唬你的意思。

frighten.en: He would never frighten anyone or cause them any harm.
frighten.zh: 他永远不会吓唬或伤害任何人。

frighten.en: All this was just designed to frighten me and keep me in line.
frighten.zh: 所有这一切只是设计来吓唬我、让我守规矩。

dread.en: My greatest dread is that my parents will find out.
dread.zh: 我最担心的就是父母会察觉出来。
它总是有这种可怕的效果吗？

tension.zh: 几个小时中，紧张局势加剧了。

turbulent.en: I had to have a boat that could handle turbulent seas.
turbulent.zh: 我必须有一条能应付汹涌海浪的船。

turbulent.en: Wars and conflicts have subjected people living in this area to turbulent life.
turbulent.zh: 战争与冲突使该地区的人民过着动荡不安的生活。

turbulent.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
turbulent.zh: 动荡的商业环境也让高级管理人员变得小心翼翼，以免含糊的声明玷污了他们的声誉。

turmoil.en: She lived through the turmoil of the French Revolution.
turmoil.zh: 她经历过法国大革命的混乱之后仍旧活着。

turmoil.en: After years of turmoil and torment, she is finally at peace.
turmoil.zh: 经历多年的动荡与痛苦后，她终于安心下来了。

turmoil.en: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers.
turmoil.zh: 阿比让因计程车司机们的抗议而陷入了混乱。

scenario.en: The worst-case scenario is an aircraft will crash if a bird destroys an engine.
scenario.zh: 如果小鸟毁坏了一部发动机，最坏的情形是飞机坠毁。

scenario.en: Then he came up with a scenario that combined some hunting by humans with some environmental stress.
scenario.zh: 然后他提出了一个结合人类捕猎和环境压力的场景。
我来设想一种可能出现的情况。

occasion.en: He was improperly dressed for the occasion.
occasion.zh: 他的衣着不大适合这个场合。

occasion.en: They were unsuitably dressed for the occasion.
occasion.zh: 他们的穿着在那种场合很不得体。

boundary.en: The Bow Brook forms the western boundary of the wood.
boundary.zh: 鲍溪成了树林的西边界。

boundary.en: How can volcanic activity occur so far from a plate boundary?
boundary.zh: 火山活动是如何在离板块边界那么远的地方发生的呢？

boundary.en: We crossed the county boundary into Devon.
boundary.zh: 我们越过郡界进入了德文。

rein.en: Many people have begun looking for long-term ways to rein in spending.
rein.zh: 很多人已经开始寻找控制开支的长远方式。

rein.en: Her parents kept her on a tight rein with their narrow and inflexible views.
rein.zh: 她的父母目光短浅而又固执地严格控制着她。

rein.en: He promised that between now and the end of the year the government would try to rein back inflation.
rein.zh: 他承诺从现在起到年底政府将努力严格控制通货膨胀。

limit.en: The road has a 30 mph speed limit.
limit.zh: 这条公路限定时速30英里。

limit.en: You should always keep to the speed limit.
limit.zh: 什么时候你都不得超过最高速度限制。

limit.en: They wish to limit the power of the State.
limit.zh: 他们希望限制政府权力。

compete.en: We can't compete with them on price.
compete.zh: 我们在价格上无法与他们竞争。

compete.en: The company must reduce costs to compete effectively.
compete.zh: 公司要有效地参与竞争必须降低成本。

compete.en: Charles has never felt the need to compete with anyone.
compete.zh: 查尔斯从未感觉到与人竞争的需要。

contest.en: The contest should be very keenly fought.
I'm going to be emceeing a costume contest.
contest.zh: 我将要主持一场时装比赛。

contest.en: Who is adjudicating at this year's contest?

contend.en: He well knew the futility of trying to contend against witches, so he gave up discouraged.
contend.zh: 他深知与女巫斗争是徒劳无益的，所以他灰心丧气地放弃了。

contend.en: Modern European states, they contend, appeared after the Renaissance through the rise of nations.
contend.zh: 他们争辩道，现代欧洲国家是在文艺复兴之后通过国家的崛起而出现的。

contend.en: It is time, once again, to contend with racism.
contend.zh: 又是对付种族主义的时候了。

competitor.en: The opposite of an opportunist is a competitor.
competitor.zh: 与机会主义者对立的是竞争者。

competitor.en: His success was beyond belief since his competitor was so experienced.
competitor.zh: 他的成功令人难以置信，因为他的对手非常有经验。

competitor.en: The girl I viewed as a competitor congratulated me on my contest results.
competitor.zh: 那个被我视为竞争对手的女孩就我取得的竞赛成绩向我表示祝贺。

rival.en: This year the newspaper has outsold its main rival.
rival.zh: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。

rival.en: Their smaller rival is battling to end their duopoly.
rival.zh: 比他们小的竞争对手正在为结束他们两家寡头集团而斗争。

rival.en: There is often no discernible difference between rival brands.
rival.zh: 相互竞争的品牌之间往往看不出明显的区别。

strategy.en: I went home and mapped out my strategy.
strategy.zh: 我回到家，制定出了我的策略。
这种策略显得越来越老套。

enemy.zh: 那个小镇落到敌人手里了。
敌人拥有战术上的优势。

tactic.en: It's thought the fires were started by the prisoners as a diversionary tactic.
tactic.zh: 人们认为火是囚犯们放的，是一种使人分心的策略。

tactic.en: One tactic involves where to display the goods.
tactic.zh: 其中一个策略涉及到在哪里展示商品。

tactic.en: This was the first time he'd used the card tactic.
tactic.zh: 这是他第一次使用纸牌策略。

maneuver.en: She can then maneuver the 3D image on the computer screen to map the shortest, least invasive surgical path to the tumor.
maneuver.zh: 然后，她可以操纵电脑屏幕上的 3D 图像，以绘制出最短、切口最小的通往肿瘤的手术路径。

maneuver.en: A new back flip maneuver allowed station astronauts to photograph the shuttle's underbelly, and an extra-long robotic arm enabled astronauts see parts of the shuttle that were previously out of sight.
maneuver.zh: 新的后空翻使空间站的宇航员可以拍摄航天飞机的腹部，超长的机械臂使宇航员可以看到航天飞机以前看不见的部分。

maneuver.en: The dorsad reduction maneuver has been used for treating 120 cases of posticous cervical spondylopathy.
maneuver.zh: 背部复位手法已经被用于治疗120例后发性颈椎病。

blueprint.en: The report is being heralded as a blueprint for the future of transport.
blueprint.zh: 这份报告被宣称是未来运输的蓝图。

blueprint.en: The president will offer delegates his blueprint for the country's future.
blueprint.zh: 总统将向代表们提出他的国家未来蓝图。

blueprint.en: There is a slight inaccuracy in this blueprint.

warn.zh: 我要跑在前头，警告他们。

warn.en: I tried to warn him, but he wouldn't listen.
warn.zh: 我设法提醒过他，可他就是不听。

warn.en: It seems only right to warn you of the risk.
warn.zh: 似乎应该警告你有风险。

compel.en: She could compel him to support the child after it was born.
compel.zh: 她可以迫使他在孩子出生后抚养孩子。

compel.en: Nothing can compel me to do such a thing.
compel.zh: 没有什么可以强迫我做这件事。

compel.en: I now take the view that religion is harmless so long as it does not compel its members to proselytize.
compel.zh: 我现在认为宗教是无害的，只要它不强迫其成员改变宗教信仰。

oblige.en: Moreover, the integration of the European community will oblige television companies to cooperate more closely in terms of both production and distribution.
oblige.zh: 此外，欧洲共同体的一体化将迫使电视公司在制作和发行方面进行更密切的合作。

oblige.en: Would you oblige me with some information?
oblige.zh: 拜托您给我透露些消息好吗？

oblige.en: Call me if you need any help—I'd be happy to oblige.
oblige.zh: 若有需要，尽管给我打电话。我很乐意帮忙。

refute.en: I covered the conference as a reporter, but what really unnerved me was a counter-conference of scholars to refute the earlier one.
refute.zh: 我以记者的身份报道了那次会议，但真正让我感到不安的是学者们召开的反驳会议。

refute.en: Even if true, this evidence does not refute the contention that editors should bear some of the blame for the reductions, unless editors are merely passive instruments responding to reader interest.
refute.zh: 即使这是真的，这一证据也不能反驳编辑应该承担部分责任的论点，除非编辑只是被动地回应读者的兴趣。

refute.en: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
refute.zh: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

might.zh: 不安全感可能会悄然而生。

force.en: Is religion always a force for good?
force.zh: 宗教一向是诲人行善的力量吗？

force.en: They realized the force of her argument.
force.zh: 他们领悟到了她那论据的威力。

force.en: The juice is extracted by centrifugal force.
force.zh: 果汁被离心力提取出来。

impair.zh: 它可能会损害消化系统。

impair.en: Their inability to scowl seemed to impair their ability to see why pushy telemarketers or a lack of birthday wishes might make one's face fall.
impair.zh: 他们无法动怒似乎削弱了他们的能力，让他们明白为什么咄咄逼人的电话推销员或没得到生日祝愿可能会让一个人沉下脸来。

impair.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
impair.zh: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

reinforce.en: I hope this will reinforce Indonesian determination to deal with this kind of threat.
reinforce.zh: 我希望这会加强印度尼西亚对付这类威胁的决心。

reinforce.en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
reinforce.zh: 要记住，你是要用视觉资料来强化你的信息，而不是削弱你所讲述的内容。

reinforce.en: We agreed on a form of splint to reinforce the damaged portion.
reinforce.zh: 我们同意用一种夹板来加固损坏的部分。

mitigate.en: One future possibility is that improved monitoring can help predict where and when bleaching will occur, which might potentially enable us to mitigate its effects.
mitigate.zh: 未来的一种可能是，升级后的监测有助于预测漂白现象发生的时间和地点，这也许能让我们减轻漂白现象的影响。

mitigate.en: It doesn't really mitigate against the confinement he has perpetrated on Lolita.
mitigate.zh: 它没能减少他对洛丽塔的限制。

mitigate.en: The leases come with painstaking stipulations to mitigate any possible environmental harm to species like the polar bear.
mitigate.zh: 这些租约附带了细致的条款，以减轻对北极熊等物种的任何可能的环境伤害。

comfort.en: I tried to offer a few words of comfort.
comfort.zh: 我试图说上几句安慰的话。
这家旅馆既舒适又方便。

event.en: The event was voted a great success.
event.zh: 大家认为这项活动很成功。

event.en: The election was the main event of 2004.
event.zh: 那次选举是2004年的主要大事。

event.en: The event is open to all comers.
event.zh: 所有人均可参加这项比赛。

matter.zh: 她谨慎细致地处理了那件事情。

occur.zh: 这一事件究竟是什么时候发生的？

occur.en: These snails do not occur on low-lying coral islands.
occur.zh: 这些蜗牛不会出现在低洼的珊瑚岛上。

occur.en: Rattlesnakes occur in the warmer, drier parts of North America.
occur.zh: 响尾蛇出现在北美温暖干燥的地区。

happen.zh: 这种事再也不能发生了。

savage.en: If you dare to have a sassy girlfriend ...You'll suddenly find that you've unexpectedly acquired a savage and wild mother.
savage.zh: 你要是敢有野蛮女友，你就会突然发现你有一个野蛮又狂野的母亲

savage.en: She had been badly hurt in what police described as 'a savage attack'.
savage.zh: 她遭受袭击而身受重伤—警方称这是一次“野蛮的袭击”。

savage.en: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
savage.zh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

reckless.en: She was a good rider, but reckless.
reckless.zh: 她是个好骑手，但太鲁莽。

reckless.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
reckless.zh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

reckless.en: Many people believe reckless drivers are treated too leniently.
reckless.zh: 很多人认为对鲁莽的司机处理得太宽大了。

fierce.en: There's been some fierce competition for the title.
fierce.zh: 已有一些为此头衔的激烈竞争。

fierce.en: The plans have already come in for fierce criticism.
fierce.zh: 这些计划已遭到激烈的批评。

foul.zh: 比赛犯规将受到严厉处罚。

foul.en: He had fallen foul of the FBI.
foul.zh: 他已惹恼了联邦调查局。

evil.en: Good and evil may co-exist within one family.
evil.zh: 善与恶可能共存于同一个家庭。

evil.en: He said that we were evil, malignant, and mean.
evil.zh: 他说我们邪恶、恶毒、卑鄙。

evil.en: You cannot pretend there's no evil in the world.
evil.zh: 你不能睁着眼睛瞎说世界上没有罪恶。

devil.zh: 他真是个令人厌烦的老家伙。
他是个奸诈狡猾的家伙。

devil.en: I miss the old devil, now that he's gone.
devil.zh: 老家伙这一走，我还真想他。

execute.en: We are going to execute our campaign plan to the letter.
execute.zh: 我们将严格执行我们的竞选方案。

execute.en: We execute that instruction and we move to the next one.
execute.zh: 我们执行那个指令，并继续下一轮。

execute.en: The lawyer argued that it is wrong to execute a person for a crime he committed while he was a minor.
execute.zh: 律师认为，因为一个人在未成年时所犯的罪而处死他是错误的。

hang.zh: 请稍候—我还没准备好呢。

hang.en: It's OK—hang loose and stay cool.
hang.zh: 没事儿，你要镇定，要冷静。

hang.en: Can you just hang on a sec?

sacrifice.en: Should motherhood necessarily mean sacrifice and self-denial?
sacrifice.zh: 做母亲必须要自我牺牲和忘我吗？

sacrifice.en: He was willing to sacrifice his happiness on the altar of fame.
sacrifice.zh: 为了名声，他心甘情愿牺牲幸福。

sacrifice.en: I thanked my parents for all their self-sacrifice on my behalf.
sacrifice.zh: 我感谢父母为我所做的一切牺牲。

bury.en: If I die, bury me under the juniper-tree.
bury.zh: 如果我死了，就把我埋在桧树下。

bury.en: Huck said: "Do they always bury it as deep as this?"
bury.zh: 哈克说：“他们总是埋得这么深吗？”

bury.en: "Good," thought Huck, "they will bury it in the old quarry."
bury.zh: “好吧，”哈克想，“他们会把它埋在石坑里。”

casualty.en: There are fears that the casualty toll may be higher.
casualty.zh: 人们担心伤亡人数可能会更多。

casualty.en: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.
casualty.zh: 训练包括伤亡处理程序的实际模拟。
受伤者被迅速送往急救室。

funeral.zh: 大约有三十人参加了葬礼。

tomb.zh: 但我始终没有找到她的陵墓。

tomb.en: Have you ever been to a tomb?
This isn't a palace; it's a tomb.

grave.zh: 死者亲属在墓前献了花圈。

grave.en: They stood in silent homage around the grave.
grave.zh: 他们恭敬地站在坟墓周围致默哀礼。

maritime.en: The reason for this swirl of maritime outlawry can be found on the nearest shore.
maritime.zh: 造成这种海上流亡者漩涡的原因可以在最近的岸上找到。

maritime.en: Today, China is trying to build the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road.
maritime.zh: 今天，中国正在努力建设“丝绸之路经济带”和“21世纪海上丝绸之路”。

maritime.en: The tiny island nation has set aside 500,000 square kilometres—80 percent—of its maritime territory, for full protection.
maritime.zh: 这个小小的岛国已经留出了占其海洋领土80%的50万平方公里用于全面保护。

naval.en: He was the senior serving naval officer.
naval.zh: 他曾是高级现役海军军官。

naval.en: He accepted a commission as a naval officer.
naval.zh: 他接受了海军军官的任命。

naval.en: He had been a naval ensign stationed off Cuba.
naval.zh: 他曾是派驻在古巴的海军少尉。

fleet.en: Russia and Ukraine have been disputing the ownership of the fleet.
fleet.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰一直在争夺该舰队的所有权。

fleet.en: With its own fleet of trucks, the company delivers most orders overnight.
fleet.zh: 因为有自己的运输车队，该公司的大部分订货可以第二天就送到。

fleet.en: They maintain a very powerful fleet in Oriental waters.
fleet.zh: 他们在远东海域保持着一支非常强大的舰队。

landing.zh: 我跑出去上了楼梯平台。

troop.en: A troop of guests was moving towards the house.
troop.zh: 一群客人朝那房子走去。

troop.en: Mr. Vlok promised new measures to protect residents, including the dispatch of police and troop reinforcements.
troop.zh: 乌洛克先生答应了新的保护居民的措施，包括派遣增援的警察和军队。

troop.en: The troop was armed with the most advanced weapons.
troop.zh: 这支军队配备了最先进的武器。

hover.en: Hover Camera records movements with a 13MP camera and takes 4K videos.
hover.zh: 无人相机可以用1300万像素记录运动，拍摄 4K 视频。

hover.en: With the development of science and technology, a Chinese young man Wang Mengqiu, invented Hover Camera.
hover.zh: 随着科技的发展，中国年轻人王梦秋发明了无人相机。

hover.en: It is the best choice for weddings, sports games and holidays because Hover Camera is convenient for the users to carry.
hover.zh: 它是婚礼、运动会和假期的最佳选择，因为无人相机方便用户携带。

proceed.en: They had to take the finely balanced decision to let the visit proceed.
proceed.zh: 他们不得不做出仔细权衡后的决定，让访问继续下去。

proceed.en: Passengers for Rome should proceed to Gate 32 for boarding.
proceed.zh: 前往罗马的旅客，请到32号登机口登机。

proceed.en: We're not sure whether we still want to proceed with the sale.
proceed.zh: 我们不确定是否还要继续减价促销。

military.zh: 他被召回执行军事任务。
军事行动可能会成为必要。
为什么军事情报如此缺乏？

nuclear.en: Uranium is used to fuel nuclear plants.

nuclear.zh: 核升级的威胁依然存在。

devastate.en: A big worry is that these transplanted megafauna might devastate plants and animals that are native to the western United States.
devastate.zh: 最让人忧心的就是这些转移过来的巨型动物可能会毁灭美国西部一些土生土长的动植物。

devastate.en: The unscrupulous commodification of food and the destruction of foodstuffs will continue to devastate soils, livelihoods and ecologies.
devastate.zh: 无所顾忌的粮食商品化和对食品的破坏将继续破坏土壤、生计和生态。

devastate.en: The bugs could potentially devastate crops in warm southern states.
devastate.zh: 这些臭虫有可能摧毁气候温暖的美国南方诸州作物。

adventure.en: He set off in quest of adventure.
Few can resist the lure of adventure.
adventure.zh: 很少有人能抵御历险的诱惑力。

adventure.en: Age hadn't blunted his passion for adventure.
adventure.zh: 岁月没有冲淡他的冒险激情。

risk.en: You must be mad to risk it.
risk.zh: 你去冒这种风险，简直是疯了。

risk.en: Dare she risk staying where she was?
risk.zh: 她敢冒险呆在原地不动吗？

peril.zh: 走开，否则发生危险自己负责！

peril.en: The switch hovered in the air—the peril was desperate.
peril.zh: 鞭子在空中晃荡——危险万分。

peril.en: Yet, there are signs of peril within American higher education.
peril.zh: 然而，美国高等教育中也有危险的迹象。

catastrophe.en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

catastrophe.en: Early warnings of rising water levels prevented another major catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 提前发出的洪水水位上涨警报防止了又一次的重大灾害。

catastrophe.en: Believe it or not, this wasn't the worst catastrophe in our planet's history.
catastrophe.zh: 信不信由你，这还不是地球历史上最严重的灾难。

poison.en: Her blood was found to contain poison.
poison.zh: 她的血液中发现有毒素。
有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

poison.en: There is no known antidote to the poison.
poison.zh: 这种毒的解药尚未发现。

collapse.en: The bridge is liable to collapse at any moment.
A few days after his collapse he was sitting up in bed.
collapse.zh: 他病倒后过了几天就在床上起身坐着了。

collapse.en: The walls were strengthened to protect them from collapse.

torture.en: Many of the refugees have suffered torture.
torture.zh: 许多难民都遭受过拷打。

torture.en: He would not torture her further by trying to argue with her.
torture.zh: 他不会通过和她争吵而进一步折磨她。

torture.en: I believed that in civilized countries, torture had ended long ago.
torture.zh: 我相信在文明国家酷刑早就废止了。

humiliate.en: "You see," said Hughes, "there's people who want to humiliate you and grind you down."
humiliate.zh: “你看，” 休斯说，“有人想羞辱你、折磨你。”

humiliate.en: I didn't want to humiliate her in front of her colleagues.
humiliate.zh: 我不想当着她同事们的面令她难堪。

harmful.en: Continuous exposure to sound above 80 decibels could be harmful.
harmful.zh: 持续曝露于超过80分贝的声音可能有害。

harmful.en: Water is not an effective shield against the sun's more harmful rays.
harmful.zh: 水不能有效阻挡太阳中更有害的射线。

harmful.en: Tears help to protect the eye from potentially harmful foreign bodies.
harmful.zh: 眼泪有助于保护眼睛去除可能有害的异物。

damage.zh: 火灾造成了巨大的损失。

mislead.en: It would be dishonest to mislead people and not to present the data as fairly as possible.
mislead.zh: 误导人们、不尽可能公正地提供数据是不诚实的。

mislead.en: As a result, these advertisements could mislead children and their parents.
mislead.zh: 因此，这些广告会误导孩子和他们的父母。

mislead.en: Some irresponsible websites allowed restaurants to post false pictures that could mislead customers.
mislead.zh: 一些不负责任的网站允许餐馆发布一些误导顾客的虚假照片。

disturb.en: Don't disturb Jane, she's studying for her exams.
disturb.zh: 不要打扰简，她正在温习功课，准备考试呢。

disturb.en: If you get up early, try not to disturb everyone else.
disturb.zh: 如果你起得早，尽量不要打扰别人。

interfere.en: We take the view that it would be wrong to interfere.
interfere.zh: 我们所持的态度是：干涉是错误的。

interfere.en: I try not to let work interfere with my personal life.
interfere.zh: 我尽量不让工作干扰我的私生活。

interfere.en: She never allows her personal feelings to interfere with her work.
interfere.zh: 她从不让她的个人感情妨碍工作。

retreat.zh: 他们切断了敌人的退路。

retreat.en: The French, suddenly outnumbered, were forced to retreat.
retreat.zh: 法军在人数上突然处于劣势，被迫撤退了。

interrupt.en: Can I interrupt you just for a minute?
interrupt.zh: 我可不可以打断你一会儿？
请继续往下说，我并非有意打断你的话。

shrink.zh: 我已经看过了精神病医生。

shrink.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
shrink.zh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

withdraw.en: A back injury forced her to withdraw from Wimbledon.
withdraw.zh: 一处背伤迫使她退出了温布尔登网球赛。

withdraw.en: There have been calls for Britain to withdraw from the EU.
withdraw.zh: 一直有人呼吁英国退出欧盟。

withdraw.en: He refused to withdraw derogatory remarks made about his boss.
withdraw.zh: 他拒绝收回对自己老板的贬抑之言。

withstand.en: The aircraft is designed to withstand turbulent conditions.
withstand.zh: 这架飞机是为经受猛烈的气流而设计的。

withstand.en: She failed to withstand the stresses and strains of public life.
withstand.zh: 她承受不了作为一个公众人物的生活压力和紧张。

withstand.en: The plants were unable to withstand the rigours of a harsh winter.
withstand.zh: 这些植物经受不住严冬的考验。

compromise.zh: 我拒绝在原则问题上妥协。

compromise.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
compromise.zh: 妥协是生活不可避免的一部分。

surrender.en: They had raised the white flag in surrender.
surrender.zh: 他们已经升起白旗投降。

avoid.en: We have tried to avoid any moralizing.
avoid.zh: 我们已力图避免任何形式的说教。

avoid.en: They avoid going out alone after dark.
avoid.zh: 他们避免黄昏后独自出门。

avoid.en: He tends to avoid all physical contact.
avoid.zh: 他倾向于避免一切身体接触。

quit.en: He quit his job as an office boy.
quit.zh: 他辞去了办公室勤杂员的工作。

quit.en: If I don't get more money I'll quit.
We decided it was time to quit the city.
quit.zh: 当时我们决定，该离开城市生活了。

discard.en: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard long-established theory.
discard.zh: 爱因斯坦拥有抛弃早已既定的理论之胆识。

discard.en: Once we start to see people as individuals, and discard the stereotypes, we can move positively toward inclusiveness for everyone.
discard.zh: 只要我们开始把人看作是独立的个体，并摒弃成见，我们就可以朝着对每个人都具有包容性的方向积极前进。

discard.en: At the same time, workers were required to discard old habits, for industrialism demanded a worker who was alert, dependable, and self-disciplined.
discard.zh: 与此同时，工厂还要求工人们摒弃原来的习惯，因为工业制度需要机敏、可靠和自律的工人。

forgo.en: No one was prepared to forgo their lunch hour to attend the meeting.
forgo.zh: 谁都不愿意放弃午餐时间出席会议。

forgo.en: Forgo synchronization and use a static field.
forgo.zh: 放弃同步，而使用一个static字段。

abandon.en: The captain gave the order to abandon ship.
Snow forced many drivers to abandon their vehicles.
abandon.zh: 大雪迫使许多驾驶者弃车步行。

abandon.en: Many want to abandon the multilateral trade talks in Geneva.
abandon.zh: 许多国家想要放弃在日内瓦的多边贸易会谈。

rid.en: I can't get rid of this headache.
We got rid of all the old furniture.
rid.zh: 我们扔掉了所有的旧家具。

rid.en: Are you trying to say you want rid of me?

defend.en: He has hired a lawyer to defend him against the allegation.
defend.zh: 他已聘请一位律师为他所受的指控辩护。

defend.en: The newspaper continues to defend its publication of the photographs.
defend.zh: 这家报纸继续为刊登这些照片辩护。
你怎能为这种行为辩解呢？

safeguard.en: The new card will safeguard the company against fraud.
safeguard.zh: 新卡将保护公司免遭诈骗。

safeguard.en: This deal could safeguard the futures of the 2 000 employees.
safeguard.zh: 这个协议可以保障2 000名雇员今后的生活。

safeguard.en: They will press for international action to safeguard the ozone layer.
safeguard.zh: 他们将竭力要求国际行动来保护臭氧层。

defeat.zh: 他蒙骗默瑟并击败了他。

defeat.en: They suffered a defeat at the polls.
defeat.zh: 他们在投票选举中惨遭失败。

resist.en: Few can resist the lure of adventure.
resist.zh: 很少有人能抵御历险的诱惑力。

resist.en: They were too spiritless even to resist.
resist.zh: 他们无精打采的，甚至都没抵抗。

resist.en: Few males can resist a self-confident seductress.
resist.zh: 很少有男人能抵挡住自信女人的诱惑。

victory.zh: 这个队为了胜利坚持不懈。
苏格兰的冠军庆祝胜利！

triumph.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
triumph.zh: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

triumph.en: Her triumph was a cause for celebration.
triumph.zh: 她的胜利是庆祝的理由。

triumph.en: The winning team returned home in triumph.

capture.en: Swanson persuaded Hubley to work undercover to capture the killer.
capture.zh: 斯旺森说服了赫布利秘密工作以捕获凶手。

capture.en: Her paintings capture the subtle hues of the countryside in autumn.
capture.zh: 她的油画捕捉住了秋天乡村的微妙色调。

conquer.en: The only way to conquer a fear is to face it.
conquer.zh: 克服恐惧的唯一方法是正视恐惧。

conquer.en: The band is now setting out to conquer the world.
conquer.zh: 这支乐队现在要去征服世界。
你不能征服珠穆朗玛峰。

monument.en: The whole house is a monument to her craftsmanship.
monument.zh: 那整座房子是她技艺的一座丰碑。

monument.en: The monument consists of a circle of gigantic stones.
monument.zh: 该纪念碑由一圈巨大的石碑组成。

monument.en: A monument to him was erected in St Paul's Cathedral.
monument.zh: 在圣保罗大教堂为他修了一座纪念碑。

tablet.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
tablet.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

tablet.en: One in five Americans will use a tablet or smartphone.
tablet.zh: 五分之一的美国人将使用平板电脑或智能手机。

statue.zh: 我目不转睛地看着那尊雕像。

statue.en: There's the statue I was telling you about.
statue.zh: 那就是我跟你们讲过的塑像。

statue.en: The statue stared down at them with sightless eyes.
statue.zh: 雕像用一双盲眼俯视着他们。

medal.en: She walked away with the gold medal.
She is hoping to win the gold medal.
Curtis is on track for the gold medal.
medal.zh: 柯蒂斯正踏上夺取金牌之途。

honor.en: He won the Medal of Honor for his actions in 1943.
honor.zh: 他因在1943年的勇敢行为获得荣誉勋章。
日本从来没有过这样的荣誉。

glorious.en: Harrison had a glorious career spanning more than six decades.
glorious.zh: 哈里森有过一段长达六十余年的辉煌的职业生涯。

glorious.en: The award of the Nobel Prize has crowned a glorious career in physics.
glorious.zh: 荣获诺贝尔奖使其物理学研究的辉煌事业达到了顶点。

glorious.en: They had three weeks of glorious sunshine.
glorious.zh: 他们度过了三周阳光灿烂的日子。

contribute.en: You need not feel obliged to contribute.
contribute.zh: 你不必认为你非得捐款。
当地的公司已经同意捐助了。

devote.en: The original intention was to devote three months to the project.
devote.zh: 最初的计划是在这个项目上投入三个月的时间。

devote.en: It can't be denied that we need to devote more resources to this problem.
devote.zh: 无可否认，我们必须投入更多的资源来解决这个问题。

devote.en: We devote several days to the exploration of the magnificent Maya sites of Copan.
devote.zh: 我们投入了几天时间在科潘宏伟的玛雅遗址考察。

owe.en: Add up all the money I owe you.
owe.zh: 把我欠你的钱全部加起来。

patrol.en: He failed to return from a patrol.
patrol.zh: 他没能从一次巡逻中回来。
公路巡警关闭了这条路。

patrol.en: Guards patrol the perimeter of the estate.
patrol.zh: 保安人员在庄园四周巡逻。

camouflage.en: They were dressed in camouflage and carried automatic rifles.
camouflage.zh: 他们身着迷彩服，手持自动步枪。

camouflage.en: There was much laughter – a perfect camouflage for the anxiety of waiting for the verdict in the trial.
camouflage.zh: 笑声不断–审判中等待裁决时焦虑的最佳掩饰。

camouflage.en: One of its adaptations is basically camouflage.
camouflage.zh: 它的一种基本的适应性是伪装。

guard.en: A guard was posted outside the building.
guard.zh: 建筑物外设了一名警卫。

obstacle.en: Overcrowding remains a large obstacle to improving conditions.
obstacle.zh: 过度拥挤仍然是改善条件的一大障碍。

obstacle.en: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
obstacle.zh: 学历不足可能成为谋职的主要障碍。

obstacle.en: Most competition cars will only roll over if they hit an obstacle.
obstacle.zh: 多数赛车在撞到障碍物时都会翻车。

spy.en: He was denounced as a foreign spy.
spy.zh: 有人告发他是外国间谍。

spy.en: He was jailed for five years as an alleged spy.
spy.zh: 他被指控为间谍而被监禁了5年。

spy.en: "She thinks you're a spy," Scott said matter-of-factly.
spy.zh: “她认为你是一名间谍，”斯科特面无表情地说。

burrow.en: They go back to their own burrow.
I come out of my burrow only at night to find food.
burrow.zh: 我只在夜间从洞穴中出来寻找食物。

burrow.en: The trip to the burrow prevents the squirrel from getting too hot.
burrow.zh: 回到地洞可以防止松鼠变得太热。

scout.en: He wore the garb of a scout.
scout.zh: 他穿了一身童子军的装束。

scout.en: We went ahead to scout out the lie of the land.
scout.zh: 我们先走一步，去侦察地形。

scout.en: Joshua sends out spies to scout out the land.
scout.zh: 约书亚派出密探去侦察那片土地。

general.zh: 将军没有被搅得慌乱不安。

general.en: The general gave the order to advance.

general.zh: 我父亲十分敬仰艾森豪威尔将军。

soldier.en: The soldier acted qua soldier, not as a human being.
soldier.zh: 那名士兵当时以军人的身份行事，而不是以一般人的身份。

soldier.en: The officers died faithful to the honour of a soldier.
soldier.zh: 军官们怀着对军人气节的忠诚而捐躯。

soldier.en: One boy did an imitation of a soldier with a loudspeaker.
soldier.zh: 一个男孩拿着扬声器学着士兵的样子。

veteran.en: He is a veteran parliamentarian whose views enjoy widespread respect.
veteran.zh: 他是一位资深议员，其观点受到广泛尊重。

veteran.en: "Hedge funds used to be set up by two guys in a back alley with a flashlight," says one veteran.
veteran.zh: 一位资深人士表示：“对冲基金过去是由两个人拿着手电筒，在一个偏僻的小巷里建立起来的。”

veteran.en: If your project is being resisted, for example, by a group of veteran employees, ask another old-timer to speak up for it.
veteran.zh: 例如，如果你的项目遭到一群资深员工的反对，那就另请一位老前辈为它辩护。

pioneer.en: What if I am a pioneer or even a genius?
pioneer.zh: 要是我是个开拓者，甚至是个天才怎么办？

pioneer.en: Li Dong, 46, is a pioneer in this field.
pioneer.zh: 46岁的李东是这一领域的先驱。

pioneer.en: In the US, California has been a pioneer.
pioneer.zh: 在美国，加利福尼亚州是一个开拓者。

prophet.en: The pity is that you are not a prophet.
The prophet appropriately appropriated the fund for repairing propeller.
prophet.zh: 提倡者恰当地为修理螺旋桨拨专款。

prophet.en: In the tradition, one of the companions asked the prophet what's the most powerful verse in Koran.
prophet.zh: 在传统中，一个同伴问先知《古兰经》中最有力量的一节是什么。

herald.en: He picked up extra money as a local stringer for the New York Herald.
herald.zh: 他通过做《纽约先驱报》的本地特约记者赚了些外快。

herald.en: The Sydney Morning Herald carried the headline: "Sorry Ma'am, Most Australians Want a Republic."
herald.zh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》有这样一则头版标题：“对不起，夫人，大多数澳大利亚人想要一个共和国。”

herald.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
herald.zh: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

heir.en: Her duty was to produce an heir to the throne.
heir.zh: 她的任务就是生育王位继承人。

heir.en: He is the eldest son and thus heir to the title.
heir.zh: 他是长子，因此是这个封号的继承人。

heir.en: He was heir to a large farm in Domleschg.
heir.zh: 他是多姆莱斯克一个大农场的继承人。

successor.en: Mr. Olsen has always avoided anointing any successor.
successor.zh: 奥尔森先生总是避免指定任何继任者。

successor.en: He had bowed out gracefully when his successor had been appointed.
successor.zh: 当他的继任者被任命时，他很有风度地退出了。

successor.en: President Hoover's successor attached even more importance to this problem.
successor.zh: 胡佛总统的继任者更加重视这个问题。

surname.zh: 他已使他的姓氏英语化了。
温特斯是一个相当普通的姓。

generation.en: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.
generation.zh: 按理他是他那一代中最优秀的演员。

generation.en: He was a beacon of hope for the younger generation.
generation.zh: 他是年轻一代的希望之灯。

generation.en: She was one of the greatest minds of her generation.
generation.zh: 她是她那一代人中最聪慧的人之一。

gender.en: Latin nouns have case, number and gender.
gender.zh: 拉丁语名词有格、数和性。

gender.en: Gender roles are often conditioned by cultural factors.
gender.zh: 文化因素常常对性别的角色有着重要的影响。

gender.en: The report was redrafted to remove gender-specific language.
gender.zh: 重新起草这个报告，删除带有性别特点的语言。

sex.zh: 我的性生活是我的私事。

sex.en: He was very open in his attitudes about sex.

spouse.en: You, or your spouse, must be at least 60 to participate.
spouse.zh: 你或你的配偶至少要有60岁才能加入。

spouse.en: It is often helpful to have your spouse in the room when major news is expected.
spouse.zh: 在等待重大消息时，让你的配偶在场往往是很有好处的。

spouse.en: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
spouse.zh: 理论上，女孩可以不接受她父母已为自己选择的配偶。

female.zh: 雌激素是一种雌性荷尔蒙。

female.en: Two of the candidates must be female.
female.zh: 候选人中必须有两名是女性。

couple.zh: 那地方离这里只有几个街区。

grandfather.zh: 他祖父是一位穆斯林教士。

gay.zh: 我不知道他是同性恋者。

gay.en: He has waffled on abortion and gay rights.
gay.zh: 他在人工流产和同性恋者的权利问题上含糊其辞。

gay.en: He has always championed the cause of gay rights.
gay.zh: 他一直在为争取同性恋者的权利而斗争。

sibling.en: The remaining 22% lived in the home of another family member (such as a grandparent, in-law or sibling), a non-relative, or in group quarters like college dormitories.
sibling.zh: 剩下22%的人住在另一个家庭成员家里（如祖父母、姻亲或兄弟姐妹）、非亲属成员家里、或是像大学宿舍一样的集体住房里。

sibling.en: A calm, rule-following child might respond better to a different sort of parenting than a younger sibling.
sibling.zh: 一个冷静、循规蹈矩的孩子对不同类型的养育方式的反应可能比弟弟妹妹更好。

sibling.en: A calm, rule-following child might respond better to a different sort of parenting than, for example, a younger sibling.
sibling.zh: 一个冷静、守规矩的孩子对某种不同的育儿方式的反应可能会好过其弟弟妹妹。

cousin.zh: 埃里克是我堂兄爱德华的儿子。

cousin.en: I tried again to get ahold of my cousin Joan.
cousin.zh: 我又试着联系了一次我表姐琼。

niece.zh: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

niece.en: She was not exactly overjoyed at the prospect of looking after her niece.
niece.zh: 想到要照料她的侄女，她就高兴不起来了。

niece.en: Now she's in assisted living, and her niece and nephew are helping with her affairs.
niece.zh: 她现在住在辅助生活型住房里，她的侄女和侄子在帮助处理她的事务。

nephew.en: He entrusted the task to his nephew.
nephew.zh: 他把这任务托付给了他的侄儿。

nephew.en: He entrusted his nephew with the task.
nephew.zh: 他把这任务托付给了他的侄儿。

nephew.en: She has a nephew who is just ten years of age.

twin.zh: 我们就是排名第1346的绝命双子星。

twin.en: I can't tell one twin from the other.
twin.zh: 我分不出双胞胎中谁是谁。

twin.en: Can you tell Tom from his twin brother?
twin.zh: 你能分得出汤姆和他的孪生弟弟吗？

orphan.en: He stayed with a raccoon orphan he had adopted.
orphan.zh: 他和一只他收养的浣熊孤儿待在一起。

orphan.en: It's the latest in a long line of orphan literature.
orphan.zh: 这是最新的孤儿文学作品。

orphan.en: He brought up the orphan and passed onto him his knowledge of medicine.
orphan.zh: 他把一个孤儿养大，并且把自己的医术传给了他。

embryo.zh: 胚胎研究是个让人情绪激动的问题。

embryo.en: An eight-week-old embryo is only an inch long.
embryo.zh: 一个8周大的胎儿仅1英寸长。

embryo.en: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.
embryo.zh: 胚胎的性别早在受精时就决定了。

infant.en: There was an infant squalling in the back of the church.
infant.zh: 教堂的后面有个婴儿大声啼哭的声音。

infant.en: The nation's infant mortality rate has reached a record low.
infant.zh: 该国的婴儿死亡率已达历史最低。

infant.en: Infant mortality is a reliable barometer of socio-economic conditions.
infant.zh: 婴儿死亡率是社会经济状况的可靠指标。

juvenile.en: Juvenile crime is increasing at a terrifying rate.
juvenile.zh: 青少年犯罪在以惊人的速度增加。

juvenile.en: She wasn't sent to the juvenile court; instead she was cautioned.
juvenile.zh: 她未被送上少年法庭，而是受到了警告。

juvenile.en: Is it just a coincidence that juvenile crime is on the rise?
juvenile.zh: 青少年犯罪率上升只是一个巧合吗？

youngster.en: As a youngster, she might have found it too restrictive, not creative enough.
youngster.zh: 作为一个年轻人，她可能会发现这项活动约束太多，不够创新。

youngster.en: Tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 测试并不弥补明显的社会不公，因此不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

youngster.en: For example, tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 例如，测试并不弥补明显的社会不公；因此，它们不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

youth.zh: 这首诗对比了青春与老年。

youth.en: Youth is simply an attitude of mind.
The music evoked memories of her youth.
youth.zh: 这乐曲勾起了她对青年时代的回忆。

gang.zh: 警方怀疑当地的一个不良帮派。

gang.en: The gang tied up a security guard.
gang.zh: 那群歹徒把一名保安人员捆绑起来。

gang.en: The gang assaulted him with iron bars.
gang.zh: 该团伙用铁棒袭击了他。

teenager.en: He was acting like a lovelorn teenager.
teenager.zh: 他表现的像一个患有相思病的少年。

teenager.en: Clothes are a safe bet as a present for a teenager.
teenager.zh: 衣服适合作为送给十几岁孩子的礼物。

teenager.en: He used to give his mother hell when he was a teenager.
teenager.zh: 他十几岁时常常给他母亲惹麻烦。

kin.en: We have notified the next of kin.
kin.zh: 我们已经通知了直系亲属。

kin.en: Her next of kin have been informed.
kin.zh: 她最近的亲属已得到通知了。

kin.en: Fair and foul are near of kin.

adolescence.en: No one knows for sure why adolescence is unique to humans.
adolescence.zh: 没人确切知道为什么青春期是人类独有的。

adolescence.en: The play is set in the dangerous no-man's land between youth and adolescence.
adolescence.zh: 该剧定位于少年和青春期之间的危险的中间年龄段。

adolescence.en: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
adolescence.zh: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

folk.en: The entertainment was provided by a folk band.
folk.zh: 这个文娱节目由民歌乐队演出。

folk.en: Garlic is widely used in Chinese folk medicine.
folk.zh: 大蒜广泛应用于中国民间医药。

folk.en: He arranged traditional folk songs for the piano.
folk.zh: 他把传统民歌改编成钢琴曲。

relative.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.
She enjoyed the relative informality of island life.
relative.zh: 她喜欢相对轻松随意的岛屿生活。

relative.en: Fitness is relative; one must always ask "Fit for what?"
relative.zh: 适宜是相对的；始终必须问问：“适宜什么？”

intimate.en: He wrote about the intimate details of his family life.
intimate.zh: 他写下了家庭生活中一些私人的细节。

intimate.en: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company.
intimate.zh: 他接着暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次改组。

intimate.en: The cafe has an intimate but buzzy atmosphere.
intimate.zh: 咖啡馆气氛暧昧但又很活泼。

darling.zh: 快点，亲爱的，我们要迟到了。
“亲爱的亨利”，信的开头这样写道。

lover.zh: 我是个户外活动爱好者。

lover.en: She acted out the role of the wronged lover.
lover.zh: 她扮作一个受冤枉的情人。

lover.en: Every Thursday she would meet her lover Leon.
lover.zh: 每个星期四她都去约会她的情人利昂。

beloved.en: It was a gift from her beloved.
beloved.zh: 那是她心爱的人送的礼物。

beloved.en: Strangely enough, the last thing he thought of was his beloved Tanya.
beloved.zh: 真奇怪，他最后想到的是他心爱的坦尼娅。

madam.en: Luncheon will be served at one, Madam.
madam.zh: 夫人，午餐在一点钟开始。

hostess.zh: 女主人正急急忙忙地向他走来。
“鲁比，这是什么？”我的女主人问。

landlady.zh: 女房东不安地轻拍着她的头发。

landlady.en: There was a note under the door from my landlady.
landlady.zh: 门下有我女房东的一张便条。

landlady.en: When my landlady said she wanted to keep $380 of my deposit to paint the walls, I threw a fit.
landlady.zh: 当女房东说她要用我的$380押金来粉刷墙壁时，我大发脾气。

housewife.zh: 我不喜欢“家庭主妇”这个称谓。

housewife.en: Sometimes being a mother and a housewife felt like a thankless task.
housewife.zh: 做母亲和家庭主妇有时使人觉得好像是个受累不讨好的差使。

housewife.en: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
housewife.zh: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

mistress.en: I must go now, for my mistress is waiting.
mistress.zh: 我现在得走了，我的女主人在等着呢。
玛丽小姐觉得完全相反。

mistress.en: Mistress Mary felt her face grow red.
mistress.zh: 玛丽小姐觉得她的脸变红了。

widow.en: She became a widow a year ago.
"You're a widow?"—"Yes. My husband's been dead a year now."
widow.zh: “你是个寡妇？”——“是的，我丈夫去世1年了。”

maid.en: There is a maid to do the housework.
Her maid locked the case in the safe.
maid.zh: 她的女仆把那盒子锁进了保险箱。

maid.en: They had a butler, a cook, and a maid.
maid.zh: 他们有一位管家、一位厨师和一位女仆。

maiden.en: The young man betrothed the neighboring maiden.
maiden.zh: 这名男青年答应娶邻居的少女为妻。

maiden.en: Now there was once a maiden whose name was Jorinda.
maiden.zh: 从前有个姑娘名叫约丽丹。

household.en: She became a household name in the 1960s.
household.zh: 她在20世纪60年代成为家喻户晓的人物。
如今，服装设计师们家喻户晓。

household.en: Many household products give off noxious fumes.
household.zh: 很多家用产品散发有害气体。

chore.zh: 对我来说，购物真是件苦差事。
这是按部就班的乏味的杂务。

chore.en: She sees exercise primarily as an unavoidable chore.
chore.zh: 她把锻炼主要看作是不得不做的琐事。

host.en: Shall I take my host family a gift?
host.zh: 我要不要给主人家带件礼物呢？

host.en: Shall I take a gift to my host family?
host.zh: 我要不要给主人家带件礼物呢？

host.en: Our host shook each of us warmly by the hand.
host.zh: 主人热情地和我们每个人握手。

landlord.zh: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

landlord.en: She has now settled with her landlord.
landlord.zh: 她现在已经和她的房东算清了。

landlord.en: The landlord has put the rent up again.

tenant.en: The decorating was done by a previous tenant.
tenant.zh: 装修是一位前房客搞的。

tenant.en: The rent is a matter for negotiation between the landlord and the tenant.
tenant.zh: 租金可以由房东和租户协商确定。

tenant.en: Under the provisions of the lease, the tenant is responsible for repairs.
tenant.zh: 按契约规定，房客负责房屋维修。

guest.en: She was a guest at the wedding.

customer.zh: 此公司与客户关系极好。

customer.en: They set high standards of customer service.
customer.zh: 他们制订了严格的客户服务标准。

client.en: Do you have a client named Peters?
client.zh: 你们有一位名叫彼得斯的客户吗？

client.en: I have a client with me right now.
He lunched with a client at the Ritz.
client.zh: 他与一位客户在里茨饭店共进了午餐。

chase.en: The movie has a car chase to end all car chases.
chase.zh: 这部影片的汽车追逐场面非常刺激。

chase.en: The thieves were caught by police after a short chase.
chase.zh: 经过短暂追捕，小偷被警察擒获。

chase.en: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
chase.zh: 无论如何，追求总比征服更令人兴奋。

encounter.en: People will encounter their destiny on the path of escaping from it.
encounter.zh: 人会在逃避命运的路上，遇见自己的命运。

encounter.en: Did you encounter anyone in the building?
encounter.zh: 你在那栋大楼里偶然遇到什么人了吗？

encounter.en: In high school, I was very unpopular, and I did encounter a little prejudice.
encounter.zh: 在中学，我很不受欢迎，确实遇到了一点偏见。

appointment.zh: 你下一次预约时间是什么时候？

accompany.en: Ken agreed to accompany me on a trip to Africa.
accompany.zh: 肯同意陪我去非洲旅行。

accompany.en: Barron invited her to accompany him to the races.
accompany.zh: 巴伦邀请了她陪他去看比赛。

accompany.en: Government monitors will continue to accompany reporters.
accompany.zh: 政府监督员们将继续陪同记者们。

engagement.zh: 那是她第一次正式约会。

dependent.en: The area is heavily dependent on tourism.
dependent.zh: 这个地区非常依赖旅游业。

dependent.en: She is still financially dependent on her parents.
dependent.zh: 她在经济上仍然依靠父母。

dependent.en: She had grown ever more peevishly dependent on him.
dependent.zh: 她脾气变得更坏，对他的依赖更重了。

propose.en: What do you propose to do now?

honeymoon.en: We went to Venice for our honeymoon.
honeymoon.zh: 我们去威尼斯度的蜜月。

honeymoon.en: They've fixed on Paris for their honeymoon.
honeymoon.zh: 他们已选定在巴黎度蜜月。

wedding.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。

kiss.en: He gave her a brief, brotherly kiss.
kiss.zh: 他给了她短促、兄弟般的一吻。
玛丽亚给了他一个飞吻。

divorce.zh: 这桩离婚案没有人提出异议。

single.en: How much is a single to York?
single.zh: 去约克的单程票多少钱？
这支单曲名为《白色之恋》。

separate.zh: 这事在三个不同的场合发生过。

separate.en: Men and women have separate exercise rooms.
separate.zh: 男士和女士有分开的健身房。

separate.en: Police moved in to separate the two groups.
separate.zh: 警察插进来分开了那两群人。

sole.zh: 她唯一的目的就是扩大个人权势。

sole.en: My sole reason for coming here was to see you.
sole.zh: 我到这儿唯一的原因就是来看你。

sole.en: The shoe's sole had a slightly textured surface.
sole.zh: 鞋底表面有较浅的纹理。

respective.en: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
respective.zh: 我们寻求各自利益共同点是重要的。

respective.en: The happy couple and their respective parents took to the floor.
respective.zh: 那幸福的一对和他们各自的父母开始跳起舞来。

respective.en: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields.
respective.zh: 他们在各自的领域都被视为专家。

each.zh: 他清楚地说出了每个音节。

commuter.en: She accidentally stepped on his foot on a crowded commuter train.
commuter.zh: 她在一辆拥挤的通勤火车上不小心踩到他的脚。

commuter.en: Commuter airlines fly to out-of-the-way places. And business travellers are the ones who go to those locations.
commuter.zh: 通勤航空公司飞往偏僻的地方。此外，商务旅客就是去那些地方的人。

commuter.en: Commuter diatoms, for example, emerge only during those low tides that occur during the day.
commuter.zh: 例如，往返于通勤硅藻只在白天出现低潮时出现。

neighborhood.zh: 这个社区就是你的村庄。

neighborhood.en: She was called the Lark in the neighborhood.
neighborhood.zh: 她在附近被称为百灵鸟。

individual.en: Some individual investors exulted at the record.
individual.zh: 一些个人投资者为这一记录欢欣鼓舞。

individual.en: It's impossible to hold any individual responsible.
individual.zh: 不可能让任何个人承担责任。

member.en: She is a life member of the club.
member.zh: 她是这个俱乐部的终身会员。

member.en: He's a member of several London clubs.
member.zh: 他是伦敦几个男性俱乐部的会员。

member.en: How much does it cost to become a member?
member.zh: 要成为会员得花多少钱？

boss.en: I'll hand you over to my boss.

boss.zh: 她对老板总是谄媚奉承。

supervisor.en: I have a meeting with my supervisor about my research topic.
supervisor.zh: 我要就我的研究课题同导师见一次面。

supervisor.en: We wanted to be here early in case the whatsit, maintenance supervisor had forgotten to deal with it.
supervisor.zh: 我们想早点儿到这儿，以防那个什么维修主管忘了处理这个事儿。

manager.en: I wish to speak to the manager.

comrade.en: Better be careful of your bookish approach, comrade.
Most of the goats ran away from their rough comrade.
comrade.zh: 大多数山羊都从它们粗暴的伙伴身边跑开了。

comrade.en: We can't remain indifferent when any comrade is in difficulty.
comrade.zh: 同志们有困难我们不能不闻不问。

subordinate.en: Sixty of his subordinate officers followed his example.
subordinate.zh: 他的60个下级官员都以他为榜样。

subordinate.en: He was both willing and able to subordinate all else to this aim.
subordinate.zh: 他既愿意也能够让别的一切从属于这个目标。

subordinate.en: He contented himself with a subordinate job.

partner.en: Gerry offered to partner me at tennis.
partner.zh: 格里提出和我搭档打网球。

partner.en: He did not dally over the choice of a partner.
partner.zh: 他没有在选择合伙人上面磨磨蹭蹭。

partner.en: He is now co-partner in a new property company.
partner.zh: 他现在是一家新房地产公司的合伙人。

colleague.en: They rated him highly as a colleague.
colleague.zh: 作为同事，他们对他评价甚高。

colleague.en: He grimaced and looked narrowly at his colleague.
colleague.zh: 他做了个鬼脸，然后仔细地看着同事。

colleague.en: "She's badly in need of some TLC," said one colleague.
colleague.zh: “她迫切需要一些温暖的关怀，”一位同事说。

friendship.zh: 友谊是一种相互的关系。
他们的友谊发展成了爱情。

acquaintance.en: I am delighted to make your acquaintance, Mrs Baker.
acquaintance.zh: 贝克太太，我很高兴与您相识。

acquaintance.en: I made the acquaintance of several musicians around that time.
acquaintance.zh: 大约在那段时间，我结识了几位音乐家。

acquaintance.en: Hammer's business pedigree almost guaranteed him the acquaintance of presidents.
acquaintance.zh: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他与几位总统的相识。

affection.en: I still have affection for my old school.
affection.zh: 我对母校依然很有感情。

affection.en: She still speaks about him with great affection.
affection.zh: 说起他来她依旧一往情深。

stranger.zh: 她等于是嫁了个陌生人。

stranger.en: I don't know him—he's a perfect stranger.
stranger.zh: 我不认识他，他是百分之百的陌生人。

stranger.en: He stared in astonishment at the stranger.

apprentice.en: Bailly encouraged his young apprentice to learn to read and write.
apprentice.zh: 贝利鼓励他的年轻徒弟去学习阅读和写作。

apprentice.en: By age 15, he had become an apprentice to Sylvain Bailly, a well-known dessert chef with a successful bakery in one of Paris' most fashionable neighborhoods.
apprentice.zh: 从15岁开始，他就成为了西尔文·贝利的学徒。西尔文·贝利是一位著名的甜点师，在巴黎最时尚的街区之一经营着一家成功的面包店。

apprentice.en: By age 15, he had become an apprentice to Sylvain Bailly, a well-known dessert chef with a successful bakery in one of Paris's most fashionable neighborhoods.
apprentice.zh: 从15岁开始，他就成为了西尔文·贝利的学徒。西尔文贝利是一位著名的甜点厨师，在巴黎最时尚的街区之一有一家成功的面包店。

deputy.zh: 她委任了谁为她的副手？

deputy.en: His brother was acting as his deputy in America.
deputy.zh: 他的兄弟充当他在美洲的代理人。

deputy.en: By convention the deputy leader was always a woman.
deputy.zh: 按惯例，这一领导职务的副职总是由女性担任。

heroine.en: The heroine is played by Demi Moore.
heroine.zh: 女主角由黛米•摩尔扮演。

heroine.en: The heroine made her exit to great applause.
heroine.zh: 女主角在热烈的掌声中退场。

heroine.en: She was well fitted to the role of tragic heroine.
heroine.zh: 她很适合演悲剧女主角。

hero.en: He called Mr. Mandela a hero who had inspired millions.
hero.zh: 他称曼德拉先生是一个曾激励千百万人的英雄。

actress.en: Her vocation is her work as an actress.
actress.zh: 她适合的职业就是当演员。
她自以为是严肃的演员。

actress.en: Jane is determined to stake her claim as an actress.
actress.zh: 简决心提出她作为一名女演员的应有权利。

chancellor.en: By the time I was vice chancellor, the Senate had become a much larger and a much more democratic body.
chancellor.zh: 到我做副校长的那个时候，大学评议会已经成为一个更大、更民主的机构了。

chancellor.en: The trembling Chancellor answered, "Good your Majesty, I cry you mercy!"
chancellor.zh: 吓得发抖的大法官回答说：“陛下圣明，我求您发发慈悲！”

chancellor.en: Andrew Hamilton, Oxford's vice-chancellor, said: "the school represents a huge milestone in oxford's history."
chancellor.zh: 牛津大学副校长安德鲁·汉密尔顿表示：“这所学校是牛津历史上的一座巨大里程碑。“

commander.en: The commander had been forewarned of the attack.
commander.zh: 指挥官预先得到敌人要发动袭击的警告。

commander.en: The commander and some of the men had been released.
commander.zh: 指挥官和一些士兵已被释放。

commander.en: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
commander.zh: 指挥官说过部队会遵从停火协议。

director.en: The director has the most to lose.
She has only the director over her.
director.zh: 她的上司只有主任一个。

director.en: We could write a letter to the director.
director.zh: 我们不妨给主管写封信。

proponent.en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
proponent.zh: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的首要支持者。

proponent.en: The most influential proponent of the coastal migration route has been Canadian archaeologist Knut Fladmark.
proponent.zh: 沿海移民路线最具影响力的支持者是加拿大考古学家克努特·弗拉德马克。

proponent.en: In 1938, at the government-convened National Health Conference, organized labor emerged as a major proponent of legislation to guarantee universal health care in the United States.
proponent.zh: 1938年，在政府召开的全国卫生会议上，有组织的劳工成为立法的主要支持者，以保证美国的全民医疗保健。

committee.zh: 委员会两星期开一次会。

council.zh: 林木委员会倡导植树造林。

council.en: The Council answered those questions in the negative.
council.zh: 理事会对那些问题做出了否定回答。

delegate.zh: 那位加拿大代表没给答复。

delegate.en: Some managers find it difficult to delegate.
delegate.zh: 有些经理认为难以做到知人善任。

delegate.en: Horton's Achilles heel was that he could not delegate.
delegate.zh: 霍顿的致命弱点是他不肯放权。

specialist.en: My doctor referred me to a specialist.
specialist.zh: 我的医生让我去找一位专家诊治。

specialist.en: A specialist has now pronounced him fully fit.
specialist.zh: 一位专家已宣布他完全康复了。

specialist.en: Each specialist has a team of doctors under him or her.
specialist.zh: 每位专家手下都有一组医生。

consultant.en: She is a consultant to the government.
He is currently engaged as a consultant.
He was a consultant rheumatologist at the local hospital.
consultant.zh: 他是当地医院的一位风湿病学顾问。

counselor.en: Listen to a conversation between a student and a counselor at the University Counseling Center.
counselor.zh: 请听一段学生和大学咨询中心辅导员之间的对话。

counselor.en: The ability to relate well with their student is something a counselor should possess, not a teacher.
counselor.zh: 与学生相处融洽的能力是辅导员应该具备的，而不是老师。

counselor.en: The ability to relate well with their students is something a counselor should possess, not a teacher.
counselor.zh: 与学生融洽相处的能力是辅导员应该具备的，而不是老师。

veterinary.en: Students should have prior experience of veterinary practice.
veterinary.zh: 学生应有兽医工作的经验。

veterinary.en: It was decided that our veterinary screening of horses at events should be continued.
veterinary.zh: 已经决定，我们对参赛马匹的疾病检查将继续进行。

veterinary.en: In Sweden, they say, 'Let's call the veterinary authorities.
veterinary.zh: 在瑞典，他们会说，'让我们叫兽医来。'

solicitor.zh: 律师保存着我们的遗嘱。

solicitor.en: My solicitor is no longer in practice.
solicitor.zh: 我的律师已不再执业了。

solicitor.en: He has always been the family solicitor.
solicitor.zh: 他一直是这个家的律师。

attorney.en: He needed to consult with an attorney.
The new district attorney has promised to fight police corruption.
attorney.zh: 新上任的地方检察官承诺要与司法腐败作斗争。

attorney.en: The attorney may present evidence as well as witnesses.
attorney.zh: 律师可以出示证据，也可以提请证人作证。

cashier.zh: 那个收银员态度不太友善。

umpire.en: He was the only National League umpire to wear an outside chest protector.
umpire.zh: 他是惟一穿着外层护胸的全国联盟裁判。

umpire.en: I still play football here, and sometimes I umpire here, so it's a great park.
umpire.zh: 我仍然在这儿踢球，而且有时候在这儿当裁判，所以这是个很棒的公园。

fireman.zh: 马克的父亲是一名消防员。
不久，一名消防员出现了。

nurse.zh: 护士给他洗了脸，刮了胡子。

nurse.en: She had spent 29 years as a nurse.

gardener.zh: 我的妻子是个热衷园艺的人。

gardener.en: She herself was not a keen gardener.
gardener.zh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

haircut.zh: 啧啧，这个头发剪得很漂亮！

haircut.en: What do you think of my new haircut?
haircut.zh: 你觉得我的新发型怎么样？

barber.en: My father marched me over to Otto, the local barber, to have my hair cut short.
barber.zh: 爸爸把我拽到当地理发师奥托跟前，让他把我的头发剪短。

fisherman.en: The fisherman rowed us back to the shore.
fisherman.zh: 渔夫划船将我们送回到岸上。

fisherman.en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
fisherman.zh: 斯派罗斯·拉齐斯最初的职业是爱琴海的一名地位低微的渔夫。

fisherman.en: With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef.
fisherman.zh: 渔夫艰难地驾着小船靠近了礁石。

butcher.en: Look on the label or ask your butcher.
butcher.zh: 看看标签或询问你的屠夫。

butcher.en: It's about music, which is too good for the butcher.
butcher.zh: 这是关于音乐的，对屠夫来说已经太好了。

hostage.en: There was none of the drama and relief of a hostage release.
hostage.zh: 丝毫没有人质释放的戏剧性场面和放松。

hostage.en: He must be treated as a hostage of high rank, not as a common prisoner.
hostage.zh: 他一定要作为一个高级人质而不是一般囚徒来对待。

hostage.en: He momentarily confounded his critics by his cool handling of the hostage crisis.
hostage.zh: 他通过冷静处理人质危机顿时使他的批评者们大吃一惊。

groom.en: Guests toasted the bride and groom with champagne.
groom.zh: 客人们以香槟为新娘新郎敬酒。

groom.en: I'd like to propose a toast to the bride and groom.
groom.zh: 我提议为新郎新娘的幸福干杯！

groom.en: The head groom is responsible for seeing that Milton and his stablemates travel safely.
groom.zh: 该马夫长负责确保密尔顿及其他来自同一养马场的赛马都能安全抵达。

toil.en: I have nothing to offer but blood, toil, tears and sweat.
toil.zh: 我所能奉献的只有热血、辛劳、眼泪与汗水。

toil.en: The finite which admits of progress and sublime toil, they do not think about.
toil.zh: 他们没有想到承认进步和高贵的辛劳这一有限之物。

beggar.en: He tossed a penny to the beggar.
A beggar came up to us and ask for money.
beggar.zh: 一个乞丐走过来向我们要钱。

beggar.en: The soldier said, "Mind thy manners, thou young beggar!"
beggar.zh: 士兵说：“注意你的举止，你这个小乞丐！”

slave.en: Huge palaces were built by slave labour.
slave.zh: 宏伟的宫殿是奴隶建成的。

slave.en: She was born a slave and remained a slave for nearly thirty years.
slave.zh: 她生下来就是奴隶，并且当了将近30年的奴隶。

coward.en: You coward! What are you afraid of?
coward.zh: 你这胆小鬼！你怕什么呢？
“胆小鬼！”内心一个小声音坚持说。

coward.en: By attacking me, by attacking my wife, he has proved himself to be a gutless coward.
coward.zh: 通过袭击我，袭击我妻子，他已经证明了自己是一个胆小的懦夫。

act.zh: 你必须表现得大胆、自信。

act.en: This was a fiendish act of wickedness.
act.zh: 这是一种残忍邪恶的行为。

behave.zh: 男孩儿和女孩儿的表现可能不同。

behave.en: Children must learn to behave at table.
behave.zh: 小孩必须学会吃饭时的规矩。

accustom.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
accustom.zh: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

accustom.en: It took him a while to accustom himself to the idea.
accustom.zh: 他过了一段时间才习惯这个想法。

accustom.en: When one has been in a family circle one cannot accustom oneself to this life!
accustom.zh: 当一个人已经在家庭圈子里，他无法习惯于这种生活！

deed.en: He is all talk and no deed.
My grandmother says a good deed is its own reward.
deed.zh: 我的奶奶说，做好事本身就是一种回报。

deed.en: Smith changed his name by deed poll to Jervis-Smith.
deed.zh: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯—史密斯。

adopt.en: In no way am I going to adopt any of his methods.
adopt.zh: 我决不会采用他的任何一个方法。

adopt.en: There is little or no incentive to adopt such measures.
adopt.zh: 几乎或根本没有鼓励来采取这样的措施。

adopt.en: There are hundreds of people desperate to adopt a child.
adopt.zh: 有数以百计的人极其渴望收养小孩。

react.zh: 他们会凶猛地作出反应。

react.en: I nudged her but she didn't react.
react.zh: 我用胳膊肘捅了她一下，可她没有反应。
很难说他会有何种反应。

respond.en: I asked him his name, but he didn't respond.
respond.zh: 我问他叫什么名字，可他没回答。

respond.en: The directors were unwilling to respond to questions.
respond.zh: 董事们不愿意回答问题。

respond.en: Some children respond more demonstratively than others.
respond.zh: 一些孩子的反应比其他孩子的更感性。

reflect.en: We should all give ourselves time to reflect.
reflect.zh: 我们都应该给自己时间来深思。

reflect.en: The third-quarter results reflect continued improvements in productivity.
reflect.zh: 第三季度的结果反映了生产率的持续提高。

reflect.en: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
reflect.zh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

nourish.en: As Tony says, "Depression strips you of any desire to nourish yourself, in any form."
nourish.zh: 正如托尼所说，“抑郁会以任何形式剥夺任何滋养你的欲望。”

nourish.en: Warm porridge could help increase one's personal heat and nourish the body in cold weather.
nourish.zh: 在寒冷的天气里，温热的粥可以暖和身子，滋养身体。

nourish.en: By investing in education, we nourish the talents of our children.
nourish.zh: 我们通过教育投资，培养孩子们的才能。

mow.en: Ten men went to mow a meadow.
I mow the lawn every week in summer.
mow.zh: 夏天我每周都要修剪草坪。

exhale.en: As the lungs exhale this waste, gas is expelled into the atmosphere.
exhale.zh: 当肺呼出这股废气，气体就被排到空气中。

exhale.en: Generally, you exhale on the effort, if doing weights, karate or boxing, and inhale on the return.
exhale.zh: 一般来说，如果你在做举重、空手道或拳击等运动用力时，你会呼气，然后吸气。

exhale.en: Without gravity to help circulate air, the carbon dioxide you exhale has a tendency to form an invisible cloud around your head.
exhale.zh: 如果没有重力帮助空气循环，你呼出的二氧化碳会在你头顶周围形成一个看不见的云状物。

support.zh: 我们向他保证给予支持。
我们免费提供技术支持。

revive.zh: 护理人员无法使她苏醒。

revive.en: Their efforts to revive him were futile.
revive.zh: 他们努力使他苏醒，但失败了。

intake.en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
intake.zh: 你每天酒精摄入量不能超过两个单位。

intake.en: Salt intake may lead to raised blood pressure in susceptible adults.
intake.zh: 盐的摄入可能导致易病的成年人血压升高。

intake.en: Nutritionists say only 33 percent of our calorie intake should be from fat.
intake.zh: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33%来自脂肪。

survive.zh: 大多数女性比她们的配偶活得长。

survive.en: He needs that amount of money to survive.
survive.zh: 他需要那笔钱来维持生活。

survive.en: Somehow the language endures and continues to survive.
survive.zh: 由于某种原因，这种语言持续生存下来了。

glare.en: I shielded my eyes against the glare.
glare.zh: 我挡住眼睛以避开强光。
他的眼镜使他怒视的目光显得更凶了。

glimpse.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
glimpse.zh: 他一眼瞥见她在人群里。

glimpse.en: Below us you could glimpse the rooftops of a few small villages.
glimpse.zh: 在我们下面，你能瞥见一些小村庄的屋顶。

glimpse.en: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
glimpse.zh: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

gaze.zh: 她用目光缓缓扫视了一下室内。
我的双眼迎视他冰冷的目光。

glance.zh: 特雷弗和我相互瞥了一眼。

peep.en: Children came to peep at him around the doorway.
peep.zh: 孩子们来到门口偷看他。

peep.en: They crept to the door and took a trembling peep.
peep.zh: 他们蹑手蹑脚地走到门口，哆哆嗦嗦地偷看了一眼。

peer.en: She gets on well with her peer group.
Teenagers may find it difficult to resist peer pressure.
peer.zh: 青少年可能觉得很难抗拒同龄人的压力。

peer.en: Climbing steep stairs to the choir gallery you peer into a cavernous interior.
peer.zh: 登上陡峭的楼梯来到唱诗班楼座，你便可窥见如洞穴般空旷的内部。

vow.en: While many models vow to go back to college, few do.
vow.zh: 很多模特儿发誓要重返大学，但几乎无人做到。

vow.en: I made a silent vow to be more careful in the future.
vow.zh: 我默默发誓今后要更加小心。

vow.en: In the classic marriage vow, couples promise to stay together in sickness and in health.
vow.zh: 在经典的婚姻誓言中，夫妻承诺无论生病还是健康都要在一起。

contemplate.en: The thought of war is too awful to contemplate.
contemplate.zh: 战争太可怕了，真不敢去想。

contemplate.en: I can't contemplate what it would be like to be alone.
contemplate.zh: 我不能想象独自一人会是个什么样子。
