contemplate.en: They contemplate trouble in obtaining hotel reservation.
contemplate.zh: 他们考虑到预订旅馆有困难。

stare.en: He fixed her with an angry stare.

stare.zh: 不要盯着我 - 这很无礼！

stare.en: Hlasek gave him a long, cold stare.
stare.zh: 赫拉塞克冷冷地盯着他看了很久。

oath.en: He took an oath of loyalty to the government.
oath.zh: 他做了效忠于政府的宣誓。

oath.en: I have sworn an oath of loyalty to the monarchy.
oath.zh: 我已经发誓效忠君主制。

oath.en: Under oath, Andy finally admitted that he had lied.
oath.zh: 宣誓之后，安迪终于承认他曾撒了谎。

whistle.en: On the platform, the guard blew his whistle.
whistle.zh: 站台上，警卫吹响了他的哨子。

pledge.en: In the treaty both sides pledge to respect human rights.
pledge.zh: 双方在条约中都许诺尊重人权。

pledge.en: He asked her to pledge the house as security for a loan.
pledge.zh: 他要她抵押房子作为贷款担保。

pledge.en: The government had retreated from its pledge to reduce class sizes.
pledge.zh: 政府已经改变了缩小班级规模的承诺。

reply.zh: 他们得到一个否定的答复。
她的回答不宜被印刷出来。

notify.en: Please notify us if the above is not correct.
notify.zh: 如果上面所说的不正确，请通知我们。

notify.en: The only course of action left to me was to notify her employer.
notify.zh: 我可能采取的唯一措施就是通知她的雇主。

notify.en: We may vary the limit at our discretion and will notify you of any change.
notify.zh: 我们可酌情决定更改限制，并会将任何变更通知你。

assert.en: I was determined to assert my authority from the beginning.
assert.zh: 我决心一开始就维护我的权威。

assert.en: Mergers and acquisitions remain common, and bidders continue to assert that their objectives are economic ones.
assert.zh: 兼并和收购仍然很常见，而且竞标者继续声称他们的目标是经济目标。

dispute.en: She played a key role in the dispute.
dispute.zh: 她在争论中起着举足轻重的作用。

dispute.en: The town is in uproar over the dispute.
dispute.zh: 该城对此争端一片哗然。

dispute.en: They supported their sisters in the dispute.
dispute.zh: 在争论中，她们支持自己的姐妹。

quarrel.en: He did not mention the quarrel with his wife.
quarrel.zh: 他没有提起和妻子的争吵。

quarrel.en: My sister and I used to quarrel all the time.
quarrel.zh: 我和妹妹过去老是吵架。

explain.zh: 解释一下你为什么不打电话。
你能再解释一下那一点吗？

hasten.en: But if he does this, he may hasten the collapse of his own country.
hasten.zh: 但是如果他这样做，他也许就会加速自己国家的灭亡。

hasten.en: There is no point whatsoever in carefully placing our valuable artifacts in paper or card that is going to hasten their demise.
hasten.zh: 小心地把我们珍贵的文物放在纸上或卡片上，这样做毫无意义，这会加速它们的灭亡。

hasten.en: There is no point whatsoever in carefully placing our valuable artifacts in paper or cards that is going to hasten their demise.
hasten.zh: 小心地把我们珍贵的文物放在纸上或卡片上的这种做法毫无意义，只会加速它们的灭亡。

mention.en: He made no mention of her work.

mention.zh: 对不起，我再也不提它了。

mention.en: I mention it only as an aside...

argument.zh: 这是一个很有诱惑力的论点。
他们的主要论点是荒谬的。

hurry.en: Hurry up or else you'll be late.
hurry.zh: 快点，否则你就要迟到了。

urge.en: He denounces people who urge him to alter his ways.
urge.zh: 他指责那些敦促他改变习惯的人们。

urge.en: He continued to urge the Republican Party to tilt rightward.
urge.zh: 他继续力劝共和党右倾。

urge.en: The urge to survive drove them on.
urge.zh: 求生的欲望驱使他们继续下去。

scold.en: If he finds out, he'll scold me.
scold.zh: 如果他发现了，他会责骂我。

curse.en: He muttered a curse at the other driver.
curse.zh: 他低声咒骂另一位开车的人。

curse.en: They see their failure to produce an heir as a curse from God.
curse.zh: 他们将自己未能生育一个后嗣看作是来自上帝的一个诅咒。
他们咒骂我并大喊大叫。

swear.en: I, Long Aotian, swear to protect Liu Bo'er with my life!
swear.zh: 我龙傲天要誓死守护刘波儿！
swear.source: 《一年一度喜剧大赛》少爷和我

swear.en: I swear I've told you all I know.
swear.zh: 我发誓我已经把我所知道的都告诉你了。
我以全能上帝之名发誓…

preach.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to preach.
preach.zh: 很抱歉，我并没有说教的意思。

preach.en: He said he was trying to preach peace and tolerance to his people.
preach.zh: 他说他正试图向他的人民宣扬和平与宽容。

provoke.en: His duty was to conciliate the people, not to provoke them.
provoke.zh: 他的任务是安抚这些人，而不是激怒他们。

provoke.en: Premature moves in this respect might well provoke a reaction against the reform.
provoke.zh: 在这方面过早的行动可能会激起对改革的抵触。

provoke.en: They accused both radicals and conservatives of trying to provoke a split in the party.
provoke.zh: 他们指责激进人士和保守人士都企图挑起党内分歧。

tease.en: It's one thing to tease your sister, but it's another to hit her.
tease.zh: 逗你妹妹玩是一回事，但打她那就另当别论了。
他们取笑它；肥皂泡破了！

tease.en: Other children often tease him because of his long hair.
tease.zh: 因为他的长头发，其他孩子经常取笑他。

boast.en: All three Internet agencies boast they've won major accounts.
boast.zh: 所有的三家网络代理公司都夸口说他们已赢得了大客户。

boast.en: I don't want to boast, but I can actually speak six languages.
boast.zh: 不是我吹嘘，我确实能讲六种语言。

boast.en: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
boast.zh: 该制片厂吹嘘，它在鼎盛时期拥有的明星比天上的星星还多。

mock.en: You can mock, but at least I'm willing to have a try!
mock.zh: 你可以嘲笑我，但我至少愿意试一试。

mock.en: What did you get in the mock?
mock.zh: 你的模拟考试得了多少分？
他沉下脸来，装出一副严厉的样子。

hug.en: She gave her mother a big hug.
hug.zh: 她热烈地拥抱了她的母亲。

hug.en: She opened her arms and gave me a big hug.
hug.zh: 她张开双臂，紧紧地拥抱了我。

hug.en: She leapt out of the back seat, and gave him a hug.
hug.zh: 她从后座上跳了出来，给了他一个拥抱。

applaud.en: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
applaud.zh: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓起掌来。

applaud.en: The analysts applaud the cuts in marginal businesses, but insist the company must make deeper sacrifices.
applaud.zh: 分析家们赞同对边际业务的削减，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。

kneel.en: Don't bend or kneel next to fireworks once you light them.
kneel.zh: 点燃烟花时不要弯腰或跪在烟花旁。

kneel.en: It seemed as though he dared not kneel directly before God.
kneel.zh: 他似乎不敢直接向上帝下跪。

kneel.en: You can squat rather than kneel to lift an object from the floor.
kneel.zh: 你可以蹲着而不是跪着把一个物体从地板上抬起来。

snatch.en: He is puzzled, rather than vengeful when other children snatch things from him or push him around.
snatch.zh: 当其他孩子从他手里抢东西或把他推来推去时，他感到困惑，而不是报复。

snatch.en: I managed to snatch an hour's sleep.
snatch.zh: 我偷空儿睡了一小时的觉。

catch.en: You'll be sorry if I catch you!
catch.zh: 要是让我抓着，你会后悔的！

catch.en: We can catch the early morning train.
catch.zh: 我们能赶上清晨的那班火车。
你能引起服务员的注意吗？

grab.en: He shot out his hand to grab her.

grasp.zh: 她挣脱了他紧紧抓着她的手。

grasp.en: The bag was wrenched from her grasp.
grasp.zh: 那只包从她紧握的手里被夺了出来。

overtake.en: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
overtake.zh: 在弯道强行超车是危险的。

overtake.en: Coming out of the final bend, the runner stepped up a gear to overtake the rest of the pack.
overtake.zh: 赛跑者绕过最后一个弯道后开始加速，以图超越同组的其他选手。

overtake.en: Come, waste not the time—cannot I overtake him?
overtake.zh: 来吧，别浪费时间——我追不上他吗？

follow.zh: 对不起，我不太听懂你的话。

grip.en: He kept a tight grip on her arm.
She tightened her grip on his arm.
grip.zh: 她抓他的手臂抓得更紧了。

grip.en: Grip the rope as tightly as you can.

twist.zh: 你总是歪曲我说的每一句话。

twist.en: She gave the lid another twist and it came off.
twist.zh: 她又拧了一下，盖儿开了。

scatter.en: A transparent object doesn't absorb or scatter light.
scatter.zh: 透明物体不吸收或散射光。

scatter.en: It's not extensive in the sense that you just have to scatter your stuff over wide fields; that's not what it is.
scatter.zh: 它不是广泛的，从这个角度说，不是你只要在宽广的土地上散播你的东西就够了；它并非是这样。

fold.zh: 你最好仔细地折叠好它。

fasten.en: There were no instructions on how to fasten the carrying strap to the box.
fasten.zh: 没有如何把背带系在箱子上的说明。

fasten.en: When Ted was six we decided that he needed to know how to fasten and unfasten his seat belt.
fasten.zh: 泰德六岁时，我们决定让他知道怎样系和解他的安全带。

loosen.en: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body.
He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck.
loosen.zh: 他伸出手松开围在脖子上的围巾。

loosen.en: Many business groups have been pressing the Federal Reserve to loosen interest rates.
loosen.zh: 许多商业团体一直在施加压力要求联邦储备局放宽利率。

smash.en: They did not need to smash paint and canvas; they went beyond this to smash the whole continuity of logical thought.
smash.zh: 他们不需要打碎颜料和画布；他们超越了这一点，打碎了整个逻辑思维的连续性。

smash.en: We had to smash the door open.
smash.zh: 我们只得用力把门撞开。

smash.en: Her new series is a smash hit.
smash.zh: 她的新系列节目极为成功，引起轰动。

scratch.en: Scratch my back – I've got an itch.
His work simply isn't up to scratch.
scratch.zh: 他的工作根本达不到要求。

wipe.en: I tried to wipe the whole episode from my mind.
wipe.zh: 我设法把这整个经历从心中抹掉。

wipe.en: You can never wipe out the past.
wipe.zh: 你永远不能把过去一笔勾销。

scrape.en: I might scrape through the exam if I'm lucky.
scrape.zh: 要是走运的话，我也许能勉强及格。

scrape.en: We managed to scrape together eight volunteers.

sway.zh: 更糟糕的是，它开始晃动。

sway.zh: 她牵着另一匹马，一匹摇摇晃晃的老母马 。

sway.zh: 玛丽，我们要不要前后晃来晃去，就好像我们是托钵僧似的？

vibrate.en: The ground shook and the cliffs seemed to vibrate.
vibrate.zh: 大地摇晃，那些悬崖似乎在颤动。

vibrate.en: It's important to tighten up the wheels properly, otherwise they vibrate loose and fall off.
vibrate.zh: 把车轮拧紧很重要，否则它们会振动而松脱。

vibrate.zh: 它们当中的一些很有能量，足以让水震动。

whirl.en: To free electrons, something has to make them whirl fast enough to break away from their nuclei.
whirl.zh: 为了释放电子，必须使电子高速旋转而足以摆脱它们的原子核。

whirl.zh: 我学会了不应拆散这些有着狂暴精力的生物，他们爆发出的精力源于天空，他们的欲念亦回旋于九霄之上。

whirl.zh: 行星被认为是由围绕恒星旋转的气体和尘埃组成的圆盘中的粒子累积而成。

rotate.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
rotate.zh: 随着低沉的隆隆声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

rotate.zh: 直升机的螺旋桨开始转动时，尽量离远点儿。

shuffle.en: You have to shuffle the cards before the cut for the deal.
shuffle.zh: 你得先洗牌，然后再倒牌和发牌。

shuffle.zh: 如果你洗牌的次数足够多，顺序就会重复。

shuffle.zh: 纯粹主义者说房价的进一步下跌只会围绕财富重新洗牌。

contact.en: He tends to avoid all physical contact.
contact.zh: 他倾向于避免一切身体接触。

combine.zh: 此次旅行将把出差和娱乐结合起来。

combine.zh: 联合收割机把庄稼绕田边割了一长条。

integrate.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
integrate.zh: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

integrate.en: They have not made any effort to integrate with the local community.
integrate.zh: 他们完全没有尝试融入本地社区。

integrate.zh: 策略就是整合这些城市的发展，以便形成更好的经济结构。

penetrate.en: Air cannot penetrate between the soil particles, making the soil oxygen-poor.
penetrate.zh: 空气不能穿透土壤颗粒，这使得土壤中缺少氧气。

penetrate.en: Our eyes could not penetrate the darkness.
penetrate.zh: 我们的眼睛在黑暗中什么也看不见。

pierce.zh: 他们未能突破利物浦队的防线。

pierce.zh: 轻轻的敲门声打断了他，萨莉•皮尔斯进来了。

insert.en: Open any of the layout templates, insert your text, make any other changes, and print.
insert.zh: 打开任何一个设计模板，插入你的文本，做任何其他改动，然后打印。

tow.zh: 他们威胁说要拖走我的车。

tow.zh: 他一直用那辆车来拖他的活动工作室。

tow.zh: 汽车抛锚了，我们只得让人拖走。

arrange.en: Can I arrange an appointment for Monday?
arrange.zh: 我可以安排星期一约见吗？

arrange.en: I will arrange for someone to take you around.
arrange.zh: 我会安排好人领你转转。

manipulate.en: The technology uses a pen to manipulate a computer.
manipulate.zh: 这项技术使用笔来操作计算机。

manipulate.en: Scientists would soon be able to manipulate human genes to control the aging process.
manipulate.zh: 科学家将很快能够通过操控人类基因来控制衰老的过程。

manipulate.zh: 在我看来，这是试图操纵人们照顾自己的又一个例子。

trail.en: The trail starts just outside the town.
trail.zh: 足迹从刚出城的地方开始。

trail.zh: 他正沿着一条崎岖小路穿过树林。

trail.zh: 一只小棕鹿在他们面前蹦跳着穿过了小路。

steer.zh: 驾驶这样大小的船会怎么样呢？

baptize.en: A third way is to use beneath baptize of agronomics.

bet.en: I'll bet they have yummy ice cream.

bet.zh: 我敢打赌，他们不会出席。

bet.en: What's he like? I bet he's really dreamy.
bet.zh: 他长得如何？我敢说他一定很俊。

stake.en: Joan of Arc was burnt at the stake.

stake.zh: 通用汽车公司以大约4亿美元获得了萨博50%的股份。

gamble.zh: 拿孩子们的未来冒险是错误的。

gamble.en: Few firms will be willing to gamble on new products.
gamble.zh: 很少有公司愿意在新产品上冒险。

obsess.zh: 为了成功地做到这一点，他们的大脑会促使他们去思考，甚至为他人着迷。

obsess.en: I think no matter what diets we follow or what slimming products we obsess ourselves with, at the end of the day there's no magic trick to shape up for the summer.
obsess.zh: 我认为，无论我们遵循什么样的饮食习惯或沉迷于什么样的减肥产品，到最后，并没有什么神奇方法可以让我们在夏天到来的时候塑形。
这项工程似乎令他着迷。

attract.en: She tried to attract the waiter's attention.
attract.zh: 她试图引起服务员的注意。

attract.zh: 我们如何才能吸引更多人访问我们的网站呢？

attract.zh: 她轻轻地咳了一声以引起我的注意。

mesmerize.en: I can feel that you mesmerize my heart.
mesmerize.zh: 我能感受到你在蛊惑我的心智。

mesmerize.zh: 他不需要虚张声势给观众催眠。

mesmerize.zh: 凭你的修养态度，你能记住所有遇到的人。

nightmare.zh: 他粗鲁的风趣和刻薄的评论是采访者的噩梦。

nightmare.en: They began to recover slowly from their nightmare of pain and suffering.
nightmare.zh: 他们开始从痛苦的噩梦中慢慢恢复过来。

amaze.en: It never ceases to amaze me what some people will do for money.
amaze.zh: 有些人为了钱什么都干得出来，这一直使我惊愕不已。

astonish.zh: Thunderstruck 这个词在 astonish 之后大约100年才出现在英语当中。

terrify.zh: 他们在整个地区的行动意在恐吓地主们放弃其财产。

impede.zh: 我从未试图妨碍任何调查的努力。
一个人不应该妨碍他人进步。

impede.en: There is a "risk of strangulation" if metal fasteners impede the flow of sap.
impede.zh: 如果金属固件阻碍了树液的流动，将会有“窒息”的风险。

bait.en: A trap was laid, with fresh bait.
bait.zh: 陷阱设置好，还投放了新诱饵。

bait.en: This type of trap uses no bait or other attractant.
bait.zh: 这种陷阱不用诱饵或其他引诱物。

induce.en: Nothing would induce me to take the job.
induce.zh: 没有什么能诱使我接受这份工作。

induce.en: Whales being sociable animals probably need the stimulus of sizeable gatherings to induce reproductives behavior.
induce.zh: 鲸作为社会性动物，可能需要大规模聚集的刺激来诱导繁殖行为。

tempt.en: Cars like that may tempt drivers to speed.
tempt.zh: 那样的汽车可能会引诱司机超速行驶。

tempt.en: Vivien refuses to put down bait to tempt wildlife to the waterhole.
tempt.zh: 维维恩拒绝放饵到水坑引诱野生动物。
什么也不能引诱她做坏事。

designate.en: Japan's prime minister-designate is completing his cabinet today.
designate.zh: 日本即将上任的首相今天将完成他的内阁组建。

designate.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
designate.zh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

designate.en: If you want to designate a period, you have to look at tangible things like pottery, particularly painted pottery, because it's easier to categorize.
designate.zh: 如果你想标注某段时期，你必须借助有形的事物，就像陶器，尤其是彩绘陶器，因为它们更容易分类。

assign.en: Influenced by old ideas, some units assign posts according to seniority.
assign.zh: 由于受旧观念的影响，有些单位分配工作按资排辈。

assign.en: Assign responsibilities around the house and make sure homework deadlines are met.
assign.zh: 为房屋中的人分配责任，并确保家庭作业在期限内完成。

assign.en: Later in the year, she'll assign them research papers.
assign.zh: 今年晚些时候，她将给他们布置论文。

despatch.en: I will despatch the business right willingly, fair sir.
despatch.zh: 我很乐意去办这件事，好先生。

despatch.en: He feels we should act with despatch.
despatch.zh: 他觉得我们应该迅速行动。

despatch.en: Mark: Hello, can I speak to despatch, please?
despatch.zh: 马克：你好，能帮我接一下派送部吗？

distribute.en: Aid workers helped distribute corn, milk and other staples.
distribute.zh: 救助人员协助分发谷物、牛奶及其他必需的食物。

distribute.en: UN peacekeepers are trying to distribute supplies to 30,000 civilians.
distribute.zh: 联合国维和士兵正努力将供给分发给三万平民。

distribute.en: He sometimes employs sales-girls to distribute samples of his product.
distribute.zh: 他有时雇佣销售小姐来分发他的产品样品。

undo.en: He tried to undo the knot by picking at it with his fingers.
undo.zh: 他用手指不停地扯，想把绳结解开。

undo.en: Oh, do let me help to undo it!
I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel.
undo.zh: 我设法偷偷地打开包裹的一角。

detach.en: The skis should detach from the boot if you fall.
detach.zh: 要是你跌倒了，滑雪板就该脱离靴子。

detach.en: I tried to detach myself from the reality of these terrible events.
detach.zh: 我尽力使自己从这些可怕事件的现实中摆脱出来。

detach.en: They clambered back under the falls to detach the raft from a jagged rock.
detach.zh: 他们爬回到瀑布下面以便将卡在锯齿状岩石间的小艇拉出来。

disguise.zh: 他竭力掩饰自己的口音。

conceal.zh: 蒂姆几乎掩饰不住自己的失望。

conceal.en: If only he could conceal his part in the accident.
conceal.zh: 如果他能掩盖他在那次事故中有份参与就好了。

conceal.en: He didn't attempt to dissimulate or conceal his true feelings.
conceal.zh: 他没有尝试着掩饰或隐瞒自己的感受。

exclude.en: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything.
exclude.zh: 如果有什么事我将她排除在外，她就会非常难过。

exclude.en: We should not exclude the possibility of negotiation.
exclude.zh: 我们不应该排除谈判的可能性。

exclude.en: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
exclude.zh: 我不能完全排除有些压力作用到了颈部的可能性。

refuse.en: Am I to understand that you refuse?

reverse.en: You should reverse the order of these pages.
reverse.zh: 你该把这几页的顺序颠倒过来。

assure.en: She's perfectly safe, I can assure you.
assure.zh: 我可以向你保证，她绝对安全。

assure.en: Victory would assure a place in the finals.
assure.zh: 胜利将确保能参加决赛。

assure.en: Victory would assure them a place in the finals.
assure.zh: 胜利将确保他们能参加决赛。

stipulate.en: Some laws also stipulate in explicit terms that Chinese citizens have obligations to take care of parents and raise children.
stipulate.zh: 一些法律也明确规定中国公民有义务赡养父母、抚养子女。

stipulate.en: Companies should stipulate that they will never ask for passwords, be consistent, document decisions, consider the source used and be aware that other laws may apply.
stipulate.zh: 公司应该明确规定会做到以下几点：永远不要求（求职者）提供密码，前后保持一致，记录（招聘）决策，考虑所用信息来源，清楚可能适用的其它法律。

stipulate.en: PayPal policies stipulate that sellers must prove buyers received an item.
stipulate.zh: Paypal的政策规定，卖家需核实买家已收到商品。

undertake.en: University professors both teach and undertake research.
undertake.zh: 大学教授既要教学又要从事研究工作。

undertake.en: Their brief is to undertake outreach work aimed at young African Americans.
undertake.zh: 他们的任务是承担主动帮助年轻美国黑人的工作。

undertake.en: We want all our members to undertake this trip responsibly, with their eyes open.
undertake.zh: 我们希望我们所有的成员都明白其中的困难、负责任地进行这次旅行。

reassure.en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers.
reassure.zh: 银行修建得看上去很坚固，以使顾客放心。

reassure.en: He didn't need to go to hospital, but he went just to reassure himself.
reassure.zh: 他用不着去医院，去了只是想让自己放心点。（北美英语）

reassure.en: His father smiled weakly in a forlorn attempt to reassure him that everything was all right.
reassure.zh: 他父亲淡淡地一笑，枉然地试图要他放心，一切都安然无恙。

convince.en: Thomas, she sensed, could convince anyone of anything.
convince.zh: 她觉得，托马斯能说服任何人相信任何事。

convince.en: It became clear that I hadn't been able to convince Mike.

aspire.en: Nor do they aspire to such command themselves.
aspire.zh: 他们自己也不渴望这样的命令。

aspire.en: Mary is ambitious enough to aspire to conversational fluency in Chinese in four months.
aspire.zh: 玛丽雄心很大， 竟立志在四个月里学会用汉语流利地会话。

aspire.en: Men aspire to be able to show off their six packs or their V-shape backs and there's a growing market of slimming pills aimed at men too.
aspire.zh: 男性渴望展示自己的六块腹肌或 V 型后背，针对男性的减肥药市场也在不断增长。

wish.zh: 爸，我但愿你不要嚷嚷了。

yearn.en: As humans, we yearn for social connection.
yearn.zh: 作为人类，我们渴望有社会联系。

yearn.en: All of us actually yearn for a slow and calm life.
yearn.zh: 事实上，我们都渴望一个缓慢而平静的生活。

yearn.en: Every night I yearn for sleep, I strive for it; yet it flutters on ahead of me like a curtain.
yearn.zh: 每天晚上我都渴望睡眠，我努力想要睡着，但睡眠像窗帘一样在我面前飘动。

desire.zh: 我们都渴望健康和幸福。

desire.en: He was overestimating their desire for peace.
desire.zh: 他高估了他们对和平的渴望。

desire.en: This condition decreases sexual desire and responsiveness.
desire.zh: 这种情况会降低性的欲望和敏感。

invoke.en: You also have to invoke the stored procedure once.
invoke.zh: 您还必须调用一次存储过程。

invoke.en: In choosing a method for determining climatic conditions that existed in the past, paleoclimatologists invoke four principal criteria.
invoke.zh: 在选择确定过去存在的气候条件的方法时，古气候学家援引了四个主要标准。

invoke.en: While we invoke the precautionary principle, which always recommends erring on the side of caution, we have to recognize there will be trade-offs to be made.
invoke.zh: 当我们援引总是建议谨慎行事的预防原则时，我们必须做出权衡。

itch.en: Scratch my back – I've got an itch.
When someone has hay fever, the eyes and nose will stream and itch.
itch.zh: 当一个人染上花粉热时，会流眼泪、流鼻涕，还会感到眼睛和鼻子发痒。

attempt.en: I was forced to attempt a gallop.
attempt.zh: 我被迫尝试一次骑马疾驰。

attempt.en: That wasn't bad for a first attempt.

strive.en: Newspaper editors all strive to be first with a story.
strive.zh: 报纸编辑都力争率先报道。

strive.en: We encourage all members to strive for the highest standards.
strive.zh: 我们鼓励所有成员为达到最高标准而努力。

strive.en: You should always strive to achieve more, however well you have done before.
strive.zh: 不管以前做得多么好，你应该始终争取更大的进步。

effort.en: You should put more effort into your work.
effort.zh: 你应该更加努力地工作。

effort.en: Emma frowned, making an effort to compose herself.
effort.zh: 埃玛皱起了眉头，努力使自己镇定下来。

effort.en: Finding a cure requires considerable time and effort.
effort.zh: 找到一种治愈方法需要相当的时间和努力。

fulfill.zh: 我们有很多的爱要实现。

fulfill.en: That is why we can fulfill our destiny.
fulfill.zh: 这就是为什么我们能实现我们的命运。

fulfill.en: These cleaners could fulfill all customers' demands.
fulfill.zh: 这些清洁剂可以满足所有顾客的需求。

loom.en: She sat at her loom and continued to weave.
loom.zh: 她坐在织布机前，继续织布。

loom.en: You've got to be able to make decisions on the fly as deadlines loom.
loom.zh: 你必须能够立刻作出决定，因为最后期限迫在眉睫。

loom.en: Now the Emperor himself wished to see the costly manufacture, while it was still in the loom.
loom.zh: 当这布还在织的时候，皇帝就亲自去看它了。

commence.en: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.
Wicher's return will commence with the upcoming European tour.
commence.zh: 维歇尔的回归将从即将来临的欧洲之旅开始。

launch.en: The official launch date is in May.
launch.zh: 正式的发行日期是在五月。

launch.en: The Navy is to launch a new warship today.
launch.zh: 海军今天有一艘新军舰要下水。

launch.en: They decided to launch a pre-emptive strike.
launch.zh: 他们决定发动先发制人的攻击。

explore.en: We will explore every avenue until we find an answer.
explore.zh: 我们要探索一切途径，直到找到答案为止。

explore.en: I want to explore and get in touch with my inner self.
explore.zh: 我想认真探索，了解我内在的个性。

explore.en: I just wanted to explore on my own.
explore.zh: 我只是想独自考察一下。

exploit.en: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology.
exploit.zh: 正如计算机系统变得越来越复杂，开发计算机技术的人所采用的方法也日趋复杂。

exploit.en: What do you think my last exploit was?
exploit.zh: 你觉得我最后一项功绩是什么？

exploit.en: Modern technology is good enough to exploit all the sea resources.
exploit.zh: 现代技术足以开发所有的海洋资源。

exert.en: A number of neurotransmitters exert their effects by first increasing cyclic AMP concentrations in target neurons.
exert.zh: 许多神经递质首先通过增加靶神经元中的循环 AMP 浓度来发挥其作用。

exert.en: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
exert.zh: 大家都知道，当我们竭尽全力时，心率会加速。

sort.zh: 他是那种通情达理的人。

sort.en: What sort of school did you go to?
So that's twenty of each sort, right?
sort.zh: 那么，每一种都是二十个，对不对？

dispose.en: Obviously we ask all our customers to dispose of litter responsibly.
dispose.zh: 显然，我们要求所有的顾客负责任地处理垃圾。

dispose.en: Agencies and companies throughout the world are working on developing technology that would dispose of or capture space debris before it causes serious damage.
dispose.zh: 世界各地的机构和公司都在致力于开发一种技术，可以在太空垃圾造成严重损害之前将其处理或捕获。

dispose.en: Subway said that it worked hard to minimize the impact of litter on communities, so it was "still down to the individual customer to dispose of their litter responsibly".
dispose.zh: 赛百味表示，公司努力将垃圾对社区的影响降到最低，因此“对垃圾处理负责仍取决于个人客户”。

tackle.en: We were awarded a penalty after a late tackle.
tackle.zh: 对方铲球犯规后，我们得到了一个点球。

tackle.en: You would be well advised to tackle this problem urgently.
tackle.zh: 你还是抓紧处理这个问题为好。

tackle.en: We must tackle the problem with sympathy and understanding.
tackle.zh: 我们必须带着同情和谅解来处理这个问题。

conduct.zh: 他因为不符合运动员道德的行为被驱逐。

conduct.en: The sport has a strict code of conduct.
conduct.zh: 体育运动有严格的行为规范。
警察会随机进行吹气酒精测试。

cope.en: I was left to cope on my own.
cope.zh: 就剩下我一个人来单独对付。

cope.en: Fit people are better able to cope with stress.
cope.zh: 健康的人较能应付压力。

cope.en: Farmers are struggling to cope with an invasion of slugs.
cope.zh: 农民正在努力对付蛞蝓的大肆侵害。

delete.en: I selected a file and pressed the delete key.
delete.zh: 我选定了一份文件，然后按下了删除键。

delete.en: After we delete their names, we have some results like Figure 21.
delete.zh: 删除它们的名称之后，我们将得到如图21所示的结果。

delete.en: Dreams organize the events of the day into folders and delete what is not needed.
delete.zh: 在梦中，一天的事情被分门别类地整理好，而不必要的则会被删除。

omit.en: If you are a student, you can omit questions 16–18.
There are as many textbooks that omit it as a type of movement as include it.
omit.zh: 也有不少课本没有把它包括在冰川移动的一种类型里。

omit.en: Omit dull and ineffective generalities and make sure you give concrete examples.
omit.zh: 避免枯燥、无效的空谈，并确保你给出了具体的例子。

cancel.en: Is it too late to cancel my order?
cancel.zh: 我现在取消订单是不是太晚了？

cancel.en: You may cancel or rearrange the appointment.
cancel.zh: 你可以取消或重新安排这次预约。

erase.en: They are desperate to erase the memory of that last defeat.
erase.zh: 他们急于抹去上次失败的记忆。

erase.en: Please erase my name from the list.
erase.zh: 请把我的名字从名单上擦去。

erase.en: You can erase pencil marks with a rubber.
erase.zh: 你可以用橡皮擦掉铅笔记号。

clear.zh: 清澈蔚蓝的大海令人向往。

resort.zh: 这个旅游胜地适合儿童玩耍。

resort.en: It's a favourite resort for the rich and famous.
resort.zh: 这是富人和名流最喜欢去度假的地方。

resort.en: The resort is a playground of the rich and famous.
resort.zh: 这个度假胜地是富翁名流的娱乐场所。

rescue.en: We had given up hope of rescue.
rescue.zh: 我们那时已经放弃了获救的希望。

rescue.en: Mercifully, a friend came to the rescue.
rescue.zh: 很幸运，一个朋友赶来解救了。

recover.en: The economy is at last beginning to recover.
He sat down to try and recover his equilibrium.
recover.zh: 他坐了下来，努力恢复平静。

recover.en: He is unlikely to ever recover his legal costs.
recover.zh: 他不大可能收回他的诉讼费用了。

restore.en: Troops were sent in to restore order.
The police are trying to restore public order.
restore.zh: 警察正在努力恢复公共秩序。

restore.en: We will restore her to health but it may take time.
restore.zh: 我们会让她恢复健康，但这或许需要时间。

rectify.en: We must take steps to rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 我们一定要采取措施整顿局面。

rectify.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
rectify.zh: 全面支出审查让政府有机会帮助纠正这一问题。

rectify.en: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 只有国会的法案才能扭转这种局面。

redeem.en: He was able to redeem his watch from the pawnshop.
redeem.zh: 他得以从当铺赎回他的表。

redeem.en: He had no way to redeem his furniture out of pawn.
redeem.zh: 他无法赎回典当的家具。

redeem.en: Level Global and Loch saw investors redeem money as soon as possible because of the raid, even though they haven't been charged with any wrongdoing.
redeem.zh: 目前水平国际和 Loch 公司看到投资者因为此次突袭而尽快赎回资金，尽管他们没有受到任何不当行为的指控。

offset.en: The decline in marriage has been offset by a rise in cohabitation.
offset.zh: 同居人数的增加跟结婚人数的减少相抵消。

offset.en: Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.
offset.zh: 为补偿原料成本的增加而提高了价格。

offset.en: A moderation in food prices helped to offset the first increase in energy prices.
offset.zh: 食品价格的降低有助于抵消能源价格的第一次上涨。

replenish.en: The cavalry must immediately replenish the new horse.
replenish.zh: 骑兵部队必须立即补充新马。

replenish.en: If you replenish the ice sheets and frozen waters of the high latitudes, more light will be reflected back into space, so reducing the warming of the oceans and atmosphere.
replenish.zh: 如果高纬度地区的冰原和冻结的水得到补充，更多的光将被反射回太空，从而减缓海洋和大气的变暖。

obtain.en: He admitted conspiring to obtain property by deception.
obtain.zh: 他承认曾密谋通过欺骗获取财产。

obtain.en: Can plants obtain adequate nourishment from such poor soil?
obtain.zh: 土壤这样贫瘠，植物能获得足够的养分吗？

obtain.en: I could obtain with the snap of my fingers anything I chose.
obtain.zh: 只要打一下响指，我就可以得到我选中的任何东西。

gain.zh: 经常锻炼有助于防止体重增加。

gain.en: The minuses far outweigh that possible gain.
gain.zh: 不利因素远远超过了那可能获得的收益。

gain.en: The research investigates how foreign speakers gain fluency.
gain.zh: 这项研究旨在调查讲外语的人如何增加流利程度。

supply.en: The electricity supply here is quite erratic.
supply.zh: 这里的电力供应相当不稳定。

offer.zh: 我们免费提供技术支持。

render.en: It's a concept that is difficult to render into English.
render.zh: 这个概念难以用英语来表达。

render.en: They couldn't resist anymore and decided to render up the city.
render.zh: 他们无法继续抵抗，决定放弃这座城市。

render.en: It contained so many errors as to render it worthless.
render.zh: 太多的错误使之变得毫无价值。

enlarge.en: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
enlarge.zh: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

enlarge.en: He didn't enlarge on the form that the interim government and assembly would take.
enlarge.zh: 他未详述临时政府和议会将会采取的形式。

augment.en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
augment.zh: 为求增加家庭收入，她开始做起了玩具娃娃。

augment.en: The government's first concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
augment.zh: 政府首要关注的是扩充军队与后备军。

augment.en: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
augment.zh: 换句话说，我们需要研究机器如何辅助人类劳动，而不是研究其如何取代它。

magnify.en: If you really magnify the spectrum of the sunlight, you could identify more than 100,000 of them.
magnify.zh: 如果你真的放大太阳光的光谱，你可以分辨出多达10万条的光谱线。

magnify.en: One of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences or invent them where they did not previously exist.
magnify.zh: 细分市场最简单的方法之一是放大性别差异，或者在以前不存在性别差异的地方创造性别差异。

magnify.en: The findings suggest that the body and brain have instinctive ways of healing that we could come to understand one day and then magnify.
magnify.zh: 这些发现表明身体与大脑具有其天生的自愈方法，我们有朝一日可以去理解并放大。

amplify.en: This landscape seemed to trap and amplify sounds.
amplify.zh: 这种地形好像能聚拢和扩大声音。

amplify.en: Subjects are wearing headphones that amplify their heartbeat.
amplify.zh: 受试者正戴着放大他们心跳声的耳机。

exaggerate.en: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness.
exaggerate.zh: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的下降。

exaggerate.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
exaggerate.zh: 画家可能会夸大或扭曲形状与形式。

prolong.en: It seems commonly believed that companies are not motivated to prolong their products' lifespan.
prolong.zh: 人们似乎普遍认为，公司没有动力去延长产品的寿命。

prolong.en: In government laboratories and elsewhere, scientists are seeking a drug able to prolong life and youthful vigor.
prolong.zh: 在政府实验室和其他地方，科学家们正在寻找一种能够延长寿命、让人保持年轻活力的药物。

prolong.en: Extreme high-performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
prolong.zh: 极限高强度运动可能会带来最佳的心血管功能，但这些运动肯定无法延长寿命。

uphold.en: We have a duty to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 维护法律是我们的责任。

uphold.en: Our policy has been to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 我们的政策一直是维护法律。

uphold.en: It is the responsibility of every government to uphold certain basic principles.
uphold.zh: 每个政府都有责任维护某些基本原则。

backup.en: You should make a copy of the disk as a backup.
backup.zh: 你应该将磁盘复制一个备份。

backup.en: If that happens, the grasshopper has a backup defense.
backup.zh: 如果发生这种情况，蚱蜢就有了后备防御。

backup.en: In areas where the wind dies down, backup electricity from a utility company or from an energy storage system becomes necessary.
backup.zh: 在风能不稳定的一些地区，需要供电事业公司或者能量储存系统来提供备用电能。

propel.en: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
propel.zh: 微型火箭附在宇宙飞船上，用来推进飞船飞向火星。

propel.en: He also used ski poles in an unorthodox way—to propel himself as he skied.
propel.zh: 他还以一种非正统的方式使用滑雪杖，就是在滑雪时用它推动自己。

propel.en: It now appears that they also have an important influence on the geophysical processes that propel the plates across the globe.
propel.zh: 现在看来，它们对推动板块在全球范围内运动的地球物理过程也有重要影响。

update.en: The one thing that she accomplished was raising money to update our facilities.
update.zh: 她完成的这项工作就是募集资金来更新我们的设备。

update.en: You'll need to update your card details directly on our website.
update.zh: 您需要直接在我们的网站上更新您的银行卡信息。

update.en: Type up to 1500 characters to append to your forum posts and click Update.
update.zh: 最多可以输入1500个字符来附加到你的论坛帖子中，然后单击更新。

leak.en: Water had started to leak into the cellar.
More details are now beginning to leak out.
leak.zh: 更多的细节现在开始泄露出来。

leak.en: Crews are working to plug a major oil leak.
leak.zh: 机组人员正在努力堵一个漏油的大洞。

raise.en: How can we raise standards in schools?
raise.zh: 我们怎样才能提高学校的水平？

raise.en: Don't you raise your voice to me!
We were forced to raise the price.

spill.en: The tanker began to spill its cargo of oil.
Someone jogged her elbow, making her spill her coffee.
spill.zh: 有人不小心轻轻碰了一下她的胳膊肘儿，把咖啡弄洒了。

spill.en: Although I poured it carefully, I still managed to spill some.
spill.zh: 尽管我倒这东西很小心，还是洒了一些。

seep.en: Many of us thrive on competition, but it can seep into areas of our lives where we do not want it.
seep.zh: 我们许多人靠竞争而发展，但竞争也会逐渐侵入到我们生活中不需要它的一些方面。

seep.en: The very reason that clichés so easily seep into our speech and writing—their insidious memorability—is exactly why they played such an important role in oral storytelling.
seep.zh: 陈词滥调之所以如此容易渗透到我们的演讲和写作中，是由于它们潜在的可记忆性，这正是它们在口述故事中扮演如此重要角色的原因。

seep.en: Water does not remain immobile in an aquifer but can seep out at springs or leak into other aquifers.
seep.zh: 水在含水层中并不是静止不动的，而是会从泉水中渗出，或渗入其他含水层。

evacuate.en: It has forced politicians to think again about the wisdom of trying to evacuate refugees.
evacuate.zh: 这已迫使政客们重新考虑试图疏散难民是否明智。

evacuate.en: The United States is sending a naval task force to the area to evacuate American citizens.
evacuate.zh: 美国正派遣一支海军特遣队赶赴该地区疏散美国公民。

evacuate.en: Remember that hearing a siren or tone alert radio does not mean you should evacuate.
evacuate.zh: 记住，听到警报或人声广播并不意味着你需要撤离。

ooze.en: Soon layer of oceanic ooze began to accumulate above the old hard layer.
ooze.zh: 很快，海洋软泥层开始在原先的硬地层上面堆积起来。

ooze.en: The lava will just ooze gently out of the crater.
ooze.zh: 熔岩只会缓缓地从火山口流出来。

ooze.en: To her dismay, the blood continued to ooze out, unabated.
ooze.zh: 让人沮丧的是，血还在继续渗出，丝毫没有减弱。

trench.en: "With virtual reality we'll be able to put a surgeon in every trench," said Satava.
trench.zh: “有了虚拟现实技术，我们就能在每条战壕里安插一名外科医生。”萨塔瓦说道。

trench.en: This plate is growing on both sides, and since there is no intermediate trench, the two ridges must be moving apart.
trench.zh: 这个板块是在两边生长的，由于没有中间的沟槽，两个脊必然是分开的。

trench.en: The bridge lies like a trench in the fortress of the moat, which is shaped to blend in with the outlines of the landscape.
trench.zh: 这座桥就像是坐落在护城河中的一条沟渠，这种造型是为了使它与周围的风景融合在一起。

saturate.en: Heavy rains can saturate hillsides, leading to devastating mudslides.
saturate.zh: 大雨会浸透山坡，会导致毁灭性的泥石流。

saturate.en: Saturate the wood with oil and let it soak in. The oil protects the wood.
saturate.zh: 油浸透了木材，使之吸收，可以起到保护作用。

saturate.en: According to our results, the server starts to saturate at 350-500 users.
saturate.zh: 根据我们的结果，服务器性能会在350 - 500个用户时趋于饱和。

contain.zh: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。
有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

excuse.zh: 她给出的借口还是老一套。
对不起，这是您的座位吗？

regard.en: I have nothing further to say in this regard.
regard.zh: 在这方面，我没什么要说的了。

regard.en: He seemed to regard the whole thing as a joke.
regard.zh: 他似乎是把整件事当成玩笑。

regard.en: I regard this as a serious matter.
regard.zh: 我认为这是一件重要的事情。

flatter.zh: 那种颜色很多人都不适宜。
巧妙的裁剪可以使你的身材显得优美。

worship.zh: 我们在圣马利教堂做礼拜。

worship.en: He prefers to worship in his own home.
worship.zh: 他更喜欢在自己的家里敬奉神明。

worship.en: Singer Brett Anderson inspires old-fashioned hero worship.
worship.zh: 歌手布雷特•安德森唤起了老式的个人崇拜风潮。

cause.zh: 他为了高尚的事业而牺牲。
这些药常常使人昏昏欲睡。

cause.en: The immediate cause of death is unknown.
cause.zh: 造成死亡的直接原因不明。

purpose.en: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
We are working together for a common purpose.
purpose.zh: 我们在为一个共同的目标一起工作。

purpose.en: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.
purpose.zh: 我们这次活动的主要目的就是募款。

objective.en: What is the main objective of this project?
objective.zh: 这个项目的主要目标是什么？

objective.en: Winning is not the prime objective in this sport.
objective.zh: 获胜不是这项体育运动的主要目的。

objective.en: Our objective must be to secure a peace settlement.
objective.zh: 我们的目标必须是确保达成一个和平协议。

arouse.en: They arouse the interest of all the readers.
arouse.zh: 它们引起了所有读者的兴趣。

arouse.en: Silly mistakes and queer clothes often arouse ridicule.
arouse.zh: 荒谬的错误和古怪的服装常引起讪笑。

arouse.en: The extension of London's Ulez will arouse strong resistance.
arouse.zh: 扩大伦敦的超低排放区会引起强烈反对。

trigger.en: Stress may act as a trigger for these illnesses.
trigger.zh: 压力也许是引发这些疾病的一个原因。

trigger.en: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
trigger.zh: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

trigger.en: Unresolved or unacknowledged fears can trigger sleepwalking.
trigger.zh: 未解决或未被注意的恐惧感会引发梦游。

retrieve.en: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.
retrieve.zh: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。

retrieve.en: The men were trying to retrieve weapons left when the army abandoned the island.
retrieve.zh: 那些人正试图找回该军队撤离这个岛时留下的武器。

retrieve.en: It includes methods to add and delete bookmarks, retrieve a user's bookmark list, and retrieve (or rename) a user's tags.
retrieve.zh: 它包括添加和删除书签、检索用户书签列表和检索（或者重命名）用户标记的方法。

seek.en: We were advised to seek legal advice.
seek.zh: 有人劝我们找律师咨询。

seek.en: They have had to seek work as labourers.
seek.zh: 他们只好找体力活来做。

seek.en: Students may decide to seek tutorial guidance.
seek.zh: 学生们可以决定寻求助教的指导。

testify.en: Fiers promised to testify fully and truthfully.
testify.zh: 菲尔斯承诺毫无保留地、如实地作证。

testify.en: He was summoned to testify before a grand jury.
testify.zh: 他被传唤出庭在大陪审团前作证。

testify.en: She was held in contempt for refusing to testify.
testify.zh: 她因拒绝作证而被判藐视法庭罪。

specify.en: For the effect, you need to specify a size, with the horizontal size first, and then the vertical size.
specify.zh: 为实现这个效果，您需要指定一个尺寸，首先是水平尺寸，然后是垂直尺寸。

specify.en: It's got to be practical so don't forget to specify things like who would be involved, and the cost, and the order that things would be done in.
specify.zh: 它必须是实用的，所以不要忘记指定诸如参与者有谁、成本、完成顺序等事宜。

specify.en: The trick is not only to specify just one or even two dimensions of the objective, but also to understand how to help people better achieve the objective.
specify.zh: 窍门在于，不仅要指定目标的一个、甚至两个维度，还要了解如何帮助人们更好地实现目标。

verify.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
verify.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

verify.en: They now take extra steps to verify the creditworthiness of customers.
verify.zh: 他们现在采取额外措施来验证客户的信用。

verify.en: Inspectors were sent to visit nuclear sites and verify compliance with the treaty.
verify.zh: 监察员被派去参观核址并核实条约的遵守情况。

enlighten.en: It was an elite that believed its task was to enlighten the multitude.
enlighten.zh: 精英人物都会认为自己的职责就是启迪群众。

enlighten.en: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
enlighten.zh: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

enlighten.en: Instead, she set up Enlighten our Future, a charity that reaches students in the countryside how to write poems.
enlighten.zh: 相反，她成立了一个名为“启迪我们的未来”的慈善机构，教导农村的学生如何写诗。

impart.en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
impart.zh: 传授知识并博得尊敬的能力对老师们来说是基本的条件。

impart.en: You need to have specialist teachers who impart what they know.
impart.zh: 你需要有专业的老师来传授他们所知道的知识。

impart.en: Forcing a child to behave morally may prevent her from internalizing the lesson you're trying to impart.
impart.zh: 强迫孩子按道德行事可能会妨碍她将你试图传授的教训内化。

deserve.zh: 这些建议值得认真研究。

deserve.en: The players deserve a pat on the back.
What have I done to deserve this?
deserve.zh: 我做了什么事应该得到这种待遇呢？

plummet.en: The glamour stocks of the age saw their values plummet.
plummet.zh: 当时的魅力股的价值大大缩水。

plummet.en: Everyone expects Broadway's box office to plummet in September.
plummet.zh: 大家都预料到9月百老汇的票房会大幅下跌。

plummet.en: After menopause, when estrogen levels plummet, some women become forgetful.
plummet.zh: 绝经期后，当雌激素水平骤然下降，一些女性开始变得健忘。

sink.zh: 他决定把水池擦洗干净。

sink.en: The boat was beginning to sink fast.
The boat will sink unless we bail out.
sink.zh: 我们若不排水，船就要沉。

drop.en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
drop.zh: 晚上气温能陡降到零度以下。

drop.en: Can you drop me near the bank?
drop.zh: 你可以让我在银行附近下车吗？

drop.en: He was told to drop the idea.
drop.zh: 他被告知放弃这个想法。

muffle.en: He tried to muffle the alarm clock by putting it under his pillow.
muffle.zh: 他把闹钟塞在枕头底下，想减低声音。

muffle.en: Blake held his handkerchief over the mouthpiece to muffle his voice.
muffle.zh: 布莱克用手帕遮住话筒来压低声音。

muffle.en: In reality, some people are vocal and may moan and groan, other folks may muffle any sounds with a pillow, and yet others may not make a single peep.
muffle.zh: 事实上，有些人会出声，他们可能会唉声叹气，其他人可能会用枕头闷住任何声音，还有另一些人可能不会发出任何声音。

overshadow.en: Fears for the president's safety could overshadow his peace-making mission.
overshadow.zh: 对总统安全的担心会给他的和平促进任务蒙上阴影。

overshadow.en: They can be used as street tree, overshadow tree, plant alone or agminate in gardens.
overshadow.zh: 它们可以被用作街树，遮荫树，单独种植或在花园中聚集。

overshadow.en: But the footwear dispute could overshadow those successes.
overshadow.zh: 但鞋类争端却可能给上述成绩蒙上阴影。

invite.en: Who did you invite to the party?
invite.zh: 你邀请了哪些人来参加聚会？

invite.en: It was nice of them to invite us.
I'm in a dither about who to invite.

sake.en: You can do it. Please, for my sake.
sake.zh: 这个你是能做的。求你了，就算为了我。

sake.en: They stayed together for the sake of the children.
sake.zh: 为了孩子，他们还待在一起。

welcome.zh: 我们受到了盛大的欢迎。

greet.en: She floated down the steps to greet us.
greet.zh: 她轻盈地下楼来迎接我们。

greet.en: He bounced across the room to greet them.
greet.zh: 他兴奋地冲过房间去迎接他们。

greet.en: He rushed to greet her, sweeping his arms wide.
greet.zh: 他张开双臂舞动着，冲过去迎接她。

salute.en: He raised his hat as a friendly salute.
They all raised their glasses in salute.

celebrate.en: I was in a mood to celebrate.

celebrate.zh: 苏格兰的冠军庆祝胜利！

celebrate.en: We went out to a restaurant to celebrate.
celebrate.zh: 我们到一家饭店里庆祝了一番。

congratulate.en: I congratulate all of you on this achievement.
congratulate.zh: 我祝贺你们的这一成就。

congratulate.en: I should congratulate you that you resisted the temptation.
congratulate.zh: 我应向你祝贺，你抗住了这种引诱。

bless.zh: “愿上帝保佑你，伊娃，”他低声说道。
祝你好运，愿上帝保佑你。

farewell.en: When we decide to say farewell, we are not far from reunion.
farewell.zh: 当我们决定告别的时候，就离重逢不远了。

farewell.en: I bade farewell to all the friends I had made in Paris.
farewell.zh: 我告别了我在巴黎结交的所有朋友。

participate.en: They expected him to participate in the ceremony.
participate.zh: 他们希望他参加这个典礼。

participate.en: Over half the population of this country participate in sports.
participate.zh: 这个国家一半以上的人参加体育运动。

assort.zh: 你必须把预订资料整理一下。

assort.en: These buttons do not assort with the samples.
His actions do not assort with his promises.
assort.zh: 他的行动和他的诺言不一致。

correspond.en: Your account and hers do not correspond.
correspond.zh: 你说的情况与她说的不相符。

correspond.en: Your account of events does not correspond with hers.
correspond.zh: 你对事情的陈述与她说的不相符。

correspond.en: Racegoers will be given a number which will correspond to a horse running in a race.
correspond.zh: 观看赛马的观众将领到一个与参赛马匹相对应的号码。

accord.en: These results accord closely with our predictions.
accord.zh: 这些结果和我们的预测相当一致。

accord.en: This action would not be in accord with our policy.
accord.zh: 这一行动不会符合我们的方针。

accord.en: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
accord.zh: 他不是自愿地辞去法国总理一职的。

attribute.en: Each level should have exactly one caption attribute.
attribute.zh: 每个级别都应该有一个标题属性。

attribute.en: People were beginning to attribute superhuman qualities to him.
attribute.zh: 人们开始赋予他超人的品质。

attribute.en: The committee refused to attribute blame without further information.
attribute.zh: 如果没有进一步的情况，委员会拒绝归罪于任何人。

recall.zh: 你能记起到底发生了什么事吗？

recall.en: He tried to recall the layout of the farmhouse.
recall.zh: 他想回忆那农舍的布局。

recall.en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
recall.zh: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

recollect.en: As far as I can recollect, she wasn't there on that occasion.
recollect.zh: 据我回忆，当时她不在场。
好吧，试着回忆一下——好吗？

retell.en: Please retell the fairy story in English.
retell.zh: 请用英语复述这篇童话故事。

retell.en: Encourage their children to retell the story.
Someday, you can retell your family's stories.
retell.zh: 有一天，你可以复述你家庭的故事。

remind.en: Remind me to phone Alan before I go out.
remind.zh: 提醒我在出去之前给艾伦打电话。

remind.en: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of wine?
remind.zh: 你能提醒我买一瓶葡萄酒吗？

remind.en: I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
remind.zh: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。提醒我一下好吗？

retrospect.en: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, I wish that I had thought about alternative courses of action.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，我真希望自己当初考虑过其他的行动方案。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, it is possible to see the uneasy and ambiguous nature of this relationship.
retrospect.zh: 回顾过去，我们可能会看到这种关系不安和模糊的本质。

repeat.en: The joke is too rude to repeat.
repeat.zh: 这个笑话太下流，不宜重复。
“这是新播出的连续剧吗？”“不，是重播的。”

repeat.en: The claims are, I repeat, totally unfounded.
repeat.zh: 我再说一遍，这些说法是毫无根据的。

surmount.en: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
surmount.zh: 我认识到我必须得克服语言障碍。

surmount.en: We were able to surmount so many obstacles.
surmount.zh: 我们能克服那么多的障碍。

impress.en: It didn't impress me as a good place to live.
impress.zh: 那地方没有给我留下适合居住的印象。
那个主意似乎打动了科林。

impress.en: The Grand Canyon never fails to impress.
impress.zh: 大峡谷永远让人叹为观止。

mortify.en: To cause to feel chagrin ; mortify or discomfit.
mortify.zh: 使懊恼，使受屈辱，使窘迫。

mortify.en: Is it not this: to humiliate oneself in order to mortify one's pride?
mortify.zh: 这个是不是：用羞辱自己的尊严来抑制自己的高傲？

mortify.en: You would not wish to disappoint and mortify the Coles, I am sure, sir;
mortify.zh: 我敢说，先生，你是不想叫科尔夫妇扫兴、丢面子的。

pervade.en: Tablets are newer and just beginning to pervade the market.
pervade.zh: 平板电脑较新且刚刚开始蔓延于市场。

Many of the bodies were unidentifiable except by dental records.
dental.zh: 许多尸体若不是靠牙科病历就无法辨认。

dental.en: You will automatically get free dental treatment if you are under 18.
dental.zh: 18岁以下的人一律免费得到牙科治疗。

blind.en: He was a teacher of the blind.
blind.zh: 他过去是位教盲人的老师。

yawn.en: She makes no attempt to stifle a yawn.
yawn.zh: 她并未试图忍住一个哈欠。

doze.en: Some students often doze off in class.
doze.zh: 有些学生经常在课堂上打瞌睡。

doze.en: We couldn't help but doze off during his lecture.
doze.zh: 他演讲时我们忍不住打瞌睡。

doze.en: I had a doze on the train.
doze.zh: 我在火车上打了个盹儿。

awake.en: Suddenly he found himself awake and fully alert.
awake.zh: 突然他发觉自己醒了过来，而且高度警觉。
我瞌睡得再也熬不住了。

nap.en: An elderly person may nap during the day and then sleep only five hours a night.
nap.zh: 上了年纪的人白天会小睡一会儿，然后晚上只睡5个小时。

nap.en: Don't take a nap in the afternoon.
Taking a nap is one of my favorites.
nap.zh: 睡午觉是我的爱好之一。

cripple.en: A total cutoff of supplies would cripple the country's economy.
cripple.zh: 全面终止供给将使该国经济瘫痪。

cripple.en: He had been warned that another bad fall could cripple him for life.
cripple.zh: 他被警告说再一次严重摔跤会使他终身残疾。

quiet.zh: 那里突然变得安静异常。

asleep.en: He had fallen asleep on the sofa.
He's half asleep and a bit boozed.
asleep.zh: 他半醒半睡，还有点微醉。

asleep.en: In moments, I was asleep once more.

lame.en: What do I want with a lame donkey?
lame.zh: 我要一只瘸腿的驴子干什么？

lame.en: So enough with the lame analogy for now.
lame.zh: 这个蹩脚的比喻到此为止吧。

condom.en: As a parting gift, she bought him a subway map and a condom, tucked into his jacket pocket.
condom.zh: 作为离别礼物，她给他买了一张地铁地图和一个安全套，塞在了他的夹克口袋里。

condom.en: Sell condom alone or sell newspaper alone, namely monomer machine alone.
condom.zh: 单独售套或单独售报，即单体机。

condom.en: It suggested that the only way to have safe sex is to use a condom.
condom.zh: 这表明进行安全性行为的唯一方法就是用安全套。

pregnancy.en: Pregnancy is a natural part of womanhood.
pregnancy.zh: 怀孕是女子成年期的一个自然部分。

dwarf.en: He might have been called the invulnerable dwarf of the fray.
dwarf.zh: 可以说，他是混战中的一个无懈可击的侏儒。

dwarf.en: This was not the best of it; for the dwarf said, "I know thee."
dwarf.zh: 这还不是最好的；因为小矮人说："我认识你。”

dwarf.en: The dwarf said, "I come to talk with your father, not with you."
dwarf.zh: 小矮人说：“我是来和你父亲谈的，不是来和你谈的。”

symptom.en: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
symptom.zh: 这种病的一个突出症状是记忆的逐步丧失。

symptom.en: Victoria was strangely undisturbed by this symptom, even though her husband and family were frightened.
symptom.zh: 维多利亚奇怪地没有因这种症状而感到不安，尽管她的丈夫和家人都吓坏了。

symptom.en: Your problem with keeping boyfriends is just a symptom of a larger problem: making and keeping friends.
symptom.zh: 你无法留住男友的问题只是一个更大的问题的征兆：结交朋友并与其维持关系。

clone.en: A team from the UK were the first to successfully clone an animal.
clone.zh: 英国的一个小组率先克隆动物成功。

clone.en: He knows her clone may not have her temperament.
clone.zh: 他知道她的克隆品可能没有她的气质。

clone.en: Every man wants his son to be somewhat of a clone.
clone.zh: 每个男人都希望自己的儿子在某种程度上是自己的克隆体。

disease.zh: 这种病目前还是不治之症。
疾病与贫穷常常相伴而生。

illness.zh: 这种病通常为不治之症。

illness.en: She is still weak after her illness.

moan.en: Suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently.
moan.zh: 突然她发出了一声低沉、令人窒息的呻吟，身体开始剧烈地抖动。

moan.en: Then suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently.
moan.zh: 然后她突然发出一声低沉的、令人窒息的呻吟，身体开始剧烈地抖动。

moan.en: He listened for the tiny voice to moan and cry.
moan.zh: 他倾听着那微小的呻吟声和哭泣声。

infection.zh: 霍乱是一种由细菌引起的感染。
脚癣是由真菌感染引起的。
传染的可能性微乎其微。

detriment.en: These difficulties have been overcome without detriment to performance.
detriment.zh: 这些困难已经被克服了，且没有损害到表演。

detriment.en: He was engrossed in his job to the detriment of his health.
detriment.zh: 他全身心地投入工作结果损害了他的健康。

detriment.en: These tests will give too much importance to written exams to the detriment of other skills.
detriment.zh: 这些测试会太侧重于书面考核而有损于其他技能。

born.zh: 我的宝宝出生时感染有李斯特菌。

disable.en: They can disable communications satellites and shut down power systems.
disable.zh: 它们能使通信卫星失效并关闭电力系统。

disable.en: There will be television chat shows hosted by robots, and cars with pollution monitors that will disable them when they offend.
disable.zh: 届时，将出现由机器人主持的电视谈话节目以及装有污染监控器的汽车，一旦这些汽车排污超标（违规），监控器就会使其停驶。

disable.en: There will be television chat shows hosted by robots, and cars with pollution monitors that will disable them when they offend.
disable.zh: 届时，将出现由机器人主持的电视谈话节目以及装有污染监控器的汽车，一旦这些汽车排污超标（违规），监控器就会使其停驶。

invalid.en: The trial was stopped and the results declared invalid.
invalid.zh: 审判被终止了，其结果被宣布无效。

invalid.en: People with invalid papers are deported to another country.
invalid.zh: 持无效证件的人被驱逐到别国。

invalid.en: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a Seattle suburb.
invalid.zh: 玛格丽特和她有病的妈妈住在西雅图郊区。

dysfunction.en: It can lead to workplace dysfunction and diminish their own job satisfaction.
dysfunction.zh: 这可能导致工作场所运行失衡，还会使他们自己的工作满意度降低。

dysfunction.en: But what's striking is the range of function and dysfunction.
dysfunction.zh: 但是，这种疾病最引人注目的是功能和功能障碍的范围。

dysfunction.en: And this returns us to the present dysfunction in Washington.
dysfunction.zh: 这个现象，使我们回归到现在的华盛顿乏力的问题上来。

patient.zh: 病人仍然拒不接受事实。

diabetes.en: He suffered from diabetes and gastric ulcers.
diabetes.zh: 他患有糖尿病和胃溃疡。

diabetes.en: My doctor wants me to be tested for diabetes.
diabetes.zh: 我的医生要我去做糖尿病检查。

diabetes.en: Blindness is a common complication of diabetes.
diabetes.zh: 失明是糖尿病常有的一种并发症。

paralyze.en: They just don't let it paralyze them.
paralyze.zh: 他们只是不会使其让自己处于被动。
对失败的恐惧感不会让他们停止向前。

paralyze.en: All the opinions and analysis will paralyze anyone who is not up to the task.
paralyze.zh: 所有的意见和分析都会使那些没有参与这项任务的人感到不知所措。

overweight.en: She was only a few pounds overweight.
There was no escaping the fact that he was overweight.
overweight.zh: 他身体超重这一事实是无法回避的。

hypertension.en: Obesity correlates with increased risk for hypertension and stroke.
hypertension.zh: 过度肥胖与高血压和中风的发病风险增加密切相关。

hypertension.en: Those who are overweight or indulge in high-salt diets are candidates for hypertension.
hypertension.zh: 那些身体超重或饮食偏咸的人属于易患高血压症的人群。

hypertension.en: Such is the stuff of hypertension and reckless driving.
hypertension.zh: 这就是高血压和鲁莽驾驶的原因。

obesity.en: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.
obesity.zh: 肥胖会增加患心脏病的危险。

obesity.en: Obesity correlates with increased risk for hypertension and stroke.
obesity.zh: 过度肥胖与高血压和中风的发病风险增加密切相关。

obesity.en: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality.
obesity.zh: 这项研究也证明了肥胖和死亡率之间的直接关系。

dizzy.en: Climbing so high made me feel dizzy.
dizzy.zh: 爬那么高使我感到头晕目眩。

insomnia.en: Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.
insomnia.zh: 抑郁症几乎总是伴有失眠。

insomnia.en: Acute insomnia means consistent inability to sleep well for a period of three weeks to six months.
insomnia.zh: 严重失眠意味着连续三周到六个月都睡不好觉。

insomnia.en: Telling yourself to stop being anxious when you're feeling anxious is a bit like telling yourself to fall asleep when you have insomnia—it doesn't work.
insomnia.zh: 当你感到焦虑时，告诉自己不要焦虑，这有点像当你失眠时，告诉自己要入睡一样——是行不通的。

allergy.en: I have an allergy to animal hair.
These are classical examples of food allergy.
allergy.zh: 这些是食物过敏的典型病例。

allergy.en: This type of allergy can very occasionally be fatal.
allergy.zh: 这类过敏症在极个别情况下有可能是致命的。

insane.en: The letter made her insane with jealousy.
insane.zh: 那封信使她妒忌得发疯。

insane.en: The boy is half insane with hysteria and self-indulgence.
insane.zh: 这个男孩歇斯底里、任性放纵，成了半个疯子了。

arthritis.zh: 她的双手因为关节炎而扭曲变形。
他的手因关节炎都扭曲了。

arthritis.en: I have a touch of arthritis in the wrist.
arthritis.zh: 我的手腕有轻微关节炎。

pimple.en: Will dotting toothpaste on a pimple get rid of it?
pimple.zh: 在痘痘上点涂牙膏能不能治好它？

pimple.en: Sometimes, it is better to remain unknown than to make pimple hate you.
pimple.zh: 有时，保持默默无闻比让人恨你要好得多。

pimple.en: Until then, expect pre-prom pimple conniptions to continue. —Katherine Harmon
pimple.zh: 在那之前，只能继续期待青春痘爆发提前结束。

flu.en: I'm glad that you're over the flu.
flu.zh: 我很高兴你的流感好了。

plague.en: It delves into everything from seasickness, jet lag and the hazards of camels to malaria and plague.
plague.zh: 它探究了从晕船、时差和骆驼的危害到疟疾和瘟疫的一切。

plague.en: Public health groups applauded the approved tax as a step toward fixing certain lasting health issues that plague Americans.
plague.zh: 公共卫生组织对批准的税收法案表示欢迎，认为这是在解决困扰美国人的某些长期健康问题方面迈出的一步。

plague.en: Iconoclasts, either because they were born that way or through learning, have found ways to work around the perceptual shortcuts that plague most people.
plague.zh: 要么天生如此，要么后天习得，总之传统叛逆者找到了困扰大多数人的认知捷径的替代方法。

stroke.zh: 他因中风身体局部瘫痪了。

stroke.en: The stroke left his right side permanently damaged.
stroke.zh: 中风使他的右半身永久受损。

stroke.en: Her idea was a stroke of genius.
stroke.zh: 她的主意是聪明的一着。

fever.en: He had an earache and a fever.
My Uncle Jim had a high fever.
fever.zh: 我的叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

headache.en: I woke up with a slight headache.

swell.en: Her arm was beginning to swell up where the bee had stung her.
swell.zh: 她胳膊给蜜蜂蜇了，肿了起来。

swell.en: When you develop a throat infection or catch a cold the glands in the neck swell up.
swell.zh: 当你咽喉发炎或感冒时, 脖子上的腺体会肿起来。

choke.en: Very small toys can choke a baby.
choke.zh: 很小的玩具可使婴儿窒息。

choke.en: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve.
choke.zh: 白兰地呛到他了，但恢复了他的勇气。

choke.en: The plant will soon choke ponds and waterways if left unchecked.
choke.zh: 如不控制这种植物的生长，池塘和水道很快就要被阻塞。

injure.en: You do not go out to injure opponents.
injure.zh: 你不会刻意去伤害对手。

injure.en: This could seriously injure the company's reputation.
injure.zh: 这会严重损害公司的声誉。

injure.en: When you use American weapons on your people, you injure us, too.
injure.zh: 当你对你的人民使用美国武器时，你也伤害了我们。

injury.zh: 由于伤病，希克斯被迫认输。

injury.en: Shrugging off her injury, she played on.
injury.zh: 她受了伤，却继续进行比赛。

bruise.en: How did you get that bruise on your cheek?
bruise.zh: 你脸颊上怎么有一块瘀伤？

bruise.en: Have you noticed that you bruise easily?
bruise.zh: 你是否注意到自己很容易受挫伤？

bruise.en: It's probably just the bruise, but it could be broken. So I'm going to say you to the hospital for an X-Ray.
bruise.zh: 可能只是擦伤，但也可能是骨折。所以我建议你去医院拍 X 光片。

bleed.en: One morning, the old man started to bleed.
bleed.zh: 有天早上，老人开始出血。

bleed.en: When winter arrives, my fingers split and bleed in the cold air.
bleed.zh: 在寒冷的冬天，我的手指会裂开流血。

bleed.en: The driver fled the scene of the accident, leaving the girl to bleed on the sidewalk.
bleed.zh: 司机逃离了事故现场，留下女孩在人行道上流血。

scar.en: He had a scar on his forehead.
The cut healed up without leaving a scar.

trauma.zh: 患者的大脑受到严重损伤。

trauma.en: He confronted his childhood trauma and tried to exorcize the pain.
trauma.zh: 他与童年时代的精神创伤对抗并试图祛除这种痛苦。

trauma.en: This would indicate that reparative therapy has the potential to help patients with advanced brain trauma to gain an improved quality of life.
trauma.zh: 这表明，修复性治疗有可能帮助晚期脑损伤患者获得更好的生活质量。

lump.en: I've got a lump on my shoulder.
She impaled a lump of meat on her fork.
The potter shaped and squeezed the lump of clay into a graceful shape.
lump.zh: 制陶工人把一块黏土塑形，压成漂亮的形状。

pain.en: If the world kisses you with pain, slap it right back!
pain.zh: 世界以痛吻你，你扇他巴掌啊！
疼痛正在一点一点地减弱。

demise.en: There is no point whatsoever in carefully placing our valuable artifacts in paper or card that is going to hasten their demise.
demise.zh: 小心地把我们珍贵的文物放在纸上或卡片上，这样做毫无意义，这会加速它们的灭亡。

demise.en: There is no point whatsoever in carefully placing our valuable artifacts in paper or cards that is going to hasten their demise.
demise.zh: 小心地把我们珍贵的文物放在纸上或卡片上的这种做法毫无意义，只会加速它们的灭亡。

demise.en: Indeed, most analysts believe that some kind of environmental degradation underlies the demise of many extinct salmon populations.
demise.zh: 事实上，大多数分析家认为某种环境退化是许多已灭绝鲑鱼种群消亡的根源。

mortal.en: The police were defending themselves and others against mortal danger.
mortal.zh: 警察在保卫他们自己和其他人免受致命的危险。

mortal.en: They were not elfin maidens, but mortal children.
mortal.zh: 她们不是山妖，而是凡人的孩子。

death.zh: 医生们对死亡变得习以为常。

doom.en: Does this spell the doom of the physical book?
doom.zh: 这是否意味着实体书的末日？

doom.en: "Proud and insolent youth," said Hook, "prepare to meet thy doom."
doom.zh: “傲慢无礼的年轻人，”胡克说，“准备迎接你的厄运吧。”

doom.en: Why are people so full of gloom and doom?
doom.zh: 人们的心里为什么满是悲观失望？

lethal.en: The barriers are lethal to fish trying to swim upstream.
lethal.zh: 这些障碍物对于逆流而上的鱼来说是致命的。

lethal.en: They were close to weaponizing ricin - a lethal plant toxin.
lethal.zh: 他们快把蓖麻毒素——一种致命的植物毒素——研发成武器了。

lethal.en: The potentially lethal device was made from a length of hose packed with gunpowder, primers, and shrapnel.
lethal.zh: 这个能致命的装置是用一根装满火药、引信和弹片的软管做出来的。

fatal.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
fatal.zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

fatal.en: Even moderate amounts of the drug can be fatal.
fatal.zh: 这种药的用量即使不很大也会致命。

fatal.en: It is impossible to say who struck the fatal blow.
fatal.zh: 不可能确定是谁给了那致命的一击。

corpus.en: The two halves are linked by a trunkline of between 200 and 300 million nerves, the corpus callosum.
corpus.zh: 两半部分由2到3亿条神经组成的主干连接，即胼胝体。

corpus.en: Research showed that these two halves of the brain had different functions, and that the corpus callosum enabled them to work together.
corpus.zh: 研究表明，大脑的这两个半球具有不同的功能，胼胝体使它们能够一起工作。

corpus.en: Scientists have found quite recently that the corpus callosum in women is always larger and probably richer in nerve fibres than it is in men.
corpus.zh: 科学家最近发现，女性的胼胝体总是比男性更大，神经纤维可能也更丰富。

overwork.en: His illness was brought on by money worries and overwork.
overwork.zh: 他的病是因操心钱和劳累过度而造成的。
过度紧张的工作使得他更加消瘦了。

overwork.en: Overwork and exhaustion are the opposite of resilience and the bad habits we acquire when we're young only magnify when we hit the workforce.
overwork.zh: 复原力与过度劳累和精力衰竭恰恰相反，进入职场后，我们年轻时养成的坏习惯只会不断放大。

fatigue.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
fatigue.zh: 这个事故是驾驶员疲劳所致。

fatigue.en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
fatigue.zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

fatigue.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
fatigue.zh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

feeble.en: Don't be so feeble! Tell her you don't want to go.
feeble.zh: 别那么软弱了！告诉她你不想去。

feeble.en: At last a feeble voice replied, "Thank you so much, dear Ratty!"
feeble.zh: 最后，一个微弱无力的声音回答道：“非常感谢你，亲爱的鼠仔！”

weary.zh: 雷切尔看起来苍白而疲惫。
她突然感到了衰老和疲倦。
她的脸色显得憔悴疲惫。

exhaust.zh: 我的汽车需要一个新排气管。

faint.zh: 炎热使他觉得快要晕倒了。
他的耳朵听到微弱的哭声。

weaken.en: Nothing could weaken his resolve to continue.
weaken.zh: 什么也不能削弱他继续下去的决心。

weaken.en: He accused them of conniving with foreign companies to weaken employment rights.
weaken.zh: 他指控他们与外国公司共谋来削弱雇用权。

uncomfortable.zh: 有一种令人不安的寂静。
他看起来既窘迫又不自在。

uncomfortable.en: I was sitting in an extremely uncomfortable position.
uncomfortable.zh: 我坐着的姿势难受极了。

unconscious.zh: 那年轻人仰面倒下，不省人事。

unconscious.en: He had drunk himself unconscious on vodka.
unconscious.zh: 他喝伏特加酒喝得不省人事。

chronic.zh: 他经受着长期的、近乎病态的嫉妒。

chronic.en: The illness frequently coexists with other chronic diseases.
chronic.zh: 这种病往往与其他慢性病同时存在。

acute.en: There is an acute shortage of water.

acute.zh: 他的身体因严重的肾衰竭而垮掉了。

sore.en: His feet were sore after the walk.

sorrow.zh: 悲剧性文学使悲伤和灾难显得尊贵。

sorrow.en: They said that the decision was made more in sorrow than in anger.
sorrow.zh: 他们说作出这个决定，与其说是出于气愤，不如说是出于悲伤。
悲伤使他的头发变白了。
