astound.en: The ease of use will astound you.
This exhibit was not designed to astound but to interest.
astound.zh: 这个展览并非要让任何人惊奇，只是想让人们感兴趣。

amazing.zh: 顺便提一句，这台机器简直太了不起了。

amazing.en: I find it amazing that they're still together.
amazing.zh: 他们还在一起，这使我大吃一惊。

hectic.zh: 这个周末忙乱得一塌糊涂。

hectic.en: My life was very hectic but empty before I met him.
hectic.zh: 我的生活在遇见他之前忙碌却空虚。

hectic.en: It seems to ease all the aches and pains of a hectic and tiring day.
hectic.zh: 它似乎可以减轻繁忙疲劳的一天带来的所有疼痛。

liberal.en: I hadn't got him marked down as a liberal.
liberal.zh: 我当时还没有把他看作自由主义者。

liberal.en: She is seeking more liberal visitation with her daughter.
liberal.zh: 她正在寻求对女儿更自由的探视权。

liberal.en: Some politicians want more liberal trade relations with Europe.
liberal.zh: 有些政治家想与欧洲大陆建立更加自由的贸易关系。

generous.zh: 他是一个慷慨大方、勇于自我牺牲的人。

generous.en: They are very generous givers to charity.
generous.zh: 他们是慈善事业的慷慨捐助者。

gentle.en: He was a very gentle boy at heart.
gentle.zh: 他实际上是一个非常温和的男孩。
这些诗显示出她温柔的一面。

gentle.en: This soap is very gentle on the hands.
gentle.zh: 这肥皂擦在手上非常柔和。

humble.en: He always makes much of his humble origins.
humble.zh: 他总是非常在意他卑微的出身。

humble.en: His views come from his own humble beginnings.
humble.zh: 他的观点源自于他卑微的出身。

humble.en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble.
humble.zh: 他的表演很精彩，但他却很谦逊。

modest.zh: 她对自己的成功非常谦虚。

modest.en: He's modest, as well as being a great player.
modest.zh: 他是一个谦虚而且出色的运动员。

humorous.en: He was quite humorous, and I liked that about him.
humorous.zh: 他很幽默，我喜欢他这一点。

humorous.en: The writing is brutally tough and savagely humorous.
humorous.zh: 该作品文笔痛快地犀利和极端地幽默。

humorous.en: Script editors are all juiced up over the humorous potential.
humorous.zh: 剧本编辑们全都因剧本潜在的幽默性而兴奋起来了。

polite.en: We were all too polite to object.
polite.zh: 我们都太客气了，没有反对。
我们说了些客气呆板的套话。

polite.en: She forced herself to be polite to them.

frank.zh: 那些谈话不留情面地坦率。

frank.en: Frank rasped a hand across his chin.
frank.zh: 弗兰克用一只手蹭着下巴发出擦擦的声音。

mysterious.en: A mysterious young woman is living next door.
mysterious.zh: 一位神秘的年轻女子住在隔壁。

mysterious.en: The water is very deep and mysterious looking.
mysterious.zh: 水很深，而且看起来很神秘。

curious.en: "I'm not meddling," Ken said mildly, "I'm just curious."
curious.zh: “我不是在管闲事，”肯温和地说，“我只是好奇。”

curious.en: Steve was intensely curious about the world I came from.
curious.zh: 史蒂夫对我是从哪里来的有强烈的好奇心。

curious.en: They entered the shop, which was a curious ramshackle building.
curious.zh: 他们走进商店，那是一所奇怪、摇摇欲坠的房子。

daring.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
daring.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

daring.en: The gallery was known for putting on daring exhibitions.
daring.zh: 该画廊以其举办的大胆画展而享有盛名。

daring.en: There are plenty of activities at the resort for the less daring.
daring.zh: 度假胜地有许多活动是供不太敢于冒险的人玩的。

manly.en: His manly figure was adorned and enriched by a beautiful pair of donkey's ears.
manly.zh: 他的男子气概被一双美丽的驴耳朵修饰的更加饱满。

manly.en: He set himself manly tasks and expected others to follow his example.
manly.zh: 他给自己安排了体现男子气概的任务，并期待其他人去效仿他。

manly.en: Manly Tooker and Nathaniel Salisbury are mentioned as early preachers.
manly.zh: 曼利·图克和纳撒尼尔·索尔兹伯里被认为是早期的传教士。

earnest.en: The earnest young doctor answered all our questions.
earnest.zh: 这个认真的年轻医生回答了我们所有的问题。

earnest.en: I could tell she spoke in earnest.
earnest.zh: 我看得出她是郑重其事地说的。

honesty.zh: 她的诚实是毋庸置疑的。
他的诚实是毋庸置疑的。
我可以担保她为人诚实。

direct.en: She prefers to act rather than direct.
direct.zh: 她宁愿当演员，不愿当导演。
克里斯托弗将指挥日常工作。

proud.en: She must be very proud of herself.
It's something you'll be mighty proud of.
proud.zh: 这是个你会非常骄傲的事。

proud.en: They are rightly proud of their children.
proud.zh: 他们当然为他们的孩子而骄傲。

seriously.zh: 我希望你认真对待我的话。
他是被严重低估的一位作家。

hospitable.en: The man is very hospitable; he keeps open house for his friends and fellow-workers.
hospitable.zh: 那人十分好客，无论是他的朋友还是同事，他都盛情接待。

hospitable.en: The author thinks her friend made a rational decision in choosing a more hospitable place over an apparently elegant assisted living home.
hospitable.zh: 作者认为她的朋友做出了一个理性的决定，选择了一个更热情友好的地方，而不是一个表面上雅致的养老院。

freedom.zh: 他滔滔不绝地谈论着自由。
我们决不可低估自由的价值。
她体味到了她新获得的自由。

romantic.zh: 这部电影是一个浪漫喜剧。
你是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。
他们演唱了一首缓慢的浪漫歌曲。

careful.zh: 小心—你弄乱我的头发了。
这次旅行需要认真计划。
这份报告值得仔细阅读。

considerate.en: It was very considerate of him to wait.
considerate.zh: 他一直在等候着，真是体贴人。

considerate.en: He was charming, considerate and impeccably mannered.
considerate.zh: 他富有魅力，待人体贴，举止无可挑剔。

considerate.en: She is always polite and considerate towards her employees.
considerate.zh: 她对待雇员总是客客气气，关心体谅。

thoughtful.en: He scratched his head and looked thoughtful.
thoughtful.zh: 他挠着头显出一副深思的样子。

thoughtful.en: Douglas was a complex man, thoughtful, gallant, and generous.
thoughtful.zh: 道格拉斯是个复杂的男人，他体贴、殷勤而且慷慨。

sympathetic.en: Tourists are, in the main, sympathetic people.
sympathetic.zh: 游客们大都是有同情心的人。

sympathetic.en: I did not feel at all sympathetic towards Kate.
sympathetic.zh: 我对凯特一点也不同情。

sympathetic.en: She was very sympathetic to the problems of adult students.
sympathetic.zh: 她对成年学生的问题很同情。

apologize.zh: 我是不是应该打电话向他道歉？

ready.zh: 大家都准备好了吗？开演！
摄影机准备好了吗？好，开拍！

apology.zh: 我认为得有人向我们道歉。
我们收到了一封道歉信。
我的道歉好像使他感到满意。

mercy.en: It's a mercy she wasn't seriously hurt.
They showed no mercy to their hostages.
mercy.zh: 他们对人质丝毫不讲仁慈。

admire.zh: 我们中途停下来欣赏一下风景。
我钦佩他办事认真仔细。

remarkable.zh: 她是一位真正非同凡响的女人。

grateful.zh: 凯特感激地对他笑了笑。

grateful.en: I am deeply grateful to my parents.

gratitude.zh: 他向他们笑了笑表示谢意。

gratitude.en: I owe a debt of gratitude to all my family.
Her arms tightened about his neck in gratitude.
gratitude.zh: 她的双臂紧紧搂住他的脖子，充满感激。

eager.en: He was eager to get into politics.
Robert was eager to talk about life in the Army.
eager.zh: 罗伯特渴望谈论军旅生活。

eager.en: He was eager to communicate his ideas to the group.
eager.zh: 他急于把他的想法传达给小组。

picturesque.en: Our journey takes us to picturesque Berber villages and lovely beaches.
picturesque.zh: 在旅程中，我们去了风景如画的柏柏尔村庄和可爱的海滩。

picturesque.en: They may be picturesque, even poetical; or they may be pedestrian, even trivial.
picturesque.zh: 它们也许如画一般，甚至富有诗意；或者它们可能平庸，甚至微不足道。

picturesque.en: Aside from the picturesque scenery of Sichuan province, the dishes there is also an attraction to tourists.
picturesque.zh: 除了四川如画的风景以外，川菜对游客也很有吸引力。

promising.en: He was voted most promising new director.
promising.zh: 他当选为最有前途的新导演。

promising.en: She shamed her father into promising more help.
promising.zh: 她使父亲感到过意不去，只好答应多给她些帮助。

promising.en: She is among the most promising players in her age group.
promising.zh: 在她那个年龄组中她是最有前途的选手之一。

sound.zh: 听你这口气，你自己也不大肯定。
数码录音的声音效果极佳。

prominent.en: He had an angular face with prominent cheekbones.
prominent.zh: 他有一张颧骨突出、棱角分明的脸。

prominent.en: He went on to earn a prominent professorial position.
prominent.zh: 他接着得到了一个著名的教授职位。

prominent.en: Here the window plays a prominent part in the design.
prominent.zh: 这里，窗户在设计中有着突出的作用。

awesome.en: I just bought this awesome new CD!
awesome.zh: 我刚买了这张特棒的新CD！

arduous.en: We must have patience in doing arduous work.
arduous.zh: 我们做艰苦的工作要有耐性。

arduous.en: He never seeks credit for himself, but is always ready to take on arduous tasks.
arduous.zh: 他在荣誉面前从不伸手，但在艰巨任务面前却当仁不让。

robust.en: She was almost 90, but still very robust.
robust.zh: 她将近90岁了，但身体仍然十分强健。

robust.en: He was always the robust one, physically strong and mentally sharp.
robust.zh: 他一向是个健壮的人，身体强壮、头脑敏锐。
他以典型的坚定风格作答。

sturdy.en: She was a short, sturdy woman in her early sixties.
sturdy.zh: 她是一位六十出头、矮小结实的女人。

sturdy.en: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.
sturdy.zh: 如果你必须爬上去，就用一个稳固的平台或者一个结实的梯子。

sturdy.en: They would peel large sheets of bark from the tree to form lightweight yet sturdy canoes.
sturdy.zh: 他们会从树上剥下大片的树皮，做成轻便而结实的独木舟。

tough.en: Who said these green beans are tough? They're amazing!
tough.zh: 谁说这豆角老啊，这豆角可太好了。
粗花呢从不过时，手感很好，结实耐磨。

steadfast.en: The twin lights, the shifting grey and the steadfast red, mastered the Water Rat and held him bound, fascinated, powerless.
steadfast.zh: 变幻莫测的灰色和坚定不变的红色，这两道光芒控制住了河鼠，使他处于动弹不得，痴痴迷迷，又无能为力的状态。

steadfast.en: He remained steadfast in his belief that he had done the right thing.
steadfast.zh: 他仍然坚信自己做了正确的事情。

steadfast.en: He remained steadfast in his determination to bring the killers to justice.
steadfast.zh: 他要将杀人凶手绳之以法的决心一直没有动摇。

tender.en: Her voice was tender, full of pity.
tender.zh: 她的声音很温柔，充满了怜悯。

tender.en: He was warm and tender towards her.

temperate.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
temperate.zh: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

temperate.en: Although these vegetables adapt well to our temperate climate, they tend to crop poorly.
temperate.zh: 虽然这些蔬菜能够适应我们这里的温和气候，但它们的产量常常不高。

temperate.en: Much human cultural development took place in temperate regions.
temperate.zh: 许多人类文化的发展发生在温带地区。

delicate.en: The name Latifah, by the way, means "delicate."
delicate.zh: 顺便提一下，Latifah这个名字有“精致”之意。

mundane.zh: 我过着相当平淡的生活。
她的生活很平静，几乎有些枯燥。

mundane.en: On a more mundane level, can we talk about the timetable for next week?
mundane.zh: 说点儿实际的吧，我们能谈谈下周的时间安排吗？

naive.en: Their approach to life is refreshingly naive.
naive.zh: 他们对待生活的态度天真率直，令人耳目一新。

naive.en: Their view was that he had been politically naive.
naive.zh: 他们的看法是，他在政治上曾是幼稚的。

naive.en: It's naive to think that teachers are always tolerant.
naive.zh: 认为老师总是很宽容是幼稚的。

childish.zh: 她真是小孩子气，太冒失了。

childish.en: It's time you put a stop to this childish behaviour.
childish.zh: 这种孩子气的行为你该收敛了。

sincere.en: He seemed sincere enough when he said he wanted to help.
sincere.zh: 他表示愿意帮忙，样子很真诚。

sincere.en: He had a way of sounding so sincere. It made me warm and tingly.
sincere.zh: 他的话听起来如此真诚。这让我觉得温暖而舒心。

sincere.en: The author didn't think Juan was sincere.
sincere.zh: 作者不认为胡安是真诚的。

liable.en: Tenants are jointly and severally liable for payment of the rent.
liable.zh: 租金由承租人共同且分别承担。

liable.en: You will be liable for any damage caused.
liable.zh: 你必须对造成的任何损失负赔偿责任。

liable.en: Offenders are liable to fines of up to $500.
liable.zh: 违者可能被处以最多500元的罚款。

enterprising.en: What would this energetic, enterprising country be without new lands to conquer?
enterprising.zh: 如果没有新的大陆可以征服，这个充满活力和进取精神的国家会是什么样子？

enterprising.en: He is upright, optimistic, active and enterprising, striving for truthfulness, kindness and beauty, and seeking for an ideal society all his life.
enterprising.zh: 他正直、乐观向上、积极进取。他一生都在追求真、善、美，一生都在追求理想的社会。

enterprising.en: To realize this vision, Ricci is mounting one of the most lavish, enterprising—and expensive—promotional campaigns in magazine-publishing history.
enterprising.zh: 为了实现这一愿景，利玛窦正在进行杂志出版史上最奢华、最进取、最昂贵的促销活动之一。

trustworthy.en: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
trustworthy.zh: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

trustworthy.en: This occurs because they're perceived to be fair and trustworthy.
trustworthy.zh: 之所以出现这种情况，是因为他们被认为是公平的、值得信赖的。

trustworthy.en: I used to think Emily was honest and trustworthy, but now I know better.
trustworthy.zh: 我曾经认为艾米丽是诚实和值得信赖的，但现在我更清楚了。

sane.en: Did he come across as a sane, rational person?
sane.zh: 他看上去是不是一个头脑清醒而理智的人？

sane.en: No sane person wishes to see conflict or casualties.
sane.zh: 理智的人都不希望看到冲突或伤亡。

sane.en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane.
sane.zh: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然神智清醒。

strenuous.en: Strenuous efforts had been made to improve conditions in the jail.
strenuous.zh: 为改善那家监狱里的条件已做了艰苦的努力。

strenuous.en: Richard Long's A Line Made By Walking, however, involved nothing more strenuous than a 20-minute train ride from Waterloo.
strenuous.zh: 然而，理查德·朗的《行走的路线》并不比从滑铁卢坐20分钟火车更费力。

strenuous.en: She made strenuous efforts to tame her anger.

rigorous.en: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
rigorous.zh: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

rigorous.en: Was it a curriculum that appeared more rigorous, perhaps?
rigorous.zh: 或许，这是一门看起来更严格的课程？

rigorous.en: All vitamin supplements would be evaluated in scientifically rigorous clinical trials.
rigorous.zh: 所有维生素补充剂都会经过科学严格的临床试验评估。

strict.zh: 法国的隐私法非常严格。

mutual.en: We met at the home of a mutual friend.
mutual.zh: 我们在彼此都认识的朋友家中会面。

mutual.en: Mutual trust is the bedrock of a relationship.
mutual.zh: 相互信任是建立关系的基础。

mutual.en: Our relationship was based on mutual dependence.
mutual.zh: 我们的关系建立在相互依存的基础上。

severe.zh: 患者的大脑受到严重损伤。
他们预言将会有一次严重的经济衰退。

severe.en: If untreated, the illness can become severe.
severe.zh: 若不加以治疗，病情就可能会变得很严重。

similar.zh: 他们有着出奇相似的嗓音。

similar.en: They themselves had had a similar experience.
similar.zh: 他们本身就曾有过类似的经历。

resemble.en: Stunt people must resemble the stars they stand in for.
resemble.zh: 特技演员必须和他们所替身的明星长相相似。

resemble.en: During winter evenings, Paris's streetlamps have a halo and resemble dandelions.
resemble.zh: 在冬天的夜晚，巴黎的街灯有一个光环，像蒲公英。

resemble.en: Gina is the exact opposite of her little sister, though they resemble each other in appearance.
resemble.zh: 尽管她们长得很像，但是吉娜和她妹妹截然不同。

familiar.zh: 他低声哼着一支熟悉的小曲。

familiar.en: He felt a longing for the familiar.

naked.en: Most stars are not visible to the naked eye.
naked.zh: 大多数星星肉眼看不见。

naked.en: It sounds inconceivable but is the naked truth.
naked.zh: 这听起来不可思议，但却是赤裸裸的事实。

intuition.zh: 她的得体和直觉从不出错。

intuition.en: Her intuition was telling her that something was wrong.
intuition.zh: 她的直觉在告诉她事情有些不对头。
直觉可能会影响反思性任务。

private.zh: 我藏起了我的私人文件。

bare.en: The hills above the valley are bare rock.
bare.zh: 河谷上面的山是光秃秃的岩石。

spontaneous.en: "Now my extroverted behaviour is spontaneous," he says.
spontaneous.zh: “现在我的外向行为是自发的。”他说。

spontaneous.en: When they got up, the whole place broke out into spontaneous applause.
spontaneous.zh: 当他们站起来时，全场爆发出自发的掌声。

imaginary.zh: 许多孩子都有假想的朋友。
很多儿童都有一个假想朋友。

imaginary.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
imaginary.zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

illusion.en: No matter how beautiful the illusion, it remains a dream.
Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
illusion.zh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

illusion.en: The idea of absolute personal freedom is an illusion.
illusion.zh: 绝对个人自由的观念是一种幻想。

implicit.en: Recent research on consumer memory and judgment suggests another advantage of implicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 最近关于消费者记忆和判断的研究显示了隐含结论的另一个优势。

implicit.en: Despite these advantages, implicit conclusions may not always be more effective than explicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 尽管有这些优势，隐性结论并不总是比显性结论更有效。

implicit.en: Because consumers are invited to make up their own minds, implicit conclusions reduce the risk of resentment, distrust, and counterargumentation.
implicit.zh: 因为邀请消费者自主决定，所以隐含的结论减少了怨恨、不信任和反驳的风险。

fancy.en: So you fancy yourself as the boss someday?
fancy.zh: 那么你认为自己有一天会成老板？

fancy.en: Do you fancy a jar after work?
fancy.zh: 下班后去喝一杯怎么样？

agony.zh: 他极度痛苦地瘫倒在地。

agony.en: He fell awkwardly and went down in agony clutching his right knee.
agony.zh: 他笨拙地摔倒了，紧抓住右膝盖痛苦地蹲了下去。

fate.en: My fate is neither up to me nor up to heaven.

fate.zh: 她的命运与他的交织在一起。

fate.en: I see no use arguing with fate.
fate.zh: 我认为与命运抗争没有什么用。

fortune.zh: 他是如何聚集起他的财富的？

fortune.en: He amassed a fortune from silver mining.
fortune.zh: 他靠开采银矿积累了一笔财富。

fortune.en: She inherited a fortune from her father.
fortune.zh: 她从她父亲那里继承了一大笔财富。

grief.en: For months he was prostrated with grief.
grief.zh: 他好几个月都悲痛不已。

grief.en: Julia's soft heart was touched by his grief.
grief.zh: 朱莉娅心肠软，见他悲伤动了恻隐之心。

grief.en: In a strange way she seemed ennobled by her grief.
grief.zh: 奇怪的是，忧伤使她显得更加高贵。

grieve.en: I didn't have any time to grieve.
Relatives need time to grieve over loved ones they have lost.
grieve.zh: 亲属需要时间痛悼他们失去的至爱。

grieve.en: He decided not to take his medicine, so as to grieve Wendy.
grieve.zh: 他决定不吃药，好让温迪伤心。

miserable.zh: 他们到头来把自己弄惨了。

miserable.en: Their early success was succeeded by a period of miserable failure.
miserable.zh: 他们起初获得成功，但随后有一段惨痛失败的时期。

distress.en: She was obviously in distress after the attack.
distress.zh: 她受到攻击后显然很痛苦。

distress.en: Widows seem to experience more distress than widowers.
distress.zh: 寡妇似乎比鳏夫感受更多痛苦。

distress.en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
distress.zh: 他经常去帮助这位处于痛苦中的少女。

sadness.en: There was more than a hint of sadness in his voice.
sadness.zh: 他的声音中流露出了深切的悲伤。

sadness.en: Levin sat there, an expression of sadness on his face.
sadness.zh: 莱文坐在那里，神情忧伤。

sadness.en: Arnold could detect a certain sadness in the old man's face.
sadness.zh: 阿诺德能察觉到老人脸上的某种悲伤。

gloomy.en: They found him in a gloomy, downbeat mood.
gloomy.zh: 他们发现他心情沮丧而消沉。

gloomy.en: Officials say the outlook for next year is gloomy.
gloomy.zh: 官员们称来年前景暗淡。

gloomy.en: Suddenly, the future didn't look so gloomy after all.
gloomy.zh: 突然感到前途似乎并非如此黯淡。

disappoint.zh: 他最近发表的这部小说没有使人失望。

disappoint.en: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
disappoint.zh: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

discourage.en: His parents tried to discourage him from being an actor.
discourage.zh: 他的父母试图阻止他去当演员。

discourage.en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
discourage.zh: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

discourage.en: This greatly surprised him, but did not discourage him.
discourage.zh: 这使他大为吃惊，但并没有使他气馁。

frustrating.en: I felt sorry for him and his colleagues – it must have been so frustrating for them.
frustrating.zh: 我很同情他和他的同事们–这对他们来说肯定是非常令人沮丧。

wretched.en: She finally agreed to have the wretched animal put down.
wretched.zh: 她最后同意用药结束这头可怜的动物的生命。

wretched.en: The wretched Hatter trembled so, that he shook both his shoes off.
wretched.zh: 可怜的帽商听到这话，吓得浑身发抖，连两只鞋都抖掉了。
你看起来愁眉苦脸的，怎么啦？

mourn.en: He does not mourn the demise of that world liberated from court etiquette, he says, he can call someone an "idiot" if he wants, instead of "Your Excellency".
mourn.zh: 他说，他不会为这个从宫廷礼仪中解放出来的世界的消亡而哀悼，如果他愿意，他可以称某人为“白痴”，而不是“阁下”。

mourn.en: They mourn the passing of a simpler way of life.
mourn.zh: 他们对逝去的较为淳朴的生活感到惋惜。

mourn.en: Today we mourn for all those who died in two world wars.
mourn.zh: 今天，我们向所有在两次世界大战中死难的人表示哀悼。

anger.zh: 他眼里冒着强压的怒火。
强压的怒火在他眼里燃烧。

furious.en: He risked a glance at her furious face.
furious.zh: 他壮着胆子瞅了瞅她那张愤怒的脸。

furious.en: The miners were furious and threatened to walk out.
furious.zh: 矿工们很愤怒，威胁要罢工。

furious.en: She drove off at a furious pace.

frown.zh: 她一皱眉，额头显出了皱纹。

frown.en: She looked up with a puzzled frown.
frown.zh: 她困惑地皱着眉抬头看。

frown.en: His forehead was bunched in a frown.

irritate.en: Some drugs can irritate the lining of the stomach.
irritate.zh: 有些药物会刺激胃内壁。

irritate.en: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
irritate.zh: 剁辣椒时戴上橡皮手套，因为它们会刺激皮肤。

irritate.en: In fact, this may irritate some people.
irritate.zh: 事实上，这可能会激怒一些人。

hatred.en: Often her feelings were nearer hatred than love.
hatred.zh: 她的感情往往更像是恨，而不是爱。

hatred.en: He felt hatred for the students who did not know the value of hard work.
hatred.zh: 他憎恨那些不懂得努力学习的价值的学生。

hatred.en: It manifests itself in hatred, stereotypes, prejudice, and discrimination.
hatred.zh: 它表现为仇恨、成见、偏见和歧视。

nuisance.en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
nuisance.zh: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

hate.en: Above all else I hate the cold.

vex.en: Waltz, nymph, for quick jigs vex Bud.
vex.zh: 女神，轻快的华尔兹激怒了巴德。

vex.en: Hereafter, we must be cautious how we vex her.
vex.zh: 从今以后，我们一定要小心不去惹她了。

vex.en: Arthas: The ranger woman is starting to vex me greatly.
vex.zh: 阿尔塞斯：这个女守护者开始令我感到厌烦了。

disgust.zh: 有些人厌恶地大声嚷嚷。

harass.en: He has sent hither swarms of officers to harass our people.
harass.zh: 他派遣大批官员到这里骚扰我们的人民。

harass.en: We've got a few small Green Peace boats that we harass the dumping ship with.
harass.zh: 我们有几艘 Green Peace 的船只，用来侵扰那艘倾倒垃圾的船。

harass.en: He will bring up your past to haunt and harass you.
harass.zh: 他将带你回到从前，困扰和骚扰你。

bore.zh: 埃玛生了个儿子，取名卡尔。
他是一个非常令人讨厌的家伙。

troublesome.en: Tom's whole class were of a pattern--restless, noisy, and troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 汤姆的整个班级都是一个模式——躁动不安、吵吵闹闹、麻烦不断。

troublesome.en: When it does rain, it tends to be a very light rain that isn't troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 下雨了一般也是小雨，不会造成太大的麻烦。

troublesome.en: It was a tedious and troublesome piece of work, but he finished it at last.
troublesome.zh: 这是一件乏味而麻烦的工作，但他终于完成了。

bother.en: I hope I haven't been a bother.
She did not bother to keep up with the news.
bother.zh: 她不愿操心去了解新闻。

bother.en: I usually buy sliced bread – it's less bother.
bother.zh: 我通常买切片面包–这样可以少些麻烦。

unpleasant.en: She thought he was an unpleasant man.
unpleasant.zh: 她曾认为他是个令人不愉快的人。

unpleasant.en: We hope to prevent anything unpleasant from happening.
unpleasant.zh: 我们希望防止任何不愉快的事发生。

unpleasant.en: The symptoms can be uncomfortable, unpleasant and serious.
unpleasant.zh: 其症状会是令人不舒服、不愉快且严重的。

awful.zh: 可怕的事实慢慢地清晰起来。

adverse.en: This drug is known to have adverse side effects.
adverse.zh: 众所周知，这种药具有不良副作用。

adverse.en: The improper use of medicine could lead to severe adverse reactions.
adverse.zh: 用药不当会引起严重的不良反应。

adverse.en: Lack of money will have an adverse effect on our research programme.
adverse.zh: 缺少资金将对我们的研究方案有不利影响。

hostile.en: It depends what you mean by 'hostile'.
hostile.zh: 那得看你所说的hostile的含义。

hostile.en: He was disheartened by their hostile reaction.
hostile.zh: 他被他们敌意的反应弄得灰心了。

hostile.en: She fixed her questioner with a hostile glare.
hostile.zh: 她敌意地瞪着向她提问的人。

indignant.en: They were indignant that they hadn't been invited.
indignant.zh: 他们因没有受到邀请而愤愤不平。

indignant.en: Imagine that you know you're an evil git, but you know that the person you're playing against or with, is an indignant angel.
indignant.zh: 想象一下，你知道你是个邪恶的卑鄙小人，但是，你知道，和你一起玩或对抗的人是一个愤愤不平的天使。

indignant.en: He was indignant that his rival was offered the job.
indignant.zh: 他对他的对手得到了那份工作感到愤愤不平。

radical.en: It was a radical departure from tradition.
radical.zh: 这从根本上违背了传统。

radical.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
Such a radical proposal would never get through Congress.
radical.zh: 如此激进的提案永远不会在国会获得通过。

wicked.en: Jane has a wicked sense of humour.
wicked.zh: 简有一种恶作剧的幽默感。

wicked.en: The judge liked using the word "wicked" of people he had sent to jail.
wicked.zh: 那位法官喜欢用“邪恶的”这个词来形容他判决入狱的人。

crazy.zh: 那噪声吵得我快发疯了。

vicious.en: We need to break the vicious cycle of violence and counterviolence.
vicious.zh: 我们需要结束暴力和反暴力的恶性循环。

vicious.en: Their loss was partly due to a vicious price war between manufacturers that has cut margins to the bone.
vicious.zh: 他们的亏损部分是因为制造商之间把利润空间削减到了极点的一场恶性价格战。

vicious.en: The more pesticides are used, the more resistant the insects become so the more pesticides have to be used. It's a vicious circle.
vicious.zh: 杀虫剂使用得越多，那些昆虫的抵抗力越强，因此就要使用更多的杀虫剂。这是一个恶性循环。

vulgar.en: I think it's a very vulgar house.
vulgar.zh: 我认为这是一栋很俗气的房子。

vulgar.en: I think that is the most vulgar and tasteless remark I have ever heard in my life.
vulgar.zh: 我认为那是我平生听到过的最庸俗没品位的话。

vulgar.en: The speaker played to the gallery by indulging in vulgar jokes.
vulgar.zh: 为了哗众取宠，那位演讲者大讲特讲粗俗的笑话。

selfish.en: Do you think I'm being selfish by not letting her go?
selfish.zh: 你觉得我不让她走是自私吗？

ego.zh: 超人的第二自我是克拉克•肯特。

ego.en: He has the biggest ego of anyone I've ever met.
ego.zh: 他是我所见的最自负的人。

ego.en: His ego allows him to be humble, if you see what I mean.
ego.zh: 他的自我使他谦卑，如果你能明白我所说的意思。

nasty.en: He had a temper and could be nasty.
nasty.zh: 他脾气暴躁，会令人讨厌。

nasty.en: Ticks can carry a nasty disease which affects humans.
nasty.zh: 壁虱可传播危害人类的严重疾病。

rash.en: Her face broke out in a rash.
rash.zh: 她脸上突然长出一片红疹。

volatile.en: The blast occurred when volatile chemicals exploded.
volatile.zh: 冲击波是在易挥发的化学品爆炸时产生的。

volatile.en: It is like the sense of chill that follows immersion of the hand in a volatile liquid.
volatile.zh: 这很像把手浸入挥发性液体后的那种凉飕飕的感觉。

excessive.en: Excessive conformity is usually caused by fear of disapproval.
excessive.zh: 过分随大流通常是由于担心不被认同造成的。

excessive.en: Excessive pressure can lead to perforation of the stomach wall.
excessive.zh: 过大的压力会导致胃壁穿孔。

excessive.en: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
excessive.zh: 警方坚决否认曾过度使用武力。

weird.zh: 这音乐有些地方有点怪。

anxiety.zh: 她因焦虑而面露忧心之色。

anxiety.en: Anxiety can be caused by lack of sleep.
anxiety.zh: 睡眠不足可能导致焦虑。

restless.en: My father seemed very restless and excited.
restless.zh: 我父亲似乎非常坐立不安和兴奋。

restless.en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
restless.zh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

uneasy.zh: 莫莉不自在地微微窃笑了一下。

uneasy.en: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
uneasy.zh: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

uneasy.en: He looked uneasy and refused to answer questions.
uneasy.zh: 他看起来心神不安，并且拒绝回答问题。

timid.en: Normally timid, they rarely stray far from their burrows.
timid.zh: 它们通常很胆小，极少远离自己的洞穴。

timid.en: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.
timid.zh: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小的时候就已经学会了顺从。

timid.en: A timid voice said at her side.
timid.zh: 她身边一个胆怯的声音说。

fear.zh: 那是种完全合乎逻辑的恐惧。
恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

insult.en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you.
insult.zh: 请原谅我，我不是有意侮辱你。

insult.en: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent.
insult.zh: 他们的行为是对他们所代表的人们的一种侮辱。

fuss.en: Don't fuss, Mum, everything is all right.
fuss.zh: 别瞎操心了，妈妈，一切都好。

fuss.en: All that fuss over a few pounds!
fuss.zh: 为几英镑就那么大惊小怪的！

fuss.en: It was all a fuss about nothing.
fuss.zh: 这完全是无谓地自寻烦恼。

unkind.en: It's not in his nature to be unkind.
He was never actually unkind to them.
unkind.zh: 其实他从没有对他们不好。

unkind.en: It would be unkind to go without him.
unkind.zh: 甩掉他那就太不够朋友了。

envy.en: I envy you having such a close family.
envy.zh: 我羡慕你有这么一个亲密的家庭。

envy.en: Their economy is the envy of the developing world.
envy.zh: 他们的经济令发展中国家羡慕。
我庆幸不必干她的那份工作。

doubt.en: There was little doubt in my mind.
There is good reason to doubt this.
doubt.zh: 有正当理由怀疑这件事。

doubt.en: I doubt the feasibility of the plan.
doubt.zh: 我怀疑这个计划的可行性。

suspicion.zh: 她以怀疑的目光看待他。

suspicion.en: He was arrested on suspicion of murder.

unsatisfactory.en: The film's ending is an unsatisfactory cop-out.
unsatisfactory.zh: 那部电影的结尾是个不令人满意的回避。

unsatisfactory.en: There are also, of course, people who interview extremely well, but are later found to be very unsatisfactory employees.
unsatisfactory.zh: 当然，也有面试表现非常好的人，但后来发现是非常不令人满意的员工。

unsatisfactory.en: The present system of funding for higher education is unsatisfactory.
unsatisfactory.zh: 目前高等教育的经费体制并不令人满意。

skeptical.en: If you're still skeptical about exercising, we can only ask you to trust us and give it a try.
skeptical.zh: 如果你仍对锻炼持怀疑态度，我们只能请你相信我们，试一试。

skeptical.en: Andrew Hacker, for the record, remains skeptical.
skeptical.zh: 准确来说，安德鲁·哈克仍然对此表示怀疑。

skeptical.en: What is skeptical observers' opinion on ancestry testing?
skeptical.zh: 持怀疑态度的观察者们对血统检测的看法是什么？

unstable.en: The situation is unstable and potentially dangerous.
unstable.zh: 情况不稳定，可能有危险。
氮是一种不稳定的元素。

unstable.en: So evanescent and unstable are men's works in this world!
unstable.zh: 在这个世界上，人的工作是这样的短暂和不稳定！

unsuitable.en: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition.
unsuitable.zh: 这种骑乘不适合紧张型性格的人。

unsuitable.en: Amy's shoes were unsuitable for walking any distance.
unsuitable.zh: 埃米的鞋根本不适合走路。

unsuitable.en: He was wearing shoes that were totally unsuitable for climbing.
unsuitable.zh: 他穿了一双完全不适合登山的鞋子。

unwilling.en: She is tough, unwilling to take no for an answer.
unwilling.zh: 她很难对付，不答应不肯罢休。

unwilling.en: The directors were unwilling to respond to questions.
unwilling.zh: 董事们不愿意回答问题。

unwilling.en: Judges were unwilling to nullify government decisions.
unwilling.zh: 法官们不愿废止政府决定。

reluctant.en: Mr. Spero was reluctant to ask for help.
reluctant.zh: 斯珀洛先生不愿意请求帮助。

reluctant.en: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
reluctant.zh: 我们不情愿的开始长途跋涉回家。

confuse.en: I always confuse my left with my right.

confuse.zh: 不要把自由与放纵混为一谈。

confuse.en: People often confuse me and my twin sister.
confuse.zh: 人们常常把我和我的孪生妹妹搞错。

hesitate.en: He's the kind of filmmaker who doesn't hesitate to over-sentimentalize.
hesitate.zh: 他是那种煽起情来从不迟疑的电影制作人。

hesitate.en: This could make your superiors hesitate to trust you with major responsibilities.
hesitate.zh: 这可能会使你的上司犹豫着不愿把重大职责托付给你。
我对这项工作有所犹豫。

embarrass.en: I didn't want to embarrass him by kissing him in front of his friends.
embarrass.zh: 我并没想当着他的朋友吻他而使他感到难堪。

embarrass.en: When you embarrass me, I'll tell you.
embarrass.zh: 你要是使我感到难堪，我就会跟你说的。

embarrass.en: They were my friends, and I just didn't want to embarrass them publicly.
embarrass.zh: 他们是我的朋友，我只是不想公开说让他们难堪的话。

repent.en: I was shown that I am a sinner, that I needed to repent of my sins.
repent.zh: 我被证明是个罪人，需要为我的罪孽忏悔。
我就不能忏悔我的罪过了！

regret.en: I regret some of my posts about President @realDonaldTrump last week. They went too far.
regret.zh: 我对上周发布的一些关于总统@realDonaldTrump的帖子感到后悔。它们太过分了。
我非常后悔说了那些话。

regret.en: I came to regret my unconsidered remarks.
regret.zh: 我对我那些考虑不周的言辞开始感到后悔。

sigh.en: We all heaved a sigh of relief.
sigh.zh: 我们都如释重负地舒了一口气。

sigh.en: Mr. Collier heaved a sigh and got to his feet.
sigh.zh: 科利尔先生深深叹了一口气，然后站起身。

ashamed.en: Peter ought to be ashamed of himself.
ashamed.zh: 彼得应为自己感到羞耻。

ashamed.en: I felt incredibly ashamed of myself for getting so angry.
ashamed.zh: 我为自己发了这么大的脾气而感到极为惭愧。

ashamed.en: I'm ashamed to say that I lied to her.
ashamed.zh: 我真不好意思说我向她撒了谎。

weep.zh: 她不由自主地哭了起来。

weep.en: She wanted to laugh and weep all at once.

tolerance.en: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
They were working to a tolerance of 0.0001 of a centimetre.
tolerance.zh: 他们在按0.0001厘米的公差加工。

tolerance.en: They have a policy of zero tolerance for sexual harassment.
tolerance.zh: 他们对性骚扰采取零容忍态度。

ignorant.zh: 他对现代科技一无所知。
千万别让你的学生感到自己一无所知。

endure.en: She could not endure the thought of parting.
endure.zh: 一想到分别她就无法忍受。

endure.en: He had to endure six months' loss of liberty.
endure.zh: 他得忍受六个月失去自由之苦。

sly.en: He has to visit them on the sly.
sly.zh: 他只得偷偷地去看望他们。
他显得偷偷摸摸，鬼鬼祟祟。

sly.en: She darted a sly sideways glance at Bramwell.
sly.zh: 她狡猾地斜瞟了布莱威尔一眼。

arbitrary.zh: 他做的决定难以预料，主观武断。

arbitrary.en: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
arbitrary.zh: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

arbitrary.en: Finally, the security was fired for his arbitrary judgment.
arbitrary.zh: 最后，保安因为他的武断判断被解雇了。

cunning.en: He was as cunning as a fox.

ridiculous.zh: 我戴这顶帽子看上去很可笑。

ridiculous.en: It did nothing but make us ridiculous.
ridiculous.zh: 它只是让我们显得可笑。
“别荒唐了！”帕特生气地回答道。

stupid.en: That made me feel kind of stupid.
stupid.zh: 那使我感到有点儿愚蠢。

clumsy.en: He tried to dance, but he was too clumsy and awkward.
clumsy.zh: 他试着跳舞，但是太笨拙，太别扭。
它喘着气嘟囔着：“笨手笨脚的。”
大家对他的拙劣发言均很反感。

awkward.en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.
awkward.zh: 艾米用双手做了一个笨拙的手势。

careless.zh: 她曾粗心大意得不可原谅。

careless.en: It's your own fault for being careless.
careless.zh: 你粗心大意是你自己的过失。

careless.en: It was careless of me to leave the door open.

naughty.en: It is unfair to label a small baby as naughty.
naughty.zh: 硬说一个小小的婴儿淘气是不公平的。

naughty.en: Whenever Daniel's little sister was asked to do something she always had a naughty reply.
naughty.zh: 每次让丹尼尔的小妹妹做点事情，她总是有调皮的回应。

oblivious.en: You eventually become oblivious to the noise.
oblivious.zh: 你终究会变得不在意吵闹声的。

oblivious.en: He drove off, oblivious of the damage he had caused.
oblivious.zh: 他车开走了，没有注意到他所造成的损害。

oblivious.en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
oblivious.zh: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

greedy.en: He attacked greedy bosses for awarding themselves big raises.
greedy.zh: 他攻击那些给自己大幅涨工资的贪婪的老板们。

greedy.en: Genesis recorded a song which took a swipe at greedy property developers who bought up and demolished people's homes.
greedy.zh: 吉尼西丝录制了一首歌曲，对买下并拆毁他人家园的贪婪房地产开发商进行抨击。

greedy.en: Mary became an honest girl and was never greedy again.
greedy.zh: 玛丽成了一个诚实的女孩，再也不贪心了。

slothful.en: He was not slothful: he had been busy all night.
slothful.zh: 他可没偷懒：他忙了整整一夜。

slothful.en: They considered being lazy or slothful one of the seven deadly SINS.
slothful.zh: 他们将懒惰归为七宗原罪之一。

slothful.en: For us, the slothful spell was broken on our second afternoon by a shrill whistle.
slothful.zh: 对我们来说，懒散的日子在第二天下午被一阵尖利的口哨声打断了。

obtrusive.en: The sofa would be less obtrusive in a paler colour.
obtrusive.zh: 沙发的颜色再浅一点就不那么扎眼了。

obtrusive.en: They tried to ensure that their presence was not too obtrusive.
obtrusive.zh: 他们尽量做到在场时不引人注目。

obtrusive.en: These heaters are less obtrusive and are easy to store away in the summer.
obtrusive.zh: 这些取暖器不那么难看，在夏天也容易收藏。

sluggish.en: He felt very heavy and sluggish after the meal.
sluggish.zh: 饭后他感觉身子很沉，不想动。

sluggish.en: Circulation is much more sluggish in the feet than in the hands.
sluggish.zh: 血液循环在脚部要比在手部慢得多。

sluggish.en: Don't be so sluggish. Put yourself together.
sluggish.zh: 不要这样懒散，振作起来。

impulse.en: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again.
impulse.zh: 他抑制不住冲动，又看了一眼大海。
他往往凭一时冲动行事。

rigid.en: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.
rigid.zh: 课程设置过于狭窄和死板。

rigid.en: He was weaned on a diet of rigid discipline and duty.
rigid.zh: 他自幼受到严格纪律和职责的约束。

rigid.en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
rigid.zh: 他通过严格控制公共开支来平衡预算。

stubborn.en: Mick was stubborn and domineering with a very bad temper.
stubborn.zh: 麦克既固执又刚愎自用，脾气还很坏。

stubborn.en: The more Sarah nagged her, the more stubborn Cissie became.
stubborn.zh: 萨拉越是对她唠叨不休，茜茜就越是固执。

stubborn.en: She's proud and stubborn, you know, under that pliant exterior.
stubborn.zh: 她既傲气又固执，你知道的，在那温顺的外表下。

stereotype.en: There's always been a stereotype about successful businessmen.
stereotype.zh: 对成功的商人们总有一种成见。

stereotype.en: That this is a positive stereotype makes it no less a stereotype, and therefore unacceptable.
stereotype.zh: 这种成见即使是积极的也依然是成见，因而是不可取的。
这是一个荒谬的刻板印象。

daily.zh: 他们召开了每日例行的新闻发布会。

daily.en: The plants want to be watered daily.
daily.zh: 这些花草需要天天浇水。

quarterly.zh: 他们的季度会议是平淡乏味的事情。

quarterly.en: A full listing of the companies will be published quarterly.
quarterly.zh: 公司名录大全每季度出版一次。

quarterly.en: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
quarterly.zh: 客户们通常提前付费，或按月，或按季度，或按年。

monthly.zh: 我们出版一份通讯月刊。

monthly.en: The agency will pay you a monthly retainer.
monthly.zh: 这个机构将会每月付给你聘用金。

monthly.en: We went to renew our monthly season ticket.

annual.en: How much annual leave do you get?

yearly.en: The two sisters looked forward to their yearly meetings.
yearly.zh: 姐妹俩期盼着她们一年一度的会面。

yearly.en: In Holland, the government sets a yearly budget for health care.
yearly.zh: 在荷兰，政府设有一个保健年度预算。

yearly.en: Pay is reviewed on a yearly basis.

anniversary.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。
今天是我们的周年纪念日。

anniversary.en: We celebrated our 25th wedding anniversary in Florence.
anniversary.zh: 我们在佛罗伦萨庆祝结婚25周年。

era.en: It was, if you like, the dawn of a new era.
era.zh: 换句话说，那就是新时代的黎明。

era.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
era.zh: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

present.en: Did you get your mother a present?

present.zh: 她的信把过去与现在结合在一起。

present.en: How do you read the present situation?
present.zh: 你对目前的形势有何看法？

contemporary.en: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer.
contemporary.zh: 当代非洲电影制作艺术有很多贡献。

contemporary.en: We weren't out to design a contemporary utopia.
contemporary.zh: 我们不想去设计一个当代乌托邦。
她赞助许多英国当代艺术家。

medieval.en: It is a perfect example of a medieval castle.
medieval.zh: 这是最典型的中世纪城堡。

medieval.en: He began studying politics and medieval history.
medieval.zh: 他开始学习政治学和中世纪史。

medieval.en: He was able to pinpoint on the map the site of the medieval village.
medieval.zh: 他能在地图上准确找出那个中世纪村庄的位置。

century.en: The brooch dates back to the fourth century BC.
century.zh: 胸针可追溯至公元前4世纪。

century.en: The family made their money in the 18th century.
century.zh: 这个家族在18世纪创下了家业。

millennium.zh: 你们是如何欢庆千禧年的？

millennium.en: Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment.
millennium.zh: 根据千禧生态系统评估报告，可持续地管理生态系统比掠夺消耗它更有好处。

millennium.en: Kofi Annan's staff devised the millennium development goals.
millennium.zh: 科菲安南的工作人员策划了千年发展目标。

million.zh: 全国的空缺职位数达到数百万。
他们净付给他约两百万美元。
他是个出类拔萃的人物。

billion.zh: 银河系由1千亿颗恒星组成。
销售额从27亿元猛增到35亿元。

dozen.en: Packages arrived by the dozen from America.
dozen.zh: 成打的包裹从美国寄来。

dozen.en: A few dozen employees picketed the company's headquarters.
dozen.zh: 几十名雇员聚集在公司总部的外面示威抗议。

midday.en: At midday everyone would go down to Reg's Café.
midday.zh: 中午每个人都去雷吉的小餐馆。

midday.en: Motorists were forced to turn on their headlights at midday.
midday.zh: 驾车者被强制要求在正午打开前灯。

midnight.zh: 这事不会延续到午夜以后。

overnight.zh: 几乎在一夜之间我被治愈了。

modern.zh: 大多数的现代艺术引不起我的兴趣。

recent.en: He seems unabashed by his recent defeat.
recent.zh: 他似乎不为近期的失败感到羞耻。
这些灌木丛是最近栽植的。

recent.en: A recent book has demolished this theory.
recent.zh: 最近出版的一本书推翻了这种理论。

secondly.en: Firstly, it's expensive, and secondly, it's too slow.
secondly.zh: 首先是价格贵，其次，速度太慢。

secondly.en: It makes you look firstly at how you're treated and secondly how you treat everybody else.
secondly.zh: 它让你首先看别人怎样对待你，其次看你怎样对待别人。

secondly.en: First of all, there are not many of them, and secondly, they have little money and, thirdly, they're hungry.
secondly.zh: 首先，他们人数不多；第二，他们没什么钱；第三，他们在挨饿。

finally.zh: 最后她不知不觉地睡着了。

first.zh: 我们要生第一个孩子了。

finish.zh: 我们预计十点钟以前结束。
我还以为你会完成不了呢！

instant.en: For an instant I was infected by her fear.
instant.zh: 一瞬间，我被她的恐惧所感染。

instant.en: For an instant, Barney was tempted to flee.
instant.zh: 那一瞬间，巴尼很想逃走。

instant.en: The engine delivers instant acceleration whatever the revs.
instant.zh: 不论转速如何，发动机都可以立即加速。

moment.zh: 我要细心品味，一刻也不错过。
可怕的时刻终于来到了。

minute.zh: 过了不到一分钟他们就到了。

minute.en: Could I see you for a minute?

prior.en: The firm I wanted to use had prior commitments.
prior.zh: 我选择的那家公司有优先承诺。

prior.en: He claimed he had no prior knowledge of the protest.
prior.zh: 他声称他事先对那次抗议一无所知。

former.en: The former option would be much more sensible.
former.zh: 前一种选择要明智得多。

former.en: Her article showed no charity towards her former friends.
former.zh: 她的文章对她以前的朋友毫不宽容。

former.en: One former director embezzled $34 million in company funds.
former.zh: 一位前任主管挪用了3400万美元的公司资金。

preceding.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
preceding.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

preceding.en: She informed us that eighteen members of the staff had left during the preceding year.
preceding.zh: 她当时告知我们，18位教职员在此前的一年里离开了。

preceding.en: We shall be known better than any preceding generations.
preceding.zh: 我们将比前几代人更出名。

foremost.en: It is first and foremost a trade agreement.
foremost.zh: 它首先是一项贸易协定。

foremost.en: This question has been foremost in our minds recently.
foremost.zh: 近来我们的心目中一直认为这个问题最重要。

foremost.en: He does a little teaching, but first and foremost he's a writer.
foremost.zh: 他干一点教学，但首要的是写作。

precedent.en: They were determined to break from precedent.
The ruling set a precedent for future libel cases.
precedent.zh: 这项裁决为今后的诽谤案提供了判例。

precedent.en: The trial could set an important precedent for dealing with similar cases.
precedent.zh: 这次审判能为处理类似案件开创一个重要先例。

initially.en: The chick initially has no fear of man.
I initially dismissed the idea out of hand.
initially.zh: 我起初不假思索地一口否决了这个主意。

initially.en: Initially the system was offline for a number of days.
initially.zh: 最初系统有几天没有联网。

midst.en: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
midst.zh: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

midst.en: Many were surprised to see him exposed like this in the midst of a large crowd.
midst.zh: 很多人看到他这样暴露在一大群人当中，都感到很意外。

midst.en: Eleanor arrived in the midst of a blizzard.
midst.zh: 埃莉诺到达时正下着暴风雪。

intermediate.en: Students are categorized as novice, intermediate, or advanced.
intermediate.zh: 学生分为新生、中级生或高级生。

intermediate.en: Honestly, the harder classes that I'm in are intermediate microeconomics.
intermediate.zh: 老实说，我现在上的更难的课程是中级微观经济学。

intermediate.en: They have to assess your level and steer you to the right class, beginner, intermediate.
intermediate.zh: 他们必须评估你的水平然后把你分到正确的班级，如初级班，中级班。

opening.zh: 他搞砸了自己的开幕讲话。

opening.en: She began opening a can of tuna.
opening.zh: 她开始打开一罐金枪鱼。

meantime.en: I'll contact them soon. Meantime don't tell them I'm back.
meantime.zh: 我会尽快和他们联系。在此期间，不要告诉他们我回来了。

meantime.en: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue.
meantime.zh: 同时心理战似乎很有可能要继续下去。

meantime.en: My first novel was rejected by six publishers. In the meantime I had written a play.
meantime.zh: 我的第一部小说遭到六家出版商的拒绝。其间我又完成了一部戏剧。

simultaneous.en: Some hypotheses fail to account for simultaneous extinctions on land and in the seas.
simultaneous.zh: 有些假说不能解释同时发生在陆地和海洋的灭绝。

simultaneous.en: A lack of flow is characterized by, interruptions, simultaneous speech or mutual silences.
simultaneous.zh: 缺乏心流的特征是打断、同时讲话或相互沉默。

simultaneous.en: With simultaneous interpreting, you start translating almost as soon as the other person starts speaking.
simultaneous.zh: 在做同声传译时，你几乎是在对方开始说话时就开始翻译。

meanwhile.zh: 同时，我的债务在不断增加。

meanwhile.en: Political stability, meanwhile, will be a prime concern.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，政治稳定将是头等大事。

meanwhile.en: You, meanwhile, will be skulking in the safety of the car.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，你会安全地藏在汽车里。

everlasting.en: That is how I found myself on the road with four kids, a baby lamb and nothing but my everlasting optimism to see me through.
everlasting.zh: 就这样，我上路了。带着四个孩子和一只小羊羔，以及支撑我走下去的永恒不变的乐观主义精神。

everlasting.en: To his everlasting credit , he never told anyone what I'd done.
everlasting.zh: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。

everlasting.en: The program, Everlasting Classics, encourages us to read more classics.
everlasting.zh: 节目《经典咏流传》鼓励我们阅读更多的经典作品。

ongoing.en: When Pemberton created his drink, it represented an ongoing trend.
ongoing.zh: 当彭伯顿发明他的饮料时，它代表了一种持续的趋势。

ongoing.en: They were also more likely to have an ongoing medical condition and be overweight.
ongoing.zh: 他们也更有可能出现持续的病症和超重问题。
警方的调查在持续进行中。

punctual.en: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
punctual.zh: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。

punctual.en: A man who gets up at seven o'clock every morning is punctual.
punctual.zh: 每天早上七点起床的人是守时的。

permanent.en: The accident has not done any permanent damage.
permanent.zh: 那场事故没有造成什么永久性损伤。

permanent.en: She has been granted permanent residency in Britain.
permanent.zh: 她获准在英国永久居住。

permanent.en: Heavy drinking can cause permanent damage to the brain.
permanent.zh: 饮酒过量可能造成永久性脑损伤。

duration.en: The duration of previous geologic periods was difficult to determine.
duration.zh: 以前很难确定地质期的持续时间。

duration.en: They were incarcerated for the duration of the war.
duration.zh: 他们在战争期间被监禁。

duration.en: The school was used as a hospital for the duration of the war.
duration.zh: 战争期间这所学校被用作医院。

consecutive.en: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
consecutive.zh: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

consecutive.en: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.
consecutive.zh: 制造业经济到10月份已连续萎缩6个月了。

consecutive.en: In Ontario, August was the first month with below-normal temperatures after eight consecutive months above normal.
consecutive.zh: 在安大略省，8月份是连续8个月高于正常温度之后的第一个低于正常温度的月份。

periodically.en: Meetings are held periodically to monitor progress on the case.
periodically.zh: 定期召开会议监控案件的进展情况。
海星的数量会周期性地激增。

imminent.en: Every one feels that a disaster is imminent, as if a catastrophe is about to come.
imminent.zh: 谁都感到大事不好，似乎有什么极大的灾难即将来临。

imminent.en: There's been a warning about the imminent death of literate civilization for a long time.
imminent.zh: 很长一段时间以来，一直有关于文化文明即将死亡的警告。

incidentally.en: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
incidentally.zh: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？
这个信息只是偶然得到的。

incidentally.en: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
incidentally.zh: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”
